Increases time required for Survivors to seal Portals by 8%Increases the distance from Portals at which Survivors can be detected by Of The Abyss by 1 meter.

beginner.whatItIs: Thorny Vines slots into Of the Abyss. It slows the seal progress survivors make on Portals and also nudges the detection range of the power outward slightly.
beginner.whyItMatters: Keeping a Portal open longer while also spotting survivors from a wider ring makes the area around the gateway feel more controlled. Both effects reinforce the same idea that the killer owns the space around the portal.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in a trial where survivors repeatedly try to seal Portals to cut off The Demogorgon's mobility. It is rare, so it will not show up in every cache.

Addon_Demogorgon_UnknownEgg.name: Unknown Egg
Addon_Demogorgon_UnknownEgg.description:
A large, warm egg coated in gruesome webbing.

Decreases the cooldown after traversing the Upside Down by 2.5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Unknown Egg slots into Of the Abyss. It shortens the cooldown after The Demogorgon finishes a traversal, letting it hop between Portals more frequently.
beginner.whyItMatters: A shorter wait between traversals means more flexibility in repositioning, chasing, and retreating. That matters most in longer trials where map control shifts back and forth between the two sides.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the game plan leans on repeated portal hops to pressure different parts of the map. It is very rare, so treat it as a bonus find rather than something to plan a whole build around.

Addon_Demogorgon_UpsideDownResin.name: Upside Down Resin
Addon_Demogorgon_UpsideDownResin.description: A sticky, flammable sap that fortifies the gateway to the interdimensional tunnels.Increases time required for Survivors to seal Portals by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: Upside Down Resin slots into Of the Abyss. It makes Portals significantly harder for survivors to seal, stretching the seal time well beyond the base value.
beginner.whyItMatters: Portals that stay open longer give The Demogorgon more traversal options and deny survivors the comfort of knowing a gateway is about to be shut down. The entire match tempo around portals shifts in the killer's favor.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in trials where The Demogorgon's strategy revolves around staying mobile between two Portals. Its very rare status means it is a treat rather than a staple in the cache.

Addon_Demogorgon_VermillionWebcap.name: Vermillion Webcap
Addon_Demogorgon_VermillionWebcap.description:
A bright red poisonous mushroom from the Upside Down.

Increases the duration of the Undetectable effect gained when emerging from a Portal by 3 seconds.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius and Red Stain.

beginner.whatItIs: Vermillion Webcap slots into Of the Abyss. It stretches the Undetectable window gained after emerging from a Portal, buying The Demogorgon more time to slip into a new position unseen.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer stealth tail after each portal exit makes it easier to drift behind a generator, loop around a pallet, or reposition near a totem without a survivor clocking the emergence. The killer gets a meaningful beat to set up the next move.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the trial rewards quiet repositioning and The Demogorgon wants to vanish for a moment after each hop. It is very rare, so it will not be in every cache.

Addon_Demogorgon_VioletWaxCap.name: Violet Waxcap
Addon_Demogorgon_VioletWaxCap.description:
A dark fleshed mushroom from the Upside Down that allows The Demogorgon to telepathically distort the senses in its prey.

Increases the duration of the Undetectable effect gained when emerging from a Portal by 1 second.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius and Red Stain.

beginner.whatItIs: Violet Waxcap attaches to Of the Abyss and stretches the Undetectable window that opens after The Demogorgon steps out of a Portal. The extra concealment time means the killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain stay hidden for a longer beat before survivors can spot and react. It is a small extension but it buys a precious moment to reposition or slip away.
beginner.whyItMatters: Even a short stealth bonus can be the difference between a survivor noticing a reposition and not. It matters most in dense map areas with many lines of sight where a single moment of visibility can ruin a setup.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when The Demogorgon wants a subtle stealth edge after portal hops and the match already leans toward a cat-and-mouse pace. It is rare, so it may take a few trials to pull from the cache.

Addon_Demogorgon_ViscousWebbing.name: Viscous Webbing
Addon_Demogorgon_ViscousWebbing.description: Wet, elastic webs that broaden the interdimensional tunnels.Increases time required for Survivors to seal Portals by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Viscous Webbing modifies Of the Abyss for The Demogorgon, making the channeling bar on every Portal drain more slowly. The elastic webs clog the interdimensional tunnel, so survivors need extra time to complete a seal. It is a modest change, but it shows up on every single Portal interaction in a trial.
beginner.whyItMatters: A portal that lingers open gives The Demogorgon an extra traversal option while denying survivors the satisfaction of shutting that route down. It is a modest but reliable extension of portal control.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in trials where survivors keep trying to cap off Portals and The Demogorgon needs those gates to stay available. Its uncommon rarity keeps it reasonably available without being guaranteed in every cache.

Addon_DreamInducer_BlackBox.name: Black Box
Addon_DreamInducer_BlackBox.description:
A black cardboard box filled with photographs.

When an Exit Gate is opened, it is blocked for Sleeping Survivors for 15 seconds.This lingers for 3 seconds after they are woken up by any means.

beginner.whatItIs: Black Box slots into Dream Demon. It locks the Exit Gate against sleeping survivors the moment the gate is opened, and that lock persists for a short time even after a survivor is woken up by any means.
beginner.whyItMatters: A sleeping survivor who reaches the gate and finds it sealed has lost the fastest escape route. They are forced to either wait out the block or try another route entirely, both of which cost them time.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when multiple survivors are asleep and the killer is positioning near the exit gates. As an iridescent drop it is a rare find, worth saving for a trial where the gate becomes the endgame.

Addon_DreamInducer_BlueDress.name: Blue Dress
Addon_DreamInducer_BlueDress.description:
A little girl's pale blue dress with white lace which front is ruined by large cuts.

Dream Snare no longer moves.Dream Snare remains active for 8 seconds.Only 1 Dream Snare can be placed at a time.

beginner.whatItIs: Blue Dress slots into Dream Demon. It reshapes Dream Snare into a static zone that stays in one spot and lingers for a longer duration, though only one can be active at a time.
beginner.whyItMatters: A fixed snare that outlasts the normal version turns a specific pallet or loop into a persistent trap. The trade-off is losing the ability to move the snare around, which suits a more positional playstyle.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer wants to park a snare on a known survivor loop and let it do the work over several passes. Its rare rarity means it will not appear in every trial.

Addon_DreamInducer_CatBlock.name: Cat Block
Addon_DreamInducer_CatBlock.description:
A white and purple wooden block depicting a sleeping cat and the letter "C".

Decreases Dream Projection's cooldown by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Cat Block slots into Dream Demon. It shaves a portion off the Dream Projection cooldown, making the ability ready again sooner after each use.
beginner.whyItMatters: More frequent access to Dream Projection means the killer can drop survivors into the Dream World more often. That chains into more Sleep builds and more control over the match tempo.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in a trial where the killer wants to string together multiple Dream Projections in quick succession to lock down a group of survivors. Its uncommon rarity keeps it available enough to build around.

Addon_DreamInducer_ClassPhoto.name: Class Photo
Addon_DreamInducer_ClassPhoto.description:
A large photograph taken at Badham preschool showing the cheerful class of 94-95.

Survivors in the Dream World are revealed with Killer Instinct while opening Exit Gates.Grants the ability to teleport to Exit Gates.

beginner.whatItIs: Class Photo slots into Dream Demon. It grants the killer the ability to teleport directly to an Exit Gate and reveals any survivor in the Dream World with Killer Instinct while they are opening a gate.
beginner.whyItMatters: Teleporting to the gate removes the travel time between where the killer is and where survivors are trying to escape. The Instinct reveal also makes it nearly impossible for a Dream World survivor to open a gate unseen.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the trial is late and survivors are rushing the exit gates. As a very rare drop it is a special find that rewards the endgame phase specifically.

Addon_DreamInducer_GardenRake.name: Garden Rake
Addon_DreamInducer_GardenRake.description:
A small claw rake, a must-have tool for any accomplished gardener.

Increases the size of the Dream Snare by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Garden Rake slots into Dream Demon. It widens the Dream Snare hitbox, making the snare zone physically larger on the ground.
beginner.whyItMatters: A bigger snare is easier to land on a running survivor and harder to sidestep. It reduces the number of whiffed attempts and makes the snare feel more reliable during a chase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer has been missing Dream Snare placements and needs more forgiveness on aim. It is common, so it shows up in the cache regularly.

Addon_DreamInducer_GreenDress.name: Green Dress
Addon_DreamInducer_GreenDress.description:
A little girl's green dress with a silky white ribbon.

Increases the time it takes for Survivors to perform the Wake Up action by 2 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Green Dress slots into Dream Demon. It slows the Wake Up action for sleeping survivors, adding extra time before they can shake off the sleep and run.
beginner.whyItMatters: That extra delay gives the killer more room to reposition, set up another Dream Snare, or watch a survivor struggle to wake up before making the next move. Sleeping survivors become a bigger liability for their own team.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when several survivors are already asleep and the killer wants maximum downtime from each one. Its uncommon rarity means it will appear in the cache with reasonable frequency.

Addon_DreamInducer_JumpRope.name: Jump Rope
Addon_DreamInducer_JumpRope.description:
A long double dutch jump rope, stained with many years of use.

Increases duration of Hindered when a Survivor is hit with a Dream Snare by 11%.

Hindered reduces Survivor movement speed.

beginner.whatItIs: Jump Rope slots into Dream Demon. It lengthens the Hindered effect applied when a survivor is caught by a Dream Snare, keeping them slowed for a longer stretch.
beginner.whyItMatters: A survivor who is slowed for longer after a snare hit is easier to track down and land a follow-up attack on. A single snare hit becomes a real chance to build combo damage instead of a brief speed penalty.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it whenever a Dream Snare connects and you want the slowness to linger long enough to set up the next attack. It suits a playstyle built around chasing down survivors who keep moving and breaking free. The drop is rare, so expect to queue several trials before one lands in the cache.

Addon_DreamInducer_KidsDrawing.name: Kid's Drawing
Addon_DreamInducer_KidsDrawing.description: An unattributed drawing clearly crafted by a young child.Increases the amount of Sleep gained from attacking with Dream Abilities by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Kid's Drawing slots into Dream Demon. It increases the amount of Sleep generated when the killer attacks with Dream Abilities, building the Sleep meter faster per hit.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster Sleep accumulation shortens the gap between attacks and the moment a survivor is pulled into the Dream World. The Dream Demon gains more chances to set snares and control chases instead of relying on raw hits to build pressure. It is a small but consistent change that makes the whole power loop feel more responsive.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the Dream Demon wants to lean on sleep buildup and snares rather than landing clean physical hits. It slots neatly into a control-focused game plan where keeping survivors drowsy is the whole point. Since the drop is common, expect to see one at the add-on bench fairly quickly.

Addon_DreamInducer_NancysMasterpiece.name: Nancy's Masterpiece
Addon_DreamInducer_NancysMasterpiece.description:
A painting of a character, made by Nancy Holbrook at Badham and kept as a treasured memory.

Decreases Dream Projection's total cooldown by 10% after hitting a Survivor with a Dream Snare or Dream Pallet.

beginner.whatItIs: A treasured painting by Nancy Holbrook that slots into Dream Demon, cutting the total cooldown on Dream Projection each time a Dream Snare or Dream Pallet lands on a survivor. The shorter wait means the killer can follow up with a projection much sooner after a hit.
beginner.whyItMatters: The cooldown shrinks after every successful snare or pallet connection, so the killer strings together projections with noticeably less dead time between them. It leans toward a bigger shift in pacing rather than a minor tweak, because the projection becomes available again much sooner in a sustained chase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in a pressure-focused build where the killer wants to keep survivors in the Dream World on a tighter rhythm. Its rarity is rare, so it will not always be available in a given trial.

Addon_DreamInducer_NancysSketch.name: Nancy's Sketch
Addon_DreamInducer_NancysSketch.description:
A crude and bold sketch made with fusain, signed Nancy H.

Decreases Sleep immunity after a Survivor uses an alarm clock by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: A crude fusain sketch signed Nancy H. that slots into Dream Demon and reduces the Sleep immunity a survivor gains when they use an alarm clock. The drop in protection makes each alarm-clock escape shorter than it would be without the add-on.
beginner.whyItMatters: The immunity reduction is modest on its own, so it reads as a small adjustment to the alarm clock rather than a full playstyle change. Across multiple uses in a single trial though, the cumulative loss of protection becomes a meaningful chunk of the survivor's escape window.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when facing survivors who lean heavily on alarm clocks to escape the Dream World, since the reduced immunity makes their wake-ups feel less secure. It is uncommon rarity, so it should show up with reasonable frequency.

Addon_DreamInducer_PaintThinner.name: Paint Thinner
Addon_DreamInducer_PaintThinner.description:
A tin of a highly volatile and inflammable material.

When a Survivor drops a Dream Pallet, they are revealed with Killer Instinct for 6 seconds.Unlocks the ability to use Dream Projection on that Survivor while they are revealed.Increases this Dream Projection's charge speed by 100%.

beginner.whatItIs: A tin of volatile material that slots into Dream Demon and reveals a survivor with Killer Instinct the moment they drop a Dream Pallet. It also unlocks a targeted Dream Projection on that survivor while they are revealed, and that projection charges at a greatly accelerated rate.
beginner.whyItMatters: It changes how the power interacts with pallet discards, turning the act of dropping a Dream Pallet into a moment of vulnerability rather than a safe escape. The killer gains a free, fast-charging projection aimed at that specific survivor, which is a substantial shift compared to the normal cooldown-based flow.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer wants to punish survivors who try to shed Dream Pallets during a chase, because the reveal plus the faster projection creates a tight follow-up window. It is rare rarity, so it may not appear in every trial.

Addon_DreamInducer_PillBottle.name: Pill Bottle
Addon_DreamInducer_PillBottle.description:
An empty pill bottle which once contained a medicine called Zoneral.

Each time a Survivor wakes up, their Sleep Meter fills 10% faster, up to a maximum of 50%.

beginner.whatItIs: An empty bottle that once held a medicine called Zoneral, slotting into Dream Demon to make each survivor wake-up fill their Sleep Meter faster. The speed increase stacks with every subsequent awakening until it reaches a cap.
beginner.whyItMatters: Early in a trial the effect barely registers, but after a survivor has woken up several times the Sleep Meter fills at a much more aggressive pace. That compounding pressure turns late-trial escapes into shorter and shorter windows.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it for longer trials where survivors are likely to use multiple alarm clocks, since the cumulative stacking punishes repeated wake-ups more than a single one. It is very rare, so it may take a while to pull.

Addon_DreamInducer_PrototypeClaws.name: Prototype Claws
Addon_DreamInducer_PrototypeClaws.description:
A homemade tool to facilitate bush trimming.

Decreases the charge time to release a Dream Snare by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Prototype Claws trims a slice of charge time off the Dream Snare release cycle in Dream Demon. The speedup is small but steady, tightening the rhythm between consecutive snare placements.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a modest tweak that trims the wait between snare releases just enough to make the killer feel slightly more responsive in a chase. The overall rhythm of the power stays the same, so it suits a build that values a small edge without a structural change.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer is comfortable with Dream Snare timing and wants a small quality-of-life edge in close-quarters chases. It is uncommon rarity, so it should be easy to find in a standard pool.

Addon_DreamInducer_RedPaintBrush.name: Red Paint Brush
Addon_DreamInducer_RedPaintBrush.description:
A large paint brush, wet with crimson paint.

Reveals the aura of Survivors in the Dream World when they are further than 32 meters away.Increases each Survivor's Sleep Meter by 50%.

beginner.whatItIs: Extends Dream Demon's awareness by surfacing survivor auras inside the Dream World from well outside normal range, while also inflating every survivor's Sleep Meter. Together the two effects let the killer track hidden survivors and close the gap before they can wake.
beginner.whyItMatters: It shifts how the power plays more than a minor tweak would, because long-range aura visibility inside the Dream World changes targeting decisions entirely. Combined with the higher Sleep Meter on every survivor, the killer holds both information and pressure at the same time.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the killer wants to see where survivors are from a distance inside the Dream World and close in before they react. It is iridescent rarity, so it is a slow pull to find in the pool.

Addon_DreamInducer_Rope.name: Outdoor Rope
Addon_DreamInducer_Rope.description:
Sturdy outdoor rope, handy to tie up anything.

While Survivors are in the Dream World:

Increases the speed at which the Dream Snare travels by 15%.

beginner.whatItIs: Sturdy outdoor rope that slots into Dream Demon and increases the speed at which a Dream Snare travels while survivors are inside the Dream World. The faster snare closes the gap on a survivor who is edging away from its arc.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a modest nudge that helps land snare hits in a close chase where the survivor is just barely out of range. The faster travel time removes a small but frustrating gap between the snare and its target.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in chase-heavy situations where a survivor is keeping just enough distance to dodge a slower snare, since the extra speed shaves off that margin. It is uncommon rarity, so it will show up in a typical pool without much waiting.

Addon_DreamInducer_SheepBlock.name: Sheep Block
Addon_DreamInducer_SheepBlock.description: A white and blue wooden block depicting two wooly lamb grazing and the letter "S".Increases the Alarm Clocks' cooldown by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Stretches the Alarm Clocks' cooldown when slotted into Dream Demon, forcing survivors to wait longer between escape attempts. The extra downtime punishes each break from the Dream World with a longer recovery period.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a small adjustment that gives the killer a wider window to re-engage before the survivor can wake again. The extended cooldown turns each alarm-clock use into a slightly bigger commitment on the survivor's part.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the survivor lineup leans on alarm clocks as their main escape tool, because the stretched cooldown turns each use into a longer vulnerability window. Its common rarity keeps it available frequently enough to be a reliable find in most matches.

Addon_DreamInducer_SwingChains.name: Swing Chains
Addon_DreamInducer_SwingChains.description:
Rusty but sturdy chains used to securely attach a swing seat.

After using Dream Projection, block all window vaults within 16 meters for 6 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Rusty but sturdy chains that slot into Dream Demon and block all window vaults within a short radius after Dream Projection fires. The block lasts for a brief window, cutting off a key escape route for the survivor.
beginner.whyItMatters: It changes the structural flow of the power because it removes the window-vault escape the moment a projection lands, forcing the survivor to commit or stay inside the Dream World. That brief lockout turns windows into a dead end and shifts chase dynamics significantly.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer wants to seal off vaults the instant a projection connects, because the blocked windows force a survivor to either commit to a chase or remain trapped in the Dream World. It is very rare, so it will not appear often in the pool.

Addon_DreamInducer_UnicornBlock.name: Unicorn Block
Addon_DreamInducer_UnicornBlock.description:
A white and red wooden block depicting a prancing unicorn and the letter "U".

Increases the Dream Pallets' rupture radius by 14%.

beginner.whatItIs: Widens the rupture radius of Dream Pallets when slotted into Dream Demon, so the blast zone reaches further from the pallet's center. Survivors who stand a bit further away are now caught in the rupture instead of slipping past it.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a modest shift that makes each pallet a slightly larger threat zone, so a survivor who thinks they have cleared the rupture distance may still get caught in the blast. The effect rewards positioning awareness and punishes survivors who hug pallets too closely.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the killer wants to control space around pallets more aggressively, since the wider radius punishes survivors who try to re-approach a recently ruptured spot. It is rare rarity, so it will not be the first option to show up in a pool.

Addon_DreamInducer_WoolShirt.name: Wool Shirt
Addon_DreamInducer_WoolShirt.description:
A small boy's orange and yellow striped shirt. Identified with a sewn name tag to "Jesse".

Decreases the delay before Dream Pallets rupture by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Shortens the delay before Dream Pallets rupture once slotted into Dream Demon, bringing the punishment phase closer to the moment of placement. The tighter timing means a survivor has less breathing room after a pallet drops.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a small change that compresses the reaction window a survivor has after the initial pallet hit. The quicker rupture makes it harder to step out of range before the second phase lands.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer wants to keep pressure on survivors who are trying to loop around a pallet, since the shorter delay means the second hit lands before they feel safe. It is common rarity, so it will likely appear early in the draw.

Addon_DreamInducer_ZBlock.name: "Z" Block
Addon_DreamInducer_ZBlock.description:
A deeply scratched and burnt wooden block which only recognizable feature is the letter "Z".

Survivors hit with a Dream Snare or Dream Pallet are revealed for 3 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Briefly reveals a survivor's position after they are struck by a Dream Snare or Dream Pallet, once slotted into Dream Demon. The moment of confirmed location lets the killer lock onto the hit target without losing track.
beginner.whyItMatters: It adds a layer of information to every successful hit, since the brief aura reveal lets the killer confirm a survivor's exact position after a connection. That matters most when the Dream World makes tracking difficult and the killer needs a fixed reference point.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the killer is struggling to keep tabs on survivors after a hit inside the Dream World, since the reveal bridges the information gap. It is very rare, so it will be a hard pull to find.

Addon_Flashlight_001.name: Battery
Addon_Flashlight_001.description:
A standard battery of unknown brand.

Adds 2 seconds of use to the Flashlight.

beginner.whatItIs: Adds a small chunk of runtime to each Flashlight charge, keeping the beam alive a little past where it would normally fade. The change is minor but consistent, useful when a charge was about to run dry mid-vault.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra seconds are modest, but in a tight chase they can be the difference between finishing a vault sprint and the beam dying mid-run. It reads as a small quality-of-life tweak rather than a change to how the Flashlight plays.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a survivor wants a little extra safety margin on the Flashlight without making a bigger trade-off elsewhere. It is common rarity, so it is one of the easier to pull.

Addon_Flashlight_002.name: Heavy Duty Battery
Addon_Flashlight_002.description:
A battery marked as "industrial strength."

Adds 4 seconds of use to the Flashlight.

beginner.whatItIs: Stamps the Flashlight with industrial-strength capacity, adding a larger block of runtime to each charge than the standard Battery does. The extra runtime is enough to cover an additional pallet interaction or a brief stretch of sustained beam use.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra runtime is a meaningful bump that keeps the beam alive through longer chases or a full generator run without constant anxiety about the battery. It still plays like the same Flashlight, just with more headroom before the light fails.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the Flashlight is the main tool in a survivor build and the beam needs to survive repeated encounters without dying. Since it sits at uncommon rarity, it should appear in the cache without too much hunting.

Addon_Flashlight_003.name: Focus Lens
Addon_Flashlight_003.description:
A thick glass lens that focuses the Flashlight beam to increase its intensity.

Increases the range of the Flashlight beam by 25%.Decreases the width of the Flashlight beam by 15%.Increases the brightness of the Flashlight beam by 20%.Increases Blindness duration by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Narrows the Flashlight beam by fitting a thick glass lens, sacrificing width in exchange for reach, intensity, and a longer Blindness window on a clean hit. The trade favors flicking a killer from across a room rather than sweeping nearby corridors.
beginner.whyItMatters: The trade-off is real: the survivor loses some cone width but gains a beam that reaches farther, hits brighter, and blinds the killer for longer. It shifts the Flashlight from a wide, close-range tool toward a precision instrument for landing flashes at distance.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a survivor wants to blind a killer from farther away, since the extended reach and longer Blindness make each successful flash harder to recover from. It lands at uncommon rarity, so a few cache pulls should turn it up.

Addon_Flashlight_004.name: Wide Lens
Addon_Flashlight_004.description:
A thin wide lens in perfect condition. Designed to spread the Flashlight beam at the cost of reducing its range of effectiveness.

Decreases the range of the Flashlight beam by 25%.Increases the width of the Flashlight beam by 25%.

beginner.whatItIs: Spreads the Flashlight beam across a wider arc by fitting a thin, wide lens in front of it. Reach shortens as a result, but the broad cone makes close-range dodges harder for the killer to execute.
beginner.whyItMatters: The wider cone means the beam is harder to dodge in tight corridors or around corners, since the killer has a larger window to step into the light. It reads as a small shift toward crowd control rather than a precision hit.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the Flashlight is being used to sweep tight spaces or corner a killer in a hallway, since the broader beam leaves fewer blind spots at close range. At common rarity, it should crop up in most cache rolls.

Addon_Flashlight_005.name: Power Bulb
Addon_Flashlight_005.description:
A tiny Flashlight bulb that packs more wattage for a brighter, more powerful light beam.

Increases the brightness of the Flashlight beam by 20%.Increases Blindness duration by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Swaps in a higher-wattage bulb for the Flashlight, punching up the beam's brightness and stretching the Blindness duration on a clean hit. Nothing about the cone shape changes, so the beam simply hits harder and stings longer.
beginner.whyItMatters: The brighter beam and the longer Blindness window give the survivor a bit more time to reposition after a flash lands. It is a small but noticeable bump in punch that makes each swing feel more decisive.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a survivor wants each use of the Flashlight to land harder, since the brighter beam and longer blind make a single flash more punishing. It is common rarity, so it is a straightforward find.

Addon_Flashlight_006.name: TIR Optic
Addon_Flashlight_006.description:
A lens and reflector combo which can magnify a Flashlight's beam.

Increases the brightness of the Flashlight beam by 30%.Increases Blindness duration by 15%.

beginner.whatItIs: Combines a lens with a reflector to magnify the Flashlight beam, pushing both brightness and Blindness duration past what the stock unit delivers. The upgrade is straightforward: a brighter beam that blinds the killer for longer on a clean hit.
beginner.whyItMatters: Compared to the Power Bulb, the TIR Optic pushes both brightness and Blindness further, making each flash feel like a heavier blow to the killer's ability to track movement. It is a meaningful step up in offensive power without changing the Flashlight's core loop.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a survivor wants maximum impact from each Flashlight swing, since the combined brightness and blind duration make the killer more vulnerable in the moment after a hit. It is uncommon rarity, so it should appear with reasonable frequency.

Addon_Flashlight_007.name: Low Amp Filament
Addon_Flashlight_007.description:
A filament bulb designed to extend a Flashlight battery's life.

Decreases Flashlight battery consumption by 24%.

beginner.whatItIs: Low Amp Filament slots into the Flashlight and stretches how long each battery holds its charge by drawing less power from it. The beam stays exactly as bright as before, so the change is purely about efficiency rather than raw output.
beginner.whyItMatters: The lower power draw means the survivor can swing the Flashlight more freely across a full trial without constantly watching the battery meter. It is a quiet, steady gain that reduces the pressure to conserve light during chases.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a survivor plans to use the Flashlight often across a full trial, since the reduced draw keeps the beam alive through late-game chases that would otherwise drain a standard battery. It sits at uncommon rarity, so it should appear with a reasonable amount of hunting.

Addon_Flashlight_008.name: Leather Grip
Addon_Flashlight_008.description:
A leather strip wrapped around the Flashlight for more grip.

Increases the accuracy of the Flashlight beam by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: Leather Grip wraps a strip of leather around the Flashlight body to steady the hand and reduce beam wobble on every swing. The aim becomes more predictable, which helps when lining up a swing through a doorway or around a corner.
beginner.whyItMatters: The steadier beam makes it easier to line up a flash on a moving killer, especially during a chase when the survivor's hands are not perfectly still. It is a small accuracy bump that compounds over the course of a trial.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a survivor keeps missing flashes because the beam drifts off target, since the extra grip tightens each swing and helps the light land where it is aimed. At common rarity, it should show up in most cache pulls.

Addon_Flashlight_BrokenBulb.name: Broken Bulb
Addon_Flashlight_BrokenBulb.description:
A damaged bulb that causes a spooky flickering effect.

Causes the Flashlight to flicker.Increases the brightness of the Flashlight beam by 15%.Increases Blindness duration by 30%.Increases the spookiness just a little.

beginner.whatItIs: It slots into the Flashlight and adds a flickering, spookier quality to the beam. The brightness is boosted and the blind effect on a killer lasts longer than usual.
beginner.whyItMatters: The brighter beam and extended blind window make each successful hit on a killer feel more decisive. It pushes the Flashlight from a quick distraction toward a tool that can truly end a chase on its own.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when running a survivor who depends on the Flashlight to escape tight chases, since the enhanced beam and extended blind duration give more payoff per swing. Its common rarity makes it a straightforward early find during the build phase.

ADDON_flashlight_highendsapphire.name: High-end Sapphire lens
ADDON_flashlight_highendsapphire.description:
A wide lens made of unscratchable sapphire that optimises the power and range of the light beam.

Increases the range of the Flashlight beam by 25%.Increases the width of the Flashlight beam by 25%.Increases the brightness of the Flashlight beam by 30%.Increases Blindness duration by 15%.

beginner.whatItIs: A very rare Flashlight add-on that boosts beam range, width, and brightness while stretching the Blindness duration. It touches every stat of the light at once.
beginner.whyItMatters: A wider, brighter, longer beam makes the Flashlight a more dependable tool for both reading the map and blinding a chasing killer. It reads as a bigger upgrade than a single-stat tweak because every aspect of the light improves together.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when one item needs to cover both utility and self-defense without a second gadget. Its very rare drop rate means builds should only plan around it when it is actually in the inventory.

ADDON_flashlight_intensehalogen.name: Intense Halogen
ADDON_flashlight_intensehalogen.description:
A chemical bulb that generates an intensely clear light.

Increases the brightness of the Flashlight beam by 40%.Increases Blindness duration by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: The Intense Halogen raises Flashlight beam brightness and extends how long the Blindness effect lasts. It is a rare add-on focused on the defensive side of the light.
beginner.whyItMatters: A brighter beam blinds for longer, giving a survivor more time to vault or dash away after the flash lands. That extra window matters most in tight corridor chases where seconds decide the outcome.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the Flashlight serves as the primary escape button during chases rather than a steady map utility. It drops at a rare rate, so it will be available in a good chunk of matches.

ADDON_flashlight_lonflifebattery.name: Long Life Battery
ADDON_flashlight_lonflifebattery.description:
A recent model of battery that lasts longer.

Adds 6 seconds of use to the Flashlight.

beginner.whatItIs: A rare Flashlight add-on that adds extra seconds of usable light to the battery. It is purely about extending how long the beam stays on.
beginner.whyItMatters: More battery life means fewer moments where the beam dies mid-chase or during a long hallway read. It reduces the risk of being caught in the dark with no tool left, which is a quiet but real quality-of-life gain.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it on long maps or in trials where the Flashlight will be used many times before the match ends. It is a rare drop, so it will not be in every loadout.

ADDON_flashlight_oddbulb.name: Odd Bulb
ADDON_flashlight_oddbulb.description:
A heavy and completely opaque bulb of unknown origin which emits a faint light even when turned off.

Increases the brightness of the Flashlight beam by 50%.Increases Blindness duration by 25%.Increases Flashlight battery consumption by 12%.

beginner.whatItIs: Iridescent and heavy, the Odd Bulb dramatically increases brightness and Blindness duration at the cost of faster battery drain. It is a trade-off item for the Flashlight.
beginner.whyItMatters: The brighter beam and longer blind stretch give a survivor real pressure when a killer is in the dark, at the cost of the battery draining noticeably faster with every second the light is on. That trade-off turns the Flashlight from a steady defensive tool into something that rewards timing and restraint over constant use.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the Flashlight is meant to be a true emergency escape rather than a steady utility, since the battery trade-off punishes casual use. Its iridescent rarity makes it a notable find when it shows up.

ADDON_flashlight_rubbergrip.name: Rubber Grip
ADDON_flashlight_rubbergrip.description:
A rubber grip specifically fitting Flashlights for more grip.

Increases the accuracy of the Flashlight beam by 40%.

beginner.whatItIs: An uncommon Flashlight add-on that tightens the beam spread for more accurate aiming during chases. It focuses the light into a narrower cone.
beginner.whyItMatters: A tighter beam is easier to land on a killer's eyes, reducing the chance the light washes over them instead of hitting squarely. It is a small but noticeable improvement for anyone who misses flashes regularly.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if more flashes miss than hit during chases and the beam needs to stay where it is pointed. It is uncommon, so expect it to appear regularly in the item pool.

Addon_FogVial_Accelerant.name: Volcanic Stone
Addon_FogVial_Accelerant.description:
The heat of its birthplace glows within this living rock.

Decreases the Fog Vial cooldown by 5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Volcanic Stone plugs into the Fog Vial and trims its cooldown. A survivor can launch another fog cloud sooner after the first one fades, turning a single panic escape into a repeatable option.
beginner.whyItMatters: Because the cooldown is shorter, the Fog Vial stops being a one-shot escape and becomes a tool a survivor can lean on twice in quick succession. That shift changes how a survivor plans their route through a dense chase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if a survivor wants to chain fog clouds to confuse a pursuing killer across multiple pallets, since the faster cooldown supports that back-to-back play. Picking it up takes little effort given its common rarity.

Addon_FogVial_Amplifier.name: Mushroom Formula
Addon_FogVial_Amplifier.description:
Blooming wisps of fog grasp at the environment, reaching farther and farther out.

Increases maximum Fog Cloud size by 2 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: Mushroom Formula slots into the Fog Vial and expands the cloud to a noticeably wider radius. The fog covers more ground around where it lands, making the escape window broader.
beginner.whyItMatters: A broader cloud is easier for a killer to stumble into while looping, which makes the Fog Vial more forgiving to place. It also catches pursuers who swing wide around a pallet, turning a narrow escape window into a wider one.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a survivor wants a wide net of fog to cover a generator area or a tight corridor, since the larger radius makes precise placement less critical. Its very rare rarity means it will take real effort to obtain across trials.

Addon_FogVial_DenseFogExtract.name: Potent Extract
Addon_FogVial_DenseFogExtract.description:
One drop is enough to change the consistency of this strange elixir.

Increases the Fog Cloud's opacity by 100%.Decreases the Fog Cloud's duration by 50%.Decreases the Fog Cloud's size by 25%.

beginner.whatItIs: Potent Extract slots into the Fog Vial and makes the cloud dramatically more opaque, though it shrinks the cloud and shortens how long it lingers. The trade-off is a dense, wall-like burst of fog that vanishes quicker than a standard cloud.
beginner.whyItMatters: A killer has a much harder time seeing through the dense fog, so even a brief window of total blindness can break a chase. The smaller, shorter-lived cloud rewards precise timing over brute coverage, making placement more important than raw area.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it in a tight chase where a brief wall of near-total concealment is enough to break a killer's line of sight, since the heavy opacity is what makes the escape work. Its iridescent rarity makes it a long-term unlock that a survivor may chase across many trials.

Addon_FogVial_LargeVial.name: Reactive Compound
Addon_FogVial_LargeVial.description:
Pressure builds within the vial. Its contents beg for release.

Decreases the Fog Cloud's expansion time by 1 second.

beginner.whatItIs: Reactive Compound slots into the Fog Vial and shaves a beat off the cloud's expansion time. The fog forms more quickly after being thrown, so the visual block appears sooner.
beginner.whyItMatters: That faster formation closes the gap between the throw and the fog actually blocking a killer's view. It matters most in the split-second window where a survivor is vaulting or turning a corner and needs the fog to be in place before the killer closes in.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a survivor often throws the Fog Vial mid-sprint and needs the fog to appear before the killer closes the distance, since the quicker expansion rewards fast, reactive play. Uncommon rarity keeps it reasonably accessible without a long hunt.

Addon_FogVial_SlowRelease.name: Oily Sap
Addon_FogVial_SlowRelease.description:
The emerging fog clings to the air, overwhelming the senses for even longer.

Increases Fog Cloud duration by 2 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Oily Sap slots into the Fog Vial and stretches the cloud's duration, keeping the fog hanging in the environment for a longer stretch. The result is a slower dissipation, giving the fog more time to hold a killer's attention.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer-lasting cloud buys a survivor extra time to vault, run, or heal while the fog holds a killer's attention. It is especially valuable when the fog is placed to cover a specific action like healing or generator work rather than a quick escape.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a survivor plans to use the Fog Vial to shield a heal or a generator repair, since the extended duration protects those longer actions better than a brief puff. Rare rarity places it in the middle of the unlock curve.

ADDON_Frenzy_ColdDirt.name: BFFs
ADDON_Frenzy_ColdDirt.description:
An unnaturally cold silver necklace split into four, one for each best friend.

Earn tokens for hitting Survivors during Feral Frenzy:Second chained hit: 2 tokensThird chained hit: 3 tokensFourth chained hit: 4 tokensFifth chained hit: 5 tokens

Once the gates are powered, if 15 or more tokens have been collected, gain 6% Haste when not using Feral Frenzy.

Haste increases Killer movement speed.

beginner.whatItIs: Earns tokens from chained survivor hits during Feral Frenzy and converts them into Haste once the gates are powered. The more survivors reached in one frenzy, the more tokens pile up.
beginner.whyItMatters: The reward scales with a wide, multi-target hunt, so it pays off for a killer who reaches several survivors per frenzy. That is a bigger shift, because the payoff depends on performance during the power.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Grab it on very rare rolls if the playstyle already reaches multiple survivors per frenzy. Good for a killer who wants extra speed in the late game after a well-hunted match.

ADDON_Frenzy_DefacedSmileyPin.name: Defaced Smiley Pin
ADDON_Frenzy_DefacedSmileyPin.description:
A once friendly-looking bright yellow button of a defaced smiley. A signature icon of The Legion.

Survivors who self-mend a Deep Wound from Feral Frenzy are inflicted with Mangled for 60 seconds.

Mangled increases time required to heal by 25% and lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

beginner.whatItIs: Punishes survivors who self-mend a Deep Wound by marking them with Mangled, which slows their healing. The cheap recovery now comes with a cost.
beginner.whyItMatters: Discouraging self-mends keeps pressure on injured survivors and makes the quick top-off feel less tempting. It reads as a targeted shift against a specific healing habit.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it on uncommon rolls if survivors keep self-mending right after a hit. Good when injured survivors keep top-off and the killer wants them to pay for it.

ADDON_Frenzy_EtchedRuler.name: Etched Ruler
ADDON_Frenzy_EtchedRuler.description:
A wooden ruler deeply etched with the names of enemies.

Survivors hit by a Feral Slash are inflicted with Oblivious for 60 seconds.

Oblivious prevents Survivors from hearing or being affected by the Killer's Terror Radius.

beginner.whatItIs: Strips survivors hit by a Feral Slash of their ability to hear or feel the killer's Terror Radius, through the Oblivious state. The early warning that normally signals an incoming chase simply goes quiet.
beginner.whyItMatters: Without the Terror Radius as a cue, the killer can close in with less warning for the target. That is a meaningful change to how chases open.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it on uncommon rolls if survivors seem to hear the chase coming from far away. Good for a killer who wants to open a chase with less warning for the target.

ADDON_Frenzy_FilthyBlade.name: Filthy Blade
ADDON_Frenzy_FilthyBlade.description:
This blade is stained with foul spots of blood and grime that make injuries particularly difficult to mend.

Increases time required for Survivors to mend by 4 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Lengthens the time survivors need to mend their injuries, keeping them in a weakened state longer. The mend progress bar simply crawls.
beginner.whyItMatters: Slower mending buys the killer more time to act after a hit, which keeps a wounded survivor on the back foot. It reads as steady, reliable pressure rather than a flashy change.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it on very rare rolls if survivors recover too quickly after a hit. Good for a killer who wants a wounded survivor to stay on the back foot.

ADDON_Frenzy_FranksMixTape.name: Frank's Mix Tape
ADDON_Frenzy_FranksMixTape.description:
Never go on a kill mission without your tunes. A track list of massive distortion and loud percussion that stabs at your eardrums.

While using Feral Frenzy:Damaging generators is 20% faster.Breaking walls is 30% faster.The Power gauge pauses while damaging a generator or breaking a wall.

beginner.whatItIs: Accelerates generator damage and wall breaking while Feral Frenzy is active, and pauses the Power gauge during those actions. A single frenzy burst now does more utility work.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster generator damage and quicker wall breaks let a killer accomplish more in a single Feral Frenzy burst. The power gauge also holds steady while working, so the window of speed does not slip away mid-task. Together these changes make each activation feel noticeably longer and more productive than a plain burst.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a Feral Frenzy build needs more wall breaks and generator work squeezed into one activation. Its very rare roll makes it worth saving for a killer who relies on those utility bursts rather than pure damage.

ADDON_Frenzy_FriendshipBracelet.name: Friendship Bracelet
ADDON_Frenzy_FriendshipBracelet.description:
A wide gray and red braided rope bracelet. The inscription "F J S J" can be seen, crudely written in bold black ink.

Increases duration of lunges during Feral Frenzy by 0.3 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Extends the lunge duration in Feral Frenzy by a small margin of extra time. The Legion gets a slightly longer window of aggressive pressure with each lunge while the buff is active.
beginner.whyItMatters: A minor quality-of-life tweak that makes each lunge feel a touch more threatening, especially in tight corridors where a survivor is already reeling. It does not change how Feral Frenzy is set up or managed, only how long the lunge animation holds.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if The Legion's lunges feel a beat too short against fast-escaping survivors, particularly in narrow hallways or generator corner loops. It is common rarity, so it is easy to come by and slot in without sacrificing anything meaningful.

ADDON_Frenzy_FumingMixTape.name: Fuming Mix Tape
ADDON_Frenzy_FumingMixTape.description:
Dark beats, violent shreds and unfathomable sounds from another world fill the mind with a vibrating sixth sense.

While using Feral Frenzy:The repair progress of Generators can be determined by the intensity of their Auras.Generators not being repaired regress at 100% speed.

beginner.whatItIs: Reveals the repair progress of each generator through the intensity of its aura while Feral Frenzy is active. Generators that are not currently being repaired also regress at full speed during the buff.
beginner.whyItMatters: A bigger shift in how Feral Frenzy plays, because it adds a layer of information and a built-in punishment loop on top of the chase. The killer can now make informed decisions about which generator to pressure and which survivors are idle.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a lobby has several survivors idling near generators and the killer needs a reason to investigate each one. Its iridescent rarity means it is harder to pull, so save the slot for a match where information advantage feels more valuable than raw speed.

ADDON_Frenzy_IridescentButton.name: Iridescent Button
ADDON_Frenzy_IridescentButton.description:
A glass-like button molded from The Fog that captures The Legion’s likeness. The surface is warm and reverberating with The Entity's power.

While in Feral Frenzy, whenever you special-vault Pallets, the Pallets special-break.While in Feral Frenzy, during a special-vault you cannot be blinded.

beginner.whatItIs: Turns pallet special-vaults in Feral Frenzy into destructive actions that break the pallet entirely, and removes the chance of being blinded by that same vault. The Legion can now punch through a pallet instead of simply jumping over it.
beginner.whyItMatters: A meaningful shift in chase dynamics because it strips the primary defensive tool out of a survivor's hands at the exact moment they would use it. A loop that once felt safe because of a single pallet becomes far more dangerous when that pallet can be destroyed mid-vault.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a map loop is built around one or two key pallets and survivors rely on them repeatedly to break chases. The iridescent rarity makes it a special situational pick rather than a default, so it fits best in matches where the killer wants to reshape the geometry of a favorite loop.

ADDON_Frenzy_JoeysMixTape.name: Joey's Mix Tape
ADDON_Frenzy_JoeysMixTape.description:
A mix of bangin' tracks and slammin' beats for when life's a bitch.

Survivors who self-mend a Deep Wound from Feral Frenzy are inflicted with Hemorrhage until fully healed.

Hemorrhage regresses healing progress when not healing, and increases blood trails left by injured Survivors. This lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

beginner.whatItIs: Inflicts Hemorrhage on any survivor who self-mends a Deep Wound from Feral Frenzy. Hemorrhage regresses healing progress when the survivor is not actively healing and leaves a thicker blood trail while injured.
beginner.whyItMatters: This directly punishes the main way survivors recover from a Feral Frenzy lunge, turning their escape tool into a liability. A survivor who self-mends to recover now has to weigh that action against losing healing stability and becoming easier to track.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a lobby contains multiple survivors who lean on self-mending to survive a Feral Frenzy lunge rather than relying on a teammate's help. Its rare rarity slots it as a deliberate pick for a killer who wants sustained pressure without the commitment of an iridescent option.

ADDON_Frenzy_JuliesMixTape.name: Julie's Mix Tape
ADDON_Frenzy_JuliesMixTape.description: A dark mix tape made out from mainly power ballads and gloomy rock.If The Legion is stunned while in Feral Frenzy, the power gauge refills once the duration of the stun ends.

beginner.whatItIs: Automatically refills The Legion's Feral Frenzy power gauge the moment any stun wears off. The buff effectively restarts its gauge after a brief interruption instead of being lost entirely.
beginner.whyItMatters: This softens one of the hardest counters to Feral Frenzy, since a well-timed stun used to cancel the entire buff and its speed stack. Now the killer only loses the stun duration itself, making aggressive play through stun-heavy lobbies more forgiving.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a lobby has multiple survivors carrying strong stun tools or when The Legion tends to get caught by a hook-throw or a well-placed pallet strike. Its uncommon rarity keeps it accessible without being too easy to pull, fitting a build that wants survivability over raw aggression.

ADDON_Frenzy_MischiefList.name: Mischief List
ADDON_Frenzy_MischiefList.description:
A list of mischievous missions to accomplish; memento of brighter days.

Increases the duration of Feral Frenzy by 1 second.

beginner.whatItIs: Adds a short stretch of extra duration to the Feral Frenzy buff, giving The Legion a slightly longer window of speed and lunge access before the gauge resets. The change is small but consistent across every activation.
beginner.whyItMatters: A minor quality-of-life tweak that eases the pressure of managing the buff timer during a long chase. It does not add new mechanics, only a small cushion that can matter when a lunge window would otherwise expire mid-pallet loop.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if the Feral Frenzy gauge feels like it always runs out right when a chase is getting interesting. It is common rarity, so it is one of the easiest slots to fill while learning the power without needing to hunt for rarer options.

ADDON_Frenzy_MuralSketch.name: Mural Sketch
ADDON_Frenzy_MuralSketch.description:
A rough sketch of The Legion mural torn from a notebook.

Increases speed bonus per hit during Feral Frenzy to 0.32 m/s.

beginner.whatItIs: Raises the per-hit speed bonus during Feral Frenzy so the buff scales harder with each chained strike. The more consecutive hits The Legion lands, the more noticeable the speed gain becomes.
beginner.whyItMatters: A bigger feel shift for chase play because it rewards sustained pressure over a single lunge-and-reset pattern. A killer who can keep a survivor in the loop will build up a speed advantage that compounds with every swing.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a chase build favors extended loops and The Legion tends to land multiple hits in a row before a survivor breaks free. Its uncommon rarity makes it a solid pick for anyone who wants the speed scaling to feel more rewarding per hit.

ADDON_Frenzy_NastyBlade.name: Stylish Sunglasses
ADDON_Frenzy_NastyBlade.description:
Oval-shaped sunglasses that exude poise and cool. Their color tinted lenses add an understated appeal.

Shows the auras of Survivors who are mending within a 24-meter radius.

beginner.whatItIs: Reveals the auras of survivors who are currently mending within a set radius, letting the killer spot recovery from a distance. It works as a standing awareness tool rather than needing any special power state to be running.
beginner.whyItMatters: Information is often the difference between a caught survivor and a lost one. Knowing where a mender is removes the guesswork from choosing which generator or hook to pressure next.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when survivors in the lobby favor recovering in the open rather than retreating to hooks, since the aura reveal makes their mending spot visible at range. Rare rarity makes it a deliberate pick, so pair it with a chase build that already tracks where healing tends to happen.

ADDON_Frenzy_NeverSleepPills.name: Never-Sleep Pills
ADDON_Frenzy_NeverSleepPills.description:
Highly caffeinated tablets to make you extra sharp for exams or other draining activities.

The Legion's base move speed during Feral Frenzy is 4.6 m/s.Increases the duration of Feral Frenzy by 10 seconds.Gain 100 to 500 bonus Bloodpoints for each successive hit on a Survivor during Feral Frenzy.

beginner.whatItIs: Boosts The Legion's base move speed during Feral Frenzy, extends the buff duration, and awards bonus Bloodpoints for each successive hit on a survivor. It is a multi-faceted upgrade that touches speed, duration, and economy all at once.
beginner.whyItMatters: One of the broader shifts available for Feral Frenzy because it improves several axes of the power simultaneously rather than focusing on a single mechanic. A chase that already felt strong gets faster, lasts longer, and pays out more for every hit landed.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a build already leans on Feral Frenzy as the primary chase tool and the killer wants a single slot that improves the whole package. Its uncommon rarity keeps it attainable without the difficulty of an iridescent pull, making it a practical choice for a round-the-clock Feral Frenzy setup.

ADDON_Frenzy_ScratchedRuler.name: Scratched Ruler
ADDON_Frenzy_ScratchedRuler.description:
A wooden ruler deeply scratched with hash marks.

Decreases Feral Frenzy recharge time by 5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Shortens the Feral Frenzy recharge timer so the buff cycles back to full faster after it expires. The gap between frenzies becomes shorter, letting The Legion re-enter the buffed state more quickly.
beginner.whyItMatters: A small but practical tweak for killers who find the downtime between frenzies too long during a drawn-out trial. It does not change the buff itself, only how fast it returns, which matters most in long trials with multiple chases.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if the recharge window feels like a wasted stretch in every chase, especially on maps with long generator paths where The Legion needs to be buffed for the second half of a loop. It is common rarity, so it is an easy first add-on to try when learning the power.

ADDON_Frenzy_SmileyFacePin.name: Smiley Face Pin
ADDON_Frenzy_SmileyFacePin.description:
A friendly-looking bright yellow button used as a sarcastic statement.

Survivors who self-mend a Deep Wound from Feral Frenzy are inflicted with Blindness for 60 seconds.

Blindness prevents Survivors from seeing auras.

beginner.whatItIs: Blinds a survivor for a stretch of time after they self-mend a Deep Wound from Feral Frenzy, keeping them from seeing auras during that window. That turns a self-mend into a trade of health for temporary blindness rather than a free recovery.
beginner.whyItMatters: This turns the self-mend recovery into a visible trade-off: the survivor heals but loses all situational awareness for a meaningful stretch. A survivor who would normally self-mend confidently now has to weigh that loss of information against the injury they are escaping.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a lobby has survivors who self-mend aggressively and then immediately re-engage with a generator or hook. Its common rarity makes it a low-risk slot to fill, and the blindness window is long enough to disrupt a follow-up action without being so long that it feels unfair.

ADDON_Frenzy_StabWoundsStudy.name: Stab Wounds Study
ADDON_Frenzy_StabWoundsStudy.description:
A printed medical article stolen from Ormond's public library vulgarizing a study on lesions and stab wounds.

The auras of Survivors who self-mend a Deep Wound from Feral Frenzy are shown for 4 seconds afterward.

Deep Wound will put a Survivor in the dying state unless it is mended before the timer runs out.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into Feral Frenzy and briefly exposes the aura of whichever survivor finishes mending a Deep Wound, opening a short tracking window after the mender puts the blade down. The reveal lasts only a handful of seconds, so the information is fleeting.
beginner.whyItMatters: A small information nudge that can turn a lost chase into a found one, because the self-mending survivor suddenly has a brief moment of exposure. It is less punishing than a heavy debuff but still enough to let a killer adjust course and re-engage.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in lobbies where survivors habitually patch their Deep Wounds in exposed areas and then sprint toward generators or the exit. Very rare rarity means it is a considered commitment, so slot it when a chase build already has a strong sense of where menders tend to reappear.

ADDON_Frenzy_StolenSketchBook.name: Stolen Sketch Book
ADDON_Frenzy_StolenSketchBook.description:
A sketch book with imaginative and evocative, if not slightly bizarre, sketches.

During Feral Frenzy, from the second chained hit onward, hit survivors drop their item.

beginner.whatItIs: Causes hit survivors to drop their held item starting from the second chained hit onward during Feral Frenzy. The first hit still lands normally, but every swing after that strips whatever the survivor is carrying.
beginner.whyItMatters: A bigger shift in chase outcomes because it removes a survivor's tool at the exact moment they are trying to use it. A medkit, a flashlight, or a hook in hand all become vulnerable once the second swing connects, which changes how survivors commit to a defensive play.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in chases where a survivor is likely to panic-drop a flashlight or hook during a multi-hit sequence, then press the advantage by chasing the dropped object. Rare rarity keeps it a deliberate pick, and it rewards a chase style that strings together hits rather than chasing one clean strike.

ADDON_Frenzy_SusiesMixTape.name: Susie's Mix Tape
ADDON_Frenzy_SusiesMixTape.description: A thrilling mix tape with energizing songs and intricate guitar riffs.Increases Killer Instinct detection range by 20 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: Widens the range at which Killer Instinct reveals survivor actions, letting the killer spot activity from further away. It functions as a standing detection boost rather than something tied to a specific power state.
beginner.whyItMatters: A broader awareness upgrade that helps The Legion make better routing decisions during a chase. Seeing what a survivor is doing from further away means fewer surprises when turning a corner or choosing which generator to pressure next.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a lobby fields survivors who lean on stealth, placing hooks in blind spots or patching wounds out of sight. Rare rarity makes it a purposeful slot, and it pays off most in chases where the killer needs an extra layer of awareness to find what would otherwise stay hidden.

ADDON_Frenzy_TheLegionPin.name: The Legion Pin
ADDON_Frenzy_TheLegionPin.description:
A handmade button with the face of The Legion. To use exclusively on intimidation dares.

Survivors who self-mend a Deep Wound from Feral Frenzy are inflicted with Broken for 60 seconds.

Broken prevents Survivors from being healed.

beginner.whatItIs: Applies Broken to a survivor as soon as they finish self-mending a Deep Wound from Feral Frenzy, so they cannot be healed for a stretch afterward regardless of who tries. That leaves the survivor vulnerable to reinjury with no way to top back up during that window.
beginner.whyItMatters: This isolates a self-mending survivor from their team's support for a meaningful stretch, which is a bigger psychological shift than a simple debuff. A survivor who relies on a teammate's heal after a lunge now has to find another way to recover or risk being caught again.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a lobby has a healer-type survivor who always follows up a self-mend with a teammate's help. Its rare rarity makes it a targeted pick, and it is most effective in a trial where the killer wants to break the natural recovery loop of a coordinated team.

Addon_GasBomb_01.name: Robin Feather
Addon_GasBomb_01.description:
A warm orange feather, soft to the touch.

Decreases bottle throw cooldown by 40%.

beginner.whatItIs: Robin Feather slots into The Afterpiece Tonic and cuts the cooldown between bottle throws. The Clown can fire more frequently, keeping gas pressure on a survivor without as much downtime.
beginner.whyItMatters: A shorter cooldown keeps the gas clouds coming with less dead time, making sustained pressure easier to maintain across a chase. It is a modest tweak that makes spamming The Afterpiece Tonic more sustainable without fundamentally changing how the power plays.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when The Clown wants to maintain constant gas pressure on a generator or a hook without long pauses, since the faster reload supports that aggressive positioning. Common rarity makes it an easy early pick.

Addon_GasBomb_02.name: Party Bottle
Addon_GasBomb_02.description:
Be the life of the party!

Party Bottles emit confetti when they break, in addition to their usual gas effect.Hitting a Survivor directly with a Party Bottle interrupts actions as usual, and awards 100 Devious Bloodpoints.

beginner.whatItIs: Party Bottle layers confetti bursts on top of The Afterpiece Tonic's standard gas cloud when a bottle shatters. It also awards Devious Bloodpoints whenever a bottle strikes a survivor directly, adding a small reward for precise throws.
beginner.whyItMatters: The confetti is purely cosmetic, but the Devious Bloodpoint reward nudges The Clown to aim for direct hits rather than just lobbing bottles at general areas. Precise throws become slightly more rewarding than casual lobs, which adds a small layer of decision-making to each use.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when The Clown wants a bit of extra Bloodpoint pressure while focusing on clean bottle hits, since the reward encourages aiming rather than spraying. The common rarity tag makes it an easy early slot.

Addon_GasBomb_03.name: Smelly Inner Soles
Addon_GasBomb_03.description:
A moldy inner sole which gives much comfort to tired feet.

Increases movement speed while reloading bottles by 15%.

beginner.whatItIs: Smelly Inner Soles slots into The Afterpiece Tonic and boosts The Clown's movement speed while he is in the middle of reloading his bottles. The faster footwork during reload lets The Clown reposition rather than standing still.
beginner.whyItMatters: Being able to move while reloading means The Clown can slip behind a pallet or shift angle during the wait, instead of being a sitting duck. It is a subtle nudge that helps most against fast runners who loop tightly and punish stationary killers.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when The Clown finds himself stuck in one spot while reloading during a chase, since the speed bump helps him stay in position rather than losing ground. Rare rarity means it takes a bit of effort to unlock.

Addon_GasBomb_04.name: Fingerless Parade Gloves
Addon_GasBomb_04.description:
Part of the standard Clown apparel; the cut fingers allow for dexterous manipulations.

Increases bottle throw speed by 25%.Decreases bottle throw angle by 15 degrees.

beginner.whatItIs: Fingerless Parade Gloves slot into The Afterpiece Tonic and speed up the bottle throw while narrowing the arc. The trade-off is a tighter, faster release with less spread, favoring precision over wide coverage.
beginner.whyItMatters: A narrower arc and faster release make each bottle easier to land on a specific survivor rather than a general area. It suits a style that favors clean, deliberate strikes over blanket gas coverage, rewarding aim over volume.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when The Clown prefers to hit a single survivor cleanly rather than blanket an area with gas, since the narrower angle rewards aimed shots. At common rarity, it is one of the first upgrades a new killer can slot in.

Addon_GasBomb_05.name: Thick Cork Stopper
Addon_GasBomb_05.description:
A sturdy cork, fitting The Afterpiece Tonic bottles perfectly.

Decreases reload time by 0.5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Thick Cork Stopper slots into The Afterpiece Tonic and shaves a small amount off the reload time. The next bottle is ready a moment sooner, shortening the gap between consecutive throws.
beginner.whyItMatters: That small time saving compounds over the course of a full trial, keeping The Clown's hands busy and pressure consistent. It matters most during extended chases where every second of downtime gives a survivor room to break line of sight.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when The Clown wants to minimize the dead time between bottle volleys, since the quicker reload supports a steady stream of gas. Uncommon rarity keeps it a reasonable mid-tier unlock.

Addon_GasBomb_06.name: Solvent Jug
Addon_GasBomb_06.description:
A volatile chemical compound that irritates the respiratory tract, but increases absorption of The Afterpiece Antidote.

Increases duration of Invigoration by 1 second.

beginner.whatItIs: Solvent Jug slots into The Afterpiece Tonic and extends how long Clown's Invigoration effect lasts once it is active. It changes how long the boosted state continues, not what causes it to begin.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer Invigoration window lets Clown carry the speed boost into more of what comes next, whether that is closing distance or lining up another throw. It matters because more time inside the buff means more can be done while it lasts, not because it changes when the boost starts.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when The Clown wants to ride out the buff through a full chase cycle rather than having it expire mid-run, since the extended duration supports sustained pressure. Uncommon rarity makes it a practical mid-range pick.

Addon_GasBomb_07.name: Kerosene Can
Addon_GasBomb_07.description:
A thin and clear combustible liquid which numbs the mind when inhaled.

Intoxication inflicts Blindness for 30 seconds.

Blindness prevents Survivors from seeing auras.

beginner.whatItIs: A power add-on for The Afterpiece Tonic that adds a Blindness effect to Intoxication. Affected survivors lose their ability to perceive auras while the debuff is active.
beginner.whyItMatters: Removing aura visibility on top of the existing speed penalty turns a single gas cloud into a double threat to a survivor's situational awareness. The extra disorientation makes routing decisions under pressure feel significantly harder to make.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want The Clown's gas to punish survivors who depend on auras to pick their escape routes, since stripping that information forces them to guess. It carries an uncommon rarity, so it shows up with reasonable frequency during hunts.

Addon_GasBomb_08.name: Sticky Soda Bottle
Addon_GasBomb_08.description:
It's sugary sweet, with only a little blood on the label.

Increases The Clown's Invigoration by 2%.

beginner.whatItIs: Sticky Soda Bottle slots into The Afterpiece Tonic and makes Clown's Invigoration effect somewhat stronger while it is active. It changes how powerful the boost feels, not what causes it to start.
beginner.whyItMatters: A stronger Invigoration bonus makes the boosted stretch more noticeable while it runs, giving Clown a bit more punch during that window. The change strengthens the existing buff rather than adding any new way to set it off.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when Clown wants the Invigoration boost itself to feel stronger whenever it is running, since the increase sharpens the existing buff rather than changing how it starts. Uncommon rarity keeps it within reach without a long grind.

Addon_GasBomb_09.name: Starling Feather
Addon_GasBomb_09.description:
A black feather with an emerald sheen, very soft to the touch.

Decreases bottle throw cooldown by 50%.

beginner.whatItIs: An add-on for The Afterpiece Tonic that sharply shortens the cooldown between bottle throws. The gap between consecutive volleys becomes much narrower, allowing more frequent gas placement.
beginner.whyItMatters: Sustained cloud coverage is a big shift from the burst-style play of the base power, since The Clown can now maintain area denial over a longer stretch. That turns gas placement from a one-time threat into a persistent zone that survivors must constantly navigate around.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when The Clown wants to flood a generator area with overlapping gas clouds and keep survivors pinned, since the fast cooldown supports that continuous pressure. Uncommon rarity makes it a solid mid-range unlock.

Addon_GasBomb_10.name: VHS Porn
Addon_GasBomb_10.description:
An all time classic. You won't see things quite the same again.

Increases the size and spread of Afterpiece Tonic gas clouds by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Widens the gas clouds of The Afterpiece Tonic on both radius and ground spread. Each throw claims a broader patch of the map than the default version allows.
beginner.whyItMatters: Survivors who miscalculate their route around a wider cloud are more likely to step in and suffer the full debuff. The expanded footprint also means the gas acts as a passive boundary that shapes how a team plans its movement near killer territory.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when The Clown wants his gas to cover more ground with each throw, since the wider spread makes it harder for survivors to thread a safe path. Common rarity means it is easy to locate without much grinding.

Addon_GasBomb_11.name: Spirit of Hartshorn
Addon_GasBomb_11.description:
A pungent chemical compound consisting of ammonia. One whiff is enough to jolt even the most sluggish of minds.

Increases the size and spread of Afterpiece Antidote gas clouds by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: Spirit of Hartshorn slots into The Afterpiece Tonic and makes the accompanying Afterpiece Antidote clouds noticeably bigger in both reach and spread. The wider cloud covers more ground than the default version.
beginner.whyItMatters: A bigger Antidote cloud means Clown does not have to be as precise about where he throws it, since the wider area is more forgiving. That extra margin makes the cloud easier to land without needing pinpoint positioning.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when The Clown wants his antidote clouds to be more forgiving to aim, since the larger area makes it easier to hit a moving or hooking survivor. Rare rarity places it further along the unlock path.

Addon_GasBomb_12.name: Sulfuric Acid Vial
Addon_GasBomb_12.description:
An odorless syrupy liquid which is highly corrosive.

Intoxication inflicts Mangled on injured Survivors for 70 seconds.

Mangled increases time required to heal by 25% and lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

beginner.whatItIs: Attaches a Mangled debuff to The Afterpiece Tonic's Intoxication, slowing the healing speed of any injured survivor caught in the gas. The Mangled penalty persists until the survivor is fully healed.
beginner.whyItMatters: By taxing healing directly, the gas cloud becomes a threat that lingers even after the initial speed penalty fades. Teams that want to recover near a gassed area now face a longer, riskier heal, which discourages them from clustering in The Clown's territory.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if The Clown wants to discourage survivors from mending each other close to his territory, since the healing penalty makes those interactions slower and more vulnerable. Its rare rarity means it demands dedicated effort to unlock.

Addon_GasBomb_13.name: Flask of Bleach
Addon_GasBomb_13.description:
A potent chemical which causes irritation, burn and lungs damage.

Increases the Hindered penalty from Intoxication by an additional 2%.

Hindered reduces Survivor movement speed.

beginner.whatItIs: Deepens the Hindered penalty from The Afterpiece Tonic's Intoxication, dragging affected survivors' movement speed even lower. Escape from a gas cloud feels noticeably more sluggish with the extra slow layered on top.
beginner.whyItMatters: Survivors who would normally slip out of a gas zone quickly now linger longer inside it, which gives The Clown more time to set up a follow-up hit. The heavier slow amplifies the pressure of every successful throw and makes the chase feel more relentless.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the goal is to make survivors feel truly pinned inside the gas, because the deeper slow stretches the window for a second hit. Earning one of rare rarity takes dedicated play rather than a single lucky drop.

Addon_GasBomb_14.name: Bottle of Chloroform
Addon_GasBomb_14.description:
A sweet-smelling organic compound with strong anesthetic capabilities.

Increases the size and spread of Afterpiece Tonic gas clouds by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: Expands the radius and ground spread of each gas cloud from The Afterpiece Tonic. Every throw paints a larger circle of debuff on the map compared to the default version.
beginner.whyItMatters: A bigger no-go zone forces survivors to plan wider detours, which disrupts their optimal routes to generators and exit gates. The expanded footprint also raises the chance that a survivor simply walks into the cloud by accident, making it a more passive area-denial tool.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the goal is to claim more map territory per throw, since the wider cloud forces survivors into longer, less predictable detours. It carries a rare rarity, positioning it as a meaningful upgrade to work toward over time.

Addon_GasBomb_15.name: Garish Makeup Kit
Addon_GasBomb_15.description:
Some for the face and some for the Antidote. The unknown compound intensifies the Antidote's effects.

Increases the duration of Invigoration by 2 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into The Afterpiece Tonic and stretches how long Invigoration lasts once triggered. The effect is purely additive, so it simply extends the existing window without changing how the tonic works.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer Invigoration window keeps Clown's boosted state going for a bit longer once it is active, giving him more time to make use of it before it fades. It reads as a modest tweak rather than a full build shift, but the extra time can still matter in a tight chase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when Clown's build already produces Invigoration often, since the extra duration lets him get more out of the boosted state each time it comes up. It is very rare, so expect a slow grind in the locker before it lands.

Addon_GasBomb_16.name: Cheap Gin Bottle
Addon_GasBomb_16.description:
When the night was rough and the day is rougher, a little hair of the dog will give you a boost.

Increases The Clown's Invigoration by 3%.
