beginner.whatItIs: A very rare offering that sharpens The Clown's own Invigoration while it is active. It slots into The Afterpiece Tonic and boosts the self-buff rather than affecting Survivors.
beginner.whyItMatters: The boost makes each tonic feel punchier on The Clown's side, giving a stronger self-boost that pairs well with follow-up pressure. It is a small numeric nudge, but in extended chases the extra edge adds up quickly.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if the build already revolves around repeated tonic throws and The Clown's own enhanced state. It is very rare, so it is a late-game locker find rather than something to expect early.

Addon_GasBomb_17.name: Ether 15 vol%
Addon_GasBomb_17.description:
A highly volatile organic compound, toxic at this concentration.

Increases the duration of Intoxication by 0.5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Volatile and toxic, the compound stretches how long Intoxication lingers on a hit Survivor. It slots into The Afterpiece Tonic and lengthens the intoxication state without altering anything else about the tonic.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer Intoxication window keeps the target impaired for an extra beat, which can be the difference between a clean chase and a broken one. It reads as a subtle timing tweak rather than a dramatic power shift.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the playstyle relies on Intoxication as a setup for follow-up pressure rather than as a standalone finisher. It is very rare, so patience in the locker is required before it shows up.

Addon_GasBomb_18.name: Cigar Box
Addon_GasBomb_18.description:
A grim and incomplete collection of fingers. Fills The Clown with longing and focuses his chemical crafting abilities.

While The Clown or a Survivor is Invigorated, they see all other Survivor and Killer auras within 6 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: A very rare slot-in for The Afterpiece Tonic that sharpens The Clown's chemical focus. While The Clown or a Survivor holds Invigoration, every other Survivor and Killer aura becomes visible from a short distance.
beginner.whyItMatters: Seeing other Survivor and Killer auras during Invigoration turns a moment of heightened state into a moment of full information, which can expose hiding positions or reveal where the killer is circling. It is a bigger shift than a simple stat bump because it changes what everyone on the board can perceive.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in a build that already triggers Invigoration often, since the aura reveal only pays off while that state is active. It sits in the very-rare tier of the pool, so treat pulling it as a stroke of luck rather than something to plan a build around.

Addon_GasBomb_19.name: Tattoo's Middle Finger
Addon_GasBomb_19.description:
The prized middle finger of a large tattooed man. Has a faint taste of machinery oil.

Auras of Intoxicated or Invigorated Survivors are revealed to you for 6 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Iridescent in rarity, it reveals the auras of Intoxicated or Invigorated Survivors to The Clown for a short window. It slots into The Afterpiece Tonic and turns a state buff into a tracking tool.
beginner.whyItMatters: The aura flash removes the guessing game the moment a Survivor is Intoxicated or Invigorated, letting The Clown pinpoint them through fog of war or around corners. It is a meaningful information play that changes how the chase flows in the seconds after a tonic hit.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the build already produces Intoxication or Invigoration reliably, since the reveal only triggers off those states. It is iridescent, making it one of the hardest to find in the locker.

Addon_GasBomb_20.name: Redhead's Pinky Finger
Addon_GasBomb_20.description:
The prized pinky of a redhead. Faintly fragrant. Tastes of potpourri and varnish.

Direct hits by a bottle of Afterpiece Tonic inflict Exposed until Intoxication ends.Sets maximum number of carried bottles to 1.

Exposed Survivors will be downed by basic attacks even if uninjured.

beginner.whatItIs: The prized pinky of a redhead makes direct tonic hits inflict Exposed on Survivors until Intoxication ends. It also limits The Clown to carrying a single bottle of Afterpiece Tonic, which is a significant constraint alongside the aggressive payoff.
beginner.whyItMatters: Exposed Survivors can be downed by a basic attack even when uninjured, which turns every direct hit into a genuine kill threat rather than just a slow. It is a bigger shift than a stat tweak because it changes the lethality of a single hit and removes the safety net of a full health bar.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when confidence in landing clean tonic hits is high, since carrying only one bottle means a miss is costly. It is iridescent and hard to obtain, so save it for a build already tuned around precision throws.

Addon_Ghost_CheapCologne.name: Cheap Cologne
Addon_Ghost_CheapCologne.description:
Dollar store cologne with a pungent scent of rubbing alcohol. Worn by Ghost Face to make his presence known. Reserved for impromptu visits.

Increases Marked duration by 10 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Common and pungent, it stretches how long the Mark lingers on a targeted Survivor. It slots into Night Shroud and is the easiest add-on to find for this power.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer Mark window gives The Ghost Face more time to close the gap or set up the next action before the marker fades. It is a small but reliable extension that makes the core loop feel smoother without demanding any change in approach.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it as a default early pick for Night Shroud builds, since it is common and simply makes the Mark easier to work with. It pairs well with any add-on that benefits from a longer Mark duration.

Addon_Ghost_ChewedPen.name: Chewed Pen
Addon_Ghost_ChewedPen.description:
Blue pen with a chewed cap that holds traces of Danny’s DNA. Incriminating evidence that was never found.

Survivors that are in the dying state take 3 seconds to reveal The Ghost Face.

beginner.whatItIs: Rare and incriminating, the chewed pen delays the moment a dying Survivor reveals The Ghost Face. It slots into Night Shroud and buys The Ghost Face a few extra seconds of stealth after a kill.
beginner.whyItMatters: Those extra seconds of invisibility can be the gap needed to reposition, hook another Survivor, or escape a risky area without being spotted. It is a modest stealth nudge that matters most in chaotic endgame situations.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when playing a hook-and-run style where surviving the post-kill window is the priority. It is rare, so it is a solid mid-tier locker find for a Night Shroud build.

Addon_Ghost_DriversLicense.name: Driver's License
Addon_Ghost_DriversLicense.description:
A driver’s license revealing Olsen’s true identity: Danny Johnson.

When Marking a Survivor repairing a Generator, the Generator explodes and loses 20% progress.The affected Generator becomes blocked for 15 seconds.When Marking multiple Survivors at the same time, the loss of progress only applies once.

beginner.whatItIs: Very rare, it detonates the generator when Marking a Survivor who is actively repairing. The affected generator also loses progress and becomes blocked for a period, and the penalty applies only once even if multiple Survivors are marked at the same time.
beginner.whyItMatters: Detonating a generator mid-repair rips away accumulated progress and locks the machine shut, forcing the whole team to scatter or walk back for repairs. It lands as a structural disruption to the generator loop rather than a small timing tweak, because it erases work that already happened and reshuffles the team's positioning.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in trials where the map layout packs generators into tight clusters, since the mark triggers the explosion the instant a repairing Survivor is tagged. The locker odds are very rare, so plan a long search before it shows up.

Addon_Ghost_DropLegKnifeSheath.name: Drop-Leg Knife Sheath
Addon_Ghost_DropLegKnifeSheath.description:
Sheath allowing a full motion range: ideal to inflict quick and powerful wounds while moving freely. Stolen from a patrol officer the night Danny left Philadelphia.

The Ghost Face gains 10% movement speed for 5 seconds after Marking a Survivor.

beginner.whatItIs: A very rare sheath granting The Ghost Face a brief burst of movement speed immediately after Marking a Survivor. It slots into Night Shroud and converts the Mark action into a mobility reward.
beginner.whyItMatters: The speed burst lets The Ghost Face close distance or escape a bad position in the instant after marking, which can turn a Mark from a passive marker into an active chase tool. It is a meaningful mobility addition that changes how the killer moves between Mark and attack.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Fit it into a Night Shroud build that marks often, because the speed burst lands the moment a mark connects and helps close distance into a hit. Locker appearances are very rare, so treat it as a long-haul unlock rather than a quick pull.

Addon_Ghost_HeadlinesCutouts.name: Headline Cutouts
Addon_Ghost_HeadlinesCutouts.description:
Cutouts of articles covering unsolved murder cases from Utah to Pennsylvania. While Ghost Face only authored some of the headlines, he committed all the murders.

Compiling your success makes you proud and boosts your confidence.

Increases movement speed while stalking by 40%.

beginner.whatItIs: Common and pride-boosting, it accelerates The Ghost Face's movement speed while in a stalking state. It slots into Night Shroud and makes the stealth approach noticeably faster.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster stalking means The Ghost Face can cross open ground, reposition between buildings, or catch up to a Survivor on the move without breaking stealth. It is a smooth mobility buff that makes the whole power feel more responsive in extended chases.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it as a default pick for any Night Shroud build, since it is common and simply makes stalking feel snappier. It pairs naturally with any add-on that rewards fast movement or quick repositioning.

Addon_Ghost_KnifeBeltClip.name: Knife Belt Clip
Addon_Ghost_KnifeBeltClip.description:
Perfect belt clip to scout carry your blade discreetly. No one knows what you’re planning to do tonight.

Reduces the Terror Radius by 12 meters while crouching.

beginner.whatItIs: Knife Belt Clip slots into Night Shroud and narrows The Ghost Face's reveal distance while crouched, letting it close in on a Survivor before detection kicks in. The tighter radius means a crouch beside a generator or a window no longer betrays the killer's position.
beginner.whyItMatters: A smaller Terror Radius means Survivors are less likely to hear The Ghost Face crouching nearby, which preserves the element of surprise in close-quarters maps. It is a targeted stealth improvement that matters most when The Ghost Face is moving through tight spaces.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it to maps with narrow hallways or when Survivors cluster in tight building corners, where the reduced radius makes a crouch pass far safer. It shows up at rare odds in the locker, so it rewards a dedicated hunt for a stealth-heavy build.

Addon_Ghost_LastingPerfume.name: Lasting Perfume
Addon_Ghost_LastingPerfume.description:
An overpowering musky fragrance worn by Ghost Face to announce his presence. Reserved for victims he planned to write about.

Survivors that are on a hook take 3 seconds to reveal The Ghost Face.

beginner.whatItIs: Lasting Perfume attaches to Night Shroud and holds back how quickly a hooked Survivor can expose The Ghost Face's position. That extra silence after each hook buys the killer time to reposition before detection lands.
beginner.whyItMatters: Those extra hidden seconds after hooking can be the gap needed to move to the next target or reposition before Survivors can coordinate a rescue. It is a modest stealth extension that compounds across multiple hooks in a single trial.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the build relies on rapid hook-and-move sequences where staying hidden between hooks is the priority. It is rare, making it a dependable mid-tier locker find.

Addon_Ghost_LeatherKnifeSheath.name: Leather Knife Sheath
Addon_Ghost_LeatherKnifeSheath.description:
Quiet and flexible sheath to carry your blade. Movement is easier when things are fastened into place.

Increases crouched movement speed by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Leather Knife Sheath clips to Night Shroud and quickens The Ghost Face's crouch-walk, making the slow stalk noticeably faster. Full-speed sprint stays the same, so the bonus only shows up during a low approach.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster crouched movement lets The Ghost Face thread through tight alleys, approach Survivors from unexpected angles, or escape a bad spot while staying crouched. It is a clean mobility buff that makes the stealth loop feel more fluid.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Fit it into a build that prioritizes crouched stalking through tight corridors rather than open-ground sprints. Locker odds sit at rare, so it is a steady find for a stealth-focused Night Shroud setup.

Addon_Ghost_MarkedMap.name: Marked Map
Addon_Ghost_MarkedMap.description:
The annotated map of Northern Roseville, Florida. Each X represents a victim of The Ghost Face. Mapping out your targets allows you to roam the streets undetected.

Increases duration of Killer Instinct after being revealed by 2 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: An uncommon annotated map for Night Shroud that extends the Killer Instinct tracking window after The Ghost Face is spotted. The extra duration gives more time to follow the trail before it fades.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer Killer Instinct window after a reveal gives The Ghost Face more time to lock onto a Survivor's last known position and close the gap. It is a small but meaningful extension that rewards aggressive follow-through after being spotted.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the build already triggers reveals regularly and benefits from extended tracking afterward. It is uncommon, so it should appear in the locker with reasonable frequency.

Addon_Ghost_NightVisionMonocular.name: Night Vision Monocular
Addon_Ghost_NightVisionMonocular.description:
Night vision lens enabling sharp photos even when shrouded in darkness. Ideal for discreet, impromptu visits late at night.

A Survivor that reveals The Ghost Face is inflicted with Exhausted for 10 seconds.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating exhausting perks.

beginner.whatItIs: Night Vision Monocular feeds into Night Shroud and inflicts Exhausted on a Survivor the instant they break Ghost Face's concealment. While Exhausted, that Survivor cannot activate any exhausting perks until the effect wears off.
beginner.whyItMatters: Stripping a Survivor's exhausting perk at the exact moment they try to disengage removes their primary escape tool and turns a near miss into a clean hit. It rewrites the power dynamic at the critical second of a chase break, not just the speed of an individual action.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it against Survivor builds that lean hard on exhausting perks for chase breaks, since the Exhausted state neutralizes exactly that layer of protection. Very rare odds mean a long locker grind before it appears.

Addon_Ghost_OlsensAddressBook.name: Olsen's Address Book
Addon_Ghost_OlsensAddressBook.description:
Filled in blunt, blue crabbed writing. All the Roseville murder victims are listed there, along with their phone number and address.

Survivors that are Marked reveal their auras for 5 seconds when performing rushed actions.

beginner.whatItIs: Uncommon, the address book exposes Marked Survivors by revealing their auras whenever they perform a rushed action. It slots into Night Shroud and turns the Mark into an information trap.
beginner.whyItMatters: The aura flash catches Survivors at the exact instant they are doing something urgent, which can expose a rushed generator sprint, a panic hook rescue, or a frantic pallet loop. It forces Marked Survivors to slow down and plan their next move, turning speed into a liability while the mark is active.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the Survivors are likely to rush generators or hooks under pressure, since the reveal triggers on those high-stakes actions. It is uncommon, so it should be reasonably accessible in the locker.

Addon_Ghost_OlsensJournal.name: Olsen’s Journal
Addon_Ghost_OlsensJournal.description:
A spiral notebook filled with stained, handwritten entries. The journal details different equipment used to stalk victims.

A Survivor that is Marked is inflicted with Oblivious until the Mark expires.

Oblivious prevents Survivors from hearing or being affected by the Killer's Terror Radius.

beginner.whatItIs: The spiral notebook blinds Marked Survivors to the Terror Radius until the Mark expires. It slots into Night Shroud and removes one of the Survivor's core awareness tools for the duration of the Mark.
beginner.whyItMatters: Removing the Terror Radius from a Marked Survivor strips away the early-warning pulse that normally telegraphs The Ghost Face's approach, converting a manageable chase into a blind one. It restructures what the Survivor can perceive during the mark rather than simply slowing them down.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the Survivors are well-coordinated and rely on the Terror Radius to call out The Ghost Face's position. It is uncommon, so it is a dependable mid-tier find for a Night Shroud build.

Addon_Ghost_OlsensWallet.name: Olsen’s Wallet
Addon_Ghost_OlsensWallet.description:
Olsen’s wallet holds thirty dollars in cash, a video club membership card, and a folded picture of Olsen’s first Roseville victim. Carrying incriminating evidence boosts your excitement and resolve.

Whenever you basic-break Pallets or Breakable Walls, instantly recharge Night Shroud.

beginner.whatItIs: Worn and incriminating, it instantly recharges Night Shroud every time The Ghost Face breaks a pallet or breakable wall. It slots into Night Shroud and ties the power's readiness to aggressive map disruption.
beginner.whyItMatters: Instant recharges mean The Ghost Face can mark, break a pallet, and be ready to mark again without waiting, which keeps the pressure loop tight and unpredictable. It is a meaningful tempo shift that rewards active, aggressive play over patient stalking.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the chase loop already revolves around breaking pallets and breakable walls, because every one of those actions instantly refills the Shroud. It sits at rare odds in the locker, making it a dependable find for a pallet-heavy stalking setup.

Addon_Ghost_OutdoorSecurityCamera.name: Outdoor Security Camera
Addon_Ghost_OutdoorSecurityCamera.description:
A small surveillance camera that filmed Ghost Face breaking into a house on Belleview Road in Northern Roseville. The camera was positioned at the perfect angle to catch a glimpse of Ghost Face without providing any real clues to the police.

The auras of all Survivors are revealed for 7 seconds when a Marked Survivor is put into the dying state.

beginner.whatItIs: An iridescent add-on for Night Shroud, built around what happens after a Marked Survivor falls. Downing one of them exposes every survivor's aura for a short window. A single successful hit turns into a read on the whole map.
beginner.whyItMatters: Seeing every Survivor's position the instant one drops into the dying state erases the fog of war and lets The Ghost Face pick the next target with complete knowledge. It reshapes the information board for the entire remainder of the trial, not just the single hook moment.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the build already downs Survivors consistently and profits from knowing where everyone else is hiding on the map. Its iridescent rarity makes it one of the hardest pulls from the locker, so treat it as a long-term goal.

Addon_Ghost_Philly.name: “Philly”
Addon_Ghost_Philly.description:
Stolen camera from a victim of Olsen’s in Philadelphia, where he worked before. The film inside captured his last night in the city.

Decreases time required to Mark a Survivor by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Philly trims the time it takes to Mark a survivor while on the Night Shroud power. The change is a small reduction in the application window.
beginner.whyItMatters: A quicker Mark lets the ghost return to hunting sooner without any change in button pattern, keeping steady pressure on the survivor loop. It reads as a minor tweak rather than a bigger shift in how the power feels.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a build already leans on repeated marks across a match, since the shortened application compounds over many uses. It drops at common rarity, so it is easy to find.

Addon_Ghost_ReusableCinchStraps.name: Cinch Straps
Addon_Ghost_ReusableCinchStraps.description:
Black straps that keep everything in place while on the prowl.

Night Shroud remains active after a failed basic attack.

beginner.whatItIs: Cinch Straps keeps the Night Shroud active even after a basic attack misses. The shroud does not drop on a whiff, which would normally expose the ghost.
beginner.whyItMatters: Losing the shroud on a missed swing opens a window where the killer is fully visible and vulnerable to survivor actions. Keeping it alive through the miss removes that risky gap and makes chases less punishing to play.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it during chases where basic attacks land inconsistently, since it forgives the swings that miss while the ghost stays hidden and mobile. Its uncommon rarity makes it a reasonable find.

Addon_Ghost_TelephotoLens.name: Telephoto Lens
Addon_Ghost_TelephotoLens.description:
A manual focus lens to take pictures from afar without being noticed.

A Survivor that reveals The Ghost Face is inflicted with Oblivious for 60 seconds.

Oblivious prevents Survivors from hearing or being affected by the Killer's Terror Radius.

beginner.whatItIs: Telephoto Lens strikes a survivor with Oblivious the moment they reveal the ghost face, cutting off their hearing of the Terror Radius. The effect persists for a long window.
beginner.whyItMatters: Stripping the auditory warning from a survivor who spots the ghost discourages careless use of reveal tools and removes a key safety net many builds depend on. It reads as a meaningful shift in how survivors must play around the ghost state.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when facing survivor builds that lean on reveal-based perks to stay safe, since it directly neutralizes the benefit of their discovery. Its uncommon rarity makes it a solid pick for an aggressive Night Shroud setup.

Addon_Ghost_TheGhostFaceCaughtOnTape.name: “Ghost Face Caught on Tape”
Addon_Ghost_TheGhostFaceCaughtOnTape.description:
Tape obtained by Olsen to write an article that terrorized Roseville.

Instantly recharges Night Shroud after a successful basic attack that puts a Survivor into the dying state.

beginner.whatItIs: Ghost Face Caught on Tape instantly recharges the Night Shroud the moment a basic attack downs a survivor. There is no recovery wait between the down and the next shroud activation.
beginner.whyItMatters: Normally a successful down leaves the ghost waiting for the shroud to recover before moving on, which creates a dead window where the killer is stationary and exposed. The instant refill bridges that gap and lets the killer keep moving immediately.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a build focuses on landing downs and transitioning to the next victim without pause, since the immediate recharge keeps the offensive rhythm going. Its iridescent rarity makes it a difficult find.

Addon_Ghost_VictimsDetailedRoutine.name: Victim’s Detailed Routine
Addon_Ghost_VictimsDetailedRoutine.description:
A ripped page outlining the weekly routine of Olsen's first victim in Roseville. Compiling your victim's habits allows you to anticipate and counter their next move.

After being Marked, Survivors are inflicted with Exhausted for 5 seconds.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating exhausting perks.

beginner.whatItIs: Victim's Detailed Routine hits a Marked survivor with Exhausted, locking them out of any exhausting perks for a short window. The effect triggers the instant the Mark lands.
beginner.whyItMatters: Many survivors rely on exhausting perks to escape chases or speed away from danger, and blocking those for a few seconds after a Mark can turn a would-be escape into a slow, vulnerable walk. It reads as a meaningful counter to specific survivor builds.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when facing survivor builds that depend on exhausting perks to survive chases, since it removes that safety net right when the survivor is most exposed. Its very rare rarity means patience or luck is required to acquire it.

Addon_Ghost_WalleyesMatchbook.name: Walleye's Matchbook
Addon_Ghost_WalleyesMatchbook.description:
A sheet of matches from Walleye's, a small bar in Northern Roseville. A victim’s phone number is scribbled in blue. One of the incriminating pieces of evidence found.

Decreases Night Shroud recovery time by 2 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Walleye's Matchbook trims a bit off the Night Shroud recovery period. The shroud comes back a little sooner after dropping.
beginner.whyItMatters: A shorter recovery window means the ghost can re-enter the hidden state more quickly, shrinking the stretch where the killer is fully visible to survivors. It is a modest improvement that stacks up over repeated cycles in a trial.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a build cycles the shroud on and off frequently, since every saved moment of recovery adds up across a full match. It comes at common rarity, making it an easy find.

Addon_Harpoon_BarbedWire.name: Barbed Wire
Addon_Harpoon_BarbedWire.description:
Pliable American made steel lined with sharp barbs. Despite its simplicity, Caleb found it could be wrapped around a spear to increase its viciousness.

Increases Survivor mend time by 3.5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Barbed Wire extends how long a speared Survivor needs to mend their wound on The Redeemer power. The Survivor takes longer to treat the spear wound before they are back to full action.
beginner.whyItMatters: Slowing down the mend means a Survivor who breaks free from the spear cannot rely on a quick fix to get back to contributing, which gives the killer more breathing room to re aim and hunt the next target. It reads as a moderate shift in how long the aftermath of a spear hit lasts.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when facing Survivor builds that mend quickly and often, since the added delay makes each spear hit cost more of their time. Its very rare rarity makes it a challenging find.

Addon_Harpoon_BayshoresCigar.name: Bayshore’s Cigar
Addon_Harpoon_BayshoresCigar.description:
A quality cigar, plucked from the jacket of Caleb’s boss while he wailed over the spear lodged in his abdomen.

Decreases the stun duration when Survivors break free by 0.75 second.

beginner.whatItIs: Bayshore's Cigar shortens the stun a survivor experiences after breaking free from a spear. The recovery window after escape is slightly reduced.
beginner.whyItMatters: A shorter stun works against the killer's interest by giving the escaping survivor a quicker return to full movement and action. It reads as a small trade-off rather than a meaningful boost to the killer's toolkit.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Since it removes a sliver of the killer's control after a successful spear, equip it only when a set effect or bundle pairs it with something that offsets the loss. Its very rare rarity means it is not an easy find.

Addon_Harpoon_BayshoresGoldTooth.name: Bayshore’s Gold Tooth
Addon_Harpoon_BayshoresGoldTooth.description:
A golden tooth torn from Henry Bayshore as he screamed for mercy, hours before he was finished off.

Increases The Redeemer's reeling speed by 5%.

beginner.whatItIs: Bayshore's Gold Tooth boosts the reeling speed used to pull a speared survivor back toward the killer. The entire hook-and-pull cycle feels snappier.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster reeling means the survivor spends less time dangling and more time being dragged, which tightens the window where they can struggle free. It reads as a small but noticeable improvement to the post-spear phase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a build leans on spearing survivors and reeling them in quickly, since the extra speed keeps the cycle tight and reduces the gap where a survivor might escape. It drops at rare rarity.

Addon_Harpoon_ChewingTobacco.name: Chewing Tobacco
Addon_Harpoon_ChewingTobacco.description:
A can of clipped and sweetened tobacco leaves lifted from a gutted body in Glenvale. Stimulates the nervous system.

Decreases the stun duration when Survivors break free by 0.25 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Chewing Tobacco trims a touch from the break-free stun on The Redeemer power. The effect is similar in shape to Bayshore's Cigar but smaller in magnitude.
beginner.whyItMatters: Like Bayshore's Cigar, this works against the killer by giving the escaping survivor a slightly quicker return to full action. It reads as a minor trade-off that is easier to absorb than the cigar version.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it only when a set or bundle effect makes the trade worthwhile, since on its own it removes a small piece of the killer's post-spear control. Its uncommon rarity makes it moderately easy to find.

Addon_Harpoon_ClearCreekWhiskey.name: Gold Creek Whiskey
Addon_Harpoon_ClearCreekWhiskey.description:
Warm comfort in a bottle that quelled Caleb’s anger and slowed his step.

Decreases Terror Radius by 8 meters while aiming down The Redeemer's sights.

beginner.whatItIs: Gold Creek Whiskey shrinks the Terror Radius while the killer is aiming down The Redeemer's sights. The auditory warning to nearby survivors gets smaller during the aim phase.
beginner.whyItMatters: A quieter aim phase is the core value here, since a tighter radius strips the early auditory cue that alerts nearby survivors to a setup shot. The adjustment is modest on its own, but across a full match every silenced spear conversion compounds and keeps the killer ahead of the group. It feels like a small dial turned down rather than a new tool added to the kit.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a build prioritizes landing surprise spears from a closer range, since the reduced radius gives the killer a quieter approach. It appears at very rare rarity, so patience is required.

Addon_Harpoon_HellshireIron.name: Hellshire Iron
Addon_Harpoon_HellshireIron.description:
The Hellshire Gang’s branding iron. Despite folklore, it never made its mark on new initiates, instead having been used to brand particularly quarrelsome bounties.

When a Survivor is speared, gain Undetectable. The effect persists for 10 seconds after the Survivor is no longer speared.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius and Red Stain.

beginner.whatItIs: Hellshire Iron grants Undetectable to the killer the moment a Survivor is speared, hiding the killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain for a while after the Survivor is no longer speared. The invisibility lingers past the moment the spear lets go.
beginner.whyItMatters: That post-spear invisibility lets the killer reposition or hunt the next target without survivors tracking the aura, which is a significant shift in how the killer moves between hooks. It reads as a bigger change than most other add-ons for The Redeemer.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in lobbies where survivors carry aura-tracking tools that let them back away the instant a spear connects, because the Undetectable window opens right as the hit lands and covers the follow-up reposition. The iridescent pool rarely rolls it into a case, so treat it as a strong situational pick for those specific matchups rather than a default slot.

Addon_Harpoon_HoneyLocustThorns.name: Honey Locust Thorns
Addon_Harpoon_HoneyLocustThorns.description:
Angered with a bounty who fled twice before, Caleb twisted thorn branches onto a spear and let it loose.

Breaking free from the spear inflicts Mangled for 70 seconds.

Mangled increases time required to heal by 25% and lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

beginner.whatItIs: Honey Locust Thorns inflicts Mangled on a survivor who breaks free from a spear, slowing their mending for a long stretch. The debuff lasts until the survivor is fully healed or the duration runs out.
beginner.whyItMatters: A survivor who pulls free from the spear normally regroups and resumes repair work within moments. The Mangled condition stretches that recovery window, keeping them slower at every heal table for the rest of the match. The shift lands on the post-escape phase, where most chases are won or lost by who can keep working while the killer rotates.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when facing survivor builds that rely on fast mends to stay functional after being hooked, since it punishes the escape with a prolonged debuff. It drops at rare rarity.

Addon_Harpoon_IridescentCoin.name: Iridescent Coin
Addon_Harpoon_IridescentCoin.description:
A glass-like coin molded from The Fog itself. Payment to the bounty hunter for services rendered.

Survivors speared from at least 12 meters away are inflicted with Exposed for as long as they remain speared.

Exposed survivors will be downed by basic attacks even if uninjured.

beginner.whatItIs: Iridescent Coin marks a survivor as Exposed when speared from a long distance, meaning a basic attack downs them even if they are not yet injured. The exposure lasts as long as they remain speared.
beginner.whyItMatters: That long-range exposure turns a distant spear into a guaranteed down on the next swing, which changes the risk calculus for survivors trying to run from a hook rather than break free. It reads as a bigger shift in how the spear interaction plays at range.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a build favors spearing from range and following up with a basic attack, since it removes the survivor's usual escape of staying uninjured. It appears at iridescent rarity, so it is a long-shot acquire.

Addon_Harpoon_JawSmasher.name: Jaw Smasher
Addon_Harpoon_JawSmasher.description:
The bullet that ripped through Caleb’s jaw during a frenzied shootout. It brings back a burning desire for revenge.

Increases movement speed by 1.5% while aiming down The Redeemer's sights.

beginner.whatItIs: Jaw Smasher nudges the killer's movement speed up slightly while aiming down The Redeemer's sights. The boost is small but applies during the entire aim phase.
beginner.whyItMatters: A small speed boost during aim helps the killer close gaps or adjust positioning while tracking a moving survivor, which can be the difference between landing a spear and missing. It reads as a minor tweak to the chase tempo.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when chases involve a lot of repositioning while aiming, since the extra pace keeps the killer in range longer. It drops at uncommon rarity, so it is not hard to come by.

Addon_Harpoon_MarshalsBadge.name: Marshal's Badge
Addon_Harpoon_MarshalsBadge.description:
A silver badge taken from the corpse of a lawman in Arizona Territory who interfered with the Hellshire Gang’s bounties.

Decreases Terror Radius by 4 meters while aiming down The Redeemer's sights.

beginner.whatItIs: Marshal's Badge trims the Terror Radius during the aiming phase of The Redeemer power. The auditory warning to nearby survivors shrinks while the killer lines up a shot.
beginner.whyItMatters: A reduced terror radius during aim lets the killer approach survivors more stealthily while setting up a spear, cutting the cue that would otherwise tip off nearby survivors. It reads as a small but useful improvement to the stealth of the aim phase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Fit it into a build that relies on lining up spear shots from behind cover or at the edge of a survivor loop, because the reduced radius keeps the audio cue quieter during the critical aiming window. The uncommon pool surfaces it often enough to make it a steady option for that stealthy approach without competing for rare rolls.

Addon_Harpoon_ModifiedAmmoBelt.name: Modified Ammo Belt
Addon_Harpoon_ModifiedAmmoBelt.description:
An old ammo belt Caleb altered for his specialized weaponry. Still holds the fine red dirt of the Arizona Territory desert.

Decreases The Redeemer's reload time by 0.25 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Modified Ammo Belt shaves a little time off the reload period for The Redeemer power. The killer can fire again a little sooner after emptying the current load.
beginner.whyItMatters: A faster reload means less vulnerable time between shots, which keeps pressure on the survivor without a long gap where they can reposition or mend. It reads as a small tweak to the offensive rhythm.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a build relies on rapid follow-up shots after a miss, since the shortened reload keeps the tempo going. It comes at common rarity, making it simple to find.

Addon_Harpoon_PoisonOakLeaves.name: Poison Oak Leaves
Addon_Harpoon_PoisonOakLeaves.description:
An ordinary looking plant, Caleb found that spears coated in its oil caused unbearable blistering around wounds.

Increases Survivor mend time by 1.5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Poison Oak Leaves adds time to a survivor's mend duration while they remain speared. The effect is similar in shape to Barbed Wire but smaller in magnitude.
beginner.whyItMatters: Slowing mends on a hooked survivor means they spend more time vulnerable and less time getting back to contributing, which stretches out the killer's advantage between hooks. It reads as a modest improvement to the hook phase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it into lobbies where the opposing side leans on quick mends to recover between hits, since the extra delay on every heal compounds across the whole match and makes each spear trade cost more output. It comes from the uncommon pool, so most cases will offer it without demanding a rare roll to secure the slot.

Addon_Harpoon_PrisonChain.name: Prison Chain
Addon_Harpoon_PrisonChain.description:
A thick, heavy chain that once held a steel ball and latched to Caleb’s ankle. It’s been repurposed to hook onto a spear.

Increases time required for a Survivor to break free from a spear by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Prison Chain extends the time a survivor needs to break free from a spear on The Redeemer power. The struggle lasts longer before the survivor escapes.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer struggle keeps the survivor pinned on the ground instead of scrambling back to a generator, which gives the killer a wider window to close distance or reposition for the next attack. The effect sits squarely in the hook phase, the moment where a chase decides whether the follow-up lands or the target breaks free. Because the veryrare pool rarely rolls it, most matches will pass without it, but when it does appear it converts a single spear into noticeably longer downtime.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a build wants to maximize the time a survivor spends hooked, since the extended break-free window keeps pressure on for longer. It drops at very rare rarity, making it a hard find.

Addon_Harpoon_RicketyChain.name: Rickety Chain
Addon_Harpoon_RicketyChain.description:
Weak steel links first used on Caleb's prototype Speargun. Despite the chain's failings, it holds sentimental value.

Grants 50% bonus Bloodpoints for Speared score events.Survivors break free 33% faster.

beginner.whatItIs: Rickety Chain grants bonus Bloodpoints for spearing score events while also letting survivors break free faster. It is a trade-off add-on that favors collection over control.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra Bloodpoints help with long-term progression, but the faster break-free works against the killer by giving survivors a quicker escape from the hook. It reads as a deliberate trade rather than a straight improvement.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when collecting Bloodpoints is a priority and the build can afford a slightly shorter hook duration, since the bonus rewards repeated successful spears. It appears at common rarity, so it is simple to acquire.

Addon_Harpoon_RustedSpike.name: Rusted Spike
Addon_Harpoon_RustedSpike.description:
A railroad spike that Caleb fastened to the front of the Speargun during a moment of morbid curiosity. The dull tip prevents it from cleanly piercing its target.

Hitting a Survivor with The Redeemer while they are being reeled in inflicts Mangled for 60 seconds.

Mangled increases time required to heal by 25% for a set duration or until fully healed.

beginner.whatItIs: A blunted spike add-on for The Redeemer that dulls the tip of the speargun. Landing a hit on a survivor who is already being reeled in applies Mangled, which stretches out any healing they start.
beginner.whyItMatters: The penalty turns an already-dangerous moment into a compounding one, since a reeled survivor who escapes still bleeds time on their next heal. It is a modest shift that rewards a committed double hit rather than changing the whole power.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a chase ends with the survivor on the wire, because a second contact while the reel is active is exactly when the spike bites. It is uncommon, so it should be easy enough to find in a locker rotation.

Addon_Harpoon_SnakeOil.name: Snake Oil
Addon_Harpoon_SnakeOil.description:
A tincture of oils and extracts purchased from a travelling salesman. Purported to cure all that ails you.

Increases The Redeemer's reeling speed by 2.5%.

beginner.whatItIs: Snake Oil is a tincture add-on for The Redeemer that slightly increases the speed at which the speargun reels in a speared Survivor. The change is small and steady, shaving a little time off every reel.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster reeling means the window to punish a struggling survivor closes a beat sooner, which matters most when the team is trying to heal through the wire. It is a small tweak, not a structural change to how the power works.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if you want a reliable edge on every reel without changing aim or positioning habits. It is common, so it is easy to find and easy to default to when nothing better is in the locker.

Addon_Harpoon_SpitPolishRag.name: Spit Polish Rag
Addon_Harpoon_SpitPolishRag.description:
A grimy piece of burlap. Spit and elbow grease was enough to wipe down the speargun in the heat of a shootout.

Decreases The Redeemer's miss cooldown by 0.25 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: A burlap rag add-on for The Redeemer that trims a small amount of time off the cooldown after a missed shot. The weapon is ready again just a touch sooner, which keeps the rhythm of whiff-and-retry tighter.
beginner.whyItMatters: A shorter penalty after a miss means a survivor who dodges at the last moment gets less breathing room before the next attempt. It is a minor quality-of-life improvement rather than a shift in how the power plays.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in any trial where aim feels a fraction off and the weapon needs to be ready sooner after a near miss. It is common, so it is a safe and accessible pick for early experimentation.

Addon_Harpoon_TinOilCan.name: Tin Oil Can
Addon_Harpoon_TinOilCan.description:
A can holding a small amount of oil to reduce friction in machinery. Early models of the Speargun were notorious for jamming, and oil had to be readily available.

Decreases The Redeemer's miss cooldown by 0.5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: The oil can add-on for The Redeemer cuts the miss cooldown by a noticeably larger margin than the rag does. Each whiffed shot leaves a shorter gap before the speargun is ready again.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra forgiveness matters most in chases where a survivor loops through pallets and a shot is missed by inches every time. It is a meaningful upgrade over the common rag, though it still operates within the same framework.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the rag is in hand but a bigger slice of that cooldown is needed, especially against survivors who break line of sight at the last moment. It is rare, so it takes a bit more luck to pull from a locker.

Addon_Harpoon_WantedPoster.name: Wanted Poster
Addon_Harpoon_WantedPoster.description:
The yellowed remains of a wanted poster for Mason Kelly. Kept Caleb focused on the hunt.

Increases movement speed by 3% while aiming down The Redeemer's sights.

beginner.whatItIs: The wanted poster add-on for The Redeemer increases the killer's movement speed while aiming down the speargun's sights. It makes lining up a shot from range a little less punishing if the target is moving.
beginner.whyItMatters: Closing distance while the sights are up means less time exposed in a static, easy-to-dodge position. It is a modest but useful shift for a power that already asks the killer to stop and aim.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a chase stretches into open ground and tracking a running survivor while keeping the weapon ready feels too slow. It is rare, so it is worth grabbing if the locker offers it during a long session.

Addon_Harpoon_WardensKeys.name: Warden’s Keys
Addon_Harpoon_WardensKeys.description:
The dull jangle of the keys evokes a furious memory within Caleb.

Decreases The Redeemer's reload time by 0.35 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: The keys add-on for The Redeemer shortens the reload time after the speargun fires. The weapon cycles back to ready a little faster, which tightens the gap between shots in a sustained chase.
beginner.whyItMatters: A quicker reload makes the follow-up hit easier to land when a survivor dodges the first spear. It is a small but reliable improvement that rewards the same aiming skill, just with less downtime in between.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when you want a smoother rhythm of aim, fire, reload, and aim again during long chases. It is rare, so it is a solid pick whenever the locker turns it up alongside the common cooldown trims.

Addon_Hatchet_AmanitaToxin.name: Amanita Toxin
Addon_Hatchet_AmanitaToxin.description:
A toxin applied to the Hatchets' blade. The Amanita mushrooms' toxin numbs the mind.

Hatchets inflict Blindness for 60 seconds.

Blindness prevents Survivors from seeing auras.

beginner.whatItIs: Worn toxin applied to the Hunting Hatchets blade blinds any survivor it strikes, stripping their ability to see auras for a set duration. The effect is a control tool that cuts off the team's shared awareness.
beginner.whyItMatters: A blind survivor cannot call out generator auras or coordinate rescues, which ripples outward across the whole team's decision-making. It is a meaningful shift for a power that otherwise deals single-target damage.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Slot it in when the team keeps healing at a distance and a single throw can silence every aura they are watching, because blindness strips that information the instant a Hatchet lands. Its common drop rate means a locker visit will surface it quickly, so treat it as a dependable default for a control-oriented build.

Addon_Hatchet_BandagedHaft.name: Bandaged Haft
Addon_Hatchet_BandagedHaft.description:
First-aid bandages securely rolled and attached to the Hatchets' haft.

Decreases Hatchet throw cooldown by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Worn bandages wrapped around the Hunting Hatchets hafts trim the cooldown between throws. Each hatchet returns to hand a little faster, keeping the pressure on a fleeing survivor without changing how the throw itself works.
beginner.whyItMatters: A shorter cooldown means more chances to land a hit during a single chase, which is most useful when a survivor is vaulting and looping around pallets. It is a small but consistent improvement to the power's tempo.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Reach for it when a survivor keeps resetting the chase after every throw and the faster cooldown recovery means another Hatchet is ready before they vault back behind cover. Being common, it shows up in lockers frequently enough to serve as a go-to tempo pick while learning the power's rhythm.

Addon_Hatchet_BegrimedHead.name: Begrimed Head
Addon_Hatchet_BegrimedHead.description:
These Hatchets' heads are stained with a foul substance that afflict anyone it touches with debilities.

Hit target suffers from the Mangled and Hemorrhage status effects for 80 seconds.

Hemorrhage regresses healing progress when not healing, and increases blood trails left by injured survivors. This lasts for a set duration or until healed.

Mangled increases time required to heal by 25% and lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

beginner.whatItIs: Bare and stained hatchet heads that apply both Mangled and Hemorrhage to any survivor they hit. The pair of penalties makes healing slower and leaks a stronger blood trail for a set duration.
beginner.whyItMatters: Hitting a survivor twice in one trial is no longer required to apply meaningful pressure, since a single throw now does double duty. It is a bigger shift than the single-debuff options and plays more like a dedicated punish tool.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a survivor is mid-heal and the goal is to both slow their recovery and mark their position with a single throw. It is very rare, so it is a reward for long sessions rather than something to expect in a fresh locker.

Addon_Hatchet_BerusToxin.name: Yellowed Cloth
Addon_Hatchet_BerusToxin.description:
A simple scrap of material to tend to blisters and wipe the puss away.

Increases thrown hatchet speed by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Coarse cloth wrapped around the handle of a thrown hatchet increases its speed in flight. The hatchet arrives at the target a moment sooner, which is hard to dodge at close range.
beginner.whyItMatters: A faster projectile is harder for a survivor to react to, especially when they are vaulting or turning a corner. It is a small tweak that rewards clean aim over reaction time.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when chases feel like they end on dodges rather than misses, and the hatchet needs to reach the target before a pivot. It is common, so it should be easy to find in a fresh locker.

Addon_Hatchet_CoarseStone.name: Coarse Stone
Addon_Hatchet_CoarseStone.description:
This stone is too coarse to do any good. A blade damaged by it inflicts awful open wounds.

Hitting a target increases the volume of their grunts of pain by 50% until healed.

beginner.whatItIs: Rough residue left on the Hunting Hatchets blade causes any struck survivor to emit noticeably louder grunts of pain. The amplified sound persists until the survivor is healed, turning each successful hit into a brief tracking cue.
beginner.whyItMatters: Loud grunts turn a hit survivor into a moving beacon, which helps when the team is spread across the map and the injured one is hard to spot. It is a small but useful information tool layered on top of the base damage.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the goal is to keep track of a hit survivor after they break line of sight, especially in dense parts of a map. It is common, so it is a dependable pick whenever the locker presents it.

Addon_Hatchet_DeerskinGloves.name: Deerskin Gloves
Addon_Hatchet_DeerskinGloves.description:
Cured leather gloves that protect the hands and give a sure grip.

Decreases time required to reload Hatchets at a locker by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: Cured leather gloves that give the Huntress a sure grip, reducing the time needed to reload Hunting Hatchets at a locker. The reload is noticeably faster, which matters when juggling a full set of hatchets.
beginner.whyItMatters: A quicker locker reload means less downtime between chases, especially when the killer is running between generators and picking off isolated survivors. It is a small but consistent quality-of-life improvement for the power.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it to lockers when the Hatchet supply runs dry mid-trial and a faster reload at the locker means less downtime between chases. As a rare drop it will not appear in every cabinet, so grab it the moment one offers the chance.

Addon_Hatchet_FineStone.name: Weighted Head
Addon_Hatchet_FineStone.description:
An oddly weighted hatchet head, crafted to deliver a hard blow to its target. It requires a wielder with a strong arm.

Hatchets inflict Incapacitated for 10 seconds.

Incapacitated prevents Survivors from healing, repairing, sabotaging, cleansing, blessing, mending, or using items.

beginner.whatItIs: Weighted Head is an oddly weighted hatchet add-on for Hunting Hatchets that inflicts Incapacitated on hit, stopping the target from healing, repairing, or doing other survival actions for a short duration. It is a control tool that shuts down whatever action the Survivor was in the middle of.
beginner.whyItMatters: A moment of full lockdown can interrupt a critical heal or a generator burst, which turns a single hatchet hit into a team-wide disruption. It is a bigger shift than the debuff-only options and plays more like a utility tool.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Look for it when a survivor is deep into a generator or a heal and one solid throw can sever that action mid-motion, leaving them stranded at the station. Uncommon rarity keeps it within reach across a few locker checks without demanding a very long search.

Addon_Hatchet_FlowerBabushka.name: Flower Babushka
Addon_Hatchet_FlowerBabushka.description:
A clean and colorful kerchief adorned with a flower pattern. This memory of a lost little one fills the Huntress with rage and focus.

Decreases time required to wind up a Hatchet throw by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Flower Babushka slots into Hunting Hatchets and shortens the wind-up before a Hatchet is thrown. The release comes quicker, giving a survivor less time to react to the incoming throw.
beginner.whyItMatters: A shorter wind-up means the hatchet leaves the hand sooner after the decision to throw, which matters most against survivors who break at the last moment. It is a small but noticeable improvement to the power's responsiveness.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when chases feel like they hinge on split-second vaults and the hatchet needs to leave the hand a beat earlier. It is rare, so it is a nice find to slot in when the locker presents it.

Addon_Hatchet_GlowingConcoction.name: Glowing Concoction
Addon_Hatchet_GlowingConcoction.description:
An otherworldly concoction that faintly glows a foreboding light.

Reveals the auras of Survivors hit by Hatchets for 5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Gleaming otherworldly liquid that coats the hatchet blade and reveals the auras of any survivor it hits for a brief moment. The flash of light gives the killer a short window to track the target even after they vanish behind cover.
beginner.whyItMatters: A brief aura reveal turns a single hit into a tracking tool, which is valuable when the team is spreading out and the struck survivor is hard to pin down. It is a meaningful shift that adds an information layer to the power.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Reach for it when a struck survivor vanishes into a wall section or a vent and the brief aura glow returns the positional information the hit just cost. Very rare status means it will not appear in most lockers, so build around it only when one actually surfaces.

Addon_Hatchet_InfantryBelt.name: Infantry Belt
Addon_Hatchet_InfantryBelt.description:
A sturdy utility belt pillaged from a soldier. He was quick in combat, but she was quicker.

Hatchet hits grant 3% Haste for 5 seconds.

Haste increases Killer movement speed.

beginner.whatItIs: Plain soldier's belt that grants a short burst of Haste to the Huntress whenever a hatchet lands. The speed boost lasts only a few seconds but is enough to close a small gap in a chase.
beginner.whyItMatters: A brief speed kick after a hit can turn a near-miss into a caught survivor, especially when the chase is stretching across open ground. It is a modest shift that rewards landing hits rather than missing them.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the map opens up after a chase breaks and the brief speed boost from a landing throw closes the gap before the survivor reaches the next pallet. Very rare availability makes it a fortunate locker pull rather than something to plan a routine around.

Addon_Hatchet_IridescentHead.name: Iridescent Head
Addon_Hatchet_IridescentHead.description:
A glass-like Hatchet head molded from The Fog Itself. The blade is warm and reverberating with The Entity's power.

Successful Hatchet hits immediately put healthy Survivors into the dying state.Sets maximum number of carried Hatchets to 1.

beginner.whatItIs: Woven glass-like hatchet head molded from The Fog that puts healthy survivors into the dying state on a single hit. It also limits the Huntress to carrying just one hatchet at a time.
beginner.whyItMatters: The trade-off is dramatic: one guaranteed kill per hatchet instead of the usual two-strike damage, which changes the entire rhythm of the power. It is a far bigger shift than any other add-on here and plays more like a different weapon.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if a one-hit-kill trade feels right and giving up the second hatchet is an acceptable cost. It is iridescent, so it is a rare collection reward rather than something to expect in regular locker pulls.

Addon_Hatchet_LeatherLoop.name: Leather Loop
Addon_Hatchet_LeatherLoop.description:
The right tool in the right hands is key to a successful hunt.

Hatchet hits grant 2% Haste for 5 seconds.

Haste increases Killer movement speed.

beginner.whatItIs: Polished leather loop wrapped around the hatchet handle that grants a brief burst of Haste on hit. The speed boost is short and gentle, just enough to nudge a chase forward after a successful throw.
beginner.whyItMatters: Even a small speed kick after a hit can close the gap on a survivor who just vaulted away, which matters in a power that depends on follow-up throws. It is a modest shift that keeps the chase feeling tight.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the goal is a reliable small reward for landing throws, especially in chases that stretch across open ground. It is uncommon, so it is reasonably accessible and a good default for a speed-focused Hatchet build.

Addon_Hatchet_MannaGrassBraid.name: Manna Grass Braid
Addon_Hatchet_MannaGrassBraid.description:
A circular decorative braid made from manna grass. This memory of a lost little one fills the Huntress with rage and focus.

Decreases time required to wind up a Hatchet throw by 5%.

beginner.whatItIs: Aged braid of manna grass tied around the hatchet that trims a small slice of the wind-up time before release. The throw animates out just a touch faster, which tightens the decision-to-throw window.
beginner.whyItMatters: The shorter wind-up matters most in tight loop fights where a survivor is already committed to a vault and the extra beat of release timing is the difference between a clean hit and a whiff. It is a modest but consistent tempo gain that keeps the throw feeling responsive throughout a trial.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick it up when chases end in last-moment vaults and the throw needs to leave the hand just a touch earlier to connect. Uncommon rarity keeps it within easy reach at a locker, making it a practical upgrade for any Huntress who wants crisper timing.

Addon_Hatchet_OakHaft.name: Oak Haft
Addon_Hatchet_OakHaft.description:
A polished haft which allows for a quick and sly manipulation of the deadly tool.

Decreases Hatchet throw cooldown by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: Waxed oak haft on the Hunting Hatchets that cuts the throw cooldown by a meaningful margin. Each hatchet returns to hand noticeably faster, which keeps the pressure rolling across a chase.
beginner.whyItMatters: A shorter cooldown feeds directly into chase tempo, because more available throws mean the killer can re-engage a resetting survivor without waiting for the base recovery. It reads as a meaningful shift in how the power sustains pressure across an entire trial.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the goal is more throws in the same window and the power's base animation feels comfortable. It is uncommon, so it is a dependable pick to slot in whenever the locker offers it.

Addon_Hatchet_PungentFiale.name: Soldier's Puttee
Addon_Hatchet_PungentFiale.description:
A wrap taken from a dead soldier, it provides protection and support to the ankle and lower leg.

The Huntress moves 4.6 m/s when she has no Hatchets.

beginner.whatItIs: An add-on for Hunting Hatchets that keeps The Huntress moving at a solid pace even when her hands are empty. It removes the slow-foot penalty she normally carries between throws.
beginner.whyItMatters: The Huntress is naturally slower on foot, and this add-on removes that handicap during the long stretches between hatchet throws. It turns her from a sluggish stalker into a steady pursuer who can keep pace with a running survivor.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when The Huntress needs to close distance on foot rather than lean on thrown hatchets. It is an iridescent drop, so expect to wait a while before it shows up in the pool.

Addon_Hatchet_RustyHead.name: Rusty Head
Addon_Hatchet_RustyHead.description:
These Hatchets' heads are covered with crusty and volatile rust spots that makes injuries particularly difficult to heal.

Hatchets inflict Mangled for 70 seconds.

Mangled increases time required to heal by 25% and lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

beginner.whatItIs: Rust-coated blades for Hunting Hatchets that leave struck survivors with wounds dragging out their healing. The debuff holds until the survivor finishes healing.
beginner.whyItMatters: Survivors rely on healing to get back in the fight, and dragging that out keeps them pinned at a bench or hook longer. The change shifts hook fights in the killer's favor, since every pause the survivor takes costs them ground.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it against survivors who lean on quick self-repairs or fast healers, since the extra time on the bench compounds in prolonged hook fights. It is a rare drop, so it will not show up every game.

Addon_Hatchet_ShinyPin.name: Shiny Pin
Addon_Hatchet_ShinyPin.description:
A copper pin defaced beyond recognition yet polished to a high sheen. Pillaged from a particularly difficult prey.

Increases The Huntress' movement speed by 5% while aiming or throwing a Hatchet.

beginner.whatItIs: A polished copper pin that slots into Hunting Hatchets and nudges The Huntress' step faster while she aims or throws. The boost only lasts during the motion itself.
beginner.whyItMatters: A quicker step during the throw motion lets her line up shots and reposition a beat sooner. It matters most in open-ground chases where repositioning between throws keeps her off a survivor's loop.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when The Huntress is chasing across open ground and needs to keep moving between each hatchet throw. It is an uncommon drop, so it should surface fairly often in the pool.

Addon_Hatchet_VenomousConcoction.name: Venomous Concoction
Addon_Hatchet_VenomousConcoction.description:
A toxic concoction applied to the Hatchets' blade. The murky concoction is mainly composed of Berus snake venom which gives it fatiguing capabilities.

Hatchets inflict Exhausted for 5 seconds.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating exhausting perks.

beginner.whatItIs: Snake-venom residue for Hunting Hatchets that briefly locks a struck survivor out of their exhausting perks. The window is short but shuts off the escape burst at the worst moment.
beginner.whyItMatters: Many survivors save their speed perks for the worst second of a chase, and cutting that window means their escape tool stays locked the instant a hatchet connects. It targets burst-speed builds specifically rather than changing the power's core behavior.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it against survivors who run on short-burst speed perks, since the lockout lands hardest in a straight chase where they would normally dash away. It is a rare drop, so plan for it to appear only sometimes.

Addon_Hatchet_YewSeedBrew.name: Wooden Fox
Addon_Hatchet_YewSeedBrew.description:
Roughly carved, this fox statuette is no more than a few inches. A reminder that stealth and cunning is as effective as raw power.

Grants Undetectable for 30 seconds after reloading.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

beginner.whatItIs: A carved fox statuette that threads onto Hunting Hatchets and grants full stealth the moment The Huntress finishes reloading. While active, her aura, terror ring, and red stain all vanish from survivor view.
beginner.whyItMatters: Vanishing from a survivor's radar right after a reload punishes anyone who camps near a hook or generator. It is a big shift in how the reload moment plays, since survivors lose both the visual and audio cues they use to track her position.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when The Huntress wants to reload in the open and reappear closer to a hook or generator. It is a very rare drop, so it will be a long time before it shows up.

Addon_Hatchet_YewSeedConcoction.name: Rose Root
Addon_Hatchet_YewSeedConcoction.description:
Dried petals that relieve symptoms of fatigue and overexertion when brewed in a tea.

Increases thrown Hatchet speed by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: Dried petals brewed into a tea for Hunting Hatchets, making each thrown hatchet travel noticeably faster. The boost applies to every throw, not just the first.
beginner.whyItMatters: A quicker projectile closes the gap with a running survivor before they can react, which is most useful on longer throws across open map space. The improvement is small but consistent, nudging the power's range without changing its identity.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when The Huntress favors landing hatchets from a distance rather than in point-blank range. It is a rare drop, so expect it to appear only now and then.

Addon_HillbillyChainsaw_IridescentBrick.name: Filthy Slippers
Addon_HillbillyChainsaw_IridescentBrick.description:
Max sometimes struggled to hear his mother’s footfalls.

After maintaining a Chainsaw Sprint for 2 seconds, grants Undetectable until the Chainsaw Sprint ends.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

beginner.whatItIs: An add-on for the Chainsaw that lets The Hillbilly vanish from all survivor detection once his chainsaw sprint gets rolling. His aura, terror ring, and red stain all disappear for the rest of the sprint.
beginner.whyItMatters: A chainsaw chase is the loudest and most obvious tool in the game, and hiding his entire presence during the sprint makes the pursuit far harder to track. It is a big shift in how a chainsaw chase plays out, since survivors lose every visual and audio cue at once.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when The Hillbilly wants a chainsaw pursuit to feel untrackable down long straightaways. As a very rare drop, it will not show up in most games.

Addon_K22Power_1.name: Cat Figurine
Addon_K22Power_1.description:
A wooden figure that had caught young Victor's eye. He shrieked until his mother stole it from the market, nearly blowing their cover.

Displays the target location of a Pounce.

beginner.whatItIs: A small wooden figure that slots into Blood Bond and paints a marker on the ground showing where Victor will land when his Pounce fires. It removes the guesswork from aiming the move.
beginner.whyItMatters: Knowing precisely where the pounce will drop turns a missed shot into a reliable tool in a chase. The fix is small but dependable, smoothing out the power's aiming without adding a new mechanic.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if Victor often misses where a pounce lands, since a common drop makes it easy to find early. It smooths out the aiming without adding any new tool to the power.

Addon_K22Power_10.name: Rusted Needle
Addon_K22Power_10.description:
A needle Madeleine used to sew up her children’s tattered clothes.

Crushing Victor when attached inflicts Hemorrhage until healed.

Hemorrhage regresses healing progress when not healing, and increases blood trails left by injured Survivors. This lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

beginner.whatItIs: Rusted Needle attaches to Blood Bond and causes Victor's crush to inflict Hemorrhage, a condition that steadily erodes healing progress the instant a survivor stops bandaging. Injured survivors also leave a much more obvious trail in their wake.
beginner.whyItMatters: A survivor who panics and pauses their heal starts losing ground on that heal, which pressures them to commit fully and makes hook escapes more fragile. The change targets sloppy healing specifically rather than shifting the power's overall tempo.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in hook-heavy games where you want to punish survivors who hesitate mid-heal. As a rare drop, expect it to surface only in select games.

Addon_K22Power_11.name: Sewer Sludge
Addon_K22Power_11.description:
A disgusting, sticky mixture that covered the Deshayes during an escape attempt through the city sewers.

Increases time to crush Victor when attached by 2 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Sewer Sludge threads onto Blood Bond and makes it take a Survivor longer to crush Victor once he has latched onto them. That extra time keeps the Survivor pinned in the struggle for longer before Victor can be thrown off.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer crush time keeps a Survivor locked in the struggle against Victor for longer, giving Charlotte more time to close in or set up her next move. It is a small tweak to how long that struggle lasts rather than a change to the rest of the power.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the plan is to keep a Survivor pinned by Victor for as long as possible before they can throw him off, since the added time works in Charlotte's favor. As a rare drop, it will not surface in every match.

Addon_K22Power_12.name: Madeleine’s Scarf
Addon_K22Power_12.description:
A cloth Madeleine wore shortly before her death. The Twins kept it as a memento.

Increases Victor's movement speed by 0.3 m/s.

beginner.whatItIs: Madeleine's Scarf fits into Blood Bond and gives Victor a slight increase in his on-foot pace. The shift is small but steady, helping him keep up with targets across longer chases.
beginner.whyItMatters: A faster Victor closes the gap with survivors a touch sooner and reaches pounce range quicker. The shift is modest, nudging his chase presence without changing how the power plays.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if Victor feels sluggish on foot and needs a small edge to keep up in a chase. It is a rare drop, so expect to wait a bit before it surfaces.

Addon_K22Power_13.name: Stale Biscuit
Addon_K22Power_13.description:
A hard, unleavened biscuit that Madeleine stole from a town’s market. It wasn’t much, but it was better than most meals.

Decreases Pounce cooldown by 0.4 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Stale Biscuit slots into Blood Bond and shaves time from the gap between Victor's Pounce leaps, so he can strike again with less downtime. The tighter cadence keeps a survivor under pressure even when they are trying to shake the chase.
beginner.whyItMatters: Getting a pounce back sooner means more pressure per generator run. The tempo shift is small, keeping the chase feeling more relentless without altering the power's core identity.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it in chases where stringing pounces together quickly matters, since the shorter cooldown rewards aggressive play. As a rare drop, it will not be in the pool every game.

Addon_K22Power_14.name: Weighty Rattle
Addon_K22Power_14.description:
A shoddily carved rattle that Victor cried over until his mother stole it for him. It’s entirely too heavy to be trusted to a child.

Crushing Victor when attached inflicts Broken for 20 seconds.

Broken prevents Survivors from being healed.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into Blood Bond and changes what a crushed Victor does to a survivor: the target becomes unable to be healed for a stretch. It shifts the post-crush phase from a simple injury into a prolonged vulnerability window.
beginner.whyItMatters: Blocking healing after a crush forces a hooked survivor to sit on the bench without any chance of being patched up, which stretches out the danger of that hook. It reads as a meaningful shift in how hook fights play out rather than a minor timing tweak.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in lobbies where you want the aftermath of a crush to keep pressuring survivors even after they are hooked. The drop is rare, so it will not show up in every match.

Addon_K22Power_15.name: Forest Stew
Addon_K22Power_15.description:
A stew of foraged vegetables mixed with moss and bark to create a false sense of fullness.

Increases Victor's movement speed by 0.6 m/s.

beginner.whatItIs: Anchors to Blood Bond and gives Victor a noticeable speed boost while he is on foot. The very rare drop makes his ground movement feel more aggressive and harder to shake off.
beginner.whyItMatters: A faster Victor closes the gap to survivors and reaches pounce range more quickly, which changes the rhythm of every chase he starts. It is a bigger shift in his chase presence than a minor stat bump.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when Victor feels sluggish on foot and the goal is to close distance faster during chases. Expect it to drop very rarely, so it is not something to count on every session.

Addon_K22Power_16.name: Spinning Top
Addon_K22Power_16.description:
A wooden top shared between The Twins, though Victor wanted it for his own. He learned he could get what he wanted if he clung tightly and screamed.

Victor's Pounce causes Survivors to drop their carried Survivor items.

beginner.whatItIs: Goes into Blood Bond so that any survivor struck by Victor's Pounce drops the item they are holding. It turns a pounce into a tool-stealing moment mid-chase.
beginner.whyItMatters: Forcing a survivor to fumble a dropped tool breaks their momentum and can cost them the very thing they were saving for an escape. It reads as a meaningful disruption to their escape plan rather than a small timing change.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it against survivors who carry a crucial item into a chase, since the pounce will strip it from their hands. It drops very rarely, so save your Blood Bond setup for it when it appears.

Addon_K22Power_17.name: Drop of Perfume
Addon_K22Power_17.description:
One of the few luxuries Madeleine escaped her past life with. It has a pleasant, disarming scent.

Survivors in Victor's alert range while he is dormant are inflicted with Oblivious.

Oblivious prevents Survivors from hearing or being affected by the Killer's Terror Radius.

beginner.whatItIs: Plugs into Blood Bond and mutes the terror radius that dormant Victor normally projects to nearby survivors. While he is in his dormant state, anyone in range cannot hear or feel the danger zone.
beginner.whyItMatters: Blinding survivors to the danger of a dormant Victor makes him far harder to detect before he wakes. It is a bigger shift in stealth than a small tweak, because it removes one of the main ways survivors spot a hiding Victor.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it in setups that lean on a dormant Victor as a trap, since survivors will not get the usual warning cues. The drop is very rare, so it will not appear in most matches.

Addon_K22Power_18.name: Victor’s Soldier
Addon_K22Power_18.description:
A toy soldier Victor clung to when scared. Something about it evoked jealousy in Charlotte.

Crushing Victor while he is dormant reveals the Survivor's aura for 6 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Fits into Blood Bond and reveals a survivor's aura for a short window after a dormant Victor is crushed. It turns a successful crush into a brief intel grab.
beginner.whyItMatters: A quick glimpse of where a survivor is hiding after a crush helps The Twins plan their next move with certainty. It is a small but useful window of information that can redirect the whole chase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a crush on a dormant Victor should reward the chase with a brief glimpse of where the target fled. It drops very rarely, so treat it as a bonus when it shows up.

Addon_K22Power_19.name: Silencing Cloth
Addon_K22Power_19.description:
A coarse strip of cloth that a five-year-old Charlotte would put in her mouth. Stopped her from screaming when witch hunters were nearby.

Charlotte gains Undetectable for 20 seconds after waking from her dormant state.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

beginner.whatItIs: Attaches to Blood Bond and grants Charlotte full stealth for a stretch right after she wakes from her dormant state. Her aura, terror radius, and red stain all vanish for that window.
beginner.whyItMatters: Vanishing from all survivor detection right after waking lets The Twins reposition unseen and choose their next approach freely. It is a bigger shift in how dangerous a waking Victor feels, because the usual tell is gone entirely.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it in plays that build around waking Victor in a specific spot where the goal is to move unseen afterward. The iridescent drop makes it a prize find rather than a common pick.

Addon_K22Power_2.name: Tiny Fingernail
Addon_K22Power_2.description:
Charlotte had many ways to mourn Victor’s death. As the fingernails loosened from his rotting hands, she took one in remembrance.

Decreases Victor's Unbind time by 33%.

beginner.whatItIs: Threads onto Blood Bond and shortens the unbind timer tied to Victor, making that step resolve faster. The common drop tightens one specific part of the hook routine.
beginner.whyItMatters: A quicker unbind means the whole hook sequence snaps shut sooner, which keeps survivors under pressure for a slightly longer stretch. It reads as a small tempo shift rather than a dramatic change to the killer's kit.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the unbind step feels slow in your games and the goal is to resolve that part of the sequence faster. It is a common drop, so it will appear more often than most other Blood Bond options.

Addon_K22Power_20.name: Iridescent Pendant
Addon_K22Power_20.description:
A glass-like pendant molded from The Fog itself. There’s a portrait of Madeleine Deshayes upon it, though something about her depiction seems unsettling.

Crushing Victor while he is dormant inflicts Exposed for 45 seconds.

Exposed Survivors will be downed by basic attacks even if uninjured.

beginner.whatItIs: Wedges into Blood Bond and makes a crushed dormant Victor leave a survivor who can be downed by a basic attack even while still uninjured. The iridescent drop turns one successful crush into a long window of extreme vulnerability.
beginner.whyItMatters: Turning a normal attack into an instant down for an extended stretch makes a successful crush far more punishing than usual. It is a bigger shift in the stakes of the hook phase, because even a clean swing becomes lethal.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it in games where a dormant-Victor crush should carry heavy consequences and the survivor should pay for it over time. The iridescent rarity means it will not appear in most sessions.

Addon_K22Power_3.name: Soured Milk
Addon_K22Power_3.description:
A metal bottle filled with milk that has since soured. Loud as Victor could be, he quieted down when presented with his meal.

Increases Victor's alert range by 2 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: Tucks a bottle of soured milk into Victor's Blood Bond power. It widens his alert range, so he notices survivor sounds from a bit further away than usual.
beginner.whyItMatters: Picking up generator work and healing sounds earlier nudges the whole kill sequence forward and catches survivors mid-action more often. The shift is small in scale, closer to a quality-of-life polish than a rework of how Blood Bond feels to play.
