beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it on casual Victor matches when you want his awareness to cover more ground without changing his core loop. It is a common drop, so it will show up in your inventory early and often.

Addon_K22Power_4.name: Toy Sword
Addon_K22Power_4.description:
A miniscule toy sword, only a few inches long. Holding it brought out a violent enthusiasm in Victor.

Decreases Pounce charge time by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots a miniscule toy sword into Victor's Blood Bond power. It shaves a small amount off the Pounce charge time, letting Victor go on the offensive a touch sooner after recovering.
beginner.whyItMatters: A faster Pounce charge tightens the window between Victor recovering and striking again, which punishes survivors who try to bait him out and punish. The change is modest, but in a tight chase that extra moment of readiness can be the difference between a hit and a clean escape.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if the Pounce cooldown feels too slow between kills and Victor needs to re-engage faster. It is a common rarity, so it will turn up regularly and is a safe default for casual play.

Addon_K22Power_5.name: Cat’s Eye
Addon_K22Power_5.description:
An eyeball that belonged to a cat eaten by the starving Deshayes’ family. Victor hid it from his mother, using it as a toy.

Victor becomes silent while Pounce is fully charged.

beginner.whatItIs: Lets Victor run completely silent while Pounce is fully charged under Blood Bond. The moment the charge completes, his footstep noise cuts out entirely.
beginner.whyItMatters: Survivors can no longer listen for Victor's approach once Pounce is ready, which turns the late stage of a chase into a guessing game about where he is. This is a meaningful shift in information flow, because sound-based positioning is a core tool for survivors during a chase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want to deny survivors their usual audio cues and reward your own map knowledge over theirs. It is an uncommon drop, so it will not appear as frequently as commons but will still show up with regular rotation.

Addon_K22Power_6.name: Madeleine’s Glove
Addon_K22Power_6.description:
A glove once owned by The Twins’ mother. During desperate times, it was held over Victor’s mouth to keep him from making a peep.

Increases Victor's alert range by 4 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: Extends Victor's alert range under Blood Bond by a wider margin than the smaller milk option. Victor hears generator work and other survivor sounds from noticeably farther away.
beginner.whyItMatters: The larger alert radius pulls Victor toward action spots more aggressively, which compresses the time survivors get to finish a generator or heal before he arrives. It reads as a bigger shift than a small tweak, because it changes how far Victor has to travel to reach most objectives.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick it over the smaller alert-range option when you want Victor to cover the map more aggressively and reach generators and downed survivors faster. It is an uncommon drop, so expect to wait a bit longer than commons before it lands.

Addon_K22Power_7.name: Bloody Black Hood
Addon_K22Power_7.description:
A hood from one of the men that hunted Charlotte. Soon, he became the prey.

Decreases Charlotte's waking time by 0.5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Shaves a fraction off Charlotte's waking time in her Blood Bond power. She stirs and gets back to her feet a sliver faster after being put to sleep.
beginner.whyItMatters: A shorter dormancy window means Charlotte spends less time helpless on the ground, which shrinks the punishment for a well-timed down and makes her harder to keep suppressed. The shift is small in raw time but meaningful in practice, since even a small reduction in down time changes how often Charlotte can re-enter the fight.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when playing Charlotte and you want her to recover from a hit faster. The uncommon drop rate means it rotates through your inventory at a steady pace.

Addon_K22Power_8.name: Ceremonial Candelabrum
Addon_K22Power_8.description:
The candelabrum that Victor tipped over, causing his captors to burn. A symbol of his tenacity.

Increases time to crush Victor when he is dormant by 0.2 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Buys Victor a sliver of extra time before survivors can crush him while he is dormant under Blood Bond. The crushing window opens slightly later than it would without the add-on.
beginner.whyItMatters: That small delay gives Victor a better chance to stir back awake before the survivors finish their crush, which reduces the risk of being caught off-guard and punished for sleeping. The effect is modest, but in a tight lobby where every second of vulnerability counts, it can keep Victor in the fight a beat longer.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when Victor keeps getting crushed before he can finish waking up from dormancy. The uncommon drop rate keeps it rotating through your inventory regularly, so it will not be hard to find.

Addon_K22Power_9.name: Baby Teeth
Addon_K22Power_9.description:
Two teeth that Victor lost long ago. They’re unusually sharp.

Crushing Victor when attached inflicts Blindness for 30 seconds.

Blindness prevents Survivors from seeing auras.

beginner.whatItIs: Baby Teeth attaches to Blood Bond and turns a successful crush of an attached Victor into a moment of blindness for the Survivor who did it. The blind effect strips their ability to see auras for a stretch of time.
beginner.whyItMatters: Survivors who just crushed Victor lose their aura vision, which blinds them to downed allies, hook status, and generator progress for a meaningful window. This is a bigger shift than a pure timing tweak, because it flips the information advantage to Victor right when survivors expect to feel safe.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want the punishment for crushing Victor to cost survivors real information. It is an uncommon drop, so expect it to show up with some regularity in your rotation.

Addon_K24Power_1.name: Damaged Syringe
Addon_K24Power_1.description: Medical equipment that fared poorly during the chaos that overwhelmed Raccoon City.Increases time it takes Survivors to use a Vaccine by 5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Slows the vaccine process under T-VIRUS. It adds a noticeable delay to how long survivors take to complete the healing ritual before the contamination lifts.
beginner.whyItMatters: A slower vaccine means contaminated survivors spend longer in a weakened state, which stretches the window where the killer can push them around and re-contaminate. The shift is meaningful because the vaccine is a core tool for breaking the infection loop, and slowing it down weakens that tool directly.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when survivors keep breaking the T-VIRUS loop by popping vaccines too quickly. The common drop rate keeps it in your rotation often, making it a low-stakes pick for early sessions.

Addon_K24Power_10.name: Tyrant Gore
Addon_K24Power_10.description: A damaged sample from a T-002 Tyrant that died in combat. There are signs of severe burns.Increases mutation rate when destroying zombies with Tentacle Strike by 75%.Decreases zombie respawn time by 7.5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Speeds up the mutation rate when zombies are destroyed with Tentacle Strike under T-VIRUS. It also shortens the time before destroyed zombies respawn, keeping the horde cycling faster.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster mutation and quicker respawns together mean the zombie horde stays thick and aggressive, which pressures survivors to spread out and avoids them stacking in one safe spot. This reads as a bigger shift in the power's tempo, because it changes how long the horde lulls between kills.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the horde feels too sparse between engagements and you want constant pressure on survivors. It is a rare drop, so it will not show up as often as commons but is worth hunting for.

Addon_K24Power_11.name: Serotonin Injector
Addon_K24Power_11.description:
A hormone that slightly relaxes the user for when stealth is required.Grants Undetectable for 15 seconds when a zombie is destroyed.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

beginner.whatItIs: Grants a brief burst of stealth the moment a zombie is destroyed under T-VIRUS. The killer becomes undetectable, hiding their aura, terror radius, and red stain for a short window.
beginner.whyItMatters: That window of invisibility lets the killer reposition, chase from a new angle, or slip past a survivor's awareness entirely. It is a meaningful tactical tool because it breaks the survivor's ability to track the killer by sight or sound cues, which can flip a lost chase into a new one.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a stealth punish window after each zombie kill is exactly what a chase build needs to re-engage from unexpected angles. Because it is a rare drop, finding one takes a bit more luck than locating a common add-on.

Addon_K24Power_12.name: T-Virus Sample
Addon_K24Power_12.description: A sample of the T-Virus developed by Umbrella Corporation, it causes extreme mutations and brain damage in its subjects.Increases mutation rate when destroying zombies with Tentacle Strike by 100%.

beginner.whatItIs: T-Virus Sample slots into T-VIRUS and sharply increases the mutation rate that builds whenever a zombie is destroyed with Tentacle Strike. It pushes that build-up noticeably further than the more common options for the same effect.
beginner.whyItMatters: A faster-climbing mutation rate means the payoff from clearing zombies with Tentacle Strike arrives sooner, changing how quickly that side of T-VIRUS ramps up over a match. It is a focused boost to one specific number rather than a change to how zombies spawn or move.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the plan leans on destroying zombies with Tentacle Strike and getting the most out of that mutation build-up as quickly as possible. It is a rare drop, so expect it to turn up only sometimes.

Addon_K24Power_13.name: Plant 43 Vines
Addon_K24Power_13.description: The tangled remnants of a plant infected with the T-Virus, it killed one of the researchers who developed it.Increases time required for Survivors to open Supply Cases by 4 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Adds friction to the supply case opening process under T-VIRUS. It forces survivors to spend extra time cracking open a supply case before they can claim the reward inside.
beginner.whyItMatters: Contaminated survivors who reach a Supply Case now spend longer in a vulnerable state before collecting their reward. That extra time weakens the payoff for taking the infection risk and gives the killer a wider window to interfere.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in lobbies where the Supply Case reward feels too easy to grab and the infection loop lacks teeth. It drops at a rare rate, so plan on saving it for a focused session.

Addon_K24Power_14.name: Licker Tongue
Addon_K24Power_14.description:
A sticky prehensile tongue that easily wraps around anything it touches.Survivors are Hindered for an extra 1 second after being Contaminated.

Hindered reduces Survivor movement speed.

beginner.whatItIs: Sticks an extra moment of hindrance onto survivors after they are contaminated under T-VIRUS. Their movement speed stays reduced for a little longer than the base effect would allow.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extended slowdown makes it harder for contaminated survivors to escape a chase or reach a safe spot, which stretches the danger window after each contamination. This is a modest but reliable shift, because it compounds on top of the existing contamination penalty rather than replacing it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when Contaminated survivors slip free before the chase can re-engage and you need that extra slowing window. Rare drops rotate less often than commons, so hold it for a session where that slowing truly matters.

Addon_K24Power_15.name: NE-α Parasite
Addon_K24Power_15.description:
A parasite used in the development of Nemesis T-Types, it’s capable of hijacking its host’s brain.Becoming Contaminated inflicts Oblivious for 60 seconds, or until the Survivor receives a Vaccine.

Oblivious prevents Survivors from hearing or being affected by the Killer's Terror Radius.

beginner.whatItIs: Punishes a contaminated survivor by making them oblivious for a stretch of time under T-VIRUS. They lose the ability to hear or be affected by the killer's terror radius until they find a vaccine.
beginner.whyItMatters: An oblivious survivor cannot use the terror radius as a warning, which blinds them to the killer's general direction and makes their escape attempts much more reckless. This is a bigger information shift than a simple stat bump, because it removes one of the survivor's core awareness tools during the most dangerous window.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when survivors keep using the terror radius to time their escapes and you want to deny them that information after a hit. It is a very rare drop, so it will take some patience to find.

Addon_K24Power_16.name: Jill’s Sandwich
Addon_K24Power_16.description: It’s tragically squished and dripping with blood from a recent battle. Despite that, it has a delicious aroma that can’t be missed.Reveals a Survivor's aura for 12 seconds after they unlock a Supply Case.

beginner.whatItIs: Flips the supply case reward against the survivor by revealing their aura for a brief moment after they unlock one under T-VIRUS. The moment of celebration becomes a moment of exposure.
beginner.whyItMatters: A survivor who just opened a supply case is usually feeling safe, and revealing their location at that exact moment punishes the confidence and the positioning. This is a meaningful punish because it converts a reward moment into a danger window, which changes the risk calculation around every supply case.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it in lobbies where survivors grab their Supply Case loot in the open and vanish before a punish lands. It is a very rare find, so reserve it for a session where that reveal truly pays off.

Addon_K24Power_17.name: Broken Recovery Coin
Addon_K24Power_17.description: A coin depicting a bird framed by a laurel wreath. It’s broken in half.Removes 1 Supply Case from the trial.

beginner.whatItIs: Strips a supply case from the trial entirely under T-VIRUS. One fewer supply case means fewer chances for survivors to break the infection loop.
beginner.whyItMatters: Fewer supply cases means fewer chances to heal the contamination, which stretches the average survival time under infection and forces survivors to make harder choices about when to push. This is a bigger shift in the lobby's economy, because it removes a whole category of recovery options rather than just slowing one down.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in lobbies where the contamination penalty feels too soft and survivors bounce back without real cost. Very rare drops are hard to find, so save it for a session where reducing the Supply Case count truly matters.

Addon_K24Power_18.name: Depleted Ink Ribbon
Addon_K24Power_18.description: Who will save them now? There’s something about this ink ribbon being dry that energizes zombies.Decreases zombie respawn time by 5 seconds.Increases zombie movement speed by 50%.Any zombies destroyed after all generators are repaired will respawn in an exit area.

beginner.whatItIs: Packs three shifts into one slot under T-VIRUS: faster zombie respawns, quicker zombie movement, and a rule that zombies killed after all generators are repaired respawn near an exit. The horde becomes more aggressive and harder to manage.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster, more numerous zombies that reposition toward the exits apply relentless pressure and punish survivors for playing it safe near the end. The endgame becomes a different kind of threat entirely, since the horde now chases rather than just lingers.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it in lobbies where the final push to the exits should feel like a gauntlet, not a quiet stroll. The very rare drop rate makes it a pick to save for a dedicated T-VIRUS session.

Addon_K24Power_19.name: Shattered S.T.A.R.S. Badge
Addon_K24Power_19.description: A symbol of hope for Raccoon City, utterly destroyed.Increases Zombie movement speed by 150% for 60 seconds after a generator is repaired.

beginner.whatItIs: Ignites a burst of zombie speed for a full minute after any generator is repaired under T-VIRUS. The horde becomes dramatically faster during that window, turning a generator completion into a danger signal.
beginner.whyItMatters: The moment a generator clicks, the horde surges forward at a terrifying pace and hunts survivors who linger to regroup. Every completed generator becomes a fresh chase threat instead of a breather, fundamentally altering the power's rhythm.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if you want to punish survivors for lingering after they finish a generator and force them to keep moving. It is an iridescent drop, so it is the rarest tier and will take significant patience to find.

Addon_K24Power_2.name: Brian’s Intestine
Addon_K24Power_2.description: The small intestine of Brian Irons, chief of the RPD. It's an appetizing sight for zombies.Increases zombie movement speed by 25%.

beginner.whatItIs: Gives zombies a small but steady speed boost under T-VIRUS. The horde closes distance a bit faster than it would without the add-on.
beginner.whyItMatters: A faster horde is harder to shake off in a chase and more likely to corner a survivor near a pallet or generator. The shift is modest in scale, but it compounds over the course of a trial because the speed difference is always present rather than triggering on a specific event.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the horde struggles to keep pace with sprinting survivors and a steady speed bump is what the trial needs. Common drops show up often in rotation, so it is a low-risk pick for early sessions.

Addon_K24Power_20.name: Iridescent Umbrella Badge
Addon_K24Power_20.description:
A glass-like badge molded from The Fog itself. It represents a corporation that pushed far beyond ethical and humane science.Survivors are inflicted with Exposed for 60 seconds when using a Vaccine.

Exposed Survivors will be downed by basic attacks even if uninjured.

beginner.whatItIs: Makes the vaccine backfire on the survivor who uses it under T-VIRUS. For a full minute after taking the vaccine, the survivor can be downed by a basic attack even if they were previously uninjured.
beginner.whyItMatters: The exposed state turns the vaccine from a recovery tool into a risk, because using it makes the survivor more vulnerable to a hit rather than less. This is a bigger shift in the infection loop, because it changes the core decision of when to heal from a safe choice into a calculated risk.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when survivors keep reaching for vaccines to break free from a tight loop and you want that escape to leave them open enough for a single basic attack to drop them. It slots into T-VIRUS and carries an iridescent rarity, so it will take considerable patience to come across one.

Addon_K24Power_3.name: Visitor Wristband
Addon_K24Power_3.description: An electronic Umbrella wristband for visitors to the facility. It also doubles as a tracking device.Increases zombie detection range by 2 meters and field of view by 10 degrees.

beginner.whatItIs: An add-on for T-VIRUS that widens the detection range of zombies and broadens their field of view slightly. The wider sensing makes it easier to spot survivors hiding in bushes or behind objects from farther away.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra awareness helps a killer keep track of survivors who strafe behind cover or duck into thickets, which is a modest but useful improvement to the power's core sensing loop. It does not change the mutation game at all, so it fits any T-VIRUS build that values consistent tracking.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it on a fresh T-VIRUS build where more consistent tracking is wanted without changing the mutation game plan. It is a common drop, so it is easy to find and swap in early.

Addon_K24Power_4.name: S.T.A.R.S. Field Combat Manual
Addon_K24Power_4.description: A manual of compiled S.T.A.R.S. close-range combat knowledge. Edited by Chris Redfield.Zombies’ auras turn yellow for 6 seconds after hitting a Survivor.

beginner.whatItIs: A field-manual add-on for T-VIRUS that makes a zombie's aura glow yellow for a short window after it lands a hit on a survivor. The highlight lasts long enough to keep a target visible through light cover but not so long that it becomes an obvious tell.
beginner.whyItMatters: That brief aura glow keeps a hit survivor visible even if they drop behind cover, which helps the zombie swarm stay focused on the right target rather than losing track mid-chase. It is a small but reliable quality-of-life tweak that does not change the power's structure.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a wounded survivor keeps dropping behind cover in dense areas, since the brief aura glow bridges that tracking gap. It is a common drop, easy to find early.

Addon_K24Power_5.name: Marvin’s Blood
Addon_K24Power_5.description: The contaminated blood of a Raccoon City police officer.Increases mutation rate when hitting Survivors with Tentacle Strike by 16% for uncontaminated Survivors and by 50% for contaminated Survivors.

beginner.whatItIs: Marvin's Blood slots into T-VIRUS and raises the mutation rate applied when a Tentacle Strike hits a survivor, with a bigger boost against survivors who are already contaminated. The effect scales with the survivor's state, so it rewards finishing off targets who have already been hit once.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster mutation means fewer hits needed to turn a survivor into a zombie, which speeds up the kill cycle and shrinks the window where a contaminated survivor can still act normally. It is a meaningful shift for builds that rely on Tentacle Strike as the primary conversion tool.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if you prefer a T-VIRUS build that leans on Tentacle Strike as the main conversion tool rather than pure swarming. It is an uncommon drop, so it takes a little hunting to find.

Addon_K24Power_6.name: Adrenaline Injector
Addon_K24Power_6.description: A hormone that heightens senses and prepares the body to fight.Increases length of Killer Instinct when Survivors use a Vaccine by 3 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Adrenaline Injector upgrades T-VIRUS by extending how long Killer Instinct lasts whenever a Survivor uses a Vaccine. The killer keeps a fix on that Survivor's location for a longer stretch right after they cure themselves.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer Killer Instinct window means the killer keeps eyes on a Survivor for longer at the exact moment they would normally slip away after curing. It turns the Vaccine from a clean escape into a moment where the killer still has a read on where they went.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it against Survivor lineups that lean on the Vaccine to break away from zombie pressure, since the extended tracking window makes that escape less clean. It is an uncommon drop.

Addon_K24Power_7.name: Mikhail’s Eye
Addon_K24Power_7.description: While little was left of Mikhail, his left eyeball survived the blast that killed him. It remains a tasty treat for zombies.Increases zombie movement speed by 35%.

beginner.whatItIs: Mikhail's Eye slots into T-VIRUS and raises the base movement speed of every zombie in the swarm. The speed boost applies to all zombies at once, so the entire horde feels faster and more aggressive from the moment they spawn.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster zombies close the gap on survivors more quickly and are harder to outrun once the chase starts, which shifts the power from a slow siege into a more aggressive pursuit. It is a bigger change to the power's feel than most common-tier options provide.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer side needs to feel more threatening in open areas where survivors can easily sprint away from a slower zombie horde. It is an uncommon drop.

Addon_K24Power_8.name: Zombie Heart
Addon_K24Power_8.description: The heart of an eviscerated zombie. It’s considered hazardous waste as it’s certainly teeming with viruses.Increases mutation rate when destroying zombies with Tentacle Strike by 75%.

beginner.whatItIs: Zombie Heart slots into T-VIRUS and sharply increases the mutation rate gained when Tentacle Strike destroys an existing zombie. The bonus only applies to the destroy action, not to hitting survivors directly.
beginner.whyItMatters: Destroying zombies was a minor mutation source before, but with this add-on it becomes a meaningful way to stack conversion progress, which rewards keeping the swarm fed rather than just letting it expire. It is a targeted boost that only matters if the build already uses Tentacle Strike regularly on zombies.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it on a T-VIRUS build that already leans on Tentacle Strike for both damage and zombie management, since the bonus synergy is strongest there. It is an uncommon drop.

Addon_K24Power_9.name: Admin Wristband
Addon_K24Power_9.description: An electronic Umbrella wristband for administrators of the facility. While allowing access to secure areas, it also doubles as a tracking device.Increases zombie detection range by 4 meters and field of view by 18 degrees.

beginner.whatItIs: Admin Wristband upgrades T-VIRUS with a larger boost to zombie detection range and field of view than the common wristband option. The wider sensing window covers more ground and makes it harder for survivors to hide in thickets or strafe behind cover.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra range is a bigger shift to the power's tracking feel than the common variant, making it noticeably harder for survivors to play hide-and-seek in dense areas. It fits a T-VIRUS build that prioritizes raw awareness over mutation speed.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when you want better early awareness in dense areas, since the expanded detection helps spot survivors hiding in foliage before they rotate. It is an uncommon drop, so it does not show up as often as the common wristband alternative.

Addon_K25Power_01.name: Bent Nail
Addon_K25Power_01.description:
A simple nail that cut deep into Larry Cotton’s hand. Though the damage was superficial, it set into motion a horrifying set of events.

Gain 100% bonus Bloodpoints when binding a Survivor with a possessed chain.When hitting a Survivor with a possessed chain, only 1 additional chain will spawn.

beginner.whatItIs: Bent Nail slots into Summons of Pain and grants bonus Bloodpoints when a possessed chain binds a survivor, while also limiting the number of extra chains that spawn on a hit. The trade-off is fewer on-screen chains in exchange for more build growth.
beginner.whyItMatters: The Bloodpoint bonus makes each successful bind more rewarding for build growth, and the reduced chain spawn keeps the power from getting cluttered during long chases. It reads as a small but practical tweak rather than a fundamental change to how the power plays.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pair it with a Summons of Pain loadout when you prefer fewer on-screen chains and a more rewarding binding moment, since each hit still spawns just one extra chain. It is a common drop that appears frequently in caches.

Addon_K25Power_02.name: Lively Crickets
Addon_K25Power_02.description:
Insects which scarcely avoided being eaten by a mysterious drifter.

Increases turn rate of possessed chains by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Lively Crickets slots into Summons of Pain and increases the turn rate of possessed chains, making them corner more responsively. The chains follow the survivor's movements more tightly, reducing the gap they can exploit to slip free.
beginner.whyItMatters: Chains that turn faster are harder for survivors to shake off once the chain is on them, which tightens the chase and cuts down the number of times a survivor can slip through a gap in the loop. It is a modest improvement that fits any Summons of Pain build without changing the overall shape.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a survivor keeps escaping the chain by weaving through narrow spaces, since the sharper turn cuts that escape angle. It is a common drop.

Addon_K25Power_03.name: Burning Candle
Addon_K25Power_03.description:
A candle lit by Frank Cotton during a fatal summoning ceremony.

Decreases the time for Chain Hunts to activate by 3 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Burning Candle slots into Summons of Pain and shortens the delay before Chain Hunts activate. The reduced downtime means the killer regains aggressive pressure sooner after a chase ends.
beginner.whyItMatters: A faster Chain Hunt punishes survivors who try to stall and reposition during the cooldown, keeping the pressure almost constant. It is a meaningful shift to the power's pacing, more so than a simple speed or range tweak.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it on a Summons of Pain build that prioritizes constant pressure over long recovery windows, especially against lineups that hide in warding circles to buy time. It is a common drop.

Addon_K25Power_04.name: Leather Strip
Addon_K25Power_04.description:
Leather strips torn from a cenobite’s uniform, allowing for the mutilation of exposed flesh.

Decreases Summons of Pain’s cooldown time after possessing a chain by 3%.

beginner.whatItIs: Leather Strip slots into Summons of Pain and trims the cooldown after possessing a chain by a small percentage. The shortened recovery lets the killer re-possess a chain slightly sooner than the default.
beginner.whyItMatters: The shave is modest but steady, making the power's overall rhythm feel a little tighter without changing its fundamental shape. It is the kind of small tweak that adds up over a long trial.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it on any Summons of Pain build where the cooldown between chain possessions feels like a small dead spot in the chase, since the shave is small but consistent. It is a common drop.

Addon_K25Power_05.name: Wriggling Maggots
Addon_K25Power_05.description:
Larvae that poured from the mouth of a corpse hidden in the Cotton household.

Increases turn rate of possessed chains by 15%.

beginner.whatItIs: Wriggling Maggots slots into Summons of Pain and gives possessed chains a noticeably higher turn rate than the common cricket option. The sharper turning makes chains feel more like a snare than a loose rope.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra turn rate is a bigger shift to chase feel than the common variant, making tight loops much harder to break and reducing the number of escapes a survivor can pull off in a confined space. It fits a build that already prioritizes chain control over raw damage.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want chains to feel relentless in tight generator rooms and narrow corridors, since the extra turn rate matters most in confined spaces. It is an uncommon drop, a step up from the common option.

Addon_K25Power_06.name: Spoiled Meal
Addon_K25Power_06.description:
A pile of mold, feasted on by a cockroach. Perhaps a sign of Frank Cotton’s mysterious disappearance...

Increases the possessed chain’s maximum travel distance by 2 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: Spoiled Meal slots into Summons of Pain and extends the maximum travel distance of a possessed chain. The extra reach opens up chase angles that were simply out of range before.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer chain reach makes it harder for a survivor to sprint past the possessed link and escape, which changes how positioning works on open maps. It is a noticeable change to the power's geometry without altering any other part of the chain behavior.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it on maps with wide open areas where the default chain length often falls short, or when a survivor keeps escaping by sprinting just beyond the chain's reach. It is an uncommon drop.

Addon_K25Power_07.name: Skewered Rat
Addon_K25Power_07.description:
A crude solution for the Cotton home’s rat problem.

Decreases Summons of Pain’s cooldown time after possessing a chain by 9%.

beginner.whatItIs: Skewered Rat attaches to Summons of Pain and shortens the wait between consecutive possessions, so the killer can grab another chain sooner. The reduced downtime keeps the pressure on during extended chases.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra responsiveness keeps the chase flow smoother and makes the power feel more continuous over a long trial. It is a targeted boost for builds that lean heavily on rapid chain possession.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a Summons of Pain chase relies on grabbing chain after chain in quick succession, because the shorter wait between possessions keeps the momentum alive. It is an uncommon drop.

Addon_K25Power_08.name: Flickering Television
Addon_K25Power_08.description:
A television that acted strangely upon the arrival of the cenobites.

Increases the maximum casting range of the gateway by 4 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: Flickering Television attaches to Summons of Pain and widens the maximum casting range of the gateway. The killer can summon the chain from a greater distance, opening up positions on the map that were previously out of reach.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer casting range removes the need to close in before triggering the power, which is a meaningful shift to how chases are initiated. It fits a build that values flexibility over raw chain control.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want to trigger Summons of Pain from a safe distance during a chase, or when the default range feels too short to reach a survivor sprinting across open ground. It is an uncommon drop.

Addon_K25Power_09.name: Liquified Gore
Addon_K25Power_09.description:
The result of summoning the cenobites. There’s no telling what part of the human body this belonged to.

Increases the time it takes Survivors to solve the Lament Configuration by 1 second.

beginner.whatItIs: Liquified Gore slots into Summons of Pain and adds a small amount of extra time to the Lament Configuration puzzle that survivors must solve. The added time is a quiet brake on the endgame.
beginner.whyItMatters: Even a brief extension can push a survivor's completion past the point where the killer can react, which makes the final board genuinely tense. It is a modest but reliable improvement for builds that already lock survivors down late in the trial.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a Summons of Pain strategy already holds survivors in place toward the late trial, because the extra solve time on the Lament Configuration makes the final board harder to clear. It is an uncommon drop.

Addon_K25Power_10.name: Larry’s Blood
Addon_K25Power_10.description:
The blood of Larry Cotton, which partially resurrected his brother Frank.

Increases the possessed chain's maximum travel distance by 4 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: Larry's Blood slots into Summons of Pain and stretches how far the possessed chain can lunge before snapping back. The extra reach lets a chase build punish survivors who park behind pallets or in windows that would normally be safe from the chain.
beginner.whyItMatters: The wider reach is a meaningful shift to the power's geometry, making it much harder for a survivor to outdistance the chain in open areas. It fits a build that prioritizes chain control on large maps.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it on large open maps where the default chain length frequently falls short, or when a survivor repeatedly escapes by sprinting just beyond the chain's old reach. It is a rare drop, so it rewards dedicated hunting.

Addon_K25Power_11.name: Torture Pillar
Addon_K25Power_11.description:
A dangling slab covered in the gore of past victims.

Decreases the time for Chain Hunts to activate by 6 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Torture Pillar slots into Summons of Pain and cuts the delay before Chain Hunts activate by a larger margin than the common candle option. The shorter downtime keeps aggressive pressure almost constant.
beginner.whyItMatters: A shorter Chain Hunt delay makes the downtime between chases feel much less exploitable, which is a bigger shift to the power's pacing than the common variant. It fits a build that prioritizes relentless pressure over recovery windows.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip Torture Pillar when survivor lineups rely on the Chain Hunt downtime to vault away or finish a generator, because the shorter gap between activations keeps the pressure unbroken through those moments. It drops at rare frequency, so bank it for trials where chasing repositioning survivors is the central job.

Addon_K25Power_12.name: Frank’s Heart
Addon_K25Power_12.description:
The beating heart of Frank, given life from his brother’s blood.

Increases the maximum casting range of the gateway by 8 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: Frank's Heart slots into Summons of Pain and pushes the gateway's maximum casting range well beyond the Flickering Television add-on. The added reach lets the killer trigger the chain from positions that were simply out of range before.
beginner.whyItMatters: Frank's Heart pushes the gateway casting range far enough that the killer no longer has to commit to a tight approach before triggering the power. On open maps that widens the gap between where a survivor hides and where the chain can reach them, which is a substantial change to how chase setups form.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want to trigger the power from a distance during long chases or when a survivor is cornered in a far room, since the extra range removes the need to close in first. It is a rare drop.

Addon_K25Power_13.name: Larry’s Remains
Addon_K25Power_13.description:
The skeletal remains of Larry Cotton, covered in a thick, sticky layer of blood.

Increases the time it takes Survivors to solve the Lament Configuration by 2 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Larry's Remains attaches to Summons of Pain and lengthens the Lament Configuration solve time by a greater margin than the Liquified Gore add-on. The extra seconds act as a serious brake on the endgame board.
beginner.whyItMatters: A survivor who is close to finishing the board may suddenly find the window has slipped, giving the killer a real chance to reach them. It compounds with other lockdown tools to make the final board genuinely dangerous to finish.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Lock in Larry's Remains for trials where the final puzzle is the last line of survivor resistance, because the extra solving time stretches the window during which the killer can apply pressure around it. As a rare drop it will not appear often, but in late-trial lockdowns it turns the Lament Configuration into a genuine time sink for a survivor team trying to escape.

Addon_K25Power_14.name: Slice of Frank
Addon_K25Power_14.description:
A slab of Frank’s face after his torture at the hand of the cenobites.

Survivors carrying the Lament Configuration are inflicted with Exhausted.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating exhausting perks.

beginner.whatItIs: A rare add-on for Summons of Pain that inflicts the Exhausted status on any survivor carrying the Lament Configuration. Exhausted blocks those survivors from activating their own exhausting perks while they hold the box.
beginner.whyItMatters: Neutralizing a survivor's support toolkit the moment they pick up the box forces them to either drop it or play without their key utility. It is a targeted disruption that reshapes how a single survivor approaches the hunt.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a team leans heavily on exhausting perks and you want to strip that safety net the instant the box is grabbed. It rolls at a rare rate, so expect to hunt across several trials before it appears in the cache.

Addon_K25Power_15.name: Greasy Black Lens
Addon_K25Power_15.description:
A lens from the sunglasses of an obese cenobite whose fleshy rolls droop down his face and neck.

Survivors hit by a possessed chain are revealed for 6 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Equipped into Summons of Pain, it reveals the aura of any survivor struck by a possessed chain for a short window. The reveal triggers on contact rather than on a fixed timer.
beginner.whyItMatters: Knowing exactly where a hit survivor is heading lets the killer close distance before that survivor can heal or reach cover. It is a small but reliable information edge that stacks nicely with other reveal effects in a chase build.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it in trials where tracking injured survivors after the initial hit feels uncertain, since the brief reveal bridges the gap between a successful strike and the next decision. It is very rare, so it will not appear in every hunt.

Addon_K25Power_16.name: Original Pain
Addon_K25Power_16.description:
The first pin pushed into Pinhead’s skull. Such pleasure and pain.

When a Survivor breaks free from a possessed chain, reveal their aura for 8 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Slotting into Summons of Pain, it reveals a survivor's aura the moment they break free from a possessed chain. The reveal lasts long enough to track where they run next.
beginner.whyItMatters: Chain-breaking is a survivor's primary escape from Pinhead's control, and seeing where they go immediately afterward removes the uncertainty of that escape. It rewards the killer for surviving a failed bind rather than wasting the moment.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when facing teams that rely on chain-breaking to reposition, since the reveal punishes them for the very action that normally saves them. It is very rare in the drop table, so patience is needed to pull it.

Addon_K25Power_17.name: Impaling Wire
Addon_K25Power_17.description:
A wire that pierces the cheeks of a cenobite, while revealing the gaping wound on her neck.

When a Survivor uses the environment to break a chain, an additional chain will target them.

beginner.whatItIs: It slots into Summons of Pain and fires a second chain at the same survivor the moment they use the environment to sever the first link. The extra chain seeks out that survivor with no further action required.
beginner.whyItMatters: Environment-breaking is the standard way to shed a possessed chain, and adding a second chain on top of that action turns the escape into a continuation of the bind. It is a meaningful shift in how the power punishes survivors who think they have broken free.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it against teams that prioritize breaking chains through walls and objects, since the penalty makes that habit cost them a second bind. It is very rare, so it will show up only occasionally in the add-on pool.

Addon_K25Power_18.name: Chatterer’s Tooth
Addon_K25Power_18.description:
A fragment from a cenobite whose mouth chatters endlessly. This tooth, having broken from his jaw, is finally silent.

Reveal the Lament Configuration.Picking up the Lament Configuration deactivates Chain Hunts.Gain the Undetectable status effect for 25 seconds after picking up the Lament Configuration.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius and Red Stain.

beginner.whatItIs: Chatterer's Tooth slots into Summons of Pain and keeps the Lament Configuration permanently in sight. Whoever picks the box up shuts down Chain Hunts, and the killer gains Undetectable for a stretch afterwards. Undetectable strips away the aura, the Terror Radius and the Red Stain together.
beginner.whyItMatters: Hiding the box forces survivors to guess where it is, while the sudden silence on Chain Hunts plus a window of invisibility gives the killer a rare moment of free repositioning. It is a broad, multi-part change that alters the tempo of the entire hunt around the box.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the team sprints for the Lament Configuration at the opening of a hunt, since the Chain Hunt lockout and the stealth window both punish that kind of aggressive timing. The very rare slot keeps it scarce in the pool, so hold the slot for a lineup where early Configuration pressure is a genuine threat.

Addon_K25Power_19.name: Engineer’s Fang
Addon_K25Power_19.description:
A sharp tooth from the maw of a fleshy, scorpion-like creature, known to accompany cenobites on their grim undertakings.

Possessed chains injure healthy Survivors, but do not bind them or spawn additional chains.Increases the time to close the gateway after hitting a healthy Survivor with a possessed chain by 50%.When hitting an injured Survivor with a possessed chain, only 1 additional chain will spawn.

beginner.whatItIs: Fitted into Summons of Pain, it reshapes possessed chains so they injure a healthy survivor without binding them or spawning extras. Striking an injured survivor caps how many extra chains appear, and the gateway close timer stretches noticeably after any hit on a healthy target.
beginner.whyItMatters: Removing the bind and extra chains in favor of pure damage and a longer gateway delay shifts the power from a control tool toward a damage and lockout tool. It is a significant redesign of how the power functions in a chase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the goal is to slow down the endgame rather than to hold survivors in chains, since the extended gateway timer gives the killer more time to set up a kill. It is iridescent, making it one of the less common drops in the pool.

Addon_K25Power_20.name: Iridescent Lament Configuration
Addon_K25Power_20.description:
A glass-like puzzle box molded from The Fog itself. This replica differs from the original, providing altogether new powers.

When a Chain Hunt is inactive, Survivors beyond 24 meters of the Lament Configuration cannot see its aura.

beginner.whatItIs: A replica add-on for Summons of Pain that hides the Lament Configuration's aura from survivors standing far away while a Chain Hunt is inactive. Survivors in close range can still see it.
beginner.whyItMatters: Removing the box from the map for distant survivors means they must commit to a search without knowing where it is, which stretches out the early game and forces them to spread out. It is a subtle information denial that changes how the whole team plans its first objective.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a team consistently locates the Lament Configuration in the first few seconds and rushes it, since the hidden aura forces them to guess. It is iridescent, so it will be a slow pull from the add-on pool.

Addon_K26Power_01.name: Oil Paints
Addon_K26Power_01.description:
There's little left but a few globs of black and gray, yet Carmina could paint an expansive landscape with them.

Increases the Dire Crow's Killer Instinct detection range by 1.5 meters.

Killer Instinct intermittently reveals the location of Survivors.

beginner.whatItIs: When equipped into Birds of Torment, it extends the detection range of the Dire Crow's Killer Instinct effect. Survivors who would normally fall just outside the reveal now get spotted.
beginner.whyItMatters: A slightly wider reveal window means the killer gets that positional read a touch earlier in a chase, which is enough to react to a survivor who is about to break line of sight. It is a small tuning change rather than a structural one.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer keeps losing track of survivors who step just past the edge of the crow's reveal, since the extra reach closes that blind spot. It is common, so it should appear frequently in the add-on pool.

Addon_K26Power_02.name: Vibrant Obituary
Addon_K26Power_02.description:
Scrap newspaper, speckled with bright, eye-catching paint. It seems tragedy is a daily thing.

Increases the length of time a Dire Crow's Killer Instinct reveals Survivors by 3 seconds.

Killer Instinct intermittently reveals the location of Survivors.

beginner.whatItIs: Equipped into Birds of Torment, it lengthens how long the Dire Crow's Killer Instinct keeps a survivor's position revealed. The reveal persists longer after the crow disintegrates.
beginner.whyItMatters: Holding a survivor's position on the map for extra moments gives the killer time to redirect toward them before the info fades. It is a modest extension that makes the reveal more reliable without fundamentally changing the power.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer wants to use the reveal to plan a route between generators rather than to chase immediately, since the longer window supports repositioning. It is common in the pool, making it an easy pull.

Addon_K26Power_03.name: Thick Tar
Addon_K26Power_03.description:
Sticky, viscous sludge that Carmina used for an experimental piece. Once it sticks to skin, it's nearly impossible to get off.

Increases the time for Survivors to repel a Dire Crow swarm by 0.5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Slotting into Birds of Torment, it makes the repel animation for a Dire Crow swarm take a little longer. Survivors need more time to push the crows away.
beginner.whyItMatters: That extra delay in the repel window gives the killer a brief moment of continued pressure after the swarm lands, which can be enough to land a hit before the survivor recovers. It is a small but tangible bump to the power's offensive tempo.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer relies on swarm hits to chip down survivors and wants the repel to feel less like an instant reset. It is common, so it should be readily available in most hunts.

Addon_K26Power_04.name: Choclo Corn
Addon_K26Power_04.description:
A type of corn common in South America. A few kernels are reason enough for a crow to stop for a snack.

Increases the time Dire Crows stay idle for before disintegrating by 2 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: It extends the idle timer before a Dire Crow disintegrates within Birds of Torment. The crow lingers longer after it stops moving.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer lingering crow gives the killer more time to reposition or set up the next move before the bird disappears. It is a small quality-of-life change that reduces wasted summons.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer often summons a crow and then has to re-summon because it expired before the next opportunity, since the extra patience on the idle timer removes that gap. It is common in the add-on pool.

Addon_K26Power_05.name: Automatic Drawing
Addon_K26Power_05.description:
An experimental drawing Carmina made without conscious planning. Do not think—act.

Decreases Birds of Torment cooldown time by 1.5 seconds after a Dire Crow disintegrates from inactivity.

beginner.whatItIs: An uncommon add-on for Birds of Torment that shortens the power's cooldown after a Dire Crow disintegrates from inactivity. The next summon becomes ready sooner in that specific situation.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster re-summoning after an idle expiry means the killer can keep pressure up without a long dead period. It is a targeted cooldown reduction that smooths out the power's rhythm during extended chases.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer tends to lose a crow to inactivity during long chases and then has to wait too long to summon the next one. It is uncommon, so it will appear less often than common drops.

Addon_K26Power_06.name: Festering Carrion
Addon_K26Power_06.description:
A stomach-churning pile of meat and guts, yet it attracts hungry crows craving a bite.

Decreases Birds of Torment cooldown time by 0.5 seconds after a Dire Crow takes flight.

beginner.whatItIs: When equipped into Birds of Torment, it trims the cooldown after a Dire Crow takes flight. The power is ready again a moment sooner after the crow is sent out.
beginner.whyItMatters: A shorter wait between summons lets the killer string together more bird interactions in a single chase sequence. It is a small cooldown adjustment that rewards active use of the power.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the build relies on repeated crow usage in close quarters, since the reduced cooldown keeps the tool available more often. It is uncommon, placing it below common in drop frequency.

Addon_K26Power_07.name: Velvet Fabric
Addon_K26Power_07.description:
A striking red fabric Carmina used on an art project. Its brightness contrasted against black feathers.

When a Survivor attempts to repel a Dire Crow swarm, the swarm's aura remains visible for an additional 1.5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Equipped into Birds of Torment, it keeps the swarm's aura visible for a short extra moment after a survivor begins repelling it. The visual indicator lingers past the repel animation.
beginner.whyItMatters: Seeing the swarm's position persist briefly after the repel starts gives the killer a hint about where the survivor is standing, which supports a follow-up attack. It is a small information nudge tied to a specific animation window.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer wants to read survivor position during the repel and then commit to a hit, since the lingering aura makes that read slightly easier. It is uncommon in the pool.

Addon_K26Power_08.name: Still Life Crow
Addon_K26Power_08.description:
An ink drawing of a dead crow. Carmina's sadness over its death can be felt with each dark line.

Increases the time Dire Crows stay idle before disintegrating by 4 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into Birds of Torment and stretches the idle phase of each Dire Crow so it sits in the air longer before breaking apart. That wider idle window gives the killer more room to reposition or lure survivors into a second swarm before the crow fades.
beginner.whyItMatters: A crow that lingers gives the killer a persistent threat on the map that survivors must account for even when no chase is happening. It is a bigger shift than a minor idle bump, turning the crow into a more constant map pressure.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer wants a lingering threat near generators or camp spots without needing to re-summon constantly. It is uncommon, so it will appear at a moderate rate in the pool.

Addon_K26Power_09.name: Untitled Agony
Addon_K26Power_09.description:
A canvas that was targeted with swipes and thrashes of black paint following Matias' death. It radiates with heavy, crippling sorrow.When Dire Crows swarm a Survivor, it afflicts them with a 15% Hindered status effect for 1.5 seconds.

Hindered reduces Survivor movement speed.

beginner.whatItIs: Adds a brief Hindered effect to survivors when Dire Crows land on them during a Birds of Torment swarm. The short speed penalty makes it harder for a survivor to break free of the crow cloud in the critical first moment.
beginner.whyItMatters: A momentary speed cut at the start of a swarm hit makes it harder for the survivor to break away, giving the killer a beat of extra chase time. It is a small but meaningful nudge to the power's offensive window.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer wants swarm hits to feel a little more punishing in open chases, since the brief slow makes it slightly harder for survivors to escape the immediate area. It is uncommon in the drop pool.

Addon_K26Power_10.name: Charcoal Stick
Addon_K26Power_10.description:
A stick of charcoal that conceals anything it rubs over.

The Dire Crow's aura is no longer visible when in flight.The Dire Crow's aura is visible for 0.5 seconds when summoned.

beginner.whatItIs: An add-on of rare rarity for Birds of Torment that hides the Dire Crow's aura while it is in flight, leaving only a brief moment of visibility when first summoned. Survivors lose their primary visual warning of the crow's position.
beginner.whyItMatters: Removing the crow's visible trail during flight means survivors can no longer track where it is headed, which removes their ability to anticipate and reposition. It is a meaningful information change that makes the power harder to read.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when survivors keep tracking the crow by its visible aura during flight, because hiding that trail forces them to react blind. Expect it only occasionally, as it sits in the rare slot.

Addon_K26Power_11.name: Darkest Ink
Addon_K26Power_11.description:
An unnatural ink, so wretched and dark that it seems to pull in light around it.

When Dire Crows swarm a Survivor, it afflicts them with the Blindness status effect. The effect persists for 15 seconds after Dire Crows are repelled from a Survivor.

Blindness prevents survivors from seeing auras.

beginner.whatItIs: Grants a Blindness penalty to a survivor the moment a Birds of Torment swarm lands, stripping every visible aura from their screen. The effect carries on well after the crows scatter, so the survivor is flying blind through the follow-up approach.
beginner.whyItMatters: Blinding a survivor for a sustained window after a swarm hit strips away their ability to see teammates, generators, and exits, which can derail an entire escape plan. It is a heavy status that shifts the power from a chase tool into a disorientation tool.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer wants to punish survivors who group up or who rely on seeing auras to navigate, since the prolonged blindness scrambles their decisions. It is rare in the add-on pool.

Addon_K26Power_12.name: O Grief, O Lover
Addon_K26Power_12.description:
An abstract ink drawing that Carmina drew before walking to the Death Leap.

When Dire Crows swarm a Survivor, it afflicts them with the Exhausted status effect.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating certain perks.

beginner.whatItIs: Fitted into Birds of Torment, it drains the target with Exhausted the instant a Dire Crow swarm connects. The status locks out certain perk activations while it persists on the survivor.
beginner.whyItMatters: Removing a survivor's exhausting perk during and after a swarm hit means they lose their best escape or burst tool at the worst possible moment. It is a targeted utility denial that pairs well with other control effects in the power.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a team fields multiple survivors with exhausting perks, since the swarm hit strips those tools from play at the critical moment. It is rare, so expect a slower pull from the pool.

Addon_K26Power_13.name: Thorny Nest
Addon_K26Power_13.description:
A nest that remained empty near Carmina's home. There are sharp thorns embedded in it.

Survivors damaged by a Dire Crow are afflicted with the Hemorrhage and Mangled status effects for 70 seconds.

Hemorrhage regresses healing progress when not healing, and increases blood trails left by injured survivors. This lasts for a set duration or until healed.

Mangled increases time required to heal by 25% and lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

beginner.whatItIs: Targeting survivors damaged by a Dire Crow within Birds of Torment, it inflicts Hemorrhage and Mangled. Hemorrhage regresses healing progress when idle and lengthens blood trails, while Mangled increases the time needed to heal.
beginner.whyItMatters: Stacking two healing-debuffing statuses on a crow hit turns a single swarm interaction into a sustained penalty that follows the survivor through every heal attempt. It is a significant escalation of the power's damage-over-time potential.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a healer camps behind a generator and keeps reviving, because the combined Hemorrhage and Mangled penalties make sustained healing punishingly slow. The rare slot means it will not show up every hunt.

Addon_K26Power_14.name: Silver Bell
Addon_K26Power_14.description:
A shiny trinket that a crow took a liking to. The clinking of the bell was a distraction to all but Carmina.

When Dire Crows swarm a Survivor it afflicts them with the Oblivious status effect.

Oblivious prevents Survivors from hearing and being affected by the Killer's Terror Radius.

beginner.whatItIs: Silver Bell slots into Birds of Torment and afflicts a swarmed Survivor with Oblivious, so they lose the ability to hear or be affected by the killer's Terror Radius for a stretch after the crow attack lands. The Survivor can still be seen, they just lose that particular audio warning.
beginner.whyItMatters: Taking away the Terror Radius warning during that window means a Survivor loses one of their main cues for judging how close the killer is. That can make them commit to a repel or a route with less certainty about what is actually nearby.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the killer is leaning on Terror Radius to punish survivors who try to repel Dire Crows, since stripping that pressure during the repel gives survivors a calmer moment to fight back. It is a rare drop, so it will not appear in every match.

Addon_K26Power_15.name: Matias' Baby Shoes
Addon_K26Power_15.description:
A grieving reminder to Carmina that Matias would be with her, always watching.

Survivors within 5 meters of an idle Dire Crow have their auras revealed for 3 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: A very rare add-on for Birds of Torment that briefly reveals the aura of any survivor standing close to an idle Dire Crow. The reveal lasts only a moment, but it is enough to mark where a survivor is hiding.
beginner.whyItMatters: Turning an idle crow into a position ping lets the killer track a survivor without having to guess where they went. That keeps the map readable during the quiet stretches between swarms, when the killer has no other signal.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if the killer wants to maintain awareness of survivor locations while crows sit still on the map, since each idle crow becomes a small radar blip. It is a very rare find, so expect it only occasionally.

Addon_K26Power_16.name: Severed Tongue
Addon_K26Power_16.description:
Carmina's tongue, cut from her mouth shortly before her death. The sight instills rage not just in her, but in her crows.

Decreases the length of time The Artist's movement slows when Dire Crows take flight by 0.5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Severed Tongue slots into Birds of Torment and trims the brief slowdown The Artist feels when Dire Crows lift off. The effect is modest, shaving just a little of the hesitation that would otherwise slow her stride mid-swarm.
beginner.whyItMatters: Keeping more of her speed after a launch means The Artist does not freeze for a beat after unleashing crows. That matters most in chases where losing even a moment of momentum lets a survivor slip through a gap.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when The Artist wants to keep pressuring survivors right after a wave of Dire Crows scatters, since the shorter slowdown lets her close the gap faster. Its very rare tier means it will show up only in the occasional trial, so it can take a long hunt to find.

Addon_K26Power_17.name: Garden of Rot
Addon_K26Power_17.description:
A nude self-portrait in which Carmina depicts a rotting darkness growing outwards from within.

When a Survivor affected by Dire Crows completes the repel action, they are afflicted by the Exposed status effect for 4 seconds.

Exposed Survivors are downed by basic attacks, even if uninjured.

beginner.whatItIs: An iridescent add-on for Birds of Torment that marks a survivor who successfully repels a Dire Crow with the Exposed status. While Exposed, a basic attack downs them regardless of how many injuries they already have.
beginner.whyItMatters: Punishing a successful repel with a downed-by-any-hit window flips the repel from a safety valve into a risk. A survivor who thought they were safe can still be brought down the instant they turn a corner, which changes how they approach the repel.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if the killer wants to discourage survivors from treating repel actions as a free escape, since the Exposed window makes the aftermath of a repel just as dangerous as the swarm itself. It is an iridescent drop, so it shows up infrequently.

Addon_K26Power_18.name: Ink Egg
Addon_K26Power_18.description:
An unusual egg that seems to be nothing but a ball of semi-solid ink.

Increases the maximum capacity of Dire Crows by 1.Decreases the time Dire Crows stay idle before disintegrating by 2 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Ink Egg plugs into Birds of Torment and grants an additional Dire Crow to the maximum pool while also cutting how long each idle crow lingers before it dissolves. The trade is a slightly larger swarm but a faster rate at which the crows cycle out and return.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra crow gives The Artist more pressure on the map at once, but the shorter idle window means each crow has less time to sit and be repelled. That shifts the power toward rapid, sustained swarming rather than slow harassment.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the killer prefers to keep constant crow pressure on multiple survivors rather than letting crows sit idle and get repelled one by one. The faster fade-out rewards aggressive placement over patient setup.

Addon_K26Power_19.name: Severed Hands
Addon_K26Power_19.description:
Carmina's severed hands, cut from her arms shortly before her death. The sight brings sheer fury to her and her protectors.

Any Survivors within 3 meters of a Survivor being swarmed by Dire Crows will also be swarmed.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into Birds of Torment and extends a Dire Crow swarm to any survivor standing close to one who is already being attacked. The swarm no longer stops at a single target if others are nearby.
beginner.whyItMatters: Spreading the swarm to nearby survivors punishes grouping and turns a single repel into a team-wide problem. The killer can now pressure multiple survivors at once from one placement, which changes the math of how survivors cluster.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if the killer wants to punish survivors who group around generators or hooks, since a single swarm can ripple outward and catch more than one target. It is a very rare find, so most trials will not offer it.

Addon_K26Power_20.name: Iridescent Feather
Addon_K26Power_20.description:
A glass-like feather molded from The Fog itself. Simple as it may be, it's a symbol of those who watch over Carmina.

The Artist gains the Undetectable status effect when Birds of Torment is in cooldown and she holds no Dire Crows.Decreases the maximum capacity of Dire Crows by 1.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

beginner.whatItIs: Grants The Artist the Undetectable status effect whenever Birds of Torment is on cooldown and she holds no Dire Crows, at the cost of reducing the maximum crow pool by one. Undetectable hides her aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain from all survivors.
beginner.whyItMatters: Hiding every visual signal during the cooldown window lets The Artist reposition or hunt without giving survivors any directional cue. That is a meaningful shift in how stealthy she can feel between swarms, since survivors lose their primary tracking tools.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the killer wants to vanish from the map during the downtime between swarms and reappear somewhere unexpected, since Undetectable strips every signal survivors would use to track her. It is an iridescent drop, so it appears rarely.

Addon_K28_01.name: Wooden Plank
Addon_K28_01.description:
A wooden plank torn from the stage where Otto Stamper sacrificed a meddling journalist.

Increases the amount Nightfall charges when a Survivor is hooked by 25%.

beginner.whatItIs: Speeds up how quickly Nightfall charges when a survivor is hooked, making each hook a bigger step toward the dark phase. The charge bonus is modest but consistent across every hook in a trial.
beginner.whyItMatters: Turning a hook into a noticeable chunk of Nightfall progress rewards the killer for putting survivors on the hook. The charge gained per hook is larger than the base rate, which means a hook-heavy trial reaches the dark phase sooner.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the killer plays an aggressive hook-heavy style and wants each hook to feel like real progress toward Reign of Darkness. The extra charge adds up fast across a full trial, making hooks feel more rewarding.

Addon_K28_02.name: Caffeine Tablets
Addon_K28_02.description:
Stamper’s followers were told not to sleep, or they would bring the wrath of Druanee upon them. Towards the end, he brought in drugs from the mainland.

Auras of locked lockers are visible while charging The Gloaming and Teleporting.

beginner.whatItIs: Reveals the auras of locked lockers while the killer is channeling The Gloaming or using Teleport. The reveal only appears during those two actions, so it is a targeted scouting tool rather than a permanent map read.
beginner.whyItMatters: Knowing which lockers are occupied during a Gloaming channel or a Teleport cast lets the killer prioritize the right one. That cuts down on wasted time checking empty lockers and keeps the post-hook search tight.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if the killer struggles to find survivors hiding in lockers after a hook, since the aura reveal during Gloaming and Teleport turns a guessing game into a directed search. It is a common drop, so it is easy to pick up in early trials.

Addon_K28_03.name: Mortar and Pestle
Addon_K28_03.description:
Disconnected from the world and modern medicine, Stamper's followers originally had to make do with the flora local to the island.

The Dredge will emerge from its Remnant facing the same direction as when Teleport is activated instead of the direction facing when the Remnant was placed.

beginner.whatItIs: Locks the direction the Dredge emerges from its Remnant to match the direction it was facing when Teleport was activated. The Remnant's current facing no longer determines where the Dredge pops out.
beginner.whyItMatters: Removing the directional uncertainty means the killer can predict exactly where the Dredge will appear after a Teleport. That makes follow-up chases and corner positioning far more reliable than the default behavior.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the killer finds the default Dredge emergence direction confusing or punishing during chases. The locked direction makes it easier to plan where to stand after a Teleport and set up the next move.

Addon_K28_04.name: Follower’s Cowl
Addon_K28_04.description:
They believed the cowls proved their enlightenment, but they merely kept them in darkness.

Teleporting to the Remnant will activate Killer Instinct even when not in Nightfall.

beginner.whatItIs: Follower's Cowl slots into Reign of Darkness and triggers Killer Instinct the moment the killer arrives at the Remnant through Teleport, even when Nightfall is not active. That tracking effect is no longer locked behind the dark phase.
beginner.whyItMatters: Getting Killer Instinct on every Teleport means the killer gets a read on nearby Survivors at every reposition, not just during Nightfall. That smooths out the pacing of the whole trial, since repositioning no longer needs to wait for the dark phase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if the killer wants a consistent read on Survivor positions after every Teleport rather than waiting for Nightfall to activate. The Killer Instinct trigger makes repositioning and re-chasing feel more informed across the whole trial.

Addon_K28_05.name: Burnt Letters
Addon_K28_05.description:
Some followers tried to write letters home. Stamper ensured that nobody would have contact with the outside world.

Increases the amount Nightfall charges when injuring a Survivor by 25%.

beginner.whatItIs: Boosts how much Nightfall charges when the killer injures a survivor, adding a visible chunk of progress every time a hit lands. The bonus applies on top of the base charge rate.
beginner.whyItMatters: Tying Nightfall progress directly to landing hits means the harder the killer presses, the faster the dark phase arrives. That rewards aggressive play over passive map control, since every injury becomes a step toward Reign of Darkness.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the killer plays a high-damage style and wants each hit to double as progress toward the dark phase. The charge bonus on injury makes a full trial feel noticeably shorter.

Addon_K28_06.name: Air Freshener
Addon_K28_06.description:
After her parents were found, this was in the bag of belongings the police returned. Haddie doesn’t know why she keeps it.

Adds 1 additional Power Token for Teleporting.

beginner.whatItIs: Adds one extra Power Token to the Teleporting power, giving the killer one more repositioning option during a trial. It is a simple bump to the token budget with no other condition attached.
beginner.whyItMatters: An extra Teleport token means the killer can reposition one more time without running out of charges. That is useful in long trials where the default token budget runs dry before the trial ends.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if the killer finds the standard Teleport budget not enough to cover every reposition they need. The extra token gives a safety valve for late-trial rotations when the default charges are already spent.

Addon_K28_07.name: Haddie’s Calendar
Addon_K28_07.description:
She planned to cross out each day until her parents took her to India, but when tragedy struck, she abandoned her calendar.

Decreases the time to exit a locked locker by 0.4 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Trims the time it takes the killer to exit a locked locker, shaving a small beat off the exit animation. The difference is brief but can matter in a tight situation.
beginner.whyItMatters: A quicker locker exit means less time trapped inside, which matters most when a survivor is right outside or when the killer needs to reposition fast. Every second saved inside the locker is a second back on the map.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the killer often feels trapped inside lockers with no quick way out. The shortened exit time reduces the window where the killer is stuck and vulnerable.

Addon_K28_08.name: Fallen Shingle
Addon_K28_08.description:
After the Ottomarians were subsumed by The Dredge, the mansion fell into disrepair.

Using Reign of Darkness increases Nightfall charge speed by an additional 15% per second.

beginner.whatItIs: Compounds the Nightfall charge speed bonus that Reign of Darkness already provides, adding an extra layer of acceleration on top of the base increase. The two bonuses stack, making the dark phase arrive faster than either one alone.
beginner.whyItMatters: The stacked charge speed means Nightfall arrives noticeably faster during active Reign of Darkness play. That shortens the wait between dark phases and keeps pressure on survivors for longer.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if the killer wants Nightfall to arrive sooner during active play. The bonus stacks with the base Reign of Darkness charge speed for a meaningfully faster dark phase.

Addon_K28_09.name: Malthinker’s Skull
Addon_K28_09.description:
Those who brought negativity to the commune would mysteriously disappear from time to time. Their remains were never found… until The Dredge brought them up.

Increases Nightfall charge speed by 25% while any Survivor is injured.

beginner.whatItIs: Accelerates Nightfall charge speed while any survivor is injured, so the dark phase rushes in whenever a hit has landed. The bonus is conditional and only applies while at least one survivor is hurt.
beginner.whyItMatters: Tying charge speed to survivor injury means the killer gets a significant boost every time a hit lands. That turns a chase into a countdown toward Reign of Darkness, since the clock only stops when all survivors are uninjured.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip Malthinker's Skull when the killer wants every downed survivor to accelerate the approach of the dark phase, since the charge bonus kicks in the moment any survivor is hurt and persists until they recover. It drops at uncommon rarity, so it should turn up fairly often across trials without needing a long hunt.

Addon_K28_10.name: Worry Stone
Addon_K28_10.description:
While the Ottomarians were told to think only positive thoughts, some kept these stones in their pockets to rub when negative thoughts arose.

Reveals the aura of a Survivor for 6 seconds when they lock a locker.

beginner.whatItIs: Flags a survivor's aura the moment they lock a locker, giving the killer a clear signal of where they went. The reveal is brief but enough to mark the locker's location on the map.
beginner.whyItMatters: Revealing a survivor's position on locker lock removes the guessing from post-locker tracking. The killer no longer has to check every locker one by one, since the aura flag points directly at the hider.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if the killer loses track of survivors who lock lockers and then scatter. The aura flag on lock gives an instant directional cue without needing to search the map.

Addon_K28_11.name: Ottomarian Writing
Addon_K28_11.description:
The words of Otto Stamper were the only words available for his followers to read, decrying malthink and malspeak.

Decreases Teleport cooldown by 2 seconds while not in Nightfall.

beginner.whatItIs: Shortens the Teleport cooldown while the killer is not in Nightfall, making repositioning slightly more frequent during the standard phase. The reduction only applies outside the dark phase.
beginner.whyItMatters: A shorter cooldown between Teleports means the killer can reposition more often without waiting. That helps in open maps where the default cooldown feels too slow to keep up with survivor movement.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the killer wants to rotate between map halves more often without Nightfall being active. The reduced cooldown keeps the Teleport ready sooner after each use.

Addon_K28_12.name: Broken Doll
Addon_K28_12.description:
Followers brought their families to live in a utopia. None of them were spared.

Increases the duration of Nightfall by 20 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Stretches the duration of Nightfall, giving the killer a longer window of dark-phase abilities and effects. The extension applies to the entire Nightfall period, not just a single ability.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer Nightfall means more time to capitalize on whatever the dark phase enables. That matters most for plays that need sustained duration to land their payoff, since the extra time keeps pressure on survivors.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if the killer wants more time to work within Nightfall before it fades. The extended window gives extra room to chase, hook, or reposition while the dark phase is still active.

Addon_K28_13.name: War Helmet
Addon_K28_13.description:
While investigating an Overlap in the Alps, she found an abandoned war bunker. She took a helmet from it after the Overlap nearly took her.

Increases Killer Instinct duration by 1.5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: War Helmet slots into Reign of Darkness and extends the duration of Killer Instinct, keeping that tracking read active for a longer stretch after it triggers. The extra time applies to every instance of Killer Instinct in a trial.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer Killer Instinct window means the killer keeps a read on nearby Survivors for more of a chase or reposition. That can be the difference between catching up to the target and losing track of them entirely.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the killer finds the standard Killer Instinct window too short to act on before it fades. The extended duration gives more time to use that positional read during a reposition or chase.

Addon_K28_14.name: Destroyed Pillow
Addon_K28_14.description:
While not allowed to sleep, leaders among the Ottomarians tore sleeping supplies to shreds to prevent malthinkers from sneaking off to nap.

Decreases Teleport cooldown by 2.5 seconds during Nightfall.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into Reign of Darkness and shortens the cooldown between Teleport activations whenever Nightfall is in effect. It lets a killer chain repositioning moves faster during the darkened phase of a trial.
