beginner.whyItMatters: The shortened cooldown makes Teleport feel more responsive during Nightfall, which is when the power's other effects are already amplified. It reads as a focused tempo boost rather than a fundamental change to how the power works.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a build already leans on repeated repositioning during Nightfall, since the extra cooldown shavings add up over a full trial. It is a rare drop, so it will not appear in every case pull.

Addon_K28_15.name: Tilling Blade
Addon_K28_15.description:
The island was self-sufficient, and followers tilled the tough soil to grow crops during the warm season.

When a Survivor is injured from full health during Nightfall, they are afflicted with the Blindness, Hemorrhage, and Mangled status effects for 80 seconds.

Blindness prevents Survivors from seeing auras.

Hemorrhage regresses healing progress when not healing, and increases blood trails left by injured survivors. This lasts for a set duration or until healed.

Mangled increases time required to heal by 25% and lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

beginner.whatItIs: A Reign of Darkness offering that layers Blindness, Hemorrhage, and Mangled onto a survivor the instant they take their first injury from full health during Nightfall. Each condition stacks on top of the others, so a single clean hit produces a cascade of debuffs.
beginner.whyItMatters: The triple-condition hit turns one ordinary swing into a sustained pressure loop, because the survivor must deal with lost auras, regressing healing, and slower actions all at once. It is a bigger shift than a simple damage bump, closer to a full control package triggered by a single interaction.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if a build already punishes early injuries heavily and wants the first hit to carry the weight of the whole engagement. It is a very rare drop, so patience in the case system is required before it becomes available.

Addon_K28_16.name: Boat Key
Addon_K28_16.description:
Only one boat allowed people on and off the island, and the keys were hidden away to prevent deserters.

Increases Teleport speed by 16% while not in Nightfall.When the exit gates are powered, all active locks are instantly broken.

beginner.whatItIs: It speeds up Teleport movement outside of Nightfall and shatters every active gate lock the instant the exit gates finish powering on. The two effects target completely different phases of a trial, so the add-on reads as a dual-purpose tool.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster Teleport travel keeps a killer mobile across the map during the early and mid game, while the lock-breaking effect removes the end-game bottleneck that usually gives survivors their best escape window. Together they smooth out both the tempo of the trial and the final scramble to the exit.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a Reign of Darkness build wants to stay fluid in the mid game and also cut through the gate-lock phase without stalling. It is a very rare drop, so it will take time to pull from cases.

Addon_K28_17.name: Field Recorder
Addon_K28_17.description:
Haddie documented all of her forays near Overlaps, to prove not only to the world but herself what she saw and felt.

Nightfall is active at the start of the trial.Nightfall is automatically triggered when the last generator is repaired.Any Survivor that comes into contact with a Remnant is afflicted with the Exhausted status effect for 15 seconds.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating certain perks.

beginner.whatItIs: Field Recorder slots into Reign of Darkness and keeps Nightfall switched on from the very first moment of the trial, then forces it to fire again the instant the last generator is finished. Any Survivor who touches a Remnant is also hit with Exhausted, locking them out of certain perks for a while.
beginner.whyItMatters: Starting with Nightfall already active removes the normal build-up phase and puts the power's full weight on survivors from the opening seconds. The auto-retrigger on the last generator ensures the darkened state is back exactly when survivors are most exposed, making it a bigger structural change than a simple cooldown tweak.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a build wants to deny perk activations the instant a survivor brushes against Remnant, whether at trial start or during the final gate push. Because it carries a very rare rarity, expect long stretches of case pulls before it arrives.

Addon_K28_18.name: Lavalier Microphone
Addon_K28_18.description:
She kept a lav mic nearby, allowing her to record her innermost feelings when under great stress.

Survivor auras are revealed for 3 seconds when using the last Teleport token.When entering a locker using Teleport, other lockers within 6 meters of Survivors open and slam their doors.

beginner.whatItIs: Pairs with Reign of Darkness to flash a survivor's aura for a brief moment when the last Teleport token is spent, and makes nearby lockers slam shut when Teleport is used to step into one. Both effects tie into the same token economy, so they reward careful management of Teleport charges.
beginner.whyItMatters: The aura flash gives a split-second window to confirm a survivor's exact position right before a locker or generator interaction, while the locker-slam effect punishes the moment a survivor tries to hide. It reads as a precision tool that rewards timing rather than raw aggression.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Slot it into a build that wants the final Teleport token to flash survivor auras and to slam nearby locker doors when dropping through into one. Its very rare rarity means patience in the case system before it lands.

Addon_K28_19.name: Sacrificial Knife
Addon_K28_19.description:
When a journalist attempted to warn the Ottomarians of his true task, he slit her throat as a warning to any dissenters.

Exiting a locker during Nightfall blocks all vault locations within 16 meters for 5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Sacrificial Knife slots into Reign of Darkness and locks down every vault location in the surrounding area the instant a Survivor exits a locker while Nightfall is active. The block lasts long enough to take away a quick window vault, forcing the Survivor to commit to a different escape route or stand still.
beginner.whyItMatters: Removing the vault option during a Nightfall window strips away one of the most reliable escape tools a Survivor has at a window, which turns a normal chase into a cornered scenario. It is a bigger control shift than a small stat bump because it removes an entire category of options rather than nerfing one.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a build already funnels survivors into locker-and-pallet corridors and wants to remove the break-out option during those moments. It is an iridescent drop, making it the hardest rarity tier to pull from cases.

Addon_K28_20.name: Iridescent Wooden Plank
Addon_K28_20.description:
Once the journalist’s blood stained the wooden boards of the stage, everything was set into motion for The Dredge’s arrival.

Survivors are afflicted with the Exposed status effect for the last 12 seconds of Nightfall.

Exposed Survivors are downed by basic attacks, even if uninjured.

beginner.whatItIs: It marks survivors as Exposed during the final stretch of Nightfall, turning even a clean, unhurt hit into an immediate down. The condition does not require a prior injury, so a healthy survivor can be dropped by a basic attack if caught in the window.
beginner.whyItMatters: The ability to down an uninjured survivor removes the usual one-hit buffer that lets a survivor survive a single mistimed swing, which raises the stakes of every encounter during the closing seconds. It is a dramatic escalation of the power's late-trial pressure rather than a subtle stat adjustment.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a build wants to punish survivors who camp in the open during the end of Nightfall and refuses to hide. It is an iridescent drop, so it will be the hardest to obtain from the case system.

Addon_K29_01.name: Jewel Beetle
Addon_K29_01.description:
A beautiful and valuable insect. While difficult to capture, it’s worth a pretty penny.

Decreases the Virulent Bound extension when grabbing a Survivor mid-Bound by 50%.Gain 100% bonus Bloodpoints for Virulent Bound score events.

beginner.whatItIs: Trims the extension distance when a survivor is grabbed mid-Bound, while doubling the Bloodpoint payout for every Virulent Bound score event. The trade-off is clear: less positional spread from a mid-Bound grab in exchange for faster token accumulation.
beginner.whyItMatters: The shorter extension keeps a mid-Bound grab tighter to the grab point, which makes it easier to chain into a hook or a second bound without losing the window. The Bloodpoint boost accelerates the overall progression of the power, making it a tempo-and-economy choice rather than a raw reach change.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a build wants to convert more grabs into hooks and also bank Bloodpoints faster to unlock the power's higher tiers. It is a common drop, so it should appear fairly often in case pulls.

Addon_K29_02.name: Green Herb
Addon_K29_02.description:
A common plant, usually known for its restorative properties.

Increases the rate of Infection when grabbing a Survivor during a Virulent Bound by 30%.

beginner.whatItIs: Speeds up how fast Infection builds on a survivor who is caught in the middle of a Virulent Bound grab. The extra Infection stack shortens the time before the survivor reaches the fully Infected state, compressing the whole pressure arc.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster Infection gain means the fully Infected threshold is reached sooner after a grab, which leaves less time for the survivor to heal or use their escape options. It reads as a focused acceleration of one specific part of the power's escalation rather than a broad stat increase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Fit it into a grab-heavy Virulent Bound build that wants to compress the gap between a successful grab and the survivor crossing into full Infection. Very rare rarity means it will sit in the case system for a long time before showing up.

Addon_K29_03.name: Unicorn Medallion
Addon_K29_03.description:
An old medallion depicting a majestic unicorn. It was placed in storage for years.

Increases the initial Virulent Bound distance by 20%.Decreases the subsequent Virulent Bound distance by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: A Virulent Bound offering that stretches the initial bound distance outward while pulling the subsequent bounds closer together. The net effect is a wider opening grab followed by a tighter, more compact follow-up sequence.
beginner.whyItMatters: The longer first reach catches survivors who sit slightly further away than the default, while the compressed follow-up bounds make it easier to keep the survivor trapped in a smaller area after the initial grab. It reads as a shape change to the power's geometry rather than a flat stat shift.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Hand it to a build that wants the opening grab to reach further, accepting that each follow-up bound will cover less ground. Common rarity means it will pop out of cases without much effort.

Addon_K29_04.name: R.P.D. Shoulder Walkie
Addon_K29_04.description:
Without the ability to communicate, the cops of Raccoon City are isolated and don’t stand a chance.

Decreases the initial Virulent Bound distance by 20%.Increases the subsequent Virulent Bound distance by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: The mirror image of the Unicorn Medallion, it pulls the initial bound distance inward while stretching the subsequent bounds farther apart. The result is a shorter opening grab that is followed by a wider, more spread-out follow-up sequence.
beginner.whyItMatters: The shorter first reach is easier to land on survivors who are already close, while the extended follow-up bounds give more positional options after the initial grab. It suits a playstyle that favors precision over raw reach and wants more flexibility in where the survivor ends up.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a build prefers to grab survivors who are already in close range and then scatter them into different positions with the follow-up bounds. It is a common drop, making it one of the easier Virulent Bound add-ons to collect.

Addon_K29_05.name: Loose Crank
Addon_K29_05.description: To the person whose only tool is a crank, the whole world looks like a crank-shaped hole.Increases movement speed between the first and second Virulent Bounds by 15%.

beginner.whatItIs: Boosts the killer's movement speed between the first and second Virulent Bound, closing the gap faster after the initial grab. The extra pace makes the transition between the two bound states feel snappier and less punishable by a survivor trying to create distance.
beginner.whyItMatters: The speed bump in that specific window reduces the chance that a survivor can break out of the bound sequence by running, since the killer covers ground more quickly. It is a focused tempo improvement for one particular phase of the power rather than a broad mobility boost.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a build already commits to multi-bound sequences and wants to minimize the travel time between each segment. It is an uncommon drop, so it will appear regularly but not in every case.

Addon_K29_06.name: Leather Gloves
Addon_K29_06.description: Gloves of a cold, calculating schemer. They impart an air of icy professionalism.Decreases the time to recharge Virulent Bound by 8%.

beginner.whatItIs: It shaves a small amount of time off the Virulent Bound recharge, making the power ready for the next use slightly sooner. The reduction is modest, but over a full trial it adds up to extra bound sequences that the default cooldown would otherwise waste.
beginner.whyItMatters: A shorter recharge means the killer can apply the bound mechanic more frequently, which increases the total number of grab-and-infection cycles in a trial. It reads as a small but reliable tempo boost rather than a dramatic power shift.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a build already uses Virulent Bound on nearly every opportunity and wants to squeeze one or two extra cycles out of each trial. It is an uncommon drop, so it should surface with reasonable frequency in cases.

Addon_K29_07.name: Lion Medallion
Addon_K29_07.description: An old medallion depicting a brave lion. It was made when the Raccoon Police Station was still an art museum.Increases the distance at which Survivors are thrown by 30%.

beginner.whatItIs: A Virulent Bound offering that pushes survivors farther away when they are thrown, increasing the distance of the toss. The extra throw distance can separate a survivor from their current position, making it harder for them to stay in a safe spot or keep looping.
beginner.whyItMatters: The longer throw repositions the survivor away from where they were, which disrupts their planned route or keeps them away from a safe area like a locker or window vault. It is a positional tool that adds a layer of map control to the power.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Choose it when a build wants its throws to carry survivors further from cover and deeper into open tiles after a bound sequence. Uncommon rarity keeps it appearing in case pulls with reasonable frequency.

Addon_K29_08.name: Chalice (Gold)
Addon_K29_08.description: A chalice of pure gold used to celebrate the summer solstice.Increases the Virulent Bound extension when grabbing a Survivor mid-Bound by 50%.

beginner.whatItIs: Extends the reach of a mid-Bound grab, making it easier to catch a survivor who is moving away during the bound window. The added extension gives a wider net for the grab, turning a near-miss into a successful catch more often.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer mid-Bound extension reduces the frustration of a survivor just barely escaping the grab radius, which in turn makes the whole bound sequence feel more reliable. It reads as a confidence boost for grab timing rather than a fundamental change to the power's structure.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Fit it into a build where mid-Bound grabs keep landing just short of a survivor and a wider window would close that gap. Uncommon rarity means it will show up in the case system without endless pulls.

Addon_K29_09.name: Bullhorn
Addon_K29_09.description:
The commands screamed into this device riled up some and disoriented others.Survivors that use the First Aid Spray suffer from the Oblivious status effect for 30 seconds.

Oblivious prevents Survivors from hearing or being affected by the Killer's Terror Radius.

beginner.whatItIs: Punishes survivors who use the First Aid Spray by leaving them Oblivious, which silences the killer's Terror Radius for a sustained period. The Oblivious window is long enough to cover a full healing cycle, so the survivor cannot rely on hearing cues to track the killer's approach.
beginner.whyItMatters: Removing Terror Radius awareness during a healing window means the survivor cannot listen for the killer's footsteps or sense their approach from a distance, which makes healing sessions far more dangerous. It is a targeted anti-heal tool that specifically counters the audio-based awareness survivors rely on.
beginner.whenToUseIt: It suits a build that wants to strip a survivor's awareness of the Terror Radius the moment they deploy a First Aid Spray. Uncommon rarity keeps it arriving in the case system at a steady pace.

Addon_K29_10.name: Portable Safe
Addon_K29_10.description:
A small container that requires a complicated combination to unlock.Survivors injured by Virulent Bound suffer from the Hemorrhage status effect until fully healed.

Hemorrhage regresses healing progress when not healing, and increases blood trails left by injured Survivors. This lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

beginner.whatItIs: Leaves survivors injured by Virulent Bound suffering from Hemorrhage until they are fully healed, regressing their healing progress and lengthening their blood trail. The condition persists across multiple healing attempts, so each pause in healing loses accumulated progress.
beginner.whyItMatters: The persistent Hemorrhage makes every healing session a race against regression, which forces survivors to either commit to a full heal in one continuous stretch or accept a longer total recovery time. It also makes the blood trail harder to hide, giving the killer extra tracking information after a bound injury.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Go with it when a build wants bound injuries to leave a persistent bleeding state that drags out healing and strengthens the trail to follow. Rare rarity means it will not land quickly in the case system.

Addon_K29_11.name: Red Herb
Addon_K29_11.description: Acts as a reagent that strengthens the effect of that with which it is combined.Increases the time it takes for Survivors to use a First Aid Spray by 2 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Slows the time it takes a survivor to use the First Aid Spray, adding a small delay to their self-heal interaction. The extra interaction time lands in the exact moment a survivor is most vulnerable, between stopping their movement and completing the heal.
beginner.whyItMatters: Even a brief delay in a self-heal interaction can be the window a killer needs to close the distance and land a hit, because the survivor is stationary and committed to the animation. It is a small but precise anti-heal tweak rather than a broad stat change.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Fit it into a build that already punishes healing attempts and wants to stretch the spray channel just a touch longer. Rare rarity means the case system will hold it back for a while.

Addon_K29_12.name: Maiden Medallion
Addon_K29_12.description:
A medallion depicting a beautiful maiden. Its purpose was unknown for many years.When a Survivor becomes fully Infected, they suffer from the Blindness status effect for 60 seconds.

Blindness prevents Survivors from seeing auras.

beginner.whatItIs: Blinds a survivor for a sustained period the moment they reach the fully Infected state, removing their ability to see auras. The Blindness window is long enough to cover an entire healing session or generator interaction, leaving the survivor without map awareness.
beginner.whyItMatters: Stripping aura visibility the instant a survivor crosses into full Infection blinds them to generators, allies, and the killer's position all at once. That kind of total sensory loss turns the Infected state into a far more punishing moment than a simple duration change would.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick it for a build that wants the fully Infected transition to feel like a wall of silence, leaving survivors unable to read auras. Rare rarity means it will not pop out of the case system overnight.

Addon_K29_13.name: Video Conference Device
Addon_K29_13.description: Many intricate conspiracies were orchestrated on devices just like this one.Increases the Infection passive gain rate by 30%.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into Virulent Bound and raises the passive rate at which Infection builds on every survivor. Survivors drift closer to the fully Infected state faster, even when no grab has landed. It makes the infection meter a constant background pressure rather than something that only moves after a successful grab.
beginner.whyItMatters: A quicker passive Infection gain means survivors have less total time before they are fully Infected, which reduces the window they have to heal, use perks, or escape. It is a broad tempo change that affects every survivor in the trial simultaneously rather than targeting one specific interaction.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Choose it when a build wants to drag every survivor toward full Infection on a faster clock and shorten the overall trial. Rare rarity means it will not appear in the case system on a regular basis.

Addon_K29_14.name: Egg (Gold)
Addon_K29_14.description: A highly coveted foodstuff. The cash worth is second only to its regenerative effects.Increases the duration of the additional Virulent Bound window by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: A rare add-on for Virulent Bound that extends the bonus window the power grants after it triggers. It keeps the extra state active for a longer stretch, which gives the killer more time to act while the bonus is live.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer bonus window means the effect of Virulent Bound carries through more chase moments before fading, which is a steady quality-of-life bump rather than a full shift in how the power plays. It turns a power that already rewards timing into one that is a bit more forgiving when a chase drags out.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the Virulent Bound bonus is about to expire and a survivor is close to breaking free, since the extra moment of the bonus state can seal the trade. It carries a rare rating, so drops come less often than common add-ons but more often than the iridescent ones.

Addon_K29_15.name: Dark Sunglasses
Addon_K29_15.description:
Glasses enhanced with AR that grant the wearer an invaluable advantage on the battlefield.When a Survivor is fully infected with the Uroboros Infection, gain the Undetectable status effect for 20 seconds.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

beginner.whatItIs: These AR-enhanced glasses slot into Virulent Bound and grant the Undetectable status effect when a survivor reaches full infection. While active, they hide the killer's aura, terror radius, and red stain from that survivor.
beginner.whyItMatters: Going undetectable at the peak of a survivor's infection gives the killer a brief window of complete invisibility, which is a meaningful tactical shift because the survivor loses every visual cue to the killer's position. It reads as a strong pressure tool rather than a small stat bump.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a full-infection chase is about to end and you want to vanish for a moment to reposition or stalk a different survivor. The veryrare rating means drops are infrequent, so save the slot for trials where the infection cycle is close to completion and the payoff justifies the wait.

Addon_K29_16.name: Helicopter Stick
Addon_K29_16.description: Debris from a helicopter crash. Few jobs are more dangerous than a helicopter pilot’s when Wesker is involved.When a Survivor uses a First Aid Spray, reveal their aura for 8 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: A veryrare add-on for Virulent Bound that reveals a survivor's aura the instant they use a First Aid Spray. The reveal lasts for a short window, making the survivor's position visible to the killer during that moment.
beginner.whyItMatters: Catching a survivor mid-heal and exposing their location breaks the safety net of a First Aid Spray, which turns a moment of recovery into a moment of vulnerability. It is a small but sharp tool that rewards the killer for being nearby when a survivor tries to heal.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a survivor has been hiding and you suspect they are about to use a First Aid Spray, since the reveal window is short and only pays off if the killer is already in range. The veryrare rating makes it a reward for persistence rather than something that drops every trial.

Addon_K29_17.name: Uroboros Tendril
Addon_K29_17.description: The result of decades of Bio Organic Weapon research. It will not rest until it has swallowed the entire world.Increases movement speed while charging Virulent Bound by 5%.

beginner.whatItIs: The Uroboros Tendril is a common add-on for Virulent Bound that increases the killer's movement speed while the power is charging. The speed boost only applies during the charge phase, so it does not affect other states.
beginner.whyItMatters: Moving faster during the charge phase shortens the time between actions, which makes the power feel snappier and more responsive in a chase. It is a small movement-speed tweak, but for a power that relies on repeated charges, that extra speed compounds over a full trial.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a chase-heavy trial is expected and the killer needs every bit of speed while channeling Virulent Bound. Its common rating means it drops frequently, so it is an easy early pick for anyone learning the power's charge cycle.

Addon_K29_18.name: Uroboros Virus
Addon_K29_18.description: For some, the strength and resistance was worth the trade-off.When a Survivor reaches full infection, reveal their aura for 4 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Uroboros Virus slots into Virulent Bound and briefly exposes the survivor's location the moment infection hits its peak. The reveal window is short, but it hands the killer a clear read at the exact point where the chase is most intense.
beginner.whyItMatters: Seeing a fully infected survivor's position for even a short beat lets the killer lock down a chase that would otherwise be blind. It is a small information window, but in the chaos of a full-infection chase that glimpse can be the difference between a clean hit and a missed swing.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it to maps where closing the final stretch matters and one brief read of the hiding spot is enough to seal the hunt. Its veryrare rating means long wait times between drops, so treat it as a bonus layer rather than a foundation for the build.

Addon_K29_19.name: Lab Photo
Addon_K29_19.description: Wesker was as much a researcher as he was a guinea pig for Umbrella's bio-weapons.You can special-break Pallets and Breakable Walls with Virulent Bound.Removes the ability to special-vault pallets while using Virulent Bound.

beginner.whatItIs: The Lab Photo is an iridescent add-on for Virulent Bound that lets the killer special-break pallets and breakable walls while using the power. It removes the special-vault ability as a trade-off, so the killer gains obstacle destruction but loses the vault shortcut.
beginner.whyItMatters: Trading the special-vault for the ability to smash through obstacles reshapes how the killer moves through the map during Virulent Bound, turning walls and pallets from cover into obstacles the power can destroy. It is a bigger shift in playstyle than most add-ons, since it changes which routes are viable during the power's active window.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a trial layout has many breakable walls and pallets blocking the killer's preferred routes, since the ability to destroy them while channeling opens up paths that would otherwise force a detour. The iridescent rating makes it a rare find, so it is best saved for maps where that extra mobility truly changes the chase geometry.

Addon_K29_20.name: Iridescent Uroboros Vial
Addon_K29_20.description:
The perfect bio-weapon. Decades of research have led to this.Survivors start the trial Infected with Uroboros.Survivors suffer from the Exposed status effect for 30 seconds when reaching maximum Infection.

Exposed Survivors will be downed by basic attacks even if uninjured.

beginner.whatItIs: Iridescent Uroboros Vial slots into Virulent Bound and starts the trial with every survivor already carrying infection. Reaching maximum infection then applies the Exposed status, turning even a clean basic attack into a guaranteed down.
beginner.whyItMatters: Starting every survivor infected removes the early chase entirely and shifts the trial toward the endgame much sooner, which is a dramatic change in pacing and pressure. The Exposed effect at full infection means even a basic attack can down an uninjured survivor, which turns the final stage into a near-guaranteed kill if the killer lands one clean swing.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a trial is about to hit the infection cap and you want the endgame to start faster with a bigger payoff. The iridescent rating means it drops very infrequently, so it is best treated as a rare reward for a trial that has already been played to the late stages.

Addon_K30_01.name: Gritty Lump
Addon_K30_01.description:
A rock-hard, dense loaf filled their stomachs on most days, giving them the energy to commit truly heinous acts.

Increases Guards' movement Speed while on Patrol by 9%.

beginner.whatItIs: The Gritty Lump is a common add-on for Guardia Compagnia that increases the movement speed of Guards while they are on Patrol. The speed boost only applies during the patrol state, so it does not affect other phases of the power.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster patrols mean Guards cover more ground in the same time, which reduces the windows where a survivor can slip between them. It is a small speed bump, but over a full trial the extra pace adds up and makes the patrol presence feel more constant.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a trial map has wide open spaces and you need Guards to cross them quickly rather than loitering in one area. Its common rating means it drops frequently, making it a solid early choice for learning how patrol speed shapes the flow of a chase.

Addon_K30_02.name: Map of the Realm
Addon_K30_02.description:
These unique leather maps were not easy to come by, but when they could not be purchased, they could be taken by force.

Increases the detection Range for Guards on Patrol by 2 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: These leather maps slot into Guardia Compagnia and extend the detection range for Guards on Patrol. The wider range lets a Guard spot a survivor from slightly further away than the base detection would allow.
beginner.whyItMatters: A wider detection range means survivors who try to stay just outside a Guard's notice have less room to hide, which tightens the space available for sneaking. It is a small range bump, but in tight maps that extra reach can turn a safe loop into a dangerous one.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a trial map is dense with cover and you suspect survivors will try to loop just beyond patrol range. Its common rating means it is easy to obtain, so it pairs well with any build that leans on patrol presence to control map space.

Addon_K30_03.name: Tattered Tabard
Addon_K30_03.description:
Cloaked in heavy fabrics, neither human nor nature could stop them once they had their target.

Increases Patrol time for all Guards by 8 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: It attaches to Guardia Compagnia and extends how long a Guard stays in its Patrol state before moving on. The longer patrol window gives the killer more predictable map presence to plan around. It carries a common rarity, making it an easy pick for anyone leaning on steady patrol pressure.
beginner.whyItMatters: Longer patrols mean Guards stay in their patrol role for more time, which gives the killer more windows of predictable movement to plan around. It is a duration bump that rewards patient play, since a Guard that patrols longer gives the killer more time to set up the next phase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a trial calls for steady, methodical pressure rather than burst aggression, since longer patrols keep the Guard cycle predictable and give more time to plan the next action. Its common rating makes it a low-risk pick for any Guardia Compagnia build that values consistency.

Addon_K30_04.name: Pillaged Mead
Addon_K30_04.description:
Drinks taken from their victims tasted sweet, but such frivolities were often short-lived.

Guards special-break Pallets and Breakable walls, and damage Generators 10% faster.

beginner.whatItIs: Pillaged Mead slots into Guardia Compagnia and lets Guards smash through pallets and breakable walls during their patrol. It also nudges their generator damage upward, pushing the trial pace a little harder.
beginner.whyItMatters: Giving Guards the ability to smash through obstacles while patrolling changes how they move through the map, since pallets and walls that once blocked their path no longer slow them down. The faster generator damage is a secondary benefit that nudges the trial pace slightly forward.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a trial map is heavy on breakables and you want Guards to push through cover rather than routing around it. Its common rating means it is widely available, making it a practical pick for maps where obstacle density is the main bottleneck in patrol speed.

Addon_K30_05.name: Dried Horsemeat
Addon_K30_05.description:
Long campaigns often required restocking, and the steeds of fallen enemies were as good as any farm-fresh ration.

Increases the amount of time a Guard will Hunt a Survivor by 4 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Dried Horsemeat is an uncommon add-on for Guardia Compagnia that extends the duration of a Guard's Hunt state once a survivor is detected. The longer Hunt gives the killer more time to track the survivor down before the Guard resets.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer Hunt window gives the killer more time to track a survivor down before the Guard resets, which is a meaningful extension of the chase phase. It is a duration bump, but for a power where the Hunt is the primary kill mechanism, that extra time compounds into noticeably more chase pressure.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a trial map is large and you need the Guard to keep chasing after a survivor for longer before giving up. Its uncommon rating means it drops less often than common add-ons, so save it for trials where chase length is the main bottleneck.

Addon_K30_06.name: Battleaxe Head
Addon_K30_06.description:
Sander Rault was a tower of a man, terrifying in form and demeanor.

Decreases the cooldown after summoning The Carnifex by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: Battleaxe Head pairs with Guardia Compagnia and trims the recovery window after calling The Carnifex into the trial. A shorter gap between deployments lets the killer reassert that entity's pressure more consistently.
beginner.whyItMatters: A shorter cooldown between Carnifex summons means the killer can pressure survivors with that entity more frequently, which tightens the window between attacks and leaves less breathing room. It is a cooldown shave that compounds over a full trial, making The Carnifex feel more like a constant threat than a burst tool.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a trial calls for sustained pressure through The Carnifex and you want the gap between summons to stay short. It carries an uncommon rating, so it is a steady drop, and it pairs well with builds that lean on repeated Carnifex engagements rather than one-shot kills.

Addon_K30_07.name: Treated Blade
Addon_K30_07.description:
Durkos Malecek stuck to the shadows, and was an efficient slaughterer.

Decreases the cooldown after summoning The Assassin by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: Treated Blade attaches to Guardia Compagnia and shortens the wait between successive deployments of The Assassin. The faster turnarounds keep the killer's offensive options available more often during extended chases.
beginner.whyItMatters: A shorter cooldown between Assassin summons means the killer can deploy that entity more frequently, which keeps pressure on survivors who try to heal or escape. It is a cooldown shave that makes The Assassin feel more like a persistent stalking presence than a one-time ambush tool.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a trial calls for repeated ambushes through The Assassin and you want the gap between deployments to stay tight. Its uncommon rating means it is a steady drop, so it fits builds that chain Assassin engages across multiple generators.

Addon_K30_08.name: Cold Steel Manacles
Addon_K30_08.description:
Alejandro Santiago apprenticed as an armorer, and showed no remorse.

Decreases the cooldown after summoning The Jailer by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: Cold Steel Manacles pairs with Guardia Compagnia and cuts the recovery time after summoning The Jailer. More frequent lockdowns keep survivors from settling into safe repair windows.
beginner.whyItMatters: Shortening the gap between Jailer summons turns a single lock into a recurring tool for dictating where survivors can and cannot recover. The cumulative effect is steady pressure on escape windows rather than one dramatic play per cycle.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Slot it in when the trial layout rewards multiple lockdown cycles and the killer wants The Jailer back in rotation quickly after each use. Its uncommon rating keeps drops reasonably frequent, so it suits any build that leans on repeated Jailer engagements to strangle survivor movement.

Addon_K30_09.name: Call To Arms
Addon_K30_09.description:
Posted across many towns, lords desperate to protect their riches posted for able-bodied mercenaries. None survived.

Increases the length of a Patrol Path by 4 meters, and, while creating the path, movement speed is increased by 7%.

beginner.whatItIs: Call To Arms slots into Guardia Compagnia and lengthens every Patrol Path the Guard traces. While the killer is laying down that extended path, a movement speed bonus makes the whole setup phase move faster.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer patrol path gives the Guard more ground to cover in a single pass, while the speed boost during path creation makes the setup phase feel faster and less vulnerable. Together these two effects turn the patrol into a more efficient tool for controlling large stretches of map.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip Call To Arms on wide, open maps where the Guard needs to sweep a larger area before survivors can slip back behind cover. Because it only drops at uncommon rarity, it shows up often enough that you can count on it being in your inventory when the map calls for a longer patrol.

Addon_K30_10.name: Sharpened Mount
Addon_K30_10.description:
To stand before the Standard of the Guardia Compagnia was to stand at the threshold between life and death.

Increases the time it takes for the Standard to spawn by 15%.

beginner.whatItIs: Sharpened Mount pairs with Guardia Compagnia and delays the moment the Standard appears on the map. Pushing that spawn later stretches the early phase of the trial, giving the killer a longer window to build momentum on their own terms.
beginner.whyItMatters: A later Standard entrance means the killer has more time to set up the trial before that entity enters the field, which can be useful for building momentum before a big set-piece. It is a timing shift rather than a power boost, so it changes the pacing of the trial more than the raw strength of any single action.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Slot it in when the early minutes of a trial need to stay under the killer's control and delaying the Standard's entrance buys time to set up patrol routes first. Its rare rating means it will not appear often, so it fits best into builds that already have a clear pacing plan before the trial starts.

Addon_K30_11.name: Grim Iron Mask
Addon_K30_11.description:
No method of torture was too base for Guardia Compagnia. Pain and humiliation went hand-in-hand.

When a Survivor is Detected by a Guard, the Survivor suffers from Blindness for 75 seconds.

Blindness prevents Survivors from seeing auras.

beginner.whatItIs: Grim Iron Mask attaches to Guardia Compagnia and blinds a survivor the instant a Guard spots them. While blind, the survivor loses all aura vision, stripping away the primary tool for tracking the killer's position.
beginner.whyItMatters: Blindness removes a survivor's ability to read the map through auras, which strips away their primary tool for tracking the killer and other survivors. It is a strong information-denial effect, and the long duration means the survivor is working blind for most of the recovery window, which shifts the balance of a chase heavily toward the killer.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a trial map is small and you want the moment of detection to cost the survivor dearly rather than just marking them. Its rare rating means it is a slower drop than common add-ons, so it is best paired with builds that detect survivors early and often.

Addon_K30_12.name: Broken Hilt
Addon_K30_12.description:
A fresh weapon is clean, even surgical; an attack with a broken one is malicious and desperate.

Guards inflict the Hemorrhage and Mangled status effects for 70 seconds when damaging a Survivor.

Hemorrhage regresses healing progress when not healing, and increases blood trails left by injured Survivors.This lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

Mangled increases time required to heal by 25% for a set duration or until fully healed.

beginner.whatItIs: Broken Hilt slots into Guardia Compagnia and coats every Guard attack with both Hemorrhage and Mangled. Hemorrhage lets healing progress regress and lengthens blood trails, while Mangled slows the pace of any healing a survivor attempts.
beginner.whyItMatters: Broken Hilt turns every Guard hit into a lasting problem: Hemorrhage quietly erodes healing progress and leaves longer blood trails, while Mangled stretches out how long a full recovery takes. The combination means injured survivors cannot simply sit at a locker and be done, because the status effects keep working against them even after they stop.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a trial calls for extended chase pressure and you want every Guard hit to make the survivor's recovery window longer and more dangerous. Its rare rating means it drops less frequently than common add-ons, so it suits trials where healing speed is the main bottleneck in the survivor escape cycle.

Addon_K30_13.name: Ironworker’s Tongs
Addon_K30_13.description:
Vital for repairs between battles and a horrifying, gauging, tearing improvisational weapon.

When a Survivor escapes a Guard Hunt successfully, they suffer from the Oblivious status effect for 60 seconds.

Oblivious prevents survivors from hearing or being affected by the Killer's Terror Radius.

beginner.whatItIs: Ironworker's Tongs pairs with Guardia Compagnia and applies the Oblivious status to any survivor who breaks free from a Guard Hunt. While Oblivious, that survivor can neither hear the Terror Radius cues nor be affected by them.
beginner.whyItMatters: Oblivious cuts off a survivor's Terror Radius feedback the moment they escape, which removes one of their most reliable early-warning tools during the critical seconds after a chase. It is a targeted information cut that punishes the escape itself rather than the chase, which is a subtle but meaningful shift in post-chase pressure.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it to maps full of escape loops where survivors routinely slip out of Guard Hunts and the killer wants to punish each successful break by silencing their Terror Radius feedback. At its rare tier it will not appear often, so it is worth holding onto for builds that generate a high volume of Hunt escapes and want every one of them to carry a cost.

Addon_K30_14.name: Town Watch’s Torch
Addon_K30_14.description:
Upon breaching a village, the first thing they would extinguish was the torches, and with them, hope.

While a Guard is actively Hunting a Survivor, gain the Undetectable status effect.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

beginner.whatItIs: An add-on for Guardia Compagnia that grants the Undetectable status to the Guard while it is actively hunting a survivor. During the hunt, the killer's aura, terror radius, and red stain all vanish from nearby survivors.
beginner.whyItMatters: Survivors lose the visual and audio cues that normally warn them a guard is closing in, which turns a tracked hunt into something that arrives almost out of nowhere. That is a meaningful shift in how an active hunt feels, since undetectable removes the primary tool survivors use to react to a chase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in matches where survivors tend to ignore the sounds of an active hunt or rely heavily on seeing the red stain to react. It is a rare pull, so the extra invisibility during chases is worth grabbing when it shows up in the menu.

Addon_K30_15.name: Blacksmith’s Hammer
Addon_K30_15.description:
In their hands, everything was a weapon.

Guards inflict the Broken status effect for 60 seconds when damaging a Survivor.

Broken prevents Survivors from being healed.

beginner.whatItIs: Every Guard hit applies Broken to the struck survivor, blocking healing for an extended window. It is a very rare add-on that slots into Guardia Compagnia.
beginner.whyItMatters: That is a bigger shift than a small tweak because it locks the struck survivor out of being healed for a long stretch after getting hit, cutting off their own path to recovery entirely. Chases become more punishing since even a glancing hit can leave that survivor fighting through the rest of the encounter with no way to mend.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if survivors in the lobby lean heavily on quick heals to recover between chases, since the Broken window will eat into that rhythm. It is a very rare pull, so the healing denial is worth slotting in when it appears.

Addon_K30_16.name: Flint and Steel
Addon_K30_16.description:
Attacks at night were not uncommon. Fear was often their greatest ally.

After summoning The Carnifex, The Knight can see the auras of Survivors within 24 meters of downed pallets for 8 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: The Carnifex summon opens a brief vision window that exposes survivor auras clustered near downed pallets. The very rare pull slots into Guardia Compagnia.
beginner.whyItMatters: That vision burst is a small but targeted tweak that punishes the specific tactic of camping near a downed pallet to hide from the knight. It does not change the overall flow of a trial but adds a reliable way to flush out survivors who try to play hide-and-seek in the early minutes.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when survivors in the lobby favor pallet-hiding play or when the killer wants to flush out someone slacking on generators. The rarity makes it a welcome bonus, so the extra vision near the boards is well worth taking.

Addon_K30_17.name: Healing Poultice
Addon_K30_17.description:
Their reputation was so large, so horrible, that the mere knowledge that they were coming was enough to bring people to their knees.

After summoning The Assassin, all Survivors within 8 meters from the Guard's initial position have their aura revealed for 8 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Summoning The Assassin flashes the auras of survivors standing close to the Guard's spawn point for a short moment. It is a very rare pull for Guardia Compagnia.
beginner.whyItMatters: That early reveal is a small tweak that helps with map awareness in the opening seconds, since it shows where survivors clustered before the trial settles into its usual rhythm. It is not a game-changing shift but a useful information nudge for a killer who wants to know where to walk first.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if the killer tends to lose track of where survivors cluster in the opening seconds, since the reveal hands over a clear heading for the first push. Rarity keeps the pull out of most inventories, so the information bonus is well worth keeping around.

Addon_K30_18.name: Jailer's Chimes
Addon_K30_18.description:
Many captives met the same grisly end for attempting to escape his clutches.

After summoning The Jailer, Survivors that cross his Patrol Path have their aura revealed for 8 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Crossing the Patrol Path after a Jailer summon flashes a survivor's aura briefly. It is a very rare add-on for Guardia Compagnia.
beginner.whyItMatters: That path-based reveal is a small but consistent tweak that rewards planning the patrol route carefully, since survivors who cross the line give themselves up. It is not a huge shift in how the Jailer plays but a reliable way to catch survivors who cut corners or shortcut through the patrol zone.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer wants to punish survivors who shortcut across open ground or cross known patrol corridors. The rarity means it will not sit in every inventory, so the extra information from a path crossing is a solid bonus to hold.

Addon_K30_19.name: Knight’s Contract
Addon_K30_19.description:
The original document contracting Tarhos to Vittorio’s employ. The laws of man could not stand up, though, to natural law.

After giving an Order, the Guard will remain for an extra 8 seconds, triggering a Hunt if they detect a Survivor.

beginner.whatItIs: An iridescent add-on for Guardia Compagnia that extends a Guard's stationed time after an Order is given. If the Guard spots a survivor during that extended window, it immediately launches a Hunt.
beginner.whyItMatters: That extra time is a small tweak that makes Orders feel more committed, since the Guard lingers long enough to actually catch someone who walks past. It is not a huge power spike but it changes the commitment of the Order from a brief flash into a more reliable threat.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if Orders feel too brief and survivors are slipping through the window before the Guard can react. It is an iridescent pull, so the extra commitment time is worth slotting in when it appears.

Addon_K30_20.name: Iridescent Company Banner
Addon_K30_20.description:
Where this banner was raised, those who called themselves "civilized" ran and hid, because for all their codes and laws, they had nothing resembling actual strength.

While a Survivor is Hunted by a Guard, spikes block the exit for the Hunted Survivor. When they vault, that vault location is blocked for all Survivors for the duration of the Hunt.While creating a Patrol Path, passing through vault locations will block these locations for 25 seconds after summoning a Guard.

beginner.whatItIs: The iridescent pull for Guardia Compagnia seals vault routes while a Guard hunts a survivor. The specific vault the hunted survivor uses becomes blocked for everyone once they clear it, and vaults passed through during a Patrol Path stay sealed after the summon.
beginner.whyItMatters: That vault-blocking is a bigger shift than a simple stat bump because it changes the geometry of an escape, forcing the hunted survivor to take a longer route or get caught in a loop. It also punishes the whole team if a vault is used during the hunt, which adds a layer of coordination cost to the survivors.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when survivors lean heavily on vaulting to break chases, since the locked exits force them into longer and more predictable escape routes. The iridescent rarity keeps it scarce, so the escape restriction is a strong reason to slot it in.

Addon_K31_01.name: Adi Valente #1
Addon_K31_01.description:
An original copy of the first issue of Adi Valente, the comic her father made while Adriana was a child.

Survivors with a Claw Trap suffer from 20% smaller skill checks. This effect lasts until the Claw Trap is removed.

beginner.whatItIs: Slotting into Eyes In The Sky, the common pull shrinks the skill check radius for any survivor caught in a Claw Trap. The tighter window makes precise button presses noticeably harder to land while the trap remains attached.
beginner.whyItMatters: That smaller circle is a small but consistent tweak that punishes survivors who are trying to land a clean skill check while trapped, since the margin for error gets tighter. It does not change the overall trap game but makes the button press feel more fragile and stressful.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if survivors in the lobby are good at skill checks and tend to land them cleanly under pressure, since the smaller radius makes their precision matter less. It is a common pull, so it will show up often enough to be a familiar part of the trap rotation.

Addon_K31_02.name: High-Power Floodlight
Addon_K31_02.description:
A sudden and overwhelming light that discombobulates anyone foolish enough to approach.

Survivors with a Claw Trap suffer from the Blindness status effect. This effect lasts until the Claw Trap is removed. Blindness prevents Survivors from seeing auras.

beginner.whatItIs: A common add-on for Eyes In The Sky that blinds any survivor under a Claw Trap. While the trap is attached, aura visibility vanishes entirely, cutting off the ability to track healers or spot the killer's position.
beginner.whyItMatters: That complete loss of auras is a bigger shift than a simple debuff because it strips away one of the core tools a survivor uses to navigate a trial, forcing them to play blind while trapped. It turns a Claw Trap from a minor inconvenience into a genuinely disorienting state where the survivor cannot see where allies or the killer are.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when survivors in the lobby rely on auras to make decisions like healing or tracking the killer, since the blindness will scramble their information flow. It is a common pull, so the aura removal is a frequent and useful addition to a trap-focused setup.

Addon_K31_03.name: Geographical Readout
Addon_K31_03.description: The drones generate and communicate a detailed three-dimensional map of the terrain, making traversal easier.Whenever you deploy a Drone, for 8 seconds, you basic-vault Windows, basic-break Pallets or Breakable Walls, and damage Generators 20% faster.

beginner.whatItIs: Eyes In The Sky drones sketch out a detailed map of the terrain and trigger a brief speed burst after each deployment. Within that window, vaulting, pallet-breaking, and generator work all proceed at a quicker clip. The mapping also eases traversal across the map between chases.
beginner.whyItMatters: That speed burst makes each drone do more than just detect, since it also helps the killer keep pace with survivor progress across the map. It reads as a quality-of-life bump that makes placement feel more rewarding rather than a raw power increase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if the killer wants the drone to feel more useful beyond detection, especially when a quick vault or pallet break is needed to close distance on a target. The rarity keeps it out of most inventories, so the speed window is a solid bonus to hold when it appears.

Addon_K31_04.name: High Current Upgrade
Addon_K31_04.description:
A wider cable with low resistance that allows faster recharging of batteries.

Increases the time Survivors appear on the radar when detected by 1 second.

beginner.whatItIs: The common pull for Eyes In The Sky extends how long a detected survivor stays visible on the radar. The extra moment gives the killer a slightly wider reaction window before the ping fades.
beginner.whyItMatters: That extra visibility is a small tweak that makes each detection more actionable, since the killer has a bit more time to turn toward the survivor and plan a response. It is not a major shift but it smooths out the moment between spotting a survivor and being able to act on it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the radar ping tends to vanish before a killer can react, since the longer window gives a more comfortable margin to respond. It is a common pull, so the extra reaction time is a familiar and useful addition to the radar setup.

Addon_K31_05.name: Adaptive Lighting
Addon_K31_05.description:
The drone takes account of the surrounding area and casts lights in a bewildering manner that obscures movement.

Increases the duration of the Undetectable status effect by 20%. Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into Eyes In The Sky and extends how long Undetectable lingers after the drone deploys. While active, the scattered light pattern obscures movement so survivors struggle to track the killer across the map.
beginner.whyItMatters: The longer invisibility window makes repositioning feel less pressured, since the killer has more breathing room to pick a better approach angle before being spotted. It is a steady quality-of-life gain rather than a dramatic power shift.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if a killer tends to get caught repositioning while a drone is still in its invisible state, since the longer window makes that transition less risky. It is an uncommon pull, so the extra stealth time is a solid addition to a sneaky drone setup.

Addon_K31_06.name: Stereo Remote Mic
Addon_K31_06.description:
An upgrade that allows increased three-dimensional audio tracking.

Decreases the Disabled state duration of Drones by 15%.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into Eyes In The Sky and trims the disabled window between drone rotations. The drones recover faster, keeping spatial audio tracking active for a longer stretch of each match.
beginner.whyItMatters: That shorter downtime is a small but consistent tweak that makes the drone feel more present and less like it disappears for long gaps. It is not a huge shift but it smooths out the rhythm of the swarm, making the detection coverage feel more continuous.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the gaps between drone availability feel too long and survivors exploit the dead time to reposition. It is an uncommon pull, so the tighter rotation is a reliable upgrade to the drone's uptime.

Addon_K31_07.name: Supercharge
Addon_K31_07.description:
The batteries may run a little hot, but removing the safety protocols from the cells makes them last a little longer.

Increases the battery life of Claw Traps by 15%.

beginner.whatItIs: Extends how long each Claw Trap stays armed once placed, and it attaches to Eyes In The Sky. The trap remains a live hazard for a longer period, raising the chance it catches a passing survivor.
beginner.whyItMatters: The longer active window makes each placed trap feel more like a persistent hazard than a quick gamble. It does not overhaul how Claw Traps play, but the extra time on the field meaningfully raises the odds that a trap actually connects with a survivor who walks past it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if a killer often places Claw Traps and they expire before a survivor walks through, since the extra window gives more time for the trap to pay off. It is an uncommon pull, so the extended duration is a solid reason to slot it in when it appears.

Addon_K31_08.name: Shotgun Speakers
Addon_K31_08.description:
Capable of directing high-frequency noises in a single direction over great distances, the drones can focus in on one individual and distract them from danger for some time.

Survivors with a Claw Trap have no skill check warning. This effect lasts until the Claw Trap is removed.

beginner.whatItIs: A Claw Trap upgrade for Eyes In The Sky that removes the skill check warning audio from trapped survivors. The survivor now presses the button blind, with no directional cue about where the target zone lands.
beginner.whyItMatters: Removing the audio cue strips away the directional signal that lets a trapped survivor time their button press, turning a learnable check into a pure reaction. The trap mechanics stay unchanged, but the survivor now faces the skill check without any auditory warning to guide the timing.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in lobbies where survivors are experienced with skill checks and time their presses carefully, since the missing audio removes their timing advantage. It is an uncommon pull, so the audio removal slots well into a trap-focused build when it appears.

Addon_K31_09.name: Low-Power Mode
Addon_K31_09.description:
By intermittently powering off and on non-vital components, the drone can stay on for longer.

Decreases Drone Rotation speed by 100%.

beginner.whatItIs: Locks the drone's detection cone into a single fixed direction when installed on Eyes In The Sky. The predictable sweep disappears entirely, so survivors can no longer time their movements against the rotation.
beginner.whyItMatters: That fixed direction is a bigger shift in how the drone plays because it changes the detection pattern from a sweeping arc to a static beam, which is harder to dodge once a survivor learns the angle. It is not about more range or faster detection but about removing the predictable rhythm that survivors use to slip past.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if survivors in the lobby have learned to time their movement against the drone's sweep, since the static cone removes that timing game entirely. It is an uncommon pull, so the fixed detection pattern is a solid change to the drone's behavior.

Addon_K31_10.name: Powdered Glass
Addon_K31_10.description:
Once used on the strings used for battle kites, this powdered glass took on a much more nefarious purpose on her blade.

Claw Trapped Survivors you hit suffer from the Hemorrhage and Mangled status effects for 70 seconds.

Hemorrhage regresses healing progress when not healing, and increases blood trails left by injured survivors. This lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

Mangled increases time required to heal by 25% and lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

beginner.whatItIs: Coats the blade so that any Claw-Trapped survivor who takes a hit picks up Hemorrhage and Mangled, and it belongs to Eyes In The Sky. Hemorrhage regresses healing progress and thickens blood trails, while Mangled slows recovery over a long window.
beginner.whyItMatters: That double debuff is a bigger shift than a single status effect because it attacks healing from two angles at once, making recovery slower and less reliable for the trapped survivor. It is not just about the hit itself but about what follows, since the survivor struggles to heal and bleeds through their progress.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a killer wants a Claw Trap to feel more punishing after a hit, especially in situations where survivors try to heal quickly after taking damage. It is a rare pull, so the stacked healing penalties are worth grabbing when it shows up.

Addon_K31_11.name: Vital Targeting Processor
Addon_K31_11.description:
An additional process in the drone’s programming more accurately predicts the weaknesses of potential prey.

Increases the Hindered status effect gained by Claw Trapped Survivors when detected by a Drone by 2%. Hindered reduces Survivor movement speed.

beginner.whatItIs: Bolts onto Eyes In The Sky and strengthens the Hindered penalty on Claw-Trapped survivors when a drone spots them. The extra slow is subtle but consistent, shaving a little more ground off each detection.
beginner.whyItMatters: The added speed loss makes each drone detection feel a touch more punishing, since the trapped survivor covers less ground while slowed. Over a full match those small penalties compound, making the trap-and-drone combo feel tighter and more cohesive.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a chase build wants drone detections to hit a little harder without overhauling the trap game, since the extra slow adds consistent pressure. It is a rare pull, so the added speed loss is a solid addition when it appears in a case.

Addon_K31_12.name: Brown Noise Generator
Addon_K31_12.description:
An ominous hum disseminates from the drone, blanketing the soundscape and making it difficult to hear anything else.

Survivors with a Claw Trap suffer from the Oblivious status effect. This lasts until the Claw Trap is removed. Oblivious prevents Survivors from hearing or being affected by the Killer's Terror Radius.

beginner.whatItIs: Drowns out Terror Radius audio for any survivor sitting inside a Claw Trap, and it slots into Eyes In The Sky. The trapped survivor loses the audio warning that signals a killer closing in, and the silence persists until the trap is broken.
beginner.whyItMatters: Cutting off the Terror Radius audio removes a core sense that survivors use to detect the killer nearby, forcing them to play blind while trapped. The trap mechanics themselves stay the same, but the survivor loses one of their primary early-warning channels during the most vulnerable window of the chase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in lobbies where survivors time their repositions by listening to the Terror Radius, since the Oblivious effect strips that audio layer entirely. It is a rare pull, so the noise suppression makes a strong addition to a trap-focused setup when it drops.

Addon_K31_13.name: Loose Screw
Addon_K31_13.description:
A bone-chilling rattling emanates from the drone, and it seems like it make fall at any minute, distracting Survivors from complicated tasks.

Survivors with a Claw Trap suffer from the Exhausted status effect for 6 seconds. Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating exhausting perks.

beginner.whatItIs: Slaps the Exhausted status onto any survivor caught in a Claw Trap for a brief window, and it fits into Eyes In The Sky. During that window, exhausting perks are locked out, cutting off a key escape tool at the worst moment.
beginner.whyItMatters: Shutting off exhausting perks at the moment a survivor is most vulnerable removes a specific counter that they rely on to break free from a chase. It does not overhaul the trap itself, but it targets the exact escape tools that make trapped survivors hard to finish.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in lobbies where survivors lean on exhausting perks to survive chases, since the brief fatigue window locks those off exactly when they would trigger. It is a rare pull, so the perk lockout is a strong addition to a trap build when it shows up.

Addon_K31_14.name: Infrared Upgrade
Addon_K31_14.description:
Heat-detecting cameras focus in on high-stress individuals with pinpoint accuracy.

Anytime a Claw Trap is removed, the Survivor's aura is revealed for 4 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: A rare upgrade for Eyes In The Sky that pings a survivor's location the moment they clear a Claw Trap from their inventory. The cameras lock onto vulnerable survivors with unusual precision during that window.
beginner.whyItMatters: Revealing a survivor at the exact moment they free themselves from a trap hands the killer a timing advantage that punishes careless inventory management. It reads as a bigger shift in how the chase unfolds rather than a small numerical tweak, because the information arrives at the most exposed moment.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want survivors who clear traps quickly during a chase to immediately give away their position. It is a rare find, so do not bank on pulling it early in a rotation.

Addon_K31_15.name: Randomized Strobes
Addon_K31_15.description:
Lights flash randomly on the ground, making it harder to find purchase on the uneven terrain.

Increases the duration of the Hindered status effect Claw Trapped Survivors suffer from when detected by a Drone by 1 second.

Hindered reduces Survivor movement speed.

beginner.whatItIs: Randomized Strobes slots into Eyes In The Sky and extends how long a survivor stays slowed after a Drone detects them through a Claw Trap. Random ground-level light bursts disrupt footing, adding a layer of physical difficulty to an already compromised state.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra slowing keeps a trapped survivor pinned long enough for the killer to close the gap and commit to a chase. It is a meaningful shift in chase control rather than a minor stat adjustment, because the window where the survivor is most vulnerable stretches noticeably longer.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if drones need to lock survivors down more reliably after a detection, especially in maps where survivors can normally bolt out of a trap zone quickly. Veryrare drops are unpredictable, so treat it as a bonus when it shows up.

Addon_K31_16.name: Advanced Movement Prediction
Addon_K31_16.description:
Even after they leave the zone of influence, a refined AI program predicts with high accuracy where a person will go next.

When a Survivor receives a Claw Trap, reveal their aura for 6 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Advanced Movement Prediction plugs into Eyes In The Sky and exposes a survivor's aura the instant they are hit with a new Claw Trap. The underlying prediction engine keeps tracking a survivor's likely path even beyond the immediate area of effect.
beginner.whyItMatters: Seeing exactly where a survivor stands the moment a trap lands gives the killer a free window to reposition or commit to a chase before the survivor can react. That is a larger shift in information control than simply slowing someone down after the fact, because the reveal arrives at the most dangerous beat of the sequence.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want the reveal to fire at the moment a trap lands rather than only after the survivor tries to move. The veryrare tier means it will show up infrequently in the locker.

Addon_K31_17.name: Ultrasonic Speaker
Addon_K31_17.description:
A high-frequency noise blaster that fills the sonic spectrum with disorienting sounds, making it impossible for observers to pick out more important noises.

Decreases Survivors' scan line immunity duration by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Ultrasonic Speaker attaches to Eyes In The Sky and shortens the scan-line immunity window survivors enjoy between drone sweeps. The device broadcasts chaotic high-frequency noise that drowns out the audio cues survivors depend on.
beginner.whyItMatters: With less time to disappear into the static, survivors are forced to make movement decisions faster and more carelessly. This suits a killer who wants to keep constant pressure on rather than letting the trial go quiet for stretches, making the overall pace feel more oppressive.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick it up whenever it drops, since common rarity makes it easy to find and the shorter immunity window helps in almost any chase-heavy matchup. It pairs well with a killer build that relies on repeated drone sweeps.

Addon_K31_18.name: Expired Batteries
Addon_K31_18.description:
The batteries on these Claw Traps have been swapped out with old alkaline batteries. Recharging is not recommended.

All Survivors start the trial with a Claw Trap, which has 50% less battery life.Claw Trap battery life increases by 10% for each Claw Trap received, up to 150%.

beginner.whatItIs: Iridescent in rarity, Expired Batteries pre-loads every survivor with a Claw Trap at the start of the trial when paired with Eyes In The Sky. The degraded power cells drain faster than usual, so the slowing effect on each survivor fades more quickly unless they collect additional traps.
beginner.whyItMatters: Starting a trial with a trapped survivor already in play removes the need to spend the first chase on setup, which changes the opening tempo considerably. It reads as a larger shift in how the power plays from the very first seconds, because the killer gains an immediate tool to work with rather than waiting for the first drone sweep.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want the very first interaction to already be a trap on someone's back, cutting into the early safety window survivors normally enjoy. Iridescent rarity means it will not appear often, so save it for a build that leans on drone pressure.

Addon_K31_19.name: Prototype Rotor
Addon_K31_19.description:
The cutting-edge design allows the drone to move with razor-sharp precision.

Increases Drones' rotation speed by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Prototype Rotor is a very rare modification to Eyes In The Sky that makes the drones spin through their sweep patterns with sharper precision. The refined rotor assembly covers the map more quickly between passes, tightening the net over survivors.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster drones mean survivors get less breathing room between passes and the killer can re-engage sooner after a miss. It reads as a small but consistent quality-of-life bump for anyone who runs drone play.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want the constant hum of scanning to feel more oppressive, especially in open maps where drones can sweep long corridors quickly. The veryrare drop rate means it is a treat rather than a staple.

Addon_K31_20.name: Iridescent Unpublished Manuscript
Addon_K31_20.description:
Before he disappeared, Adriana’s father had started a newer, darker manga, Sonhadores Sombrios.

When a Drone is disabled, it gains a 32-meter Terror Radius for 15 seconds. During this time, gain the Undetectable status effect.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

beginner.whatItIs: Iridescent Unpublished Manuscript pairs with Eyes In The Sky to turn a disabled drone into a burst of Terror Radius while granting the killer Undetectable for that window. The lore behind it references Adriana's father and his unfinished work, Sonhadores Sombrios.
beginner.whyItMatters: Losing a drone, which normally hurts the killer, becomes a trade where the killer vanishes from the map while the area around the dead drone becomes a danger zone. That is a bigger philosophical shift in how the power's setbacks are handled.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you do not mind losing drones as long as the killer can disappear and reposition, since the Undetectable window rewards aggressive re-entry after a sweep. Iridescent rarity keeps it a rare find in the locker.

Addon_K32_01.name: Broken Security Key
Addon_K32_01.description:
Dozens of security measures were applied across the ship’s equipment, and many of them were in a state of disrepair.

The reboot timer when the EMP affects the Biopods is reduced by 15%.

beginner.whatItIs: Broken Security Key slots into Quantum Instantiation and shortens the reboot timer on Biopods after they are hit by an EMP. The worn-out locks on the ship's systems recover quicker than they should, leaving less downtime between disruptions.
beginner.whyItMatters: A faster recovery means the killer gets back into the fight sooner after a survivor lands a disruption, which keeps the tempo of the trial tighter. It reads as a small but welcome tweak for a power that can stall when interrupted, rather than a fundamental change to how the power functions.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want less downtime after an EMP interrupt, especially in lobbies where survivors carry multiple EMPs. Common rarity makes it an easy find to slot in.

Addon_K32_02.name: Heavy Water
Addon_K32_02.description:
A byproduct of the microfission reactors powering cryo and life support. Even a tiny leak would prove disastrous for onboard sensors.

Supply cases' aura distance is reduced by 8 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: Heavy Water attaches to Quantum Instantiation and shrinks the aura distance of supply cases scattered across the map. The chemical residue interferes with the ship's sensor arrays, muddying the signal survivors rely on to spot pickups from a distance.
beginner.whyItMatters: Losing the early warning about where EMPs and other supplies will spawn forces survivors to gamble on pickup locations and commit to areas blind. That shifts the map toward killer-controlled information, turning supply hunting into a riskier endeavor than the default setup allows.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want survivors to feel uncertain about where to run for EMPs, since the reduced visibility punishes anyone trying to plan a supply grab from far away. Common drops make it a reliable option to keep in the locker.

Addon_K32_03.name: Kid’s Ball Glove
Addon_K32_03.description:
A kid’s baseball glove owned by one of the colonists. His memories of a youth playing catch were implanted.

Overclock Mode duration is increased by 8%.

beginner.whatItIs: Kid's Ball Glove plugs into Quantum Instantiation and extends the duration of Overclock Mode. The colonist's childhood glove somehow stretches the window of boosted speed, as if a forgotten memory of backyard games is fueling the effect.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer overclock window lets the killer sustain full chase speed for more time, which is a straightforward speed bump that helps in every extended pursuit. It reads as a small, focused adjustment rather than a structural change, but the compounding effect over repeated chases makes the extra duration feel meaningful.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the goal is to keep a sprint advantage going a beat longer before it falls off, which matters most in long chases around generators and exit gates. Uncommon rarity keeps it within reach without being guaranteed.

Addon_K32_04.name: Nutritional Slurry
Addon_K32_04.description:
Made for the organics, this disgusting concoction works well to nourish any organic matter.

Get 2 extra Biopods.

beginner.whatItIs: Nutritional Slurry modifies Quantum Instantiation to place extra Biopods on the map. The thick nutrient paste, brewed for organic life, feeds the pods and creates more slowing zones for survivors to navigate around.
beginner.whyItMatters: More pods on the map mean more opportunities to slow survivors and more places to set up ambush points, which is a bigger shift in map control than a simple stat adjustment. It changes the geometry of the trial by adding chokepoints that did not exist before, forcing survivors to route around additional danger zones.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the goal is a denser web of slowing zones across the map, especially in lobbies where survivors group up and several can be caught at once. Common rarity makes it easy to lock in.

Addon_K32_05.name: Diagnostic Tool (Construction)
Addon_K32_05.description:
A device that gives highly accurate information on the lay of the land.

Reveals the auras of Survivors who pick up an EMP for 8 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Diagnostic Tool (Construction) is a very rare modification to Quantum Instantiation that flashes a survivor's aura after they grab an EMP. The precision diagnostic unit turns a defensive pickup into a moment of exposed location, catching survivors off guard at the worst possible time.
beginner.whyItMatters: The moment a survivor grabs an EMP is exactly when the killer most needs to know where they are, so a reveal at that precise instant punishes the defensive grab. It is a meaningful information shift, because the survivor who was trying to protect themselves accidentally broadcasts their position to the killer.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want survivors to think twice before snatching an EMP mid-chase, since the aura flash after pickup can expose a bad position. Veryrare rarity means it is a treat to find.

Addon_K32_06.name: Diagnostic Tool (Repair)
Addon_K32_06.description:
A device that can find the flaws in constructed objects. Intended to help with repair.
