Increases targeting range while in a Biopod by 4 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: Diagnostic Tool (Repair) is a common slot for Quantum Instantiation that gives the killer a wider lock-on radius while seated inside a Biopod. The broader reach means the killer does not need to be as close to a group before locking on.
beginner.whyItMatters: Sitting inside a pod already slows the killer down, so a wider lock-on range makes that stationary moment less punishing. The change is modest in scale, but it smooths out the awkward window where the killer sits still and is most vulnerable.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want a little more leeway in lining up a Biopod shot, which helps a lot for newer killer players still getting used to the aim. Common rarity keeps it easy to find.

Addon_K32_07.name: Android Arm
Addon_K32_07.description:
Destroying the other HUX units not only made his extermination of humans easier, it gave him more parts to work with.

Slipstream infection range between Survivors is increased by 2 meters and spreads 25% faster.

beginner.whatItIs: An uncommon addition to Quantum Instantiation that lets Temporal Slipstream travel farther between survivors and spread more quickly once it lands on the first target. The chain reaction ripples outward faster than the default mechanic allows.
beginner.whyItMatters: Catching one survivor in the trap now puts their nearby allies at risk almost immediately, which forces the group to scatter rather than huddle together. The shift turns a single failed escape into a cascading problem that is harder for a team to solve quietly.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want Slipstream to cascade through a cluster of survivors who stay close together, which punishes coordinated map play hard. Uncommon rarity keeps it accessible without being too easy to find.

Addon_K32_08.name: Cremated Remains
Addon_K32_08.description:
After extracting the other colonists’ DNA, he burned their remains.

Survivors afflicted with Temporal Slipstream suffer from Blindness.

Blindness prevents survivors from seeing auras.

beginner.whatItIs: Cremated Remains is an uncommon slot for Quantum Instantiation that layers Blindness on top of Temporal Slipstream, removing all aura sight from a trapped survivor. Pallets, hooks, and generators vanish from view the moment the effect takes hold.
beginner.whyItMatters: A survivor who loses aura sight inside a Slipstream pocket cannot see where the next pallet or generator is, turning a confined struggle into a blind navigation puzzle. The effect escalates the default Slipstream significantly, which only slows movement without blinding the survivor.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want trapped survivors to struggle even with simple navigation, turning a slow effect into a disorienting one. Uncommon rarity makes it a reasonable bet to find in the locker.

Addon_K32_09.name: Foreign Plant Fibers
Addon_K32_09.description:
Xenobotanists would have a field day with these strange samples of alien plant life.

Decreases the duration of the Hindered status effect after being stunned by a pallet while in Overclock mode by 20%.

Hindered reduces Killer movement speed.

beginner.whatItIs: A very rare option for Quantum Instantiation that shortens how long the Hindered slow lasts after the killer takes a pallet hit during Overclock mode. The recovery window shrinks, so the killer regains full speed sooner.
beginner.whyItMatters: Overclock is a speed-focused mode that punishes pallet hits heavily, so shaving that slow down keeps the chase momentum alive. The shift is modest in isolation, but it matters most in long chases where every lost second of speed lets a survivor put distance between them and the killer.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want to feel less punished by pallets while overclocked, since the quicker recovery keeps the chase momentum going. Veryrare rarity means it shows up only occasionally.

Addon_K32_10.name: Live Wires
Addon_K32_10.description:
Unconnected wires attached to a live current that have a tendency to deliver a shocking surprise.

A Survivor who is cleansed of Slipstream screams, interrupting their current action.

beginner.whatItIs: Live Wires is a rare option for Quantum Instantiation that makes a survivor scream and drop whatever they are doing the moment they cleanse Temporal Slipstream. The shock forces an audible and visible reset that breaks their momentum.
beginner.whyItMatters: Punishing the precise instant a survivor tries to free themselves turns a routine cleanse into a loud, attention-drawing event that alerts the whole map. The shift is psychological as much as mechanical: the killer gains pressure exactly when a survivor tries to recover.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want survivors to hesitate before cleansing, since the scream gives the killer a fresh location ping and the interrupt can ruin a mid-heal or mid-repair. Rare rarity keeps it a solid find without being too common.

Addon_K32_11.name: Cryo Gel
Addon_K32_11.description:
A no-friction gel applied to crew members before entering deep cryo sleep.

Slipstreamed Survivors suffer from the Hemorrhage status effect for 60 seconds when hit with a basic attack.

Hemorrhage regresses healing progress when not healing, and increases blood trails left by injured Survivors.

beginner.whatItIs: Cryo Gel is an uncommon addition to Quantum Instantiation that applies Hemorrhage to a Temporal Slipstream survivor the moment a basic attack connects. The bleeding status undoes healing progress between heals and makes the blood trail harder to lose.
beginner.whyItMatters: Stacking Hemorrhage on top of Slipstream means a single hit now punishes a survivor twice: they bleed healing progress while stationary and leave a brighter trail while running. The combined pressure makes it much harder for a trapped survivor to heal quietly or ghost away.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want every clean hit on a trapped survivor to compound the problem, turning a single swing into a lasting penalty. Uncommon rarity keeps it findable in the locker.

Addon_K32_12.name: Denied Requisition Form
Addon_K32_12.description:
Despite the advent of light speed technology, it seemed nothing could make bureaucracy any faster.

At the start of the trial, EMPs take 30 seconds longer to generate.All survivors start the match Slipstreamed.

beginner.whatItIs: Denied Requisition Form is an iridescent slot for Quantum Instantiation that traps every survivor in Temporal Slipstream the instant the trial begins while also delaying EMP generation. The killer opens the chase with the whole team already confined and no escape available for a while.
beginner.whyItMatters: Opening a trial with every survivor already trapped removes the early-game breathing room that normally lets a team coordinate and find their footing. The delayed EMPs compound that advantage, handing the killer a long stretch to build pressure before anyone can break free.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want to own the opening of the trial and force survivors to spend their first minutes managing Slipstream instead of working generators. Iridescent rarity means it will not appear in every locker rotation.

Addon_K32_13.name: Iridescent Crystal Shard
Addon_K32_13.description:
A crystal from the alien structure that gave him sentience.

When a Biopod is created, the auras of all Survivors within 10 meters of that Biopod are revealed to you for 6 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Iridescent Crystal Shard is an iridescent option for Quantum Instantiation that reveals where nearby survivors are standing for a short burst whenever a new Biopod appears on the map. The flash is brief but immediate, letting the killer read the local area in one glance.
beginner.whyItMatters: Every pod placement doubles as a scouting tool, showing the killer exactly where the nearest survivors are standing without needing to chase first. The shift moves pod placement from a pure trapping tool into an information play, which changes how the killer plans where to set each new pod.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want to use pod placement as a scouting tool, checking where survivors cluster before committing to a chase. Iridescent rarity means it is a rare but powerful find.

Addon_K32_14.name: Ultrasonic Sensor
Addon_K32_14.description:
A limitation of organic hearing is a limited aural spectrum. Expanding that range is like gaining an entirely new sense.

Exiting a Biopod within 2 seconds of Slipstreaming a Survivor decreases your Terror Radius by 12 meters for 12 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: An uncommon add-on for Quantum Instantiation that temporarily shrinks the killer's Terror Radius after a quick exit from a Biopod following a Slipstream. The shorter radius lasts for a brief window and makes the killer harder to pin down by sound.
beginner.whyItMatters: Losing the audio cue that normally betrays a killer's position gives room to reposition or close distance without nearby survivors getting a listening ping. It is a modest tweak rather than a fundamental shift, since the shortened window is brief and only triggers on a specific sequence.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the build leans on teleporting out of a Biopod to reappear elsewhere, since the brief silence window lets the killer land in a new spot with fewer clues left behind. It is an uncommon add-on, so it rolls in offerings more often than the rare or veryrare slots.

Addon_K32_15.name: Spent Oxygen Tank
Addon_K32_15.description:
Without air to breathe, organics don’t last long.

When a survivor becomes Slipstreamed, they are Exhausted for 6 seconds.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating exhausting perks.

beginner.whatItIs: A rare slot for Quantum Instantiation that stamps a Slipstreamed survivor with Exhaustion, which blocks them from activating their own exhausting perks for a short period. The effect rides on the Slipstream itself, so no extra input is needed to trigger it.
beginner.whyItMatters: Stripping a survivor of their escape tool in the exact moment they would reach for it can swing a close chase. The change reads as a bigger shift than a cosmetic tweak, because it removes a defensive layer at the worst possible instant.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if the opponent's loadout leans on perks that cost stamina or movement, because silencing those during a Slipstream removes the one thing that might save them. It is a rare add-on, so expect to wait a bit longer between offerings.

Addon_K32_16.name: Nanomachine Gel
Addon_K32_16.description:
A gel that can heal wounds extremely quickly. However, the machines in it have a history of being hacked to hurt people too.

Decreases Biopod cooldown by 15% after Slipstreaming a Survivor.

beginner.whatItIs: A rare Quantum Instantiation slot that trims the Biopod cooldown each time the killer Slipstreams a survivor, letting the power cycle back sooner. The reduction applies the moment the Slipstream lands, so no follow-up action is required.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster Biopod turnover shifts Quantum Instantiation from a single ambush into a repeating pressure loop, since the killer can chase, teleport, and hunt again with less dead time. The read is a meaningful change to the power's rhythm rather than a small polish.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the build already favors repeated Slipstreams over a single long chase, since the shorter cooldown rewards a rhythm of ambush and reposition. As a rare add-on it appears less frequently in offerings than uncommon slots.

Addon_K32_17.name: Hyperawareness Spray
Addon_K32_17.description:
Used by crew members during long shifts to avoid lapses in focus. Side effects of overuse include paranoia and, in extreme cases, hallucination.

While a Survivor is Slipstreamed, they hear the Terror Radius as if you were nearby.

beginner.whatItIs: A rare slot on Quantum Instantiation that makes a Slipstreamed survivor hear the killer's Terror Radius as though the entity were standing right beside them. The auditory deception lasts for the duration of the Slipstream effect.
beginner.whyItMatters: Hearing the Terror Radius from far away scrambles the distance cues a survivor uses to gauge how close the danger is, which throws off loop timing and makes pallet decisions feel riskier. It is a small but sharp disruption aimed at the moment a survivor is most disoriented.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it against survivors who rely on audio cues to play safe, because the false proximity sound can trick them into running the wrong direction or wasting a pallet swing. It is a rare offering, so it will not show up in every trial.

Addon_K32_18.name: Hologram Generator
Addon_K32_18.description:
Originally used for communication and entertainment, this has been repurposed for obfuscation.

After a successful Slipstream teleport from a Biopod, the target Survivor suffers from the Oblivious status effect for 60 seconds.

Oblivious prevents Survivors from hearing or being affected by the Killer's Terror Radius.

beginner.whatItIs: Quantum Instantiation gains an Oblivious window with the Hologram Generator: after a Slipstream teleport from a Biopod completes, the target survivor loses all connection to the killer's Terror Radius for an extended period. The effect activates the instant the teleport finishes, stripping away both the audible warning and the panic it triggers.
beginner.whyItMatters: Removing Terror Radius awareness entirely for that long a window turns the post-teleport moment into a free reposition with zero audio warning for the target. It is a bigger shift in how the power feels to play, because the survivor loses a core defensive sense for an extended period.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer wants to vanish after a Slipstream and reappear elsewhere without the survivor knowing where to look, since the Oblivious effect hides the approach completely. It is a rare add-on and appears less often than uncommon slots in the offering pool.

Addon_K32_19.name: Soma Family Photo
Addon_K32_19.description:
A sentimental object that grounds someone to an imagined past.

Slipstreaming a Survivor using a Biopod inflicts a 3% Hindered status effect for 6 seconds.

Hindered reduces Survivor movement speed.

beginner.whatItIs: With the Soma Family Photo, Slipstreaming a survivor using a Biopod inflicts a short Hindered window that slows their movement. The drag is modest but lands at the exact moment of maximum disorientation after the teleport.
beginner.whyItMatters: Even a short speed penalty right after a Slipstream can stretch the gap between killer and survivor just enough to land a hit before they recover their pace. The change reads as a modest nudge, since the slowdown window is brief and the movement cut is mild.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the build wants to punish a Slipstream immediately rather than chase for a long time, since the brief slow makes the first swing easier to land. It sits at a veryrare tier, so it takes real patience to pull compared to the more common slots.

Addon_K32_20.name: Crew Manifest
Addon_K32_20.description:
A complete list of biographical data on the entire crew of the ship sent to Dvarka.

Reveals a Slipstreamed Survivor's aura for 8 seconds when they infect another Survivor.Increases the Slipstream infection range between Survivors by 2 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: The Crew Manifest widens the Slipstream infection spread between survivors and flashes a Slipstreamed survivor's aura the moment they infect another. Together the two effects turn a single well-placed teleport into a chain that ripples through a group.
beginner.whyItMatters: Seeing exactly where an infected survivor is heading makes interception far easier, while the wider infection range means one Slipstream can chain to more nearby survivors in a crowded area. Together these two shifts turn the power from a single-target tool into a crowd-control option.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the build relies on chaining Slipstreams through groups of survivors who are working close together, since both the aura reveal and the wider range reward dense survivor clusters. It is a veryrare add-on and shows up less often in offerings than uncommon or rare slots.

Addon_K33_01.name: Lambert’s Star Map
Addon_K33_01.description:
Vital for interstellar travel, but not as useful on a smaller scale.

Decreases the flame distance of Turrets by 2 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: An uncommon Hidden Pursuit add-on that trims the flame distance of Turrets, giving each one a shorter reach against survivors. The reduction is small but consistent across every Turret the killer deploys.
beginner.whyItMatters: Shorter flame range means each Turret threatens a smaller pocket of ground, which is a modest cut to the area pressure Turrets can apply on a survivor looping nearby. It reads as a small tweak rather than a fundamental change to how Turrets play.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Skip it in the offering menu when another Hidden Pursuit slot is rolling, since it works against the killer's own Turret pressure. Expect it to appear with fair regularity given its uncommon rarity, so declining it is a safe call most of the time.

Addon_K33_02.name: Cereal Rations
Addon_K33_02.description:
Contains 100% of the recommended daily intake of Vitamin A. Tastes awful.

Turret auras are visible while in tunnels and when coming out of vents for 3 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Cereal Rations keep Turret auras visible while the killer moves through tunnels and for a brief moment after emerging from a vent. The short window is enough to spot where placed Turrets are sitting before the next engagement.
beginner.whyItMatters: That flash of awareness helps the killer keep track of their Turret positions during tunnel play, which makes route planning easier in the dark stretches between objectives. It is a small quality-of-life improvement rather than a power spike.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if tunnel-heavy routes are part of the killer's usual flow, since the brief aura reveal smooths out the disorientation that comes with moving through enclosed spaces. It is a common add-on, so it will appear in offerings frequently enough to grab when it rolls.

Addon_K33_03.name: Ripley's Watch
Addon_K33_03.description:
On a ship as massive as the Nostromo, synchronizing watches was important to keep track of work shifts.

When a Turret removes Crawler Mode, it is destroyed automatically.

beginner.whatItIs: Ripley's Watch causes a Turret to self-destruct the instant it removes Crawler Mode from a survivor. The removal is automatic and leaves no lingering effect behind.
beginner.whyItMatters: Losing a Turret after each Crawler Mode removal means fewer Turrets remain available for ongoing pressure, which is a small but real reduction in sustained map control. It reads as a trade-off: the Turret does its job and then is gone.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Decline it when the build depends on keeping Turrets up for extended zones of control, since each one spent on a Crawler Mode break is gone for good. As a common add-on it will roll often enough that skipping it costs little in the offering pool.

Addon_K33_04.name: Ovomorph
Addon_K33_04.description:
It looks harmless, but the horrors held inside are immeasurable.

The cooldown of Crawler Mode is 25% faster while outside of tunnels.

beginner.whatItIs: Outside of tunnels, Ovomorph accelerates the Crawler Mode cooldown so the ability cycles back faster in open areas. Tunnel play is unaffected, making the bonus most relevant during extended surface chases.
beginner.whyItMatters: A faster Crawler Mode cooldown in open areas means the killer can switch to Crawler more often while pushing through generator rooms and hallways, adding another layer of pressure during chases. It is a modest bump that rewards killers who spend most of their time outside the tunnels.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the killer favors open-map chases over tunnel ambushing, since the shorter cooldown rewards frequent Crawler Mode use in the wide spaces where most generators sit. It is a common add-on and shows up regularly in the offering rotation.

Addon_K33_05.name: Drinking Bird
Addon_K33_05.description:
One of the many tchotchkes littering the Nostromo’s living quarters. A bit of whimsy in an otherwise sterile environment.

After exiting a tunnel, Killer Instinct duration is increased by 3 seconds.

Killer Instinct intermittently reveals the location of Survivors.

beginner.whatItIs: Each time the killer exits a tunnel, Drinking Bird extends the Killer Instinct duration, buying extra tracking time on the map beyond the tunnel phase. The added window bridges the transition from enclosed passages to open ground where survivors scatter.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer Killer Instinct window after surfacing means the killer can keep tracking survivors for extra time, which smooths the transition out of a tunnel and into the next push. It reads as a small comfort rather than a major power shift.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer's routine involves diving into tunnels and then popping out to hunt, since the extended tracking makes each emergence feel more productive. Its common rarity means it will show up in the offering list with regular frequency, so grabbing it is a low-risk call.

Addon_K33_06.name: Crew Headset
Addon_K33_06.description:
While they facilitated team communication, the constant chatter made the crew easier to track.

While in tunnels, footstep detection is increased by 6 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: An uncommon Hidden Pursuit add-on that widens the footstep detection radius while the killer stays inside tunnels. The extra hearing range helps track survivors moving through dark passages without needing a visual lock.
beginner.whyItMatters: Hearing footsteps from farther away in enclosed spaces lets the killer pin down a survivor's route before they reach an exit. It turns tunnel corridors into a one-sided surveillance zone where position information flows only one way.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the chase keeps drifting through tunnel networks and you want the killer to hear survivors rounding corners before they surface. The uncommon slot means it shows up with reasonable regularity in offerings, so it is a dependable pick for tunnel-focused plans.

Addon_K33_07.name: Emergency Helmet
Addon_K33_07.description:
An extra helmet on the bridge, for use in emergencies only.

Increases resistance to staggering from Turrets by 15%.

beginner.whatItIs: Emergency Helmet raises the killer's resistance to being staggered by their own Turrets, letting them push through Turret-dense areas without losing momentum. The effect matters most when the chase forces a path through a cluster of previously placed Turrets.
beginner.whyItMatters: Staying stable while Turrets are active around the killer means fewer interrupted attacks and cleaner chase flow through cluttered loops. The added stability reads as a small but meaningful quality-of-life shift for Turret-heavy playstyles.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when Turrets are scattered tightly around a chase loop and the killer keeps getting bumped off balance by their own placements. The rare slot means it appears less frequently in offerings, so slot it in when a Turret-heavy build is already locked.

Addon_K33_08.name: Ash’s Innards
Addon_K33_08.description:
While hardier, mechanical beings break too when enough force is applied.

Turrets take 15 seconds longer to respawn after they are destroyed.

beginner.whatItIs: Once a Turret is destroyed, Ash's Innards stretches its respawn timer, keeping the spot empty for a wider window than the default. The delay gives survivors a longer breather at a demolished Turret position before it comes back online.
beginner.whyItMatters: Destroyed Turrets staying offline for a longer window gives survivors a wider safe passage through areas the killer has already invested in. It reads as a deliberate nerf to the Turret cycle, forcing the killer to commit placements more carefully.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Skip it when the build depends on rapid Turret turnover to maintain constant pressure, since the extended downtime opens a gap that survivors can exploit to reset their position. As an uncommon add-on it rolls with fair regularity, so declining it keeps the offering pool cycling toward better slots.

Addon_K33_09.name: Light Wand
Addon_K33_09.description:
A portable light source used by Ash and Dallas while looking for the invasive creature. Mostly ineffective for lighting larger spaces.

Increases downtime of Turrets by 3 second after exiting a tunnel.

beginner.whatItIs: Right after exiting a tunnel, Light Wand adds extra downtime to the killer's Turrets, slowing their return for a short stretch. The penalty lands hardest during the transition from enclosed passage to open ground.
beginner.whyItMatters: Less immediate Turret support during the tunnel-to-open transition creates a brief window where the killer is more exposed than the power normally allows. It is a small but noticeable dip in the flow of a chase that crosses a tunnel boundary.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Decline it if the plan involves popping out of a tunnel and immediately using Turrets to corner a survivor, since the extra downtime breaks that sequence. It is an uncommon add-on and will show up in offerings with reasonable frequency, making it a frequent skip candidate.

Addon_K33_10.name: Kane’s Helmet
Addon_K33_10.description:
A thin layer of glass was the difference between a minor inconvenience and the tragic destruction of the Nostromo’s crew.

Survivors hit with a Tail Attack are Mangled for 70 seconds.

Mangled increases time required to heal by 25% and lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

beginner.whatItIs: Kane's Helmet turns a Tail Attack hit into a Mangled window that stretches the time a survivor needs to heal. The penalty holds for a sustained period or until the survivor is fully patched up, whichever comes first.
beginner.whyItMatters: Healing that takes noticeably longer after a Tail Attack leaves survivors more vulnerable during the recovery window, especially after a hook or a hard hit. The sustained bleed on their healing capacity reads as a meaningful shift in how long a chase can stay dangerous.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the build wants Tail Attacks to do more than just deal damage, since the prolonged healing penalty punishes survivors who rely on quick patch-up after taking a hit. It is a rare add-on, so it will not roll in every offering cycle.

Addon_K33_11.name: Multipurpose Hatchet
Addon_K33_11.description:
Equally useful for destruction and repair.

Survivors hit by a Tail Attack suffer from Hemorrhage.

Hemorrhage regresses healing progress when not healing, and increases blood trails left by injured Survivors. This lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

beginner.whatItIs: Multipurpose Hatchet inflicts Hemorrhage on survivors struck by a Tail Attack, causing healing progress to regress whenever they stop patching up. The effect also thickens the blood trail left by an injured survivor, making them easier to track across the map.
beginner.whyItMatters: A wound that keeps worsening between heal sessions turns every pause in a chase into a ticking pressure on the survivor. It compounds the pain of a Tail Attack well beyond the initial hit and makes full recovery a genuine effort.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the build leans on Tail Attacks to create lasting pressure rather than a single burst, since the bleeding effect keeps a survivor from settling back into a safe rhythm. It rolls less often than uncommon entries in the offering list, so reserve a slot for it in a chase-focused loadout.

Addon_K33_12.name: Parker’s Headband
Addon_K33_12.description:
A bold fashion choice that doubled as a handy way to wick sweat from the eyes.

After exiting a tunnel, gain 5% Haste for 3 seconds.

Haste increases Killer movement speed.

beginner.whatItIs: Parker's Headband is a rare Hidden Pursuit add-on that grants the killer a short Haste boost the instant they exit a tunnel. The speed bump is meant to carry them through the exposed stretch of open ground right after they resurface.
beginner.whyItMatters: Closing the distance on a survivor in the seconds after surfacing turns a tunnel exit from a vulnerable moment into an offensive one. The short duration means it rewards timing rather than raw power, rewarding a killer who reads the loop correctly.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the playstyle involves tunneling up to a survivor and then popping out to chase, since the speed window rewards the exit as a chance to gain ground. Being a rare add-on, it will not show up in every offering cycle.

Addon_K33_13.name: Molted Skin
Addon_K33_13.description:
The Xenomorph molted many times as it rapidly grew on the Nostromo. Its shed skin was a constant reminder of its presence.

After deploying a Turret, the deploying Survivor suffers from the Exhausted status effect for 30 seconds.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating certain perks.

beginner.whatItIs: Molted Skin is a rare add-on that slots into the Hidden Pursuit power. After a survivor deploys a Turret, the Exhausted effect hits them and blocks activation of certain perks. It turns the moment of setup into a vulnerable window for the killer.
beginner.whyItMatters: Losing access to perks right after a Turret deployment can stall an escape plan or a recovery attempt at exactly the moment the survivor needs those tools most. The sustained duration of the effect means the penalty lingers well past the immediate action.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a match features a survivor who leans heavily on Turret placement for defensive loops, since the Exhausted penalty removes their perk access right at the moment they commit. As a rare offering it only surfaces infrequently in the machine, so take it the first time it shows up.

Addon_K33_14.name: Brett’s Cap
Addon_K33_14.description:
This Nostromo ballcap was fashionable, but severely limited his vertical field of vision.

Destroying a Turret causes all Survivors within 16 meters to suffer from Blindness for 25 seconds.

Blindness prevents Survivors from seeing auras.

beginner.whatItIs: A ballcap add-on slotted into Hidden Pursuit. It makes destroying a Turret blind nearby Survivors, stripping their ability to see auras for a short stretch.
beginner.whyItMatters: Blinding a cluster of Survivors at once is a bigger shift in how a turret takedown plays compared to the usual single-target hit. It rewards finishing turrets in tight spaces where multiple Survivors are packed close together.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when Survivors are likely to cluster near the exit gates or in narrow corridors, since the area effect lands harder in confined spaces. The uncommon rarity means it shows up often enough to build around without too much waiting.

Addon_K33_15.name: Semiotic Keyboard
Addon_K33_15.description:
Its symbols are designed to be universally recognizable, but they take some getting used to.

Generators within 16 meters of a Turret have the intensity of their auras determined by their repair progression.

beginner.whatItIs: Semiotic Keyboard is a power add-on for Hidden Pursuit. It makes generator auras near a Turret shift in brightness based on how far along their repair is.
beginner.whyItMatters: Reading a generator aura to guess its progress adds a layer of information to the Killer's decision-making without changing the core chase. It is a smaller tweak than effects that deal damage or reveal Survivors, but it sharpens map awareness around turrets.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if the game revolves around protecting a small number of generators, since the aura shifts make it easier to spot which ones are close to completion. Its very rare rarity means patience is needed, so slot it in when the offering finally presents it.

Addon_K33_16.name: Harpoon Gun
Addon_K33_16.description:
Barely a weapon, its use is only viable in a situation of last resort.

Exiting a tunnel and hitting a Survivor within 30 seconds causes all Survivors further than 16 meters from you to scream and reveal their locations.

beginner.whatItIs: Harpoon Gun attaches to Hidden Pursuit. Exiting a tunnel and hitting a Survivor within a short window makes all distant Survivors scream and reveal their locations.
beginner.whyItMatters: Forcing distant Survivors to reveal themselves after a single chase turns a one-on-one hit into a map-wide information spike. It punishes Survivors who hide far away rather than pressing them directly in the chase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in matchups where Survivors split up and go solo, since the scream-and-reveal effect hits hardest when the Killer cannot see where everyone is. It is very rare, so it is worth waiting for in the offering when playing the Xenomorph.

Addon_K33_17.name: Cat Carrier
Addon_K33_17.description:
Saving the cat is a noble goal. It’s also very distracting.

Exiting Crawler Mode due to a Turret attack makes you Undetectable for 30 seconds.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

beginner.whatItIs: Cat Carrier modifies Hidden Pursuit. Exiting Crawler Mode after a Turret attack makes the Killer Undetectable for a short window, hiding the aura, Terror Radius, and red stain.
beginner.whyItMatters: Becoming invisible right after a turret strike lets the Killer reposition or start a new chase without Survivors noticing the approach. That is a bigger shift in how Crawler Mode transitions feel, since the usual tell of the red stain disappears for a beat.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if Survivors in the lobby tend to play cautiously and hide near generators, since the brief invisibility lets the Killer reposition without warning. It is very rare, so slot it in when the offering presents it rather than rushing a weaker build.

Addon_K33_18.name: Self-Destruct Bolt
Addon_K33_18.description:
They needed to be removed to start, and replaced to end, the self-destruct sequence. Just seeing them evokes a sense of urgency.

While in Crawler Mode, you basic-vault Windows 30% faster.

beginner.whatItIs: An add-on for Hidden Pursuit that makes the Killer's vaults through Windows faster while in Crawler Mode. The bonus helps the Xenomorph keep pace when navigating tight interior routes during a chase.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster window vaults in Crawler Mode make the Xenomorph noticeably quicker through the map, which is a smaller tweak than damage or reveal effects but one that compounds over a full trial. It helps close gaps that would normally let a Survivor slip through a window and escape.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it on maps packed with window-rich escape paths, because the vault speed bonus shines when the Xenomorph is threading through interior corridors. Being very rare means it takes patience to find in the offering, so a build centered on Crawler Mode movement is the natural home for it.

Addon_K33_19.name: Improvised Cattle Prod
Addon_K33_19.description:
A brutal and noisy weapon, which might have been more effective against a cow.

Each time a generator is completed, a 15-second timer starts. Any Survivor who comes within 10 meters of a Control Station during that time has their aura revealed for the remainder of the timer.

beginner.whatItIs: The Improvised Cattle Prod is an iridescent add-on for Hidden Pursuit. Each time a generator is completed, a short timer starts, and any Survivor near a Control Station during that window has their aura revealed.
beginner.whyItMatters: Revealing Survivors who linger near Control Stations after a generator finishes punishes a common endgame strategy of camping the exits. It is a bigger shift in endgame play than most mid-trial add-ons, since it targets a specific tactical choice rather than a general stat.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pair it with a Xenomorph build that likes to camp near exit gates, since the aura reveal punishes Survivors who loiter around a Control Station right after a generator finishes. As an iridescent drop it will not appear often in the offering, but it pays off in the late-trial phase where the final push happens.

Addon_K33_20.name: Acidic Blood
Addon_K33_20.description:
When damaged, the Xenomorph’s unique physiology made it deadlier than ever.

While exiting a tunnel in Crawler Mode, any Survivor who stuns you with a pallet in the next 20 seconds takes damage. If that Survivor is already injured, they suffer from Deep Wound.

Deep Wound will put a Survivor in the dying state unless it is mended before the timer runs out.

beginner.whatItIs: Acidic Blood modifies Hidden Pursuit. While exiting a tunnel in Crawler Mode, a Survivor who stuns the Killer with a pallet in the next stretch takes damage, and an already-injured Survivor suffers Deep Wound.
beginner.whyItMatters: Converting a pallet stun into damage and potentially Deep Wound changes the risk calculus for Survivors defending a Crawler Mode tunnel exit. The usual safe window for dropping a pallet becomes a gamble, so the Xenomorph can commit to tunnel entries with less fear of being stopped.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in matchups where Survivors lean on pallets to escape chases, since the punishment for stunning the Killer makes that play riskier. It is iridescent, so it is a long wait in the offering, but it is worth the patience for a Xenomorph build that favors aggressive tunnel exits.

Addon_K34_01.name: Strobing Light
Addon_K34_01.description:
With the right training, can be used to make people more suggestible.

Decreases the Terror Radius by 8 meters when Hidey-Ho Mode is in cooldown.

beginner.whatItIs: Strobing Light is a common add-on for Playtime's Over. It shrinks the Terror Radius while Hidey-Ho Mode is on cooldown.
beginner.whyItMatters: A tighter Terror Radius during the Hidey-Ho Mode cooldown gives Survivors less warning before the Killer strikes, making blind corners and dense interiors feel more dangerous. It is a modest change on its own, yet it stacks with other stealth-focused picks to make the whole chase feel more predatory.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in early-trial matchups where Survivors are still learning the map, since a reduced radius makes their first reaction to a chase slower. It is common, so it is easy to find in the offering and a safe pick when building a first Chucky loadout.

Addon_K34_02.name: Doll Eyes
Addon_K34_02.description:
One of the advantages of possessing a mass-produced doll is easy access to replacement parts.

While in Hidey-Ho Mode, reveals auras of all windows and downed pallets within 20 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: Slot it into Playtime's Over to highlight the auras of nearby windows and downed pallets while Hidey-Ho Mode is active. The visual markers let the Killer track escape routes and spot where Survivors have already dropped boards.
beginner.whyItMatters: Seeing windows and downed pallets during Hidey-Ho Mode helps the Killer track Survivors who have already committed to an escape route. It is a smaller tweak than damage effects, but it sharpens the decision of which direction to push after a hit.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the Survivor lineup leans toward window vaults and bait-and-run pallet plays, because the aura highlights make those escape options visible during a Hidey-Ho Mode chase. Common availability means it shows up frequently in the offering, so it is a low-risk pick for a Chucky build that needs better chase tracking.

Addon_K34_03.name: Tiny Scalpel
Addon_K34_03.description:
Sometimes, a precision cut can lead to a beautiful bleed.

While in Hidey-Ho Mode, pools of blood are brighter.

beginner.whatItIs: A common pick for Playtime's Over that makes the blood pools left by Slice & Dice glow brighter during Hidey-Ho Mode. The enhanced visibility helps the Killer follow a wounded Survivor through cluttered map sections.
beginner.whyItMatters: Brighter blood pools make it easier to see where a Slice & Dice hit landed, which helps the Killer confirm the hit connected and track the Survivor's direction. It is a small visual tweak, but in a dark corner of the map it can be the difference between losing track and continuing the chase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when playing on maps with heavy darkness or fog, since the brighter pools stand out more against a dim background. It is common, so it is an easy pick for any Chucky build that wants to feel more confident in hit confirmation.

Addon_K34_04.name: Good Guy Box
Addon_K34_04.description:
Someone kept this box around in case they needed to bring Chucky back to the store.

Decreases Slice & Dice hit cooldown by 7%.

beginner.whatItIs: Good Guy Box slots into Playtime's Over and shortens the cooldown between consecutive Slice & Dice hits. The faster reset lets the Killer chain follow-up attacks with less downtime between swings.
beginner.whyItMatters: Shorter cooldowns between hits let the Killer land repeated strikes in quick succession, turning a single chase into a sustained damage exchange. Compared to add-ons that overhaul Hidey-Ho Mode itself, it reads as a focused improvement to the core attack loop without changing the power's structure.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if the trial favors close-range chases through narrow rooms, since the faster cooldown matters most when the Killer can keep the Survivor in front of them. It is common, so it is a safe early pick for a Chucky build focused on damage.

Addon_K34_05.name: Power Drill
Addon_K34_05.description:
Comes with a dozen convenient drill tips. They all make a big mess when applied to people.

Reduces Hidey-Ho Mode cooldown by 10% after hitting a Survivor with Slice & Dice.

beginner.whatItIs: Power Drill is an uncommon add-on for Playtime's Over. Hitting a Survivor with Slice & Dice reduces the Hidey-Ho Mode cooldown.
beginner.whyItMatters: Getting Hidey-Ho Mode back sooner after a confirmed hit creates a tighter loop of attack and reposition, which is a bigger shift in how the power cycle feels. It rewards landing the first hit cleanly, since the cooldown reduction only triggers on a successful Slice & Dice.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in matchups where the Killer can reliably find Survivors one at a time, since the cooldown reduction only pays off when the first hit connects. It is uncommon, so it is a step up from common picks and worth saving for a build that already has a solid chase routine.

Addon_K34_06.name: Electric Carving Knife
Addon_K34_06.description:
The annoying buzzing sound means it’s ready to carve some flesh.

Decreases Slice & Dice miss cooldown by 5%.

beginner.whatItIs: An uncommon addition to Playtime's Over that cuts down the cooldown after a Slice & Dice swing misses its target. The reduced recovery window keeps the Killer's attack rhythm intact even when a hit is dodged.
beginner.whyItMatters: A shorter miss cooldown means the Killer can retry the attack sooner after whiffing, which is a smaller tweak than hit-based effects but one that reduces the penalty for a bad swing. It is especially useful in chases where the Survivor keeps moving unpredictably and clean hits are harder to land.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if the Survivor lineup is full of mobile characters who keep shifting angle during a chase, since the faster retry helps recover from a whiff. It is uncommon, so it is a good steady pick for a Chucky build that values consistency over peak damage.

Addon_K34_07.name: Jump Rope
Addon_K34_07.description:
Good for a bit of exercise, or for tying up your target.

Increases duration of Slice & Dice by 8%.

beginner.whatItIs: A jump rope add-on slotted into Playtime's Over. It extends the duration of Slice & Dice.
beginner.whyItMatters: Extending the Slice & Dice duration gives the effect more time to tick down, rewarding a patient approach where the Killer holds position rather than immediately swinging again. The longer active window shifts the power from a quick burst into a sustained pressure tool during close-range chases.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in matchups where Survivors play defensively and rarely commit to a dash, since the extended duration punishes them for lingering in the hit zone. It is uncommon, so it is a solid pick for a patient Chucky build that likes to control tempo.

Addon_K34_08.name: Hair Spray & Candle
Addon_K34_08.description:
An aerosolized inferno that will ensure a bad hair day is the least of your worries.

Decreases the time that basic attacks remove from Hidey-Ho Mode by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: Hair Spray & Candle modifies Playtime's Over by reducing how much Hidey-Ho Mode time is lost when a basic attack connects. The slower drain lets the Killer stay in the mode through longer exchanges.
beginner.whyItMatters: Basic attacks usually drain Hidey-Ho Mode quickly, so reducing that drain means the Killer can swing more times while the mode is active. That is a bigger shift in how Hidey-Ho Mode sustain feels, since the mode lasts longer through a full combat exchange.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the Survivor lineup favors characters who trade blows during a chase, since the reduced drain keeps Hidey-Ho Mode alive through a drawn-out exchange. Uncommon rarity means it will take a few offerings to surface, but it rewards a Chucky build that wants to outlast the first exchange.

Addon_K34_09.name: Automatic Screwdriver
Addon_K34_09.description:
A good way to make mechanical adjustments on the fly.

Missing a Slice & Dice reduces Hidey-Ho Mode cooldown by 8%.

beginner.whatItIs: An uncommon modifier for Playtime's Over that shrinks the Hidey-Ho Mode cooldown whenever a Slice & Dice swing comes up empty. Even a whiffed attack now pushes the power closer to being ready again.
beginner.whyItMatters: Getting a cooldown benefit even when the hit lands empty keeps the power cycle tight no matter how well the Survivor is dodging. It reads as a modest reliability bump rather than a damage overhaul, and it smooths out the rhythm for a Chucky player still dialing in hit timing.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in early trials while learning the timing of Slice & Dice, since the miss-reduction keeps the power cycle moving even when the first swing goes wide. It is uncommon, so it is a forgiving pick that helps a new Chucky player find the rhythm.

Addon_K34_10.name: Portable TV
Addon_K34_10.description:
Small enough for any room. Just keep it out of the bath.

Slice & Dice duration increased by 70% once the Exit Gates have been powered.

beginner.whatItIs: Portable TV is a rare add-on for Playtime's Over. Once the Exit Gates are powered, Slice & Dice duration is extended significantly.
beginner.whyItMatters: The significant duration increase kicks in only after the Exit Gates are powered, which shifts the late-game feel of the power compared to the mid-trial. It rewards a Killer who has been managing the trial toward the end, since the effect is dormant until the gates are live.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Save it for trials that are clearly heading into the endgame, because the extended Slice & Dice duration lands right when Survivors are committing to the exit push. Its rare drop rate means the offering must be patient, but a Chucky build focused on closing out a match is the natural fit.

Addon_K34_11.name: Silk Pillow
Addon_K34_11.description:
For when you want to smother your target with silky-smooth softness.

Terror Radius is reduced by 6 meters, but Slice & Dice charge time is increased by 50%.

beginner.whatItIs: Slotted into Playtime's Over, Silk Pillow shrinks the Terror Radius and stretches the Slice & Dice charge time. Both shifts reshape the power's rhythm, favoring a slower, more deliberate cadence over a wide passive zone.
beginner.whyItMatters: The trade-off of a smaller Terror Radius for a longer charge means the Killer gains stealth at the cost of attack readiness, shifting the power cycle toward a more deliberate pace. It favors a setup-heavy approach over a fast, aggressive one.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it on maps with many hiding spots where Survivors can easily lose track of the Killer, since the reduced radius gives more room to reposition quietly. It is rare, so it is a pick for a patient Chucky build that values setup over raw chase speed.

Addon_K34_12.name: Iridescent Amulet
Addon_K34_12.description:
A pendant of great power, recreated within the Realm.

Increases duration of Hidey-Ho Mode by 50%. Basic attacks immediately end Hidey-Ho Mode.

beginner.whatItIs: Iridescent Amulet is an iridescent add-on for Playtime's Over. It extends the duration of Hidey-Ho Mode, but basic attacks immediately end the mode.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extended Hidey-Ho Mode window gives Playtime more room to reposition across the map before the red stain fades, turning a short burst into a more sustained hiding tool. The instant cancellation from a basic attack means committing to the mode is a gamble, since one wrong swing strips the whole benefit away. It reads as a meaningful change to how the power is committed to rather than a small timing tweak.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a chase build already wants to cross long distances while Survivors are searching, since the extended hiding window lets Playtime reposition without leaving a visible trail. Iridescent drops are slow to appear in the offering, so saving one for a Hidey-Ho focused build makes sense. The single-swing cancellation means timing the commit around pallets and corners matters more than it would with the default mode.

Addon_K34_13.name: Plastic Bag
Addon_K34_13.description:
Nothing tires out a kill like a lack of oxygen.

If a Survivor walks through an illusory Footfall, they suffer from Exhausted for 15 seconds.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating other perks that cause Exhausted.

beginner.whatItIs: Plastic Bag attaches to Playtime's Over and targets the illusory Footfalls left lying around. Walking through one saddles that survivor with Exhausted for a short spell. While Exhausted is running, perks that would cause it cannot be used.
beginner.whyItMatters: Applying Exhausted through a Footfall adds a new layer to the power's deception, since Survivors who step on the illusion lose their ability to use other Exhausted-granting perks for a while. It is a bigger shift in how Footfalls punish mistakes, turning a cosmetic effect into a real gameplay debuff.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it to lobbies where Survivors casually walk through every Footfall they see, since the Exhausted debuff turns that habit into a genuine cost. Very rare drops are worth holding for a Footfall-heavy Chucky build that already uses illusory markers to split Survivor movement. It also blocks other Exhausted perks from stacking on the same Survivor, which is useful against coordinated support builds.

Addon_K34_14.name: Pile of Nails
Addon_K34_14.description:
It’s a lot easier to stay hidden when your target is worried about a pile of nails flying at their head.

Upon manually exiting Hidey-Ho Mode, The Good Guy remains Undetectable for 3 seconds.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

beginner.whatItIs: An add-on for Playtime's Over that keeps The Good Guy Undetectable for a short moment after manually leaving Hidey-Ho Mode. During that window the killer's aura, terror radius, and red stain are all hidden.
beginner.whyItMatters: That brief window of invisibility lets the killer drift back into hiding right after a scare. It turns each exit from the doll into another chance to reposition unseen instead of being spotted mid-move.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if you like hiding behind the Good Guy and want the pop of leaving it to stay stealthy. It is very rare, so expect to wait a while before it shows up in an offer.

Addon_K34_15.name: Yardstick
Addon_K34_15.description:
Good for measuring distance. Even better for laying down a beating.

A Scamper reveals Survivor auras within 16 meters of you for 3 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: It turns a Scamper into a short detection pulse that reveals nearby survivor auras for a moment. The effect is centered on the killer and fades quickly.
beginner.whyItMatters: A quick flash of positions helps confirm where survivors are right after a scare. That information is useful for choosing whether to chase one direction or slip away to cut a survivor off.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want information out of a Scamper instead of just distance. It is rare and fits a killer who repositions around a chase rather than committing to a long run.

Addon_K34_16.name: Running Shoes
Addon_K34_16.description:
The latest in high-performance killer doll athletic technology.

Gain 2% movement speed after a Scamper for 5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: It grants the killer a brief movement speed boost immediately after a Scamper. The exit from the doll carries extra momentum into whatever comes next.
beginner.whyItMatters: The added pace right after leaving the doll helps close the gap on a survivor who turns to run. A chase build gets a small but real head of ground before the target can reach a pallet.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if a Scamper often ends too close to losing the chase. It is rare and suits a killer who finishes chases by chasing rather than by hiding.

Addon_K34_17.name: Rat Poison
Addon_K34_17.description:
The secret ingredient in a killer chili.

While performing a Slice & Dice, the auras of Survivors within 6 meters of you are revealed for 2.5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: It exposes survivor auras close to the killer while performing a Slice & Dice. Anyone nearby is marked for a short moment during the takedown.
beginner.whyItMatters: Revealing survivors who hang around during a takedown helps punish those who wait to heal or interfere. It can also confirm a second survivor hiding in the shadows.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when survivors like to camp nearby and meddle during a takedown. It is rare and rewards a killer who takes down survivors in the open.

Addon_K34_18.name: Straight Razor
Addon_K34_18.description:
For when a close shave needs to be really, really close.

Slice & Dice attacks inflict the Hemorrhage and Mangled  status effects for 80 seconds.

Hemorrhage regresses healing progress when not healing, and increases blood trails left by injured survivors. This lasts for a set duration or until healed.

Mangled increases time required to heal by 25% and lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

beginner.whatItIs: A heavy-hitting add-on for Playtime's Over that makes Slice & Dice attacks inflict Hemorrhage and Mangled on the survivor. Both conditions last for a set duration or until the survivor is healed.
beginner.whyItMatters: Stacking those two conditions slows healing and drags out every takedown a survivor tries. The match shifts toward a killer who wants survivors bleeding and struggling at generators.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in a build focused on dragging out healing and punishing injured survivors. It is very rare and rewards patient, pressure-heavy play.

Addon_K34_19.name: Hard Hat
Addon_K34_19.description:
Keeps the dome intact while performing high-impact activities.

Whenever you Scamper under Pallets, they special-break immediately.

beginner.whatItIs: A pallet tool that makes boards special-break the moment the killer scampers beneath them. The exit from the doll becomes a free pallet break.
beginner.whyItMatters: Breaking a pallet for free mid-chase keeps the killer moving and strips a survivor of the exact cover they were about to use. That is a big swing in a tight loop.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when survivors lean hard on pallet loops and you want the Scamper to double as a board break. It is iridescent, so it will be hard to pull from offers.

Addon_K34_20.name: Mirror Shards
Addon_K34_20.description:
A bunch of shattered mirror pieces that reflect light and shadow, further disorienting the already disoriented.

The Good Guy can see the illusory Footfalls around Survivors.

beginner.whatItIs: A visibility upgrade that lets the killer see the illusory Footfalls around survivors. It shows which trail is the real one.
beginner.whyItMatters: Cutting through the fake footsteps stops a survivor from baiting the killer down the wrong tile. A chase build stays honest and wastes less time chasing a ghost trail.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if survivors keep escaping through Footfalls and you want cleaner reads on the real path. It is very rare and suits a killer who chases through those decoys.

Addon_K35_01.name: Rabbit's Foot
Addon_K35_01.description:
The unlucky creature’s remains were found by a tree, its intestines wedged between its teeth.

Pools of blood are brighter when charging UVX.

Survivors injured by UVX suffer from the Hemorrhage status effect for 45 seconds.

Hemorrhage regresses healing progress when not healing, and increases blood trails left by injured Survivors.

beginner.whatItIs: Pools of blood left by UVX glow brighter while the power is charging. Survivors injured by UVX also suffer from Hemorrhage for a set duration.
beginner.whyItMatters: The brighter trail makes it easier to track a survivor through dark corners. The Hemorrhage keeps an injured survivor's healing progress from sticking, adding pressure on anyone hurt by the power.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if you want a simpler, more tracking-friendly version of UVX. It is common and appears in offers fairly often.

Addon_K35_02.name: Footprint Cast
Addon_K35_02.description:
The cast sits in the Museum of the Weird in Sarasota, Florida and has long since been debunked.

Decreases the time until the next Hallucination spawns by 15 seconds when a Survivor becomes Weakened.

Weakened Survivors lose health states when hit by UVX’s Blast Area.

beginner.whatItIs: The cast shortens the wait until the next Hallucination spawns whenever a survivor becomes Weakened. It reacts to the killer's own pressure on a survivor.
beginner.whyItMatters: Weakening a survivor already signals they are in trouble. Speeding up the next hallucination right after that decision punishes them for staying in UVX's blast area.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when survivors keep getting Weakened by the blast and you want the follow-up to come faster. It is rare and fits a pressure-heavy UVX build.

Addon_K35_03.name: Blurry Photo
Addon_K35_03.description:
The photo was found at an abandoned campsite. The campers were never seen again.

After Teleporting, regain full movement speed 7% faster.

beginner.whatItIs: The photo restores full movement speed a little faster after a Teleport. The killer regains pace out of the reposition more quickly.
beginner.whyItMatters: A quicker recovery of speed keeps the killer mobile right after a Teleport. That matters in a map where the killer needs to chase a survivor across open ground after repositioning.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the gap right after a Teleport feels slow and you want smoother repositioning. It is common and easy to find in offers.

Addon_K35_04.name: Slashed Backpack
Addon_K35_04.description:
When the hiker was rescued from the mountain pass, she insisted her companion would never wander off alone.

UVX triggers a Blast Area upon contact with Hallucinations.Hallucinations can be destroyed by UVX. Doing so decreases the time until the next Hallucination spawns by 65%.

beginner.whatItIs: UVX can destroy Hallucinations on contact. Clearing one also cuts the time until the next hallucination spawns.
beginner.whyItMatters: Turning hallucinations into something the killer can actively clear changes the pace of the match. Clearing them on purpose keeps the killer in control of when the next one appears.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want to manage Hallucinations rather than react to them. It is uncommon and suits a killer who plays around them on purpose.

Addon_K35_05.name: Punctured Eyeball
Addon_K35_05.description:
The station was a scene of madness. The officers had seemingly turned on each other.

Survivors who are both Weakened and injured suffer from the Deep Wound status effect when they Dispel a Hallucination.

Deep Wound will put a Survivor in the dying state unless it is mended before the timer runs out.

Weakened Survivors lose health states when hit by UVX’s Blast Area.

beginner.whatItIs: Survivors who are both Weakened and injured gain Deep Wound when they dispel a Hallucination. That can drop them into the dying state if it is not mended in time.
beginner.whyItMatters: That extra punish on survivors who are already struggling turns a risky dispel into a potentially fatal mistake. It adds real teeth to UVX's pressure on a weakened target.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if survivors keep dispelling hallucinations while Weakened and you want that choice to hurt more. It is common and shows up often in offers.

Addon_K35_06.name: Notebook of Theories
Addon_K35_06.description:
His studio apartment was empty and reeked of black mold. The book was the only thing left.

Survivors hit by UVX while it is airborne suffer from the Hindered status effect for an additional 2 seconds.

Hindered reduces Survivor movement speed.

beginner.whatItIs: Hindered is applied for a bit longer to survivors hit by UVX while it is airborne. The added duration keeps them grounded a moment after the power lands.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer slow keeps a survivor from breaking into a sprint the instant the power lands. It helps the killer stay on top during a chase and makes escaping the blast area harder.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when survivors keep sprinting clear right after an aerial hit and you want that window of speed loss to last a beat longer. It is uncommon and suits a chase-focused UVX build.

Addon_K35_07.name: Last Known Recording
Addon_K35_07.description:
She studied musique concrète before she disappeared, her screams the last sound on the tape.

Decreases your Hallucinations’ Aura Range that is visible to Survivors by 35%.

beginner.whatItIs: Stealth is improved for UVX by shrinking the aura range of Hallucinations that survivors can see. They become harder to spot from a distance.
beginner.whyItMatters: Survivors who plan around where hallucinations will appear get less warning. The killer can place them closer to survivors without tipping them off as early.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if survivors keep dodging hallucinations early and you want them to notice later. It is uncommon and fits a control-focused UVX build.

Addon_K35_08.name: Sketch Attempt
Addon_K35_08.description:
The victim’s child was given paper and crayons at the station, while he waited for his father to pick him up.

Survivors hit by UVX's Blast Area suffer from the Oblivious status effect for 20 seconds.

Oblivious prevents Survivors from hearing or being affected by the Killer's Terror Radius.

beginner.whatItIs: The Oblivious status lands on survivors hit by UVX's blast area. It blocks them from sensing the killer's terror radius for a set time.
beginner.whyItMatters: Removing a survivor's sense of the killer's position right after a blast hit makes it harder for them to plan a safe exit. A chase build gains an edge in the moments right after contact.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if survivors keep slipping away cleanly after being hit and you want that window to be messier. It is common, so it tends to show up in offers regularly.

Addon_K35_09.name: Victim’s Map
Addon_K35_09.description:
He thought the key to solving the mystery lay beyond the forest, and feared he would never return.

When a Survivor successfully Stares Down The Unknown, The Unknown gains Killer Instinct for 3 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Killer Instinct lands on UVX for a short moment when a survivor successfully Stares Down The Unknown. The reward triggers only on a survived stare-down.
beginner.whyItMatters: That burst of awareness after a survived stare-down helps the killer quickly find the survivor who just defied the power. It turns a defensive win for the survivor into a fresh chance to hunt them down.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when survivors keep surviving the Stare Down The Unknown check and you want that moment to flip into a fresh hunt in your favor. Because it is uncommon, plan to encounter it less frequently than common drops.

Addon_K35_10.name: Vanishing Box
Addon_K35_10.description:
The magician was popular at children’s parties, and quickly became the top suspect.

Survivors who complete generators become Weakened against UVX.Increases Hallucination spawn time by 120%.

Weakened Survivors lose health states when hit by the UVX's Blast Area.

beginner.whatItIs: Both halves of the effect apply at once. Survivors who finish a generator become Weakened against UVX, and the wait until the next Hallucination is stretched out.
beginner.whyItMatters: That trade-off slows the hallucination cycle but hands UVX an edge over survivors who finish generators. It favors a killer who punishes progress with the blast area.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if you want survivors to feel the cost of finishing generators and are happy with fewer hallucinations. It is rare and suits a control-heavy build.

Addon_K35_11.name: Front-Page Article
Addon_K35_11.description:
The assailant had torn gaping holes in the walls of the cabin, and drove the family into the woods.

Performing the break interaction on a pallet or breakable wall decreases the time until the next Hallucination spawns by 50%.

beginner.whatItIs: Paired with UVX, it reduces the wait for the next Hallucination spawn whenever the killer breaks a pallet or a breakable wall. Aggressive hunting through boards and breakables keeps pressure on survivors by shortening the cycle more often.
beginner.whyItMatters: Linking hallucination spawns to the killer's pallet and wall breaks keeps the power active during chases. It rewards a killer who keeps breaking things rather than letting them sit.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when survivors lean on pallets and walls and you want the act of breaking them to speed up the next hallucination. It is rare and fits an aggressive UVX build.

Addon_K35_12.name: Hypnotist’s Watch
Addon_K35_12.description:
Hypnotherapy was recommended to recover repressed memories. What emerged from his mind would be his undoing.

Survivors hit by UVX while it is airborne suffer from the Exhausted status effect for 15 seconds.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating certain perks.

beginner.whatItIs: Attached to UVX, it applies Exhausted to any survivor struck while the projectile is still airborne. The debuff locks out certain perks for the duration, which can cut a survivor off from key abilities at a critical moment.
beginner.whyItMatters: Blocking a survivor's key perk right as they are hurt removes their usual escape or self-save. A well-timed aerial hit lands much harder because of it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if survivors keep relying on a strong escape perk and you want an aerial hit to shut that off. It is rare and fits a punish-heavy UVX build.

Addon_K35_13.name: B-Movie Poster
Addon_K35_13.description:
The movie was rumored to be state-funded propaganda, made specifically for something called Project Apple-Pie.

Survivors damaged by UVX's Blast Area suffer from the Broken status effect for 30 seconds.

Broken prevents Survivors from being healed.

beginner.whatItIs: Healing is blocked for survivors damaged by UVX's blast area. They gain the Broken status and cannot be healed for a set duration.
beginner.whyItMatters: Removing the healer's window right after a blast hit keeps a damaged survivor stuck injured. It pressures the whole survivor team to play more carefully around UVX.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a survivor keeps getting patched up right after the Blast Area connects and the healing window needs to shut. The drop is rare, so do not expect to cycle through it as often as a common one.

Addon_K35_14.name: Device of Undisclosed Origin
Addon_K35_14.description:
Was the thing made on Earth? Or somewhere else entirely?

Survivors entering the Aura Range of a Hallucination suffer from the Oblivious status effect.

Oblivious prevents Survivors from hearing or being affected by the Killer's Terror Radius.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into UVX and adds the Oblivious status effect to survivors who step inside a Hallucination's Aura Range. Oblivious cuts off their ability to hear or react to the killer's Terror Radius.
beginner.whyItMatters: Removing the audio and visual cues that normally warn survivors of an approaching killer makes chases feel more sudden and disorienting. It reads as a meaningful shift because it strips a core detection tool rather than just tweaking a stat.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when facing survivors who lean heavily on hearing the killer to time their vaults and escapes. The uncommon rarity keeps it accessible enough to slot into most UVX builds.

Addon_K35_15.name: Homemade Mask
Addon_K35_15.description:
The killer had made the mask in the shed in his backyard, where he would bring the others when the sun went down.

Survivors who Dispel Hallucinations suffer from the Blindness status effect for 60 seconds.

Blindness prevents Survivors from seeing auras.

beginner.whatItIs: Punishes survivors who Dispel a Hallucination by blinding them for a long stretch, and it slots into the UVX power. During Blindness they cannot see any auras at all.
beginner.whyItMatters: Turning a defensive action into a crippling debuff flips the risk-reward on dispelling entirely. It reads as a bigger shift because it forces survivors to weigh whether removing a Hallucination is worth losing all aura vision.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if the survivor team keeps breaking your Hallucinations to track your position. The very rare rarity means it will take some luck to pull, but it pays off against teams that dispel aggressively.

Addon_K35_16.name: Obscure Game Cartridge
Addon_K35_16.description:
Some maintained Project Apple-Pie evolved over time, turning to new forms of media for results.

Triggers for 20 seconds following a Teleport.Increases the action speed for breaking downed pallets, breakable walls, damaging generators, and vaulting windows by 30%.

beginner.whatItIs: Extends the UVX toolkit by giving the killer a burst of increased action speed for a short window after each Teleport. The speed boost covers breaking pallets, smashing breakable walls, damaging generators, and vaulting windows.
beginner.whyItMatters: It keeps the killer moving and interacting fast right after repositioning, which smooths out the gap between a Teleport and the next engagement. The effect is a meaningful shift because it rewards chaining Teleport into immediate map work.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a build already leans on Teleport to cross the map and you want to follow up with fast interactions on the far side. The very rare rarity makes it a reward for patience with the unlock system.

Addon_K35_17.name: Discarded Milk Carton
Addon_K35_17.description:
She decided to take the long way home, and waved goodbye to her friends before parting ways.

Doubles the UVX projectile's bounce strength.

beginner.whatItIs: Modifies the UVX projectile by doubling its bounce strength off surfaces. Shots that would normally stop at a single wall or object now ricochet with far more force.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra bounce makes the projectile harder to play safe against, since survivors can no longer simply stand behind cover expecting the shot to die there. It is a small tactical tweak that opens up angled shots around corners.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when maps pack in tight cover and survivors tuck just past bends where a single projectile would otherwise miss. It is very rare, so it takes time to find, but it pairs well with a UVX chase build.

Addon_K35_18.name: Serum Vial
Addon_K35_18.description:
The molecular structure of the substance was synthesized in the lab, but its effects could never be replicated.

Survivors within a Hallucination’s Aura Range suffer from the Exhausted status effect for 15 seconds.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating certain perks.

beginner.whatItIs: Applies the Exhausted status effect to any survivor caught inside a Hallucination's Aura Range for a noticeable window. Exhausted blocks them from activating certain perks.
beginner.whyItMatters: Stripping perk activation on contact with the Hallucination zone punishes survivors who camp near generators with defensive perk setups. It is a bigger shift than a simple stat bump because it changes what tools survivors can reach during a chase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it against survivor builds that rely on exhausting or cooldown-heavy perks, since the Hallucination zone becomes a soft penalty for loitering. Very rare rarity makes it a long-term goal rather than a first pick.

Addon_K35_19.name: Captured by the Dark
Addon_K35_19.description:
The documentary purported that the disappearances were linked to small-town cinemas. Audiences left the theater feeling uneasy.

Survivors begin the trial Weakened.Decreases the maximum number of Hallucinations that can be spawned by 1.

Weakened Survivors lose health states when hit by UVX’s Blast Area.

beginner.whatItIs: An add-on for the UVX that opens every trial with all survivors already Weakened and lowers the ceiling on Hallucinations the UVX can spawn at once. The Blast Area further drains health states from any Weakened survivor it reaches.
beginner.whyItMatters: The trade is fewer Hallucinations in exchange for stronger opening pressure and a hit that does more damage than usual. It reads as a bigger shift in the power's identity, trading sustained zone control for burst damage at the start of the trial.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a trial should open with every survivor already Weakened and the Blast Area ready to punish anyone lingering in the zone. Iridescent rarity means it takes a long grind to find, so save it for a UVX build already dialed in.

Addon_K35_20.name: Iridescent OSS Report
Addon_K35_20.description:
The report was redacted to the point of being meaningless. But still, theorists tried to extract meaning from it.

Decreases Teleport cooldown by 5 seconds.The Decoy left behind after The Unknown teleports takes 10 seconds longer to disappear.When created, the Decoy has the same Terror Radius and Red Stain as The Unknown.

beginner.whatItIs: An add-on for the UVX that trims the Teleport cooldown and keeps the Decoy on the field for a noticeably longer stretch. While it lingers, the Decoy inherits the killer's full Terror Radius and Red Stain.
beginner.whyItMatters: A Decoy that projects a Terror Radius and Red Stain is no longer a useless prop; it becomes a second source of pressure that forces survivors to check which figure is real. This is a bigger shift that changes how survivors plan their routes around teleported markers.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a build wants to use Teleport repeatedly and the Decoy itself should contribute to the kill plan rather than just marking where the killer was. Iridescent rarity puts it well beyond the casual unlock curve.

Addon_K36_01.name: Tattered Headband
Addon_K36_01.description:
An enchanted accessory once owned by a powerful summoner. It still carries a whisper of its former magic.

Increases the distance of Flight of the Damned’s spectral entities by 4 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: Extends the reach of the spectral entities spawned by Flight of the Damned, sending them farther from the killer's position before they expire. The extra distance covers more of the surrounding area.
beginner.whyItMatters: A wider spread of entities means survivors have a larger zone to be cautious about, which helps the killer control more open ground without moving closer. It is a small but tangible tweak that makes the power feel more oppressive in open maps.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it on maps with wide-open sightlines where Flight of the Damned needs to stretch its reach and keep spectral entities farther from the killer. It is common, so it shows up early and drops easily into a VILE DARKNESS loadout.

Addon_K36_02.name: Raven's Feather
Addon_K36_02.description:
A material component most typically used for the Fly spell.

Increases duration of the Fly spell by 0.5 second.

beginner.whatItIs: A VILE DARKNESS entry that adds a small amount of extra duration to the Fly spell, keeping the killer airborne just a little longer. The difference is subtle but consistent.
beginner.whyItMatters: Even a short extension of flight time can let the killer clear one more obstacle or hold a high vantage point for a beat longer before landing. It is the smallest of tweaks, useful for smoothing out a chase that would otherwise end with an awkward landing.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if Fly feels like it cuts off just a touch too early on long map stretches. Common rarity means it is available early and pairs with any VILE DARKNESS build that leans on Fly for repositioning.

Addon_K36_03.name: Trickster's Glove
Addon_K36_03.description:
A glove once belonging to an arcane trickster whose mastery of Mage Hand clings to its fibers.

Increases the time Mage Hand holds a pallet up by 0.3 second.

beginner.whatItIs: Lengthens the hold time of Mage Hand on an upright pallet, keeping the pallet suspended for a fraction longer than the base effect. The extra window is short but can matter at the edge of a chase.
beginner.whyItMatters: A slightly longer pallet hold gives the killer a marginally bigger opportunity to swing through before the pallet drops, which can tighten a kill window by a few frames of timing. It is a small refinement rather than a redesign of the power.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if you frequently use Mage Hand to hold pallets over a survivor and want a touch more time to land the hit. Common rarity keeps it within easy reach for any VILE DARKNESS rotation.

Addon_K36_04.name: Crystal Ball
Addon_K36_04.description:
Used by spellcasters for centuries to scry upon friend and foe alike.

When a Survivor is revealed by Dispelling Sphere, the Killer Instinct effect lasts for an additional 1 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Extends the Killer Instinct effect that triggers when a survivor is revealed by Dispelling Sphere, keeping the tracking glow active for a brief additional moment. The killer can see the survivor's location through walls for slightly longer.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra tracking time after a reveal gives the killer a small but real advantage in closing the distance before the survivor can reposition. It is a modest tweak that rewards clean Dispelling Sphere hits with a fraction more follow-up time.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when Dispelling Sphere is the primary way of finding survivors and each successful ping should lead into a cleaner approach. Common rarity makes it a straightforward upgrade for any VILE DARKNESS detection build.

Addon_K36_05.name: Lantern of Revealing
Addon_K36_05.description:
Even those who evade your attacks cannot evade your gaze.

Reveals the aura of Survivors narrowly missed by Flight of the Damned for 3 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Turns near-misses from Flight of the Damned into information by revealing the aura of any survivor the spectral entities pass close to but fail to hit. The reveal lasts long enough to register the survivor's position on the map.
beginner.whyItMatters: Converting a miss into a reveal reduces the wasted cast of the spell and keeps the killer informed even when the entities do not connect. It is a small quality-of-life shift that makes the power more forgiving of imperfect aim.
