beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if you often cast Flight of the Damned and wish the near-misses still gave something back. Uncommon rarity is a step up from common but still very attainable for a VILE DARKNESS kit.

Addon_K36_06.name: Potion of Speed
Addon_K36_06.description:
A curious concoction that downgrades the rules of physics to mere suggestions.

Decreases the period where you cannot attack after casting Fly by 0.1 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Shortens the brief attack lockout that follows casting Fly, letting the killer swing a weapon a moment sooner after landing from the spell. The reduction is small but removes a tiny stutter from the combo flow.
beginner.whyItMatters: Removing that sliver of unresponsiveness makes the Fly-into-attack sequence feel tighter and more predictable, which matters in close-quarters chases where every fraction of a second counts. It is a micro-tweak that rewards a player who chains Fly into a hit.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if Fly is used as a gap closer right before a swing and the slight delay breaks the rhythm of a chase. Uncommon rarity keeps it accessible for most VILE DARKNESS builds.

Addon_K36_07.name: Ring of Telekinesis
Addon_K36_07.description:
Its arcane energy crackles to life when its user manipulates objects from afar.

Whenever you cast Mage Hand on an upright Pallet, for 10 seconds, you basic-vault Windows 10% faster.

beginner.whatItIs: An add-on for VILE DARKNESS that fires when Mage Hand is used on an upright pallet, granting a short burst of faster window-vaulting speed. The boost is brief, so timing the pallet interaction just before a window matters.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster vaults after a pallet interaction help the killer maintain chase momentum through window-heavy map sections, where vault speed can be the difference between catching a survivor and losing them. It is a small but situational speed bump.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the map is full of window vaults and the chase should keep flowing through them without the usual pacing dip. Uncommon rarity is a reasonable mid-tier pick for a VILE DARKNESS chase build.

Addon_K36_08.name: Glass Eye
Addon_K36_08.description:
A material component used to cast spells of detection.

Increases the size of Dispelling Sphere by 2 meters and its movement speed by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Grows the detection area of Dispelling Sphere and increases its movement speed, so it covers more ground and reaches targets faster. The combined effect makes the sphere a more reliable and quicker scouting tool.
beginner.whyItMatters: A larger and faster sphere means the killer spends less time waiting for it to arrive and gains a bigger radius of coverage on arrival, which is especially helpful on larger maps. It is a modest but welcome upgrade to a core detection tool.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if Dispelling Sphere feels slow or too small to reliably find survivors on the maps played most. Uncommon rarity makes it a solid early-to-mid priority for any VILE DARKNESS detection setup.

Addon_K36_09.name: Ring of Spell Storing
Addon_K36_09.description:
A magical ring that rewards those who are well-prepared.

Decreases the cooldown of all spells by 1 second.

beginner.whatItIs: It attaches to VILE DARKNESS and trims the cooldown across the killer full spell set, so every cast comes back online a little sooner. The reduction applies evenly rather than favoring any one spell over the others.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster spell cycling means the killer can chain the full spell kit more frequently without waiting as long between casts, which adds up over a full trial into noticeably more pressure. It is a small universal tweak that improves the feel of the whole kit at once.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if the wait between spells feels too long during a chase or a map-clearing sequence. Uncommon rarity keeps it within reach and it pairs with any VILE DARKNESS playstyle.

Addon_K36_10.name: Ornate Horn
Addon_K36_10.description:
Once used to rally troops to battle, its very presence brings great armies to bear.

Increases the number of entities created by Flight of the Damned by 1.

beginner.whatItIs: Adds one more entity to each cast of Flight of the Damned, increasing the total number of spectral projections that sweep through the area. The extra body covers more angles and leaves fewer safe gaps for a survivor.
beginner.whyItMatters: More entities in the air at once means the survivor has a harder time finding a clean path between them, which turns a medium-pressure spell into a heavier one. It is a bigger shift in the spell's coverage than most of the common-tier tweaks.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when Flight of the Damned should be a harder spell to dodge, especially on maps with tight corridors and narrow escape routes. Rare rarity makes it a mid-to-late goal for a VILE DARKNESS loadout.

Addon_K36_11.name: Cloak of Elvenkind
Addon_K36_11.description:
Its colors are constantly shifting, making you more difficult to detect from afar.

Reduces Terror Radius by 22 meters while the Fly spell is active.

beginner.whatItIs: Shrinks the killer's Terror Radius by a large margin while the Fly spell is active, making the airborne approach far less audible to survivors. The reduction is significant and lasts for the full duration of the flight.
beginner.whyItMatters: A quieter flight means the killer can close distance or reposition without the usual audio warning giving survivors a head start to run or hide. It is a meaningful stealth shift that changes how aggressively the killer can use Fly near the action.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if the goal is to fly directly over or beside a survivor without the Terror Radius tipping them off early. Rare rarity puts it a few unlocks beyond the casual curve, but it is a strong pick for a stealth-flavored VILE DARKNESS build.

Addon_K36_12.name: Boots of Speed
Addon_K36_12.description:
A simple click of their heels grants their wearer incredible pace.

Casting Mage Hand grants you 3% Haste for 2 seconds.

Haste increases Killer movement speed.

beginner.whatItIs: Grants a brief movement speed boost the moment Mage Hand is cast, giving the killer a small burst of pace for a short window after the interaction. The speed increase is modest but immediate.
beginner.whyItMatters: A tiny speed nudge after a pallet interaction helps the killer maintain forward momentum and can close a gap that would otherwise let a survivor slip past a window. It is a micro-tweak that smooths out the rhythm of a pallet-heavy chase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if a small kick of speed is wanted every time Mage Hand is used, particularly in chases that run through open hallways. Rare rarity makes it a mid-tier upgrade for a VILE DARKNESS chase kit.

Addon_K36_13.name: Staff of Withering
Addon_K36_13.description:
Its necrotic power brings its targets closer to death.

Dispelling Sphere causes the Exhausted status effect for 30 seconds to Survivors who enter its radius.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating exhausting perks.

beginner.whatItIs: Turns the Dispelling Sphere into a debuff tool by applying the Exhausted status effect to any survivor who enters its radius, blocking their access to certain perks for a prolonged period. The sphere now does double duty as both a detection and a suppression tool.
beginner.whyItMatters: A sphere that strips perk usage on contact changes the risk calculus for survivors near the detection zone, forcing them to weigh the value of a perk against the cost of standing in the radius. It is a bigger shift in the sphere's role than a simple stat bump.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it against survivor teams that lean on exhausting or long-cooldown perks, since the sphere becomes a penalty for staying near generators. Rare rarity makes it a strong but not trivially available pick for a VILE DARKNESS control build.

Addon_K36_14.name: Pearl of Power
Addon_K36_14.description:
Its shimmering face energizes mages who hold it, allowing them to cast more spells.

Reduces the remaining cooldown for your spells by 2 seconds each time you land a basic attack.

beginner.whatItIs: It fits into VILE DARKNESS and shortens the remaining cooldown on every spell each time a basic attack connects. It rewards keeping pressure on survivors with the blade so the spell rotation recovers faster.
beginner.whyItMatters: The relief compounds over a long chase, so a mage who keeps trading hits recovers spells noticeably faster and can keep more options on the table during extended pursuits. It reads as a small tweak that snowballs into a real difference once the tempo of the trial picks up.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a trial already leans on basic attacks to keep magic flowing, since the synergy only pays out if the killer stays in contact. It rolls at rare, so bank it if VILE DARKNESS is already a core part of the rotation.

Addon_K36_15.name: Robe of Eyes
Addon_K36_15.description:
When worn, none can escape its bearer’s unyielding gaze.

Reveals the auras of Survivors within 6 meters of a Treasure Chest for 4 seconds each time you cast a spell.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into VILE DARKNESS and flashes the auras of survivors standing near a treasure chest every time a spell is cast. The reveal window is brief but can expose survivors who linger by a chest to grab loot.
beginner.whyItMatters: That brief reveal can expose a survivor who thinks they are hidden behind a chest, turning a safe looting spot into a dangerous one. It is a small but sharp change that rewards positioning near treasure chests instead of chasing down open ground.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if a trial keeps seeing survivors camp around treasure chests, since each spell cast near one will flush them out. It is a very rare roll, so hold it for matchups where the survivor lineup favors hiding.

Addon_K36_16.name: Dragontooth Dagger
Addon_K36_16.description:
Made from the actual tooth of a dragon, its edge is jagged and cruel.

Applies Hemorrhage and Mangled status effects to Survivors hit with a basic attack while holding a Magic Item for 60 seconds.

Hemorrhage regresses healing progress when not healing, and increases blood trails left by injured survivors. This lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

Mangled increases time required to heal by 25% and lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

beginner.whatItIs: Attaches to VILE DARKNESS and deals both Hemorrhage and Mangled to any survivor struck by a basic attack while a magic item is held. The bleeding slows their healing progress over time, while the mangled state makes completing a heal take longer still.
beginner.whyItMatters: Hemorrhage keeps bleeding the healing progress of an injured survivor even while they are idle, and Mangled makes any heal they do manage take noticeably longer. Together they form a meaningful shift in how injured survivors recover, not just a small damage tick.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the survivor lineup includes healers or a build that relies on quick top-offs, since the stacking debuffs slow their entire healing rhythm. It is a very rare roll, so stock it when the power already fits a chase-heavy playstyle.

Addon_K36_17.name: Cloak of Invisibility
Addon_K36_17.description:
A powerful magic item, envied by rogues and the conflict-averse alike.

Gain Undetectable for 20 seconds each time all of your spells are on cooldown at the same time.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

beginner.whatItIs: Grants VILE DARKNESS the Undetectable state for a short window whenever every spell is sitting on cooldown at once. While active, the killer's aura, terror radius, and red stain all vanish from the survivor's screen.
beginner.whyItMatters: Undetectable hides the killer aura, the terror radius, and the red stain all at once, which can turn a visible hunter into a ghost for a key moment. It reads as a bigger shift than most cooldown add-ons, since it changes whether survivors can see the killer at all.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the survivor lineup leans on aura counters or terror-radius tracking, since the invisibility window lets the killer slip through their defenses unnoticed. It rolls at very rare, so save it for trials where stealth positioning matters more than raw chase speed.

Addon_K36_18.name: Bag of Holding
Addon_K36_18.description:
The realm itself bends to its astounding capacity, populating trials with even more to take.

Two Treasure Chests are guaranteed to roll 1 on the dice roll.Opening Treasure Chests grants the Oblivious status effect to Survivors for 15 seconds.

Oblivious prevents Survivors from hearing and being affected by the Killer's Terror Radius.

beginner.whatItIs: It hooks into VILE DARKNESS and guarantees a set of treasure chests roll their best possible loot, while opening any chest also strikes nearby survivors with Oblivious for a short window. That status cuts off their sense of the killer Terror Radius, not their aura vision. The result is a more reliable loot economy paired with a subtle awareness punish for anyone hovering near an opened chest.
beginner.whyItMatters: The guaranteed chest rolls make the power economy more reliable, and the Oblivious effect on survivors near opened chests can deny them the terror-radius warning they rely on. It is a bigger shift than a simple loot bonus, since it changes both the killer resources and the survivors awareness.
beginner.whenToUseIt: It shines when a trial wants to lean into treasure-chest economy and the survivor lineup depends on hearing the killer approach. It rolls at very rare, so keep it stashed for matches where VILE DARKNESS is already a go-to power.

Addon_K36_19.name: Vorpal Sword
Addon_K36_19.description:
A powerful magical artifact whose blade has severed many a head from its accompanying body.

Any injured Survivor that enters a Dispelling Sphere screams and gains Broken for 30 seconds.Whenever you cast Mage Hand on a dropped Pallet, after 4 seconds, it special-breaks.

Broken prevents Survivors from being healed.

beginner.whatItIs: The Vorpal Sword slots into VILE DARKNESS and causes any injured survivor who steps into a Dispelling Sphere to scream and gain the Broken state. It also lets Mage Hand special-break a dropped pallet after a brief delay, removing that cover entirely.
beginner.whyItMatters: Broken prevents healing entirely, which means a survivor who stumbles into a sphere can lose the chance to recover for a meaningful stretch. The pallet special-break adds a second pressure point that keeps survivors from safely dropping a pallet to escape.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the survivor lineup relies on healing to recover from hits, since the Broken state punishes them for lingering near spheres. It is an iridescent roll, so save it for trials where VILE DARKNESS is already the chosen power.

Addon_K36_20.name: Iridescent Book of Vile Darkness
Addon_K36_20.description:
The ultimate compilation of cruelty, wickedness and depravity.

Using the Fly spell to pass through any vault location blocks that location for Survivors for 45 seconds.Lowers the number of spectral entities created by Flight of the Damned by 3 and makes them fly lower to the ground.

beginner.whatItIs: An iridescent add-on for VILE DARKNESS that lets the Fly spell seal a vault location behind it after passing through, trapping survivors who rely on that route. It also trims the number of spectral entities in Flight of the Damned and drops their altitude closer to the ground.
beginner.whyItMatters: Blocking vault locations can cut off the escape routes survivors rely on during a chase, and the lower-flying entities from Flight of the Damned are harder to avoid. It is a bigger shift in the power toolkit, adding area denial to a spell kit that was already about mobility.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Best suited for trials where survivors lean on vaults to break chases, since the blocked locations force them into longer, riskier routes. It is an iridescent roll, so hold it for trials where the power already fits the killer's playstyle.

Addon_K37_01.name: Sylph Feather
Addon_K37_01.description:
An enchanted feather that grants its holder great agility.

Whenever you break a Pallet, earn 1 Token, up to 5. For each Token, Hellfire's cooldown is 5% shorter.

beginner.whatItIs: Fits into Vampiric Shift and earns a token every time a pallet is broken, up to a fixed cap. Each stored token shaves a small slice off Hellfire's cooldown, rewarding aggressive pallet destruction during a chase.
beginner.whyItMatters: The more pallets that break, the shorter Hellfire cooldown becomes, so a trial full of pallet destruction pays off with a faster ultimate. It reads as a small tweak that scales with how aggressively the killer plays the board.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the map has plenty of pallets and the trial tends to see a lot of destruction, since the tokens stack naturally with that tempo. It is a rare roll, so stock it if Vampiric Shift is already a go-to power.

Addon_K37_02.name: Ruby Circlet
Addon_K37_02.description:
An enchanted headpiece that brings even the mightiest of flames to heel.

Decreases the cooldown of Hellfire by 5%.

beginner.whatItIs: A common add-on for Vampiric Shift that trims the Hellfire cooldown by a modest amount. The change is small but it lets the fire burst come back a little sooner between engagements.
beginner.whyItMatters: A shorter Hellfire cooldown means the killer can land that ultimate more often, which adds a steady layer of pressure without changing the fundamental shape of the playstyle. It is a small tweak, the kind that makes a power feel a little snappier over a full trial.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it in any trial where Hellfire is a core part of the rotation, since the cooldown relief is universal and does not depend on a specific matchup. It rolls at common, so it is an easy add-on to slot in.

Addon_K37_03.name: Cerberus Talon
Addon_K37_03.description:
A sharp memento from one of Dracula’s most terrifying guards.

Increases the reveal distance of Scent Orb by 100%.

beginner.whatItIs: The Cerberus Talon fits into Vampiric Shift and pushes the reveal distance of Scent Orb far beyond its default range. Survivors who tuck behind walls or hug pallets become much harder to hide from once the orb is active.
beginner.whyItMatters: A wider Scent Orb reveal means the killer can spot survivors from farther away, which is a meaningful edge in open areas or when a survivor tries to loop far from the action. It is a small but reliable tweak that extends the killer sensory range.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the map is wide and survivors tend to kite far from generators, since the extended reveal helps track them down. It rolls at common, so it is a safe bet for most Vampiric Shift trials.

Addon_K37_04.name: Clock Tower Gear
Addon_K37_04.description:
A piece of the great clock tower, a reminder of the inevitability of time itself.

Reduces the cooldown of Shapeshift by 5%.

beginner.whatItIs: Hooks into Vampiric Shift and trims the Shapeshift cooldown by a small margin. The shorter wait between forms means the killer can swap identity more often during a chase.
beginner.whyItMatters: A faster Shapeshift means the killer can cycle through forms more often, which keeps survivors guessing about what is coming next. It is a small tweak that rewards a killer who already knows when to shift forms.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Keep it handy when the survivor lineup relies on predicting which form the killer will take, since the extra shift frequency makes that prediction harder to maintain. It is a common roll, easy to keep in the loadout and swap in whenever the power is on the card.

Addon_K37_05.name: Magical Ticket
Addon_K37_05.description:
A strange artifact once used to transport across Dracula’s castle.

Increases the maximum speed of Teleport by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into Vampiric Shift and raises the top speed of Teleport during its burst. The extra velocity helps the killer close gaps faster when repositioning across the map.
beginner.whyItMatters: A faster Teleport closes the gap between the killer and the target location sooner, which matters most in long maps or when a survivor has already put distance between themselves and the action. It is a small tweak that makes the ultimate feel more decisive.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the map is large and survivors tend to split up across far corners, since the extra speed helps the killer reposition faster. It rolls at uncommon, so bank it if Vampiric Shift is already a core power.

Addon_K37_06.name: Moonstone Necklace
Addon_K37_06.description:
A simple necklace by day, but its power comes to life in the dark.

Reduces the size of the Terror Radius in Vampire and Wolf Forms by 8 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: A necklace that slots into Vampiric Shift and shrinks the terror radius in both Vampire and Wolf Forms. The smaller radius makes the transformed state less visible to survivors watching for the glow.
beginner.whyItMatters: A smaller terror radius means survivors get less warning before a chase begins, which can catch them off guard if they are not paying close attention to the killer position. It is a small but meaningful shift in how the killer approaches survivors from behind.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it in matchups where survivors stack auras that counter the terror radius, since the reduced size gives the killer a shorter window to be detected. It rolls at uncommon, so it is a reliable add-on for the power.

Addon_K37_07.name: Blood-Filled Goblet
Addon_K37_07.description:
The blood of his victims sustains him and makes him an even greater hunter.

Increases the duration of Scent Orbs by 60%.

beginner.whatItIs: A goblet that attaches to Vampiric Shift and extends how long Scent Orbs stay active on a tracked survivor. The longer trail gives the vampire more time to follow a survivor who pauses or loops after being marked.
beginner.whyItMatters: Longer-lasting Scent Orbs give the killer more time to track a survivor after the orb is triggered, which is especially useful when the target is still and quiet. It is a small tweak that extends the window for following a trail.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when survivors in the lineup favor hiding after a chase, since the extended orb window keeps their trail alive long enough to track them down. The uncommon roll means it shows up often enough to keep in a Vampiric Shift rotation without crowding out other options.

Addon_K37_08.name: Traveler’s Hat
Addon_K37_08.description:
A wide-brimmed hat that once belonged to a well-traveled man.

Increases Shapeshift speed by 5%.

beginner.whatItIs: Traveler's Hat slots into Vampiric Shift and speeds up Shapeshift activation. A quicker transition helps a vampire switch forms mid-chase while still closing the distance to a survivor.
beginner.whyItMatters: A faster Shapeshift activation means less time spent vulnerable while cycling forms, which matters most when the killer is in the middle of a chase and needs to switch forms quickly. It is a small tweak that tightens the form-cycling rhythm.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it to trials where rapid form switching is already central to the kill, since the extra speed rewards that tempo. The common roll makes it an easy find, so slot it into any Vampiric Shift build that leans on quick switches.

Addon_K37_09.name: Winged Boots
Addon_K37_09.description:
Long used by their wearers to move quickly.

Increases maximum distance of Teleport by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: Winged Boots attach to Vampiric Shift and stretch the maximum range Teleport can cover. The extra distance helps a vampire reach objectives that would otherwise require a longer approach.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra Teleport range lets the vampire cross wide maps with fewer interruptions, which matters when survivors spread their work across distant generators. It reads as a modest upgrade that extends reach without altering how the power fundamentally plays.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it on maps where survivors tend to work generators far from each other, since the longer range lets the vampire close the gap in one jump. The uncommon roll keeps it worth picking up whenever Vampiric Shift is in the rotation.

Addon_K37_10.name: White Wolf Medallion
Addon_K37_10.description:
A trinket once used to call a great spirit guide.

Increases Killer Instinct duration by 1 second while in Wolf Form after Survivors complete rushed actions.

beginner.whatItIs: White Wolf Medallion fits into Vampiric Shift and stretches the Killer Instinct window a wolf gains in Wolf Form after a survivor finishes a rushed action. The extra time makes it easier to chase down whoever just escaped through an exit.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer Killer Instinct window in Wolf Form means the killer gets more time to capitalize on a survivor rushed action, which is a small but meaningful edge in a chase that is already turning. It is a targeted tweak that rewards the killer for being in the right form at the right moment.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Slot it in when survivors lean heavily on rushed actions to break away from Wolf Form chases, since the extended instinct window punishes that escape gamble. The uncommon roll makes it a solid pick to hold for any build that favors the wolf.

Addon_K37_11.name: Killer Doll
Addon_K37_11.description:
One of Dracula’s minions, and a reminder that all are his playthings.

Increases the cooldown reduction of Pounce Attacks from Scent Orbs by 30%.

beginner.whatItIs: Killer Doll slots into Vampiric Shift and deepens the cooldown reduction Pounce Attacks earn from Scent Orbs. The faster recovery means a vampire can pounce again shortly after a hit lands instead of waiting as long between strikes.
beginner.whyItMatters: A stronger cooldown reduction means Pounce Attacks recover faster after being triggered by a Scent Orb, which keeps the pressure on a survivor who is already being tracked. It is a meaningful shift in the tempo of the orb-and-pounce loop.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it to trials where the killer already orbits around Scent Orbs and survivors try to slip away after being orbbed, since the quicker pounce reset punishes that escape. The rare roll is worth keeping whenever Vampiric Shift anchors the loadout.

Addon_K37_12.name: Sunglasses
Addon_K37_12.description:
They protect against bright lights, in addition to looking cool.

Hellfire has 1 extra pillar. Increases Hellfire charging time by 25%.

beginner.whatItIs: Sunglasses pair with Vampiric Shift, giving Hellfire an extra pillar at the cost of a slower recharge. The wider flame coverage protects more ground, but the killer must wait longer before the ability comes back.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra pillar makes Hellfire cover more ground, but the longer charge time means the killer has to commit to it earlier. It is a trade-off add-on that shifts Hellfire from a quick burst into a more deliberate area-denial tool.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when survivors spread across wide open areas where the extra pillar helps seal off escape routes, since the broader Hellfire makes it harder to slip past. The rare roll makes it worth holding for rotations that already center on Hellfire as the primary area control.

Addon_K37_13.name: Force of Echo
Addon_K37_13.description:
An artifact that grants bats even greater senses in the dark.

Increases the spawn rate of Scent Orbs by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: An artifact that bolts onto Vampiric Shift and nudges the Scent Orb spawn rate upward. More orbs on the map means more hooks for the vampire to follow a moving target.
beginner.whyItMatters: More frequent Scent Orbs give the killer more chances to track survivors without having to chase them down directly, which is a meaningful edge in trials where survivors try to stay mobile and out of reach. It is a small tweak that increases the tempo of the tracking game.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it to trials where survivors kite and rarely hold still, since the extra orbs give the killer more threads to pull. The rare roll makes it worth holding whenever the Vampiric Shift build already leans on tracking.

Addon_K37_14.name: Pocket Watch
Addon_K37_14.description:
A tool that bends the rules of time itself.

Whenever you break Pallets or Breakable Walls, instantly recharge Teleport.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into Vampiric Shift and rewires the Teleport cooldown around a single trigger: destroying Pallets and Breakable Walls. Every obstacle the killer smashes instantly refills the jump, removing the usual wait between relocations.
beginner.whyItMatters: That constant recharge keeps the killer mobile across the entire match instead of stalling in one corner, which shifts the chase rhythm from measured positioning to a fast, unpredictable series of relocations. It rewards a killer who plays through obstacles rather than around them.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in any match where the map is dense with Pallets and Breakable Walls between generators and safe zones, since the more the killer smashes, the more free Teleports they bank up. It is a rare drop, so it will not show up in every unlock rotation.

Addon_K37_15.name: Medusa’s Hair
Addon_K37_15.description:
A snakelike memento from one of Dracula's most ancient and fearsome minions.

All Survivors within 8 meters of your teleport destination suffer from an 8% Hindered status effect for 4 seconds.

Hindered reduces Survivor movement speed.

beginner.whatItIs: A Vampiric Shift add-on that coats everyone near the teleport destination in a slow-down effect. Survivors who were standing or walking in that zone get dragged to a crawl the instant the killer materializes.
beginner.whyItMatters: The slow zone turns a normal landing spot into a trap, since survivors who park near where the jump will land find themselves unable to bolt. That gives the killer a free window to swing first before anyone can react.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when facing survivors who tend to group near windows or Pallets at predictable chase endpoints, because the area slow punishes anyone who lingers where the teleport will land. It is a very rare drop, so expect to wait before it shows up in the unlock pool.

Addon_K37_16.name: Warg’s Fang
Addon_K37_16.description:
A mighty tool of destruction taken from one of Dracula’s most dangerous allies.

Reveals the auras of all Survivors whose Scent Orbs you have collected whenever Pounce Attack becomes available for 5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into Vampiric Shift and reveals the auras of every survivor whose Scent Orbs the killer has already banked. The reveal fires the instant Pounce Attack is ready, spotlighting targets at the peak of the killer's offensive window.
beginner.whyItMatters: That timed reveal removes the guesswork of where to swing Pounce Attack, since the killer sees exactly where the tracked survivors are sitting. It rewards a methodical orb-collecting route and punishes sloppy play that leaves orbs uncollected.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer has built a strong habit of collecting Scent Orbs and wants a reliable burst of information at the moment Pounce Attack refreshes. The very rare rarity means it will take several sessions to unlock, so plan a patient grind if the info spike feels worth it.

Addon_K37_17.name: Cube of Zoe
Addon_K37_17.description:
A strange box whose presence creates something from nothing.

When a generator is completed, creates pillars of Hellfire around The Dark Lord for 10 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Plugs into Vampiric Shift and spawns pillars of Hellfire around the killer every time a generator finishes. The danger zones appear at the exact moment survivors want to regroup and push toward the next objective.
beginner.whyItMatters: Because the pillars materialize right at generator completion, they punish the natural survivor instinct to bunch up and sprint toward exits. A clean group dash becomes a scattered, risky weave through active Hellfire, costing time and health.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in matches where survivors have shown a tendency to cluster after each generator, since the surprise danger zones in the middle of a rush are the worst place to be. Its very rare rarity means it will not appear often in the unlock queue.

Addon_K37_18.name: Lapis Lazuli
Addon_K37_18.description:
A stone said to bring luck to its holders, or take it from their enemies.

After Teleporting to a window vault, the Entity blocks that window for Survivors for 8 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Fits onto Vampiric Shift and seals the window vault behind the killer for a short period after teleporting through it. Survivors are blocked from vaulting the same spot while the seal holds, removing their clean escape route.
beginner.whyItMatters: That brief window lock removes the one exit survivors are counting on the moment the killer appears on the other side. A clean vault-out becomes a panicked reroute, and the killer gains the tempo advantage of forcing that detour.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it in lobbies where survivors rely heavily on window vaults as their primary escape tool, since sealing the vault for a few seconds is enough to break their muscle-memory loop. It is a very rare drop, so patience is needed to earn it.

Addon_K37_19.name: Alucard’s Shield
Addon_K37_19.description:
A family heirloom that blocks its bearer’s enemies at every turn.

When the gates are opened, pillars of Hellfire continuously spawn within the exit gates.

beginner.whatItIs: Bolted onto Vampiric Shift, it continuously spawns pillars of Hellfire inside the exit gates the moment they open. The final escape route fills with active danger zones the instant survivors think they are home free.
beginner.whyItMatters: The gate area is where survivors feel safest, and filling that space with Hellfire forces them to hesitate or take a longer path around the pillars. Every second of navigation cost at the gate is a second the killer gets to reposition or chase down a straggler.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Save it for the exit-gate phase, when forcing survivors to weave through active Hellfire pays off the most. Because it comes from the iridescent tier, expect to chase it as a long-term unlock rather than something in reach early.

Addon_K37_20.name: Iridescent Ring of Vlad
Addon_K37_20.description:
A unique relic belonging to Dracula. It is said none can approach The Dark Lord without it.

Hellfire pillars home in on nearby Survivors.

beginner.whatItIs: A Vampiric Shift add-on that makes every Hellfire pillar actively seek out and home in on nearby survivors. Instead of sitting in a fixed spot, the pillars drift toward anyone who gets close.
beginner.whyItMatters: The homing behavior turns static danger zones into moving threats, so survivors cannot simply walk around a pillar the way they would with a stationary one. The pressure to keep moving is constant, and threading gaps becomes a gamble instead of a known route.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it into matches where survivors are used to dodging static hazards, since the homing pillars punish anyone who assumes they can walk a safe line. Its iridescent rarity means landing it takes patience, so treat it as a distant goal rather than a near-term pickup.

Addon_K38_01.name: Young Coconut
Addon_K38_01.description:
Her first meal as a castaway, she shared it with her loyal companion.

Increases the Dog's Chase speed by 5%.

beginner.whatItIs: Goes into Scent of Blood and gives the Dog a noticeable bump in chase speed. It closes the gap on a survivor a little faster than the default pace, tightening the leash on every pursuit.
beginner.whyItMatters: A faster Dog means the killer reaches the end of a chase sooner and can follow up with a hit or a re-grab before the survivor has room to loop out. The overall chase tempo tightens, and pure-speed escapes become less reliable for survivors.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in lobbies where survivors tend to rely on their base sprint speed to shake the Dog, since the extra chase speed narrows that gap. It is a common drop, so it should show up fairly quickly in the unlock rotation.

Addon_K38_02.name: Sticky Pitch
Addon_K38_02.description:
A vital commodity for keeping a ship in tip-top shape.

Increases The Houndmaster's bonus movement speed gained while running on the Search Path by 2%.

beginner.whatItIs: Coats Scent of Blood and boosts the killer's own movement speed while following the Dog's Search Path. The approach to a chase feels snappier, cutting down the dead time between the trail and the killer arriving.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster tracking along the scent path means the killer reaches the survivor's position sooner, which shortens the setup phase. The Dog gets a tighter starting leash for the actual chase because the killer is already close when it latches on.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer wants the Dog to reach its target faster after locking onto a scent trail. Being a common drop, it tends to surface in the unlock pool frequently enough to try in most lobbies.

Addon_K38_03.name: Creature's Bone
Addon_K38_03.description:
It was unlike anything she'd ever seen, and the marrow in its bones was delectable.

The Dog's stun duration is reduced by 50%.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into Scent of Blood and cuts the Dog's stun duration roughly in half. A survivor who lands the stunlock gets a much shorter window before the Dog shakes it off and keeps running.
beginner.whyItMatters: A shorter stun on the Dog means it bounces back from a stunlock faster and re-enters the chase sooner. Survivors lose the long breathing room they were banking on, and the killer gets back into the fight before they fully reset.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if the killer finds the Dog getting stunned too often and losing long stunlock sequences to survivor counter-plays, since a shorter stun means a quicker return to the chase. Its common rarity means it will turn up in the unlock pool with little waiting.

Addon_K38_04.name: Trainer's Book
Addon_K38_04.description:
Some of the advice contained within helped strengthen their bond.

Increases Houndsense duration by 35%.

beginner.whatItIs: Attaches to Scent of Blood and stretches the Houndsense duration, giving the Dog a longer window to track a survivor's trail before the sense fades. The tracking leash extends, so broken or winding paths stay followable for more time.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer Houndsense means the Dog can follow a trail that survivors tried to break with Pallets or long detours, and it simply keeps going. That extra patience on the trail is exactly what separates a successful hunt from a lost one.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when survivors are good at breaking the Dog's trail through clever routing, because a longer Houndsense window lets the killer keep tracking a severed path to its end. Its common rarity means it should show up in the unlock rotation on a regular cadence.

Addon_K38_05.name: Barley Meal
Addon_K38_05.description:
The key ingredient for a bland but reinvigorating porridge.

Increases the Dog's initial Chase distance by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: Widens the Dog's opening chase range in Scent of Blood, letting it snap onto a survivor from further away than the default starting distance. The initial grab radius expands, catching survivors who thought they had already put enough distance between themselves and the Dog.
beginner.whyItMatters: A wider opening leash gives the killer more room to position the Dog before a chase even starts. Survivors who rely on just barely staying outside the initial snap find that narrow margin has closed, and the Dog reaches them sooner.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when survivors keep escaping the initial Dog grab by staying just outside its range, since the extended reach closes that gap. It is an uncommon drop, so it will show up less frequently than common items but still within a reasonable number of sessions.

Addon_K38_06.name: Belaying Pins
Addon_K38_06.description:
Ideal for holding rope, securing knots, and rigging sails.

Survivors revealed by Killer Instinct when entering the Houndsense Radius also become Oblivious for 20 seconds.

Oblivious prevents Survivors from hearing or being affected by the Killer's Terror Radius.

beginner.whatItIs: Fits into Scent of Blood and makes any survivor revealed by Killer Instinct upon entering the Houndsense Radius also become Oblivious. That debuff cuts off their ability to hear the killer's Terror Radius while it lasts.
beginner.whyItMatters: Oblivious removes the early audio warning that Terror Radius normally gives survivors, so they lose the cue that tells them to reroute or brace for a chase. The result is a survivor who walks into danger without the usual heads-up.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in lobbies where survivors use the Terror Radius audio as their primary early-warning tool, since stripping that sense forces them to rely on sight and instinct alone. It is an uncommon drop, so expect a moderate wait in the unlock pool.

Addon_K38_07.name: Smoked Snapper
Addon_K38_07.description:
A protein-packed foodstuff, preserved to ensure its quality over long expeditions.

Power cooldown is reduced by 5%.

beginner.whatItIs: Plugs into Scent of Blood and trims the power cooldown slightly, letting the killer call the Dog back into action a little sooner after each use. The gap between engagements shrinks, keeping the pressure cycle tighter.
beginner.whyItMatters: A faster cooldown means more Dog engagements per trial, which is a small but consistent tempo boost that compounds over a full match of chases and resets. The killer is rarely stuck waiting for the Dog to come back, which keeps survivors off-balance.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the killer feels the wait between Dog deployments is too long to keep pressure on multiple survivors back to back. At an uncommon rarity it will not flood the pool, but a few sessions should be enough to see it appear.

Addon_K38_08.name: Knotted Rope
Addon_K38_08.description:
The dog's jaws tightened around the makeshift toy, and he thrashed it back and forth.

Reduces the cooldown of basic attacks against Survivors injured while in the Dog's Grab by 2%.

beginner.whatItIs: Tucks into Scent of Blood and shaves a small amount off the basic-attack cooldown when the killer is fighting a survivor who was injured inside the Dog's grab. Follow-up swings come faster against that specific target.
beginner.whyItMatters: That extra attack speed against an already-injured survivor means the killer can land follow-up hits faster, turning a single Dog grab into a sustained pressure window. The survivor has less time to break free and loop out, since the next swing is already coming.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the killer's chase flow depends on chaining a Dog grab into a fast follow-up swing, since the trimmed cooldown makes that sequence feel snappier. At an uncommon rarity it will show up at a moderate cadence in the unlock rotation.

Addon_K38_09.name: Spyglass
Addon_K38_09.description:
Used to spot what one is looking for, no matter how far away.

When Houndsense duration ends, the Survivor's aura is revealed for 3 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Flashes the targeted survivor's aura for a brief moment the instant Houndsense ends, tacked onto Scent of Blood as a final tracking aid. It covers the awkward gap where the Dog loses its trail and the killer is left guessing.
beginner.whyItMatters: That split-second reveal at the end of the sense window bridges the blind spot between the Dog losing its trail and the killer lining up the next approach. A moment of information at the worst time for the survivor is all it takes to set up the next chase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the killer keeps losing track of survivors the instant Houndsense expires, since the closing aura flash covers the blind spot that follows. At an uncommon rarity it will drift through the unlock pool at a steady, predictable pace.

Addon_K38_10.name: Waterskin
Addon_K38_10.description:
She gave him the last of her water, knowing he needed the strength to hunt.

Increases the Dog's Chase redirect distance by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: A Scent of Blood add-on that increases the Dog's chase redirect distance, letting it curve back toward a survivor who is trying to loop out. The Dog bends back into the chase after a survivor sprints around a Pallet or corner.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer redirect leash punishes the classic loop-and-vault escape pattern, since the Dog can snap back and re-engage instead of running past. Survivors who rely on tight loops to break the chase find the Dog is still right behind them.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in lobbies where survivors are very good at breaking the Dog's chase with tight loops, since the extended redirect gives the Dog a better chance to snap back. It is a rare drop, so expect a longer wait in the unlock queue.

Addon_K38_11.name: Unfinished Map
Addon_K38_11.description:
Features details on the area that would come to be known as the Bermuda Triangle.

Survivors revealed by Killer Instinct when entering the Houndsense Radius also become Exhausted for 15 seconds.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating certain perks.

beginner.whatItIs: Attaches to Scent of Blood and applies Exhausted to any survivor that Killer Instinct reveals upon entering the Houndsense Radius. While that debuff is active, the survivor cannot trigger certain perks.
beginner.whyItMatters: A perk lock at the worst possible moment can turn a near-escape into a caught survivor, since their key defensive tool is offline exactly when they need it. The combination of the aura reveal and the perk lock creates a window where the survivor is exposed and disarmed.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it against lobbies where the killer has noticed a specific survivor leaning heavily on active perks, since the Exhausted tag at the Houndsense moment strips away that safety net outright. Given its rarity it will not surface often, so it is worth saving for a match where the matchup clearly calls for it.

Addon_K38_12.name: Training Bell
Addon_K38_12.description:
Even over great distances, it will notify a dog exactly where their owner is.

When the Dog is stunned, the responsible Survivor's aura is revealed for 8 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Attaches to Scent of Blood and reveals the aura of whichever survivor stunned the Dog, exposing their position for a short window after the stunlock lands. The very action that freed their teammates now marks them.
beginner.whyItMatters: That reveal creates a clear priority target the instant a stunlock happens, since the killer knows exactly who to chase down. Survivors who stunlock the Dog to save their group now carry a visible tag that the killer can exploit.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it in lobbies where a handful of survivors are the usual stunlock targets, since the aura flash points the killer at exactly who to chase next. Given its rarity it will take a fair number of sessions to unlock.

Addon_K38_13.name: Spiked Collar
Addon_K38_13.description:
A dangerous accessory worn by dogs sent to battle.

Survivors injured while in the Dog's grab suffer from Mangled and Hemorrhage for 60 seconds.

Mangled increases time required to heal by 25% and lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

Hemorrhage regresses healing progress when not healing, and increases blood trails left by injured survivors. This lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

beginner.whatItIs: Fits onto Scent of Blood and applies both Mangled and Hemorrhage to any survivor injured inside the Dog's grab. The double debuff stacks on top of the hit itself, making a single grab far more punishing than a normal one.
beginner.whyItMatters: Mangled slows healing and Hemorrhage bleeds off progress whenever the survivor is not actively patching a wound, so the aftermath of one grab demands far more time and risk. A survivor who would normally heal and move on is now forced to spend a long, vulnerable window just recovering.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the killer wants the Dog's grab to feel like a true catch rather than a brief bump, since the stacked debuffs make the aftermath genuinely dangerous for the survivor's healing plan. Given its rarity it will sit deep in the unlock queue and should not appear often.

Addon_K38_14.name: Fatty Meat
Addon_K38_14.description:
A strange and irresistible treat for a canine friend.

Survivors who are affected by Houndsense periodically scream without notifying The Houndmaster every 15 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: It slots into Scent of Blood and makes any survivor marked with Houndsense let out a periodic scream that The Houndmaster never actually hears. The scream plays out for the survivor side of the match, not as a cue the killer can act on.
beginner.whyItMatters: Because the scream never reaches The Houndmaster, it does not actually hand over any tracking benefit despite sounding like a useful cue. It reads as flavor layered onto Houndsense rather than a real information tool.
beginner.whenToUseIt: It fits a Scent of Blood build where the flavor of a struggling marked survivor matters more than any mechanical edge, since the scream itself gives the killer nothing to act on. It carries a rare drop rate, so it will not show up on every loot board.

Addon_K38_15.name: Leather Harness
Addon_K38_15.description:
Allows greater control over a dog’s every movement.

Increases the Dog's Chase speed by 20% for 30 seconds after a generator is repaired.This bonus becomes permanent once all generators are repaired.

beginner.whatItIs: A leash-style add-on that fits Scent of Blood and boosts the Dog's running speed after a generator repair. The speed bonus lasts for a short window and becomes permanent once every generator on the map is completed.
beginner.whyItMatters: A faster Dog after repairs means chases close quicker in the mid-to-late game, which is when survivors usually start pushing remaining generators. It reads as a bigger shift because it changes the Dog's role from a moderate threat to a serious chase pressure once repairs ramp up.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the Houndmaster's Dog is a core part of the chase plan and the killer wants stronger late-game pressure. It is a very rare add-on, so patience on loot boards is expected before it turns up.

Addon_K38_16.name: Gunpowder Tin
Addon_K38_16.description:
Useful for all manner of explosive schemes.

Whenever at least one Survivor becomes affected by Houndsense, for 20 seconds, you basic-break Pallets or Breakable walls, and damage Generators 30% faster.

beginner.whatItIs: An explosive-themed add-on for Scent of Blood that grants a temporary burst of faster pallet-breaking, breakable-wall damage, and generator damage. The window activates the moment a survivor picks up Houndsense.
beginner.whyItMatters: The short burst of efficiency lets the killer make meaningful progress on the map right after marking a survivor, which is a moment when the survivor is likely to run. It reads as a small but useful tempo tool that rewards keeping Houndsense active.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer wants map-control momentum tied to marking survivors rather than pure chase speed. It is a very rare drop, so it will take some time to appear on a loot board.

Addon_K38_17.name: Marlinspike
Addon_K38_17.description:
As good for unsplicing rope as it is for causing grievous bodily harm.

Survivors within 20 meters of a Survivor who is Grabbed by the Dog become afflicted with Houndsense.

beginner.whatItIs: Fits the Scent of Blood power and spreads Houndsense to nearby survivors when the Dog grabs one of them. Any survivor standing close to the grabbed target also picks up the Houndsense mark.
beginner.whyItMatters: The splash-marking turns a single Dog grab into a zone control moment, because it can mark multiple survivors at once and give the killer more tracking signals. It reads as a bigger shift since it changes the Dog from a single-target tool into a small area denial effect.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip Marlinspike when the killer wants grabs to ripple outward and pressure nearby survivors beyond the immediate target, particularly in enclosed spaces where multiple survivors are close together. Since it is very rare on loot boards, budget time to collect it before relying on the wider awareness it provides.

Addon_K38_18.name: Ship Figurehead
Addon_K38_18.description:
A trophy torn from the bow of another ship.

While the Dog is following The Houndmaster, Terror Radius is increased by 8 meters.While the Dog is away from The Houndmaster, Terror Radius is reduced by 8 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: A nautical add-on that changes the Houndmaster's Terror Radius depending on where the Dog is positioned. The radius grows when the Dog is close and shrinks when the Dog is sent out to track or chase.
beginner.whyItMatters: The dynamic radius means the killer trades detection range for Dog freedom, which creates a real decision point every time the Dog is dispatched. It reads as a bigger strategic shift because it forces a constant awareness trade-off rather than just boosting one stat.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip Ship Figurehead when the killer is comfortable with a Terror Radius that shifts depending on whether the Dog is attached or off on its own, since the expanded detection while tethered rewards keeping the Dog close during pushes. The very rare drop rate means patience is needed on the loot boards before it lands.

Addon_K38_19.name: Torn Novel
Addon_K38_19.description:
A book given to her by her father. All but destroyed after a raid.

While aiming the Chase Redirect, auras of Survivors within 10 meters of the Dog are revealed.Upon reassuming control of The Houndmaster, Survivors' auras revealed this way are shown for an additional 2 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Goes into Scent of Blood and reveals the auras of survivors near the Dog while aiming the Chase Redirect. Those revealed auras linger for a brief moment after control returns to The Houndmaster.
beginner.whyItMatters: The short aura window gives the killer a split-second snapshot of where nearby survivors are, which can confirm a chase direction or expose a survivor who thinks they are hidden. It reads as a small information tool that rewards precise timing on the redirect.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the killer wants to confirm survivor positions before committing the Chase Redirect, especially in fog or building interiors. It is an iridescent add-on, making it one of the harder drops to find.

Addon_K38_20.name: Iridescent Wheel Handle
Addon_K38_20.description:
Once used to guide a great vessel across the open seas, its remnants now serve as a memory of times past.

Increases the time the Dog lingers at a Search destination by 20%.While the Dog is running to and from the Search destination, The Houndmaster gains the Undetectable status effect.Standing on the Search Path removes the Undetectable status effect.


Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

beginner.whatItIs: An iridescent add-on for Scent of Blood that keeps the Dog waiting longer once it reaches a Search destination. While the Dog travels out and back, The Houndmaster goes Undetectable, losing the aura, Terror Radius and Red Stain. Stepping onto the Search Path ends that cover immediately.
beginner.whyItMatters: The stealth window that opens while the Dog is en route to a Search destination lets The Houndmaster reposition without survivors noticing the move. Standing on the Search Path strips that concealment, so the benefit only lasts for the travel portion. That turns Scent of Blood from a straight tracking power into one that also offers brief invisibility, which is a meaningful shift in how the power plays out over a full chase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer wants a stealth repositioning tool built into the Dog's search loop, especially on open maps where line of sight is a constant threat. It is an iridescent add-on, so it will be a long haul to pull from loot boards.

Addon_K39_01.name: Kaneki’s Wallet
Addon_K39_01.description:
Lost to a strange boy who happened to bump into him on the street.

Increases the window to perform consecutive Kagune Leaps by 3 second.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into One-Eyed Terror and widens the time window for chaining consecutive Kagune Leaps. A slightly larger window means there is more margin between each leap in a combo string.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra margin makes multi-leap combos less punishing to land, which matters in close-quarters chases where timing is tight. It reads as a small but tangible ease-of-use tweak that smooths out the leap chain.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when learning the Kagune Leap combo or when the killer wants a more forgiving window for chaining leaps in tight corridors. It is a common add-on, so it should show up on loot boards fairly often.

Addon_K39_02.name: The Black Goat’s Egg
Addon_K39_02.description:
The book he used to bond with a woman of consequence.

Perfectly timed grab-attacks grant a 100% Bloodpoints bonus.

beginner.whatItIs: A memento add-on for One-Eyed Terror that grants a full Bloodpoints bonus whenever a grab-attack lands with perfect timing. It rewards clean, well-read grabs rather than sloppy ones.
beginner.whyItMatters: The bonus accelerates Bloodpoint income, which speeds up perk progression and makes the trial feel more rewarding when the killer is reading survivors well. It reads as a small efficiency boost that compounds over a full match.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer is confident in grab timing and wants extra Bloodpoints to fuel perk charges. It is a common drop, so it is easy to find on most loot boards.

Addon_K39_03.name: Anteiku Apron
Addon_K39_03.description:
Standard-issue uniform at a lovely little coffee shop.

Decrease the slide after a Kagune Leap by 50%.

beginner.whatItIs: Reduces the slide after a Kagune Leap by a significant amount. The killer retains more positional control after each leap, making repositioning cleaner.
beginner.whyItMatters: Less slide means the killer can leap into a tighter spot and stay there, which is useful for corner control and preventing survivors from looping away. It reads as a small but useful precision tweak for anyone who leans on Kagune Leaps in chases.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip Anteiku Apron when post-leap slide keeps pushing The Ghoul into unfavorable spots, such as corners or behind obstacles inside buildings. Being a common drop means it should surface on loot boards without much waiting, making it an easy quality-of-life upgrade to lock in.

Addon_K39_04.name: Fresh Coffee
Addon_K39_04.description:
Every ghoul's favorite drink, the one human delicacy they can consume.

Increases Kagune Leap speed by 14%.

beginner.whatItIs: Speeds up the Kagune Leap travel, letting the Ghoul cross gaps a bit faster than the base speed. The whole leap arc is slightly quicker from start to finish.
beginner.whyItMatters: A faster leap means the killer can reposition over survivors more quickly, which shortens the window where a survivor can react and loop away. It reads as a small but consistent chase-speed improvement that feels noticeable in back-and-forth chases.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip Fresh Coffee when faster leaps are the priority for closing distance or escaping tight corners, particularly in trials where The Ghoul repositions often. The very rare drop rate means it will not show up frequently, so it is worth saving for a dedicated chase build rather than a casual pick.

Addon_K39_05.name: Broken Chain
Addon_K39_05.description:
Nothing could restrain him once he finally embraced his full potential.

Decreases Kagune Leap cooldown by 35% when not Enraged.

beginner.whatItIs: Cuts the Kagune Leap cooldown while The Ghoul is not in Enraged Mode. The shorter cooldown means more leap opportunities in a calm, tracking-focused phase of the trial.
beginner.whyItMatters: More leap availability outside of Enraged Mode gives the killer a reliable mobility option during the early and mid game, when Enraged is not yet active. It reads as a solid utility tweak that makes the Ghoul feel more mobile without Enraged.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the killer wants a dependable mobility tool before Enraged Mode kicks in, especially in long tracking stretches between generator completions. It is an uncommon drop, so it shows up on loot boards more often than rare or iridescent options.

Addon_K39_06.name: Kaneki's Satchel
Addon_K39_06.description:
Essential gear for any student trying to keep up with their studies.

Increases the speed of the third consecutive Kagune Leap by 30%.

beginner.whatItIs: Fits One-Eyed Terror and boosts the speed of the third leap in a consecutive chain. The final leap in a combo string travels noticeably faster than the first two.
beginner.whyItMatters: A fast third leap makes the full combo feel more rewarding and gives the killer a strong finisher to cross a gap or land behind a survivor. It reads as a small but satisfying chain-completion bonus.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer regularly strings multiple Kagune Leaps and wants the combo to end with a fast, decisive reposition. It is an uncommon drop, so it is reasonably available on loot boards.

Addon_K39_07.name: Hide’s Headphones
Addon_K39_07.description:
They belonged to his best friend, who he tried to keep safe at all costs.

Survivors affected by Kagune Mark are afflicted with the Oblivious status effect.

Oblivious prevents Survivors from hearing and being affected by the Killer's Terror Radius.

beginner.whatItIs: Makes Kagune Mark carry the Oblivious status effect, which prevents marked survivors from hearing or being affected by the Ghoul's Terror Radius. The mark now doubles as a stealth tool for the killer.
beginner.whyItMatters: Stripping Terror Radius from a marked survivor removes the constant audio and visual warning that keeps them alert, letting The Ghoul close in with far less resistance. That is a substantial change to the marked survivor's experience because their primary proximity cue disappears for the entire duration of the mark.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the killer wants to close distance on a marked survivor without the usual Terror Radius warning giving them away. It is an uncommon drop, so it should appear on loot boards with moderate frequency.

Addon_K39_08.name: Taiyaki
Addon_K39_08.description:
Ghouls can never eat human food, but they can find ways to pretend.

Increases the Enraged Mode countdown by 5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Extends the Enraged Mode countdown by a small amount, giving The Ghoul more time in the empowered state before it wears off. The longer window means more opportunities to land grabs or reposition while Enraged.
beginner.whyItMatters: Extra Enraged time translates directly into more chase pressure and grab chances, which is meaningful in trials where the killer needs to secure downed survivors before the state expires. It reads as a small but reliable tempo extension.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip Taiyaki when every extra second of Enraged Mode counts, such as in extended chases or when The Ghoul needs the empowered window to stretch through multiple actions. As a common drop it is straightforward to find on loot boards, so it can slot into most chase-oriented builds without much effort.

Addon_K39_09.name: Blood-Stained Handkerchief
Addon_K39_09.description:
Even a single drop of blood can excite the senses of any gourmet.

Increases the Kagune's reach by 1 meter.

beginner.whatItIs: Lengthens the Kagune's reach by a small margin, extending how far the Ghoul can grab or leap toward a target. The extra distance closes the gap slightly on close-range interactions.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer reach means the Ghoul can grab survivors who are a touch farther away, which can turn a missed grab into a landed one in tight chases. It reads as a small but tangible range bump that matters most in close-quarters play.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip Blood-Stained Handkerchief when grab distance is the limiting factor, particularly in tight interiors where The Ghoul needs that extra reach to connect on a passing survivor. The uncommon drop rate means it appears on boards with reasonable frequency, making it a practical pick for spacing-sensitive play.

Addon_K39_10.name: Mado’s Glove
Addon_K39_10.description:
A glove worn by a ghoul investigator.

Upon removing Kagune Mark, Survivors suffer from the Exhausted status effect for 15 seconds.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating exhausting perks.

beginner.whatItIs: Adds an Exhausted penalty to survivors when Kagune Mark is removed. Exhausted prevents them from activating exhausting perks during the duration, limiting their escape tools.
beginner.whyItMatters: Denying burst-movement perks the instant the mark drops closes off the exact escape tools a survivor would reach for, turning the mark's expiration into a vulnerability rather than a relief. This is a substantial shift because it removes an entire category of survivability options instead of adjusting a single stat.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip Mado's Glove against survivors who lean heavily on dash or speed-based perks to break free from chases, since the Exhausted window at mark removal neutralizes their primary escape. Being a rare drop, it will not surface on every board, so plan ahead and secure it before a dedicated anti-escape run.

Addon_K39_11.name: Hinami’s Umbrella
Addon_K39_11.description:
It was raining the day her mother was viciously taken from her.

Increases the amount of time added to the Enraged countdown for each perfectly timed grab-attack by 10 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: An umbrella add-on for One-Eyed Terror that extends the Enraged countdown by a larger amount for each perfectly timed grab. Each clean grab buys more empowered time on top of the base extension.
beginner.whyItMatters: Each perfectly timed grab stacks additional Enraged duration, so a skilled killer can keep the empowered state alive through most of a trial rather than losing it between engagements. That kind of scaling reward makes execution quality directly translate into sustained pressure, which is a meaningful departure from a flat-timer power.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip Hinami's Umbrella when grab timing is reliable and the goal is to chain Enraged windows across multiple chases without long cooldown gaps. The uncommon drop rate means it will appear on boards with moderate frequency, making it a reasonable choice for a dedicated Enraged-focused build.

Addon_K39_12.name: Rize's Glasses
Addon_K39_12.description:
They made her look innocent enough, which was exactly what she wanted.

Upon entering Enraged Mode, reveals the auras of any healthy Survivors repairing generators for 8 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Reveals the auras of healthy survivors who are repairing generators the moment The Ghoul enters Enraged Mode. The reveal window gives the killer a clear picture of who is working and where.
beginner.whyItMatters: The targeted reveal lets the killer pick a specific generator to rush or a specific survivor to chase the instant Enraged activates, which is a strong information edge at the start of the empowered state. It reads as a solid information tool that pairs well with aggressive Enraged play.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip Rize's Glasses when spotting a repairing survivor at the start of Enraged Mode is the priority, especially on maps where generators are spread far apart. The rare drop rate means it will not appear on every board, so slot it into a dedicated generator-hunt run rather than a casual pick.

Addon_K39_13.name: Aogiri Tree Robe
Addon_K39_13.description:
Garments worn by an anti-human ghoul organization.

If a generator is completed while The Ghoul is in Enraged Mode, gain the Undetectable status effect for 20 seconds.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

beginner.whatItIs: It slots into One-Eyed Terror and grants The Ghoul a brief Undetectable window the moment a generator is finished while in Enraged Mode. During that window the aura, red stain, and terror radius all vanish from survivor screens. It is a small but well-timed concealment burst that fires only when the Ghoul has already been pressing hard.
beginner.whyItMatters: Vanishing the moment a generator completes gives The Ghoul a clean escape route at the exact point where survivors expect to press the advantage. This is a substantial tactical change for a killer who normally has very little cover, since it creates a brief pocket of true invisibility in the mid-to-late game.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip Aogiri Tree Robe on maps where open sightlines make the killer vulnerable the instant a generator finishes, since the stealth window lets The Ghoul slip away and reset the chase. As a rare drop it takes patience to find, so pair it with a plan to be in Enraged Mode at the moment of completion.

Addon_K39_14.name: Amon’s Necktie
Addon_K39_14.description:
Cold, calculated, precise. He had a firm grasp of every situation.

While aiming mid-Leap, reveals the auras of pallets and windows within 32 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: A rare slot-in for One-Eyed Terror that exposes nearby pallet and window auras while the killer is mid-leap and aiming. It turns the leap animation into a scouting window over the immediate surroundings.
beginner.whyItMatters: Seeing where escape routes sit before the leap lands lets a killer commit to a landing spot with intent rather than guessing. It turns the leap from a reach tool into a targeted punish that lines up with the exact break a survivor was trying to take.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a chase tightens around a corridor and the survivor is clearly lining up a pallet or window line. The rarity is rare, so save it for chases where breaking a specific escape object is the whole goal.

Addon_K39_15.name: Red Spider Lily
Addon_K39_15.description:
The white flowers turned red as blood.

While in Enraged Mode, base attacks afflict Survivors with the Hemorrhage status effect for 60 seconds.

Hemorrhage regresses healing progress when not healing, and increases blood trails left by injured Survivors. This lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

beginner.whatItIs: Every standard swing inflicts Hemorrhage on the survivor it hits while Enraged Mode is running. A rare One-Eyed Terror slot-in, it layers a bleeding penalty onto basic attacks.
beginner.whyItMatters: Hemorrhage bleeds healing progress and thickens blood trails, so every swing during the enrage becomes a tool for keeping survivors pinned and easy to track after a hook. It reads as a bigger shift toward hook-and-chase pressure rather than a small speed tweak.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when enrage should reward aggressive swinging rather than just extra damage. Lean on it in trials where the plan already commits to hooks early and chases run long.

Addon_K39_16.name: CCG ID Card
Addon_K39_16.description:
A card carried by every ghoul investigator.

Whenever you special-vault with Kagune Leap, for 3 seconds, you see the auras of all Kagune Marked Survivors within 24 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: A very rare One-Eyed Terror slot-in that flashes the auras of every Kagune Marked survivor for a short window right after a Kagune Leap vault. Committing to the leap pays back with a quick look at marked targets around the landing zone.
beginner.whyItMatters: That instant read of every marked survivor at once lets the killer commit to the next target without scanning the fog. It is a meaningful shift in how the marks feel to manage across a wide map.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the fight is spread out with several survivors marked at the same time and the next target needs locking in after a leap. The rarity is very rare, so treat it as a premium slot for information.

Addon_K39_17.name: Red-Headed Centipede
Addon_K39_17.description:
The thing caused him immeasurable torment.

While in Enraged Mode, whenever you vault a Window, it is blocked for 10 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Slotting into One-Eyed Terror, it seals each window the killer passes through during Enraged Mode, blocking survivors who chase from following the same path. The effect turns the killer's own escape route into a short-lived wall behind them.
beginner.whyItMatters: Closing the exact window a survivor just escaped through removes a favorite break on the spot and forces a new route. It is a solid map-control tool that punishes survivors for leaning on that vault.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a chase runs along window-heavy sections and survivors rely on vaults to lose the killer. It is very rare, so keep it in reserve for those tight window chases.

Addon_K39_18.name: Torture Apparatus
Addon_K39_18.description:
A cutting tool used every time his extremities grew back.

When Enraged Mode ends, The Ghoul gains 5% Haste for 6 seconds.

Haste increases Killer movement speed.

beginner.whatItIs: Fitting into One-Eyed Terror, it grants a spike of speed the moment Enraged Mode expires, carrying the killer forward at a quickened pace. The boost is short, so it sharpens the very next pursuit rather than extending it indefinitely.
beginner.whyItMatters: A short speed kick right as the enrage fades lets the killer stay in the fight instead of losing momentum as the state drops. It smooths out the rhythm of the power and keeps pressure on through the transition.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when enrage usually lands close to the end of a chase and the killer wants to keep the push after the state ends. The rarity is very rare, so save it for chases already near a hook.

Addon_K39_19.name: Yamori’s Mask
Addon_K39_19.description:
Worn by a ghoul from the 13th district whose hobby was torture.

Upon hooking a Survivor while in Enraged Mode, all Survivors further than 40 meters scream and reveal their location for 3 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Landing a hook during Enraged Mode triggers a scream from every survivor far enough away, briefly exposing their position to the killer. An iridescent One-Eyed Terror slot-in, it converts a single hook kill into a short map-wide ping of distant targets.
beginner.whyItMatters: Pinning far-off survivors at the exact instant a hook lands turns each enrage hook into a map-wide read on hidden survivors. It is a big shift toward hook-and-stalk play rather than a chase tweak.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the killer wants enrage hooks to double as information tools against survivors hiding near generators. It is iridescent, so it is a premium pick that also changes how the trial reads.

Addon_K39_20.name: Iridescent Eye Patch
Addon_K39_20.description:
An innocent way to hide his true nature from the world.

While in Enraged Mode, whenever you special-vault a Pallet on your third consecutive Kagune Leap, it special-breaks.

beginner.whatItIs: Slotting into One-Eyed Terror, the third consecutive Kagune Leap while Enraged Mode holds gains enough force to shatter a pallet on contact. The combo reward pushes aerial pressure further by removing the cover that would normally stop the chain.
beginner.whyItMatters: Breaking a pallet on a set cadence rewards the rhythm the power already encourages and turns it into a concrete wall-breaking reward. It is a bigger commitment to the leap string than a simple damage bump.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer already strings multiple leaps in a row and wants the third one to tear through a pallet. It is iridescent, so it suits a committed leap style.

Addon_K40_01.name: Help Wanted Ad
Addon_K40_01.description:
We all need a little help sometimes...

While winding up an axe throw, see a preview of the starting trajectory.

beginner.whatItIs: While the wind-up for an axe throw plays out, a trajectory line appears to show where the blade will start its arc. A common Fazbear's Fright slot-in, it removes guesswork from the throw animation by previewing the initial path.
beginner.whyItMatters: A visible line before release makes aiming the axe far more consistent, especially across awkward angles and long throws. It is a quality-of-life shift that turns a guess into a guided line.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when learning the axe or when the map throws in tight angles that make blind throws unreliable. It is common, so it is a low-risk pick for new trials.

Addon_K40_02.name: Security Guard’s Badge
Addon_K40_02.description:
The badge comes with certain privileges for whoever carries it.

When exiting a Security Door after a teleport, gain the Undetectable status effect for 25% longer.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

beginner.whatItIs: Stepping out of a Security Door after a teleport stretches the Undetectable duration by a noticeable margin. An uncommon Fazbear's Fright slot-in, it gives the killer a longer breath of invisibility to reposition before the next contact.
beginner.whyItMatters: Hiding aura, terror radius, and red stain for a longer stretch after a teleport gives the killer room to reposition without being read. It is a meaningful boost to the teleport-and-hide loop.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the killer leans on teleporting through Security Doors and wants more time to vanish after each exit. It is uncommon, so it is a fine mid-rarity pick for that style.

Addon_K40_03.name: Restaurant Menu
Addon_K40_03.description:
The lamination is peeling and crusty. How appetizing.

Decreases the minimum time required to retrieve an axe embedded in the environment by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: The minimum wait before a stuck axe can be picked back up gets shorter for the killer carrying it. A common Fazbear's Fright slot-in, it smooths out the downtime between throws by shaving the recovery window.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster axe recovery keeps the killer in the fight with a usable weapon and less downtime between chases. It is a small but reliable tempo boost for the whole trial.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer wants to stay mobile and re-throw quickly after every hook or miss. It is common, so it is a safe fit for most Fazbear's Fright builds.

Addon_K40_04.name: Rotten Pizza
Addon_K40_04.description:
Food poisoning is no laughing matter.

Increases the duration of Killer Instinct from the Axe's area of effect by 100%.

beginner.whatItIs: The Killer Instinct effect that radiates from a thrown axe's landing zone lingers noticeably longer. A common Fazbear's Fright slot-in, it widens the pressure window around where the blade embeds, giving the killer more time to close in.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer instinct window gives survivors more time to be caught and tracked by the aura, which amplifies the fear of an embedded axe. It reads as a bigger change to how the axe's zone pressures a chase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the killer wants the zone of an embedded axe to loom over survivors for a longer stretch. It is common, so it is an easy pick to test in most trials.

Addon_K40_05.name: Ripped Curtain
Addon_K40_05.description:
Taken from Pirates Cove, caught on the animatronic that lived there.

When an Axe hits a Survivor, they gain the Hemorrhage and Mangled status effects for 60 seconds.

Hemorrhage regresses healing progress when not healing, and increases blood trails left by injured Survivors. This lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

Mangled increases time required to heal by 25% and lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.
