beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer wants to control generator space without actively chasing, since the threat of an explosion discourages survivors from clustering around repair points. It is very rare, so it suits a build that is already centered on Omnipresent Evil.

Addon_K43_19.name: Dirty Money
Addon_K43_19.description:
No amount of money can save you from him.

Gain 2 Tokens whenever a Generator is completed.

If you are not holding a Spike when vaulting a Window or breaking a Pallet or Breakable Wall, immediately spend a Token and gain a Spike.

beginner.whatItIs: Dirty Money feeds the token economy under Omnipresent Evil by awarding tokens each time a generator finishes. When the killer vaults a window or smashes a pallet or breakable wall without a spike in hand, a token is spent instantly to conjure one.
beginner.whyItMatters: Guaranteeing a Spike at the exact moment of a vault or break transforms those interactions into reliable attack opportunities, removing the downtime of having no spike ready. It is a bigger shift because it makes the power's core tool always accessible during key moments.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if consistent access to the Spike during chases and vaults is the priority, since it removes the gaps where no spike is available. It sits at the iridescent tier, so expect a long wait before it appears in a rotation.

Addon_K43_20.name: Iridescent Boat Motor
Addon_K43_20.description:
The blades are chipped and cracked, as if having cut through something solid.

Passing through Windows while in Omnipresent Evil mode marks them for 13 seconds. When you perform a Jump Scare, all marked Windows become blocked for 13 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Iridescent Boat Motor tags each window the killer walks through while in Omnipresent Evil mode. The instant a jump scare connects, every marked window seals shut and blocks survivor movement for a short stretch.
beginner.whyItMatters: Blocking windows at the moment of a scare removes the primary escape route survivors use to break line of sight, making the scare far more punishing. It is a bigger shift in how the end-of-chase moment plays, since survivors lose their usual bailout.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in situations where shutting down window vaults as an escape tool is the goal, since it rewards setting up the kill through movement first. It is iridescent tier, so budget plenty of trials before it drops.

Addon_K44_01.name: Koenrad's Gauntlet
Addon_K44_01.description:
“When darkness threatened to swallow his flock, he led them towards the light.” (Witness to Koenrad, ch. 1)

Increases the max time that could be spent controlling Divine Light before it's Cast by 25%.

Decreases the max speed of controlled Divine Light by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Koenrad's Gauntlet extends the duration the killer can steer Divine Light under Will of the Gods before it must be released. In exchange, the controlled light travels a bit slower while in the killer's hands.
beginner.whyItMatters: More control time means more room to reposition the light and choose a better angle before committing to a cast, which rewards patience over reflex. The speed trade-off is a small concession that keeps the add-on balanced without undermining the extra control window.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when casts feel rushed and the killer struggles to land them at the right moment, since the extra time allows positioning adjustments without pressure. It is a common-tier add-on, so it will appear frequently enough to test in any rotation.

Addon_K44_02.name: Heretic's Mark
Addon_K44_02.description:
“Those who stray from the path shall never escape ostracization once they receive the mark.” (III On Heresy, ch. 3)

When Cast Divine Light passes a Survivor within 1 meter without hitting them, reveal them with Killer Instinct for 2 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Under Will of the Gods, Heretic's Mark flashes Killer Instinct on any survivor that a cast of Divine Light passes close to without striking them. A near-miss no longer goes entirely unrewarded, since the brief mark gives the killer a moment of positional awareness.
beginner.whyItMatters: A graze that misses by a hair still feeds the killer a moment of insight, turning sloppy casts into useful information rather than pure waste. The shift is subtle, adding a thin layer of reward around precision without reshaping how Divine Light deals damage.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if casts often clip but do not connect, since it turns those near-misses into positioning information. It is common tier, so it is easy to find and pair with other Will of the Gods add-ons.

Addon_K44_03.name: Holy Winged Icon
Addon_K44_03.description:
“Clutch it to your chest and pray, lest your heart appear untrue to It.” (II On Heresy, ch. 14)

While controlling Divine Light, gain the ability to press the Killer Ability button to Cast it back towards yourself.

When Cast in this way,The minimum delay before it is lethal is set to 0.4 seconds.Increase its max speed by 10%.It only damages Heretics.

beginner.whatItIs: Holy Winged Icon adds a self-directed cast to Will of the Gods, letting the killer yank controlled Divine Light back toward their own position. That return cast strikes Heretics with minimal delay and extra speed, but deals no harm to anyone else.
beginner.whyItMatters: A self-directed cast is a completely new interaction that lets the killer punish heretics at close range, adding a defensive and aggressive tool the base power does not have. It is a bigger shift because it creates a new button press with a distinct tactical purpose.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a survivor marked as a Heretic is in close range and a quick, high-speed punishment tool is needed, since it cannot hurt non-heretic survivors. It is rare tier, so it fits best in a focused Heresy build.

Addon_K44_04.name: Prayer Kneeler
Addon_K44_04.description:
“Suffer the pain of prayer, for the suffering of unbelievers is far worse.” (II On Heresy, ch. 8)

While controlling Divine Light that is slowed down by a tall obstruction, further decreases its max speed by 99%.

beginner.whatItIs: Prayer Kneeler brings controlled Divine Light to a crawl whenever it is already slowed by a tall obstruction under Will of the Gods. The near-standstill gives the killer a long window to reposition and line up a precise cast in cluttered rooms.
beginner.whyItMatters: A light that barely moves behind cover gives survivors far more time to dodge or loop away, which changes the feel of control through obstacles without altering open-field behavior. It is a small shift that makes the control phase more deliberate and easier to read.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when slower, more precise control of Divine Light in cluttered areas is the priority, since the near-stop allows extra time to adjust positioning. It is common tier and appears often enough to be a reliable part of a control-focused build.

Addon_K44_05.name: Electric Torch
Addon_K44_05.description:
“The faithful shall go out in great numbers at night, searching for the heretics who hide in the dark.” (Witness to Koenrad, ch. 40)

Increases the max speed of controlled Divine Light by 25%.

You move 10% faster while controlling Divine Light.

beginner.whatItIs: Electric Torch pushes the controlled Divine Light to a noticeably higher top speed under Will of the Gods. The killer also moves a bit faster while steering it, making the control phase feel quicker and more agile.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster light and faster movement together make the control phase more aggressive, since the killer can close distance and reposition while keeping the light threatening. It is a moderate shift that speeds up the overall tempo of the power without changing its mechanics.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when closing gaps quickly during control mode is the goal, since the speed boost helps catch survivors who are trying to keep distance. It is rare tier, so it suits a build that prioritizes chase pressure over slow control.

Addon_K44_06.name: Undying Flame
Addon_K44_06.description:
“The village of Dend was repentant in its last moments, but its remnants still burn to this day as a warning.” (II Barbarians, ch. 4)

While Zealous,Increases the maximum lifetime of the Cast Divine Light by 200%.Decreases the radius of Divine Light by 20%.The range that Survivors can observe Divine Light's Aura is extended by 200%.

beginner.whatItIs: Undying Flame slots into Will of the Gods and changes how Divine Light behaves while Zealous. It stretches the lifetime of a cast beam far beyond its usual span while trimming the radius slightly, and survivors can see the aura from much farther away.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer-lived light with a visible long-range aura creates a persistent threat zone that survivors must route around, changing how they plan their paths across the map. It is a bigger shift because it turns a short-lived cast into a lasting map hazard, even at the cost of a smaller hitbox.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when cast Divine Light should persist as a territorial tool rather than a quick burst, since the extended lifetime rewards placing it in high-traffic areas. It is uncommon tier, so it is reasonably common in unlock rotations.

Addon_K44_07.name: Aurora's Telereceptor
Addon_K44_07.description:
“None should stare into the abyss with the wretched devices made by the heretics.” (III On Heresy, ch. 12)

Whenever a Survivor gains Heresy, for 4 seconds,Their Aura is revealed to you.Your Aura is revealed to them.

Whenever a Heretic sees your aura for a duration, they see it for 2 seconds longer.

beginner.whatItIs: Aurora's Telereceptor attaches to Will of the Gods and creates a brief mutual aura reveal whenever a survivor picks up the Heresy mark. Both sides see each other's position for a short window, and a Heretic keeps the killer's aura in view a little longer than usual.
beginner.whyItMatters: The two-way reveal turns every Heresy application into a moment of mutual risk, because the survivor can also spot the killer and adjust their path. It reads as a meaningful shift in how information flows, rewarding a killer who can punish the brief opening without overcommitting.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when punishing survivors who gain Heresy by briefly seeing their position is the goal, since the killer-side reveal is the primary benefit. It is uncommon tier and pairs well with add-ons that apply Heresy frequently.

Addon_K44_08.name: Magnetized Manacles
Addon_K44_08.description:
“Those who do not go into hiding will be locked deep underground, far from the guiding light of the stars.” (Visions of Gerhardt, ch. 6)

Whenever you Exile a survivor with the lowest amount of Hook States, gain a Token, up to a max of 5.

Whenever you become Zealous, you become Zealous for 10% longer per Token.

beginner.whatItIs: It slots into Will of the Gods and banks a charge every time an exile finishes off whichever survivor in the match currently has the fewest hook states. Those banked charges then stretch out the Zealous window a little more each time it triggers, so spreading exiles toward less-hooked survivors builds toward a longer Zealous state over the course of a match.
beginner.whyItMatters: Spreading exiles toward whichever survivor has been hooked the least turns that early spread of pressure into a noticeably longer Zealous state later on. It nudges the power toward rewarding a killer who avoids leaning on the same already-hooked survivor again and again, since doing so stops earning new charges.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when Zealous should last longer in endgame scrum, since the Token bank converts early hooks into late-game pressure. It is uncommon tier, so it appears often enough to build around.

Addon_K44_09.name: Order of Inquisition
Addon_K44_09.description:
“All those who believe in Its glory are deputized to search for heretics. Trust not even your own neighbor.” (Witness to Koenrad, ch. 16)

Whenever Divine Light is Cast, its radius starts 25% smaller, but grows until it is 50% larger over 1 second.

beginner.whatItIs: Order of Inquisition modifies Will of the Gods so that a cast Divine Light begins at a reduced radius and then swells outward to a size larger than the standard version. The brief expansion window gives the beam a pulsing, expanding feel rather than a fixed circle.
beginner.whyItMatters: The expanding radius catches survivors who would normally be just outside the initial hitbox, rewarding casts aimed slightly wide and adding a growth phase that is harder to dodge. It is a moderate shift that changes the timing of when the light deals damage.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when casts tend to land just outside the hitbox, since the expansion gives extra reach at the end of the cast. It is rare tier, so it fits builds that already rely on precise Divine Light placement.

Addon_K44_10.name: Blindfold of the Devoted
Addon_K44_10.description:
“Those who follow Gerhardt's path shall wear blindfolds, to remember the sacrifice he made for his prophecy.” (III On Heresy, ch. 61)

Whenever you Exile a Survivor with the lowest amount of Hook States, reveal the Auras of all other Survivors with the lowest amount of Hook States outside 32 meters for 5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Slotting into Will of the Gods, it triggers a group aura reveal the instant a survivor with the fewest hook states gets exiled. Every other survivor sharing that same low hook count is exposed to the killer for a short window, but only if they are standing far enough away.
beginner.whyItMatters: A single exile now exposes every other survivor who has also managed to stay off the hook so far, stripping away the safety that untouched survivors normally count on when they scatter across the map. It turns the exile moment into a sweeping information play that punishes a team for letting several members go untouched instead of sharing hook pressure evenly.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when several survivors in the match still have low hook counts, since the group reveal punishes a team that lets multiple members stay fresh instead of spreading hook pressure around. It sits at a rarer drop rate, so plan a build around it rather than expecting it to surface mid-match.

Addon_K44_11.name: Superheated Glass
Addon_K44_11.description:
“The planet of Aleide was unrepentant; after their leader was Exiled, Its Divine Light turned the surface to glass.” (II Barbarians, ch. 12)

You are Zealous for 20% shorter.

While you are Zealous, a Cast Divine Light breaks all Breakable Walls and Dropped Pallets it passes through.

Whenever you break an object this way, survivors within 12 meters of it gain Heresy and scream.

beginner.whatItIs: Superheated Glass attaches to Will of the Gods and shortens the Zealous window slightly in exchange for a much more aggressive Divine Light. While Zealous, the beam shatters breakable walls and dropped pallets in its path, and each broken object marks nearby survivors as Heretics with a scream.
beginner.whyItMatters: Breaking cover objects while applying Heresy and a scream turns the light into a map-altering tool that destroys the obstacles survivors hide behind. It is a bigger shift because it changes the physical map during Zealous and applies Heresy as a side effect.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when clearing line-of-sight obstacles and applying Heresy in one action is the goal, since it rewards casting through cluttered areas. It is rare tier, so it pairs well with add-ons that extend or enhance the Zealous state.

Addon_K44_12.name: Mark of the Adherent
Addon_K44_12.description:
“Wear your faith proudly and permanently. Let it be a reminder to others that It is always present.” (II On Heresy, ch. 1)

While not Zealous, increases the radius of Divine Light by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Mark of the Adherent slots into Will of the Gods and widens the radius of Divine Light whenever the killer is outside the Zealous state. It is a quiet baseline improvement that makes every non-Zealous cast cover a slightly broader area than the default.
beginner.whyItMatters: A larger hitbox during normal play makes casts more forgiving and easier to land on moving survivors, reducing the precision required for a clean hit. It is a small tweak that improves consistency without adding new mechanics.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when Divine Light casts feel too small to land reliably, since the extra radius absorbs small positioning errors. It is uncommon tier, making it a practical choice for a straightforward damage build.

Addon_K44_13.name: Confessor's War Horn
Addon_K44_13.description:
“The sound of the horn shall strike fear into the hearts of unbelievers and muster the will of the faithful.” (Witness to Koenrad, ch. 33)

Survivors gaining Heresy additionally gain Exhausted for 10 seconds.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating other perks that cause Exhausted.

beginner.whatItIs: Confessor's War Horn pairs with Will of the Gods and layers an Exhausted state onto every survivor who picks up the Heresy mark. During that window the survivor also cannot activate other perks that would normally trigger Exhausted, so the debuff stacks cleanly without interference.
beginner.whyItMatters: Stacking Exhausted on top of Heresy slows the survivor down at the exact moment they are already marked, making escape harder and giving the killer more chase time. It is a moderate shift that punishes the Heresy application with a movement penalty instead of just a mark.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when you want every Heresy application to also slow the survivor down, because the combined exhaustion and mark make it far harder for them to vault or sprint clean. It drops at an uncommon rate, so it is easy enough to find for a build that already centers on stacking Heresy.

Addon_K44_14.name: Searcher's Skull
Addon_K44_14.description:
“The skulls of the heretics shall be cleaned and displayed as a warning to others who might stray from the light.” (Witness to Koenrad, ch. 33)

When a Survivor blinds you, they gain Heresy. Additionally, If they were already a Heretic, they become blinded themselves for 2.5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Searcher's Skull slots into Will of the Gods and marks any survivor who blinds the killer with Heresy. If that survivor was already marked, they are blinded in return for a brief moment.
beginner.whyItMatters: The retaliation punishes survivors who rely on blind mechanics to break a chase, since using the tool on an already-marked survivor costs them their own vision. It is a small but sharp deterrent against repeated blind attempts.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if a survivor keeps using blind mechanics to escape chases, because the risk of losing vision makes the attempt much less appealing. It is common, so finding one should not require much luck.

Addon_K44_15.name: Chains of the Heretic
Addon_K44_15.description:
“Examples shall be made of the loudest apostates. They shall be dragged through the streets in chains.” (Witness to Koenrad, ch. 41)

While Zealous,The minimum delay before Divine Light is lethal is set to 0.35 seconds.Increases the max speed of Controlled Divine Light by 100%.Increases the max speed of Cast Divine Light by 50%.Cast Divine Light will always be directed towards you.

beginner.whatItIs: Chains of the Heretic modifies Will of the Gods while Zealous, cutting the delay before Divine Light becomes lethal to a very short window. It also makes Controlled and Cast Divine Light move substantially faster, and Cast Divine Light always tracks back toward the killer.
beginner.whyItMatters: The speed boost and shortened lethal delay turn Divine Light from a slow projectile into a rapid, punishing tool during Zealous. This is a bigger shift in how the power plays rather than a minor stat tweak.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the killer wants Divine Light to feel like a fast, lethal threat the moment Zealous activates. Very rare rarity means it takes several trials to turn up.

Addon_K44_16.name: Improvised Detonators
Addon_K44_16.description:
“Like cowards, they strike with bombs in the night, afraid to let the light of day illuminate their blackened souls.” (Witness to Koenrad, ch. 35)

Whenever you Exile a Survivor with the lowest amount of Hook States, if no Survivors are dead, gain a Token.

Then if you have 4 or more Tokens,The generator with the most progression explodes and instantly regresses by 20% of its total progression.

beginner.whatItIs: Improvised Detonators slots into Will of the Gods and grants a Token every time a survivor with the fewest hook states is Exiled while no survivors are dead. Once enough Tokens accumulate, the most-progressed generator explodes and regresses by a large chunk of its total work.
beginner.whyItMatters: The regression penalty adds real map-wide pressure, because a generator losing a big slice of progress forces survivors to regroup or risk falling further behind. It is a meaningful shift that rewards consistent Exile play over single-moment spikes.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the killer's build revolves around Exiling survivors and they want a built-in generator threat to keep pressure on. It is very rare, so patience is the main requirement.

Addon_K44_17.name: Eyes of Gerhardt
Addon_K44_17.description:
“He rapturously tore the eyes from his face after seeing such brilliant visions of the future.” (II Barbarians, ch. 60)

Whenever a Heretic completes a Generator, opens an Exit Gate, or exits a Locker, the aura of all Heretics are revealed to you for 5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Eyes of Gerhardt hangs off Will of the Gods and watches what the Heretics are doing. Finishing a Generator, opening an Exit Gate or stepping out of a Locker gives every Heretic away at once. The window is brief, but it covers all of them together.
beginner.whyItMatters: Burst visibility at those exact moments can turn a generator completion into a hunt, since the killer suddenly knows where every Heretic stands. It is a targeted information tool rather than a broad permanent buff.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the killer wants to punish Heretics for finishing generators or using lockers, because each of those actions flashes their position. Very rare means it will not show up often, but it is obtainable.

Addon_K44_18.name: Obsidian Feather
Addon_K44_18.description:
“Some villagers will carve feathers from rocks, hoping that their faith might protect them.” (Visions of Gerhardt, ch. 3)

You can no longer manually Cast or cancel controlled Divine Light, and it is automatically Cast when it would instead time out.

You move 100% faster while controlling Divine Light, and decreases the max time that could be spent controlling it by 25%.

You recover 10% slower and move 30% slower while Casting Divine Light.

beginner.whatItIs: Obsidian Feather reworks Will of the Gods by removing manual control over Divine Light, which now auto-casts the moment it would time out. The killer moves faster while holding Divine Light, the control window is shortened, and both recovery and casting movement become slower.
beginner.whyItMatters: The trade-off is speed and automation in exchange for less fine control, which suits a playstyle that prefers a fixed, faster cadence over manual timing. It is a bigger shift than a simple stat bump because it changes how the power is operated entirely.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the killer prefers a quicker, more automatic Divine Light rhythm and does not mind losing the ability to cancel a cast early. Iridescent rarity means it is a high-effort pull that will not come around quickly.

Addon_K44_19.name: Crown of the Destroyer
Addon_K44_19.description:
“The Creators saw this and bestowed upon It a crown and said, use this to bring light to the darkness.” (I Barbarians, ch. 6)

Whenever a Survivor Liberates another Survivor from Exile, for 20 seconds,Your Terror Radius is reduced by 70%.Your Terror Radius is copied to every Shrine of Judgment.You gain Undetectable.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

beginner.whatItIs: It slots into Will of the Gods and triggers a defensive window whenever a survivor frees another from Exile. During that window the Terror Radius contracts significantly, that contracted value is mirrored onto every Shrine of Judgment, and Undetectable hides the killer from survivor tracking.
beginner.whyItMatters: Liberating someone from Exile is supposed to be a relief, and here it is the moment the map goes quiet instead. The Terror Radius shrinks, gets copied onto every Shrine of Judgment so none of it means anything, and Undetectable removes the aura and Red Stain as well. Nothing fires unless a liberation actually happens, so the payoff stays conditional.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the killer expects survivors to attempt liberations and wants a stealth reward for letting that happen. It is very rare, so expect a long wait before it appears in the pool.

Addon_K44_20.name: Mirror of the Creators
Addon_K44_20.description:
“And They said unto It, take this mirror, and show them the error of their ways.” (I Barbarians, ch. 6)

A Cast Divine Light now Reflects off the first 2 tall obstructions it would otherwise pass through.

When Reflecting, it pauses for 0.4 seconds before being Cast again.

beginner.whatItIs: Mirror of the Creators changes how Divine Light behaves under Will of the Gods by letting a Cast Divine Light bounce off tall obstructions before re-casting after a brief pause. Instead of passing through walls, it reflects and continues on a new path.
beginner.whyItMatters: The bounce mechanic makes Divine Light far more versatile, since it can now reach survivors hiding behind pallets or inside rooms where a straight cast would miss. This is a meaningful change to how the projectile is aimed and where it can land.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the killer struggles with Divine Light hitting survivors who hide behind obstacles or in enclosed spaces. Iridescent rarity makes it a demanding pull, but the bounce it adds to Divine Light is well worth the patience.

Addon_Kanobo_AkitosCrutch.name: Akito's Crutch
Addon_Kanobo_AkitosCrutch.description:
The crutch used by Kazan's son after falling from a tree. Akito's playmate and her family were punished for the boy's injury.

Increases movement speed of Demon Dash by 13%.

beginner.whatItIs: Akito's Crutch is a very rare slot for Yamaoka's Wrath that increases the movement speed of Demon Dash. The boost is modest but makes each dash cover noticeably more ground.
beginner.whyItMatters: A faster Demon Dash helps close the distance to a survivor or reposition after a miss, which is a small but tangible mobility improvement. It does not change the overall flow of the power, only how quickly the dash completes.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when Demon Dash feels a half-beat too slow for catching survivors who vault away. Its very rare pull takes a long run of trials to show up, so plan the slot early.

Addon_Kanobo_BlackenedToenail.name: Blackened Toenail
Addon_Kanobo_BlackenedToenail.description:
Fell off during one of Kazan's hundred winter treks to the temple. Despite his pilgrimage, Akito's leg would never heal.

Increases movement speed while absorbing Blood Orbs by 0.4 m/s.

beginner.whatItIs: Blackened Toenail is a common slot for Yamaoka's Wrath that gives a small movement speed boost while the killer absorbs Blood Orbs. The effect is active only during orb collection, not during normal walking between them.
beginner.whyItMatters: Moving a little faster between orbs shortens the time spent vulnerable while collecting, which is a small but useful comfort buff. It gives a gentle bump to orb-collection speed without any other changes.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the killer wants a gentle speed bump during orb runs and has nothing better in the slot. It is common, which means it shows up often enough to be a practical choice.

Addon_Kanobo_BloodySash.name: Bloody Sash
Addon_Kanobo_BloodySash.description:
Blood from a boy who called Kazan The Imposter Noble. Kazan hid evidence of the fight from his father, often reveling at the sash in secret.

Increases movement speed while absorbing Blood Orbs by 0.7 m/s.

beginner.whatItIs: Bloody Sash slots into Yamaoka's Wrath and provides a larger movement speed increase while absorbing Blood Orbs compared to the common alternative. The faster pace makes each orb-collection run feel snappier and less exposed.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra speed matters most when orbs are scattered far apart, since the killer covers more ground in less time and has fewer moments standing still. It is a noticeable step up from the common orb-speed option.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the killer regularly collects orbs from spread-out locations and wants to minimize the time spent in that vulnerable state. Uncommon rarity keeps it accessible without making it trivial to find.

Addon_Kanobo_ChildsWoodenSword.name: Child's Wooden Sword
Addon_Kanobo_ChildsWoodenSword.description:
Akito's practice sword. The child had little use for it after his injury.

Increases Blood Orb aura reading range by 3 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: Child's Wooden Sword slots into Yamaoka's Wrath and extends the range at which Blood Orbs appear on the killer's screen. The extra sightline lets the killer spot orbs from further away than the base power allows.
beginner.whyItMatters: Seeing orbs earlier helps the killer plan a collection route before committing to a direction, which reduces wasted backtracking. It is a straightforward information buff with no hidden conditions or timing requirements.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the killer often walks past orbs without noticing them or wants to plan orb runs from a distance. It is uncommon, so most trials will eventually yield one.

Addon_Kanobo_ChippedSaihai.name: Chipped Saihai
Addon_Kanobo_ChippedSaihai.description:
A baton that belonged to Renjiro, it was stolen by Kazan upon his departure.

Increases Blood Fury duration by 6 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Chipped Saihai is an uncommon slot for Yamaoka's Wrath that extends the duration of Blood Fury. The longer window gives the killer more time inside the empowered state after activation.
beginner.whyItMatters: Extra time in Blood Fury means more downs and more chase distance covered before the state ends, which is a straightforward extension of the power's peak. It does not change how Blood Fury is activated, only how long it lasts.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the killer finds Blood Fury ending just before they finish a chase or a multi-down sequence. At uncommon rarity it is easy enough to find without much searching.

Addon_Kanobo_CrackedSakazuki.name: Cracked Sakazuki
Addon_Kanobo_CrackedSakazuki.description:
A cup from Kazan's wedding ceremony, it never made it through the night before being damaged.

Decreases Blood Fury activation time by 0.5 seconds.Decreases Blood Fury cooldown by 0.5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: A common add-on for Yamaoka's Wrath, it trims both the activation delay and the cooldown of Blood Fury. The empowered state becomes available again sooner, letting the killer re-enter it more often.
beginner.whyItMatters: Shorter activation and cooldown mean the killer can re-enter Blood Fury sooner after it expires, which is a meaningful cadence improvement for a power that already revolves around short bursts. It is a small but consistent quality-of-life change.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the killer wants to use Blood Fury more frequently in a trial and finds the base cooldown too long. Common rarity means it will appear frequently in the add-on pool.

Addon_Kanobo_InkLion.name: Ink Lion
Addon_Kanobo_InkLion.description:
An ink painting that once hung in the Yamaoka estate. Depicts the story of a lion eaten by mice.

Decreases Blood Fury activation time by 0.5 seconds.Decreases Blood Fury cooldown by 0.5 seconds.Decreases Blood Fury consumption when downing a Survivor by 2 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Slotting into Yamaoka's Wrath at uncommon rarity, it cuts the Blood Fury activation delay, the cooldown, and the amount of charge a down costs. All three reductions work together, making the empowered state cheaper and more frequent in a single pick.
beginner.whyItMatters: The combined effect makes Blood Fury cheaper to use and faster to recycle, which bundles several efficiency improvements into one slot. It is a well-rounded choice for anyone who wants a broad Blood Fury buff without specializing in a single stat.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer wants a broad efficiency boost for Blood Fury without needing to pick one specific stat. Uncommon rarity keeps it reasonably accessible, so it can show up without a long grind.

Addon_Kanobo_KanaianzenTalisman.name: Kanai-anzen Talisman
Addon_Kanobo_KanaianzenTalisman.description: A trinket given to Kazan at birth, its powers are meant to protect his family from harm.Increases movement speed of Demon Dash by 8%.

beginner.whatItIs: A rare pick for Yamaoka's Wrath that makes Demon Dash cover more ground with every use. The speed bump is modest but still makes each dash feel snappier against sprinting survivors.
beginner.whyItMatters: A slightly faster Demon Dash helps with repositioning and closing small gaps after a miss, which is a modest but useful mobility tweak. Because the boost is moderate rather than extreme, it fits a build that wants steadier movement without leaning fully into an all-out speed loadout.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the killer wants a noticeable but not extreme Demon Dash speed boost and has access to a rare slot. It is rare, so it will not appear in every single pool.

Addon_Kanobo_LionFang.name: Lion Fang
Addon_Kanobo_LionFang.description: A tooth sold from an exotic vendor, it symbolizes power and nobility.Increases Blood Fury duration by 10 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: A very rare add-on that plugs into Yamaoka's Wrath and stretches the Blood Fury window by a large amount. The longer empowered state gives the killer more time to land hits or reposition while the buff is active.
beginner.whyItMatters: A much longer Blood Fury window means the killer can string together multiple downs and chases before the state ends, which is a substantial power spike compared to the base duration. It is a big extension that gives the killer a long window to work with.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the killer wants a long, sustained Blood Fury window and plans to use the extra time for multiple downs in a row. Very rare rarity means it does not come around quickly in the add-on pool.

Addon_Kanobo_PaperLantern.name: Paper Lantern
Addon_Kanobo_PaperLantern.description:
Perhaps a memento of simpler times, before rage fully enveloped him.

Increases Blood Orb absorption speed by 4 m/s.

beginner.whatItIs: It slots into Yamaoka's Wrath at common rarity and speeds up how quickly Blood Orbs are absorbed. The faster fill rate means Blood Fury reaches its threshold sooner than the base power allows.
beginner.whyItMatters: Charging Blood Fury faster shortens the downtime between uses, which is a small but consistent improvement to the power's overall tempo. It is a straightforward way to speed up the Blood Fury cycle without touching any other stat.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the killer wants to charge Blood Fury quicker and is looking for a low-effort, high-availability option. It is common, so it will show up regularly in the add-on pool.

Addon_Kanobo_PolishedMaedate.name: Polished Maedate
Addon_Kanobo_PolishedMaedate.description:
A horned crest Kazan tore from his helmet after being compared to a demon.

Increases Yamaoka's Wrath passive charge rate by 50%.

beginner.whatItIs: An uncommon add-on for Yamaoka's Wrath that accelerates the passive charge building in the background. Reaching the active threshold happens sooner, so the killer has access to the empowered state more often throughout the trial.
beginner.whyItMatters: A faster passive charge means the killer can use their active ability more often, which is a meaningful tempo improvement for any build that relies on the passive filling up. It does not change what the active does, only how quickly it becomes available.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the killer finds the passive taking too long to fill and wants to shorten that wait. It is uncommon, so it is accessible without needing to chase a rare or better pull.

Addon_Kanobo_RenjirosBloodyGlove.name: Renjiro’s Bloody Glove
Addon_Kanobo_RenjirosBloodyGlove.description:
The glove Renjiro held to his sternum following the strike dealt by his son.

All Survivors can see Blood Orbs at the same distance as you.A Survivor's aura is revealed for 2 seconds when coming into contact with a Blood Orb.

beginner.whatItIs: Renjiro's Bloody Glove is an iridescent slot for Yamaoka's Wrath that lets all survivors see Blood Orbs at the same distance as the killer. Additionally, a survivor's aura is revealed for a brief moment when they come into contact with a Blood Orb.
beginner.whyItMatters: The aura reveal on contact is the real value here, because it punishes survivors for collecting orbs by flashing their position to the killer. Giving survivors orb visibility is a trade that only makes sense because the contact reveal offsets it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a chase build wants survivors to grab orbs on their own terms and then flash their position to the killer. The reveal only lasts a short moment, so it rewards fast decisions around a generator rather than slow orb hoarding. Because iridescent pulls are rare, save it for a match where orb greed is already a known habit.

Addon_Kanobo_RottingRope.name: Rotting Rope
Addon_Kanobo_RottingRope.description:
Had the rope been stronger, it would have likely held Kazan. As it was, he escaped and butchered his captors.

Increases Blood Orb aura reading range by 2 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: Yamaoka's Wrath benefits from a longer Blood Orb sight line, so the killer spots orbs earlier and can commit to the dash with more information. Its common rarity keeps it easy to find in trials, which suits a killer who wants a steady small upgrade to orb tracking.
beginner.whyItMatters: A small range bump helps the killer notice orbs they would otherwise walk past, which is a low-key quality-of-life improvement. It pairs well with a build that already plans orb routes carefully and just needs a little extra sightline.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the killer wants a slight sightline extension and has nothing better in a common slot. Common rarity means it will appear often enough to be a reliable filler choice.

Addon_Kanobo_ScalpedTopknot.name: Scalped Topknot
Addon_Kanobo_ScalpedTopknot.description:
The topknot of a samurai who questioned Kazan's honor. The roots cling to a thin strip of bloody skin.

Decreases time to activate Demon Dash by 0.5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: An add-on for Yamaoka's Wrath that shortens the activation delay on Demon Dash. It lets the killer commit to that dash a beat sooner than the base power allows.
beginner.whyItMatters: Shaving the delay makes the follow-up after a chase feel snappier, since the killer no longer waits as long between a hit and the dash. It reads as a small tweak that smooths out the rhythm of a kill sequence.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if the killer build leans on Demon Dash as a recovery or repositioning tool, since the shortened delay pays off each time the dash is triggered. Its rare rarity means it will not show up on every trial.

Addon_Kanobo_ShatteredWakizashi.name: Shattered Wakizashi
Addon_Kanobo_ShatteredWakizashi.description: The fragments of an ancestral blade, destroyed by Kazan in a fit of rage.Increases Yamaoka's Wrath passive charge rate by 100%.

beginner.whatItIs: Fits Yamaoka's Wrath and doubles the rate at which its passive charge accumulates. The power is ready for use much sooner after each activation as a result.
beginner.whyItMatters: A faster charge cycle turns Yamaoka's Wrath into a tool that can be leaned on more frequently throughout a trial. It shifts the power from an occasional burst to a more constant presence in chases.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a chase build wants to string together more Wrath activations per trial rather than save them for single big moments. At rare rarity it will appear with moderate frequency in the offering pool.

Addon_Kanobo_SplinteredHull.name: Splintered Hull
Addon_Kanobo_SplinteredHull.description:
Fragments of a ship that carried Renjiro Yamaoka. Against all odds, the legendary samurai seemed to survive.

Increases the frequency of Blood Orbs dropped by Survivors by 33%.Survivors drop an additional Blood Orb when they vault, throw pallets, exit lockers, crouch, or fail a skill check.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into Yamaoka's Wrath so survivors shed Blood Orbs more often during vaults, pallet throws, locker exits, crouches, and failed skill checks. The extra orbs land on the ground as survivors go about their normal actions.
beginner.whyItMatters: More orbs on the ground means the killer can top up Blood Fury between hooks more easily, which keeps the power cycle rolling without long idle gaps. It is a moderate shift that makes sustained pressure feel less punishing on the resource side.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the build wants to keep Blood Fury topped up during extended chases or hook loops, since the extra orbs fall naturally from survivor actions. At very rare rarity it will not show up often, so plan ahead when it does appear in the offering.

Addon_Kanobo_TearSoakedTenugui.name: Tear Soaked Tenugui
Addon_Kanobo_TearSoakedTenugui.description:
The cloth that Kazan's mother cried into when he left on his pilgrimage to cleanse the samurai.

Decreases Blood Fury consumption when downing a Survivor by 4 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Cloth-themed, it trims the Blood Fury cost paid when downsing a survivor on Yamaoka's Wrath. More fury remains in the tank after each down as a result.
beginner.whyItMatters: Lowering the cost per down means the killer can string together more downs before the fury runs dry. It matters a lot in a trial where multiple survivors are downed in quick succession.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it in trials where the plan is to hook multiple survivors in one rotation, since the savings stack up and keep the power loop alive. Its very rare rarity means it is a treat to find, not something to expect every time.

Addon_Kanobo_WoodenOniMask.name: Wooden Oni Mask
Addon_Kanobo_WoodenOniMask.description:
A mask that a young Kazan bought to celebrate Setsubun, its repulsively fanged mouth began haunting his nightmares.

Increases the frequency of Blood Orbs dropped by Survivors by 14%.Survivors drop an additional Blood Orb when they vault, throw pallets, exit lockers, crouch, or fail a skill check.

beginner.whatItIs: Mask-themed, it rides on Yamaoka's Wrath and nudges up how frequently survivors drop Blood Orbs during their normal actions. The extra orbs appear on vaults, pallet hits, locker exits, crouches, and failed skill checks.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra orbs make refilling Blood Fury less of a headache, especially when the killer is spending fury on long chases rather than quick hook rotations. It is a modest tweak that smooths out the resource side of the power loop.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the build prioritizes keeping Blood Fury topped up during long chases, since the orbs fall naturally from vaults and pallet hits. At rare rarity it shows up more often than the very rare options but is not guaranteed every trial.

Addon_Kanobo_YamaokaFamilyCrest.name: Iridescent Family Crest
Addon_Kanobo_YamaokaFamilyCrest.description:
A crest that denotes its owner as being a part of the Yamaoka family.

Miss a charged attack during Blood Fury to smash the ground and create a shock wave. Any Survivors within 24 meters will scream and reveal their current location to you for 4 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Iridescent and exclusive to Yamaoka's Wrath, it turns a whiffed charged attack during Blood Fury into a ground slam. Nearby survivors scream and their location is revealed briefly to the killer.
beginner.whyItMatters: Turning a missed attack into information means the killer loses less from a whiff, since the reveal helps close the gap or set up the next hook. It is a bigger shift because it changes the risk calculus of swinging a charged attack in Blood Fury.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the killer wants to punish survivors who bait whiffs at long range, since the reveal after a miss keeps the pressure on. At iridescent rarity it is a rare find and worth saving for a build that already commits to Blood Fury aggressively.

Addon_Kanobo_YamaokaSashimono.name: Yamaoka Sashimono
Addon_Kanobo_YamaokaSashimono.description:
The banner of the Yamaoka family, Kazan felt an overwhelming pride from it.

Increases Blood Fury duration by 8 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: The banner add-on for Yamaoka's Wrath, stretching how long Blood Fury persists once triggered. The killer gets a wider window to land hits while the effect is active.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer fury window gives the killer more time to corner a survivor or chain multiple downs before the effect fades. It turns Blood Fury from a burst into a sustained phase, rewarding patient chase management.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the build wants to win long chases inside Blood Fury rather than relying on quick hook-and-reset cycles. At rare rarity it is a reasonable find and suits builds that already favor extended fury phases.

Addon_Key_001.name: Friendship Charm
Addon_Key_001.description:
Someone's thumb has worn off the initials once carved into it.

Increases a key's charges by 1.

beginner.whatItIs: Simple and common, it adds an extra charge to the survivor key so the item lasts longer in a trial. The key can be used more times before it is fully spent.
beginner.whyItMatters: That extra use can be the difference between escaping a hook and getting downed, since it gives a second shot if the first reveal misses the mark. It is a small but reliable bump that makes the key feel less like a single-use gamble.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it whenever the key is part of the loadout and the trial feels tight, since the backup charge covers a wrong first guess. At common rarity it will appear frequently in offerings, making it an easy grab.

Addon_Key_002.name: Prayer Beads
Addon_Key_002.description:
A chain of matte beads of various sizes used in praying rituals. Can be attached to the Key.

Adds 15 seconds of use to the Key.

beginner.whatItIs: Attached to the survivor key, it tacks on extra seconds of usable channel time. The key gets more room to do its job before the effect fades.
beginner.whyItMatters: More channel time means the survivor can finish a reveal or a generator pop without rushing. It matters when a killer is pressing and every second of exposure is dangerous.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in chases or when the survivor expects to use the key while being hunted, since the extra time reduces the window where the action is visible. At uncommon rarity it is a reasonably common find in the offering pool.

Addon_Key_003.name: Shrill Whistle
Addon_Key_003.description:
The high-pitched scream gives a sense of urgency to everything.

Decreases the time to channel a key by 35%.

beginner.whatItIs: Whistle-themed, it cuts the channeling time required for the survivor key. The action finishes faster, which exposes the survivor for less time.
beginner.whyItMatters: A shorter channel means less time in the vulnerable animation, which is a real advantage when a killer is close. It reads as a meaningful shift in how safe the key feels to use under pressure.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the survivor plays aggressively and uses the key often in tight spots, since the speed-up compounds over multiple uses. At uncommon rarity it is a solid find that pairs well with a build that leans on the key for utility.

Addon_Key_004.name: Gold Token
Addon_Key_004.description:
A gold token with a dull appearance. Both faces are smooth and void of any inscriptions. Can be attached to the Key using its jump ring to channel the key's aura reading ability.

Reveals Survivor auras when within a 48 meter range.

beginner.whatItIs: Rare, it uses a jump ring to let the key reveal survivor auras within a set radius when channeled. The key becomes a team-visibility tool rather than just a personal one.
beginner.whyItMatters: A wider aura range on the key lets a survivor spot nearby allies who may be in trouble, making it easier to call out positions and route around threats together. That turns a solo utility into something the group can rely on for shared awareness.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the survivor wants to keep tabs on teammates during a long chase or while heading to a distant generator, since the reveal window is the whole point. At rare rarity it is a solid find and worth grabbing when the offering pool is thin.

Addon_Key_005.name: Blood Amber
Addon_Key_005.description: A blood-red amber striped with black veins. The amber is warm to the touch.Using this key reveals the Killer to you, and you to the Killer.Reduces aura reveal time by 6 seconds.Reduces number of charges by 2.

beginner.whatItIs: Iridescent in rarity, it reveals both the survivor using the key and the killer to each other when activated. The trade-off is shorter aura reveals and fewer charges on the key.
beginner.whyItMatters: Mutual visibility is a double-edged tool: it helps the survivor spot the killer, but it also gives the killer a lock on the survivor for the duration. The choice suits a playstyle built on controlled engagement rather than pure evasion.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it right before a risky push to the Hatch or a generator far from the killer, so the brief mutual reveal confirms the threat is not nearby. Because it is an iridescent find and trims the key's charges, save it for a moment when that one check changes the decision.

Addon_Key_006.name: Milky Glass
Addon_Key_006.description:
This opaque piece of glass emits a dull vibrating noise. When the Key is used to unlock the Hatch, the glass token protects the Key from breaking, channeling The Fog's energy into the glass.

Do not lose the Key when unlocking the Hatch, lose this add-on instead.

beginner.whatItIs: Very rare, it absorbs the breaking cost when the key is spent on the Hatch so the key itself survives the unlock. The add-on is consumed instead of the key.
beginner.whyItMatters: Keeping the key after the Hatch unlock means the survivor still has a reveal tool in the final phase. It can be the difference between a clean escape and a last-second hook.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the plan is to use the key for the Hatch unlock and still want a backup reveal in the final moments. At very rare rarity it is a special find and worth prioritizing over common or uncommon key options when it appears.

Addon_Key_007.name: Weaved Ring
Addon_Key_007.description:
A mundane key ring in appearance with an unusual bluish dark sheen. The ring binds the Key to the user, preventing its loss even in the darkest of times.

Do not lose the Key on death, lose this add-on instead.

beginner.whatItIs: It anchors the key to its holder so dying does not drop the key into the open. The add-on is sacrificed instead, protecting the key through a down or death.
beginner.whyItMatters: Surviving a hook without losing the key means the survivor can still pop a generator or reveal a locker on the next trip. It is a safety net that matters most in trials where the survivor gets hooked often.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the survivor plays in a way that invites hooks, such as aggressive looping or long generator work far from lockers. At very rare rarity it is a prized find that protects the key investment across the whole trial.

Addon_Key_008.name: Braided Bauble
Addon_Key_008.description:
Four thin but sturdy cords, all masterfully wrapped around one another.

Increases the duration of auras revealed by keys by 2 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Rare, it stretches the window during which key-revealed auras remain visible to the survivor after the channel completes. The information lingers longer on the screen.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer reveal window gives the survivor more time to react to what the key shows, whether that is a generator about to be sabotaged or a hook with a survivor on it. It is a small tweak but one that compounds over multiple uses in a trial.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the survivor wants to read the map between chases and act on what the key reveals, since the extra visibility time makes those reads more actionable. At rare rarity it is a moderate-frequency find and fits builds that lean on the key for scouting.

Addon_Key_WeddingRing.name: Unique Wedding Ring
Addon_Key_WeddingRing.description: An engraved wedding ring that emerged from The Fog and resonates with an indescribable and incomprehensible energy. The Obsession and yourself both see each other's aura at all times.Decreases your chances to be The Killer’s Obsession.

beginner.whatItIs: It swaps constant aura visibility between the key holder and whoever the trial has designated as the Obsession, so both of them see each other for the whole match. It also makes the key holder less likely to be chosen as the Obsession in the first place.
beginner.whyItMatters: Constant mutual visibility forces the Obsession to account for the survivor's position as carefully as the survivor tracks the Obsession's, which breaks the usual one-sided pressure of being hunted. It also lowers the odds of becoming the Obsession in the first place, giving the survivor a quieter start to the trial.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the survivor plans to read the Obsession's position and route around it rather than reacting to sound alone, because the constant reveal rewards that deliberate play. Being a very rare find, it suits a build that already leans on careful map awareness and positioning.

Addon_Killer_Halloween2020.name: Blight Serum
Addon_Killer_Halloween2020.description:
A small amount of Compound Thirty-Four, the final serum The Blight worked on before his transformation. Causes extreme mutations in high doses.

You gain 1 charge of Blighted Rush that replaces your Killer power until consumed. Press the Power button to initiate a Blighted Rush, allowing you to quickly dash forward.You can not attack during a Blighted Rush.You gain 1 additional charge of Blighted Rush every time you hook a Survivor, up to a maximum of 1 charge.This add-on may have unknown effects on certain Killers.Only playable during the Haunted by Daylight Event.

beginner.whatItIs: Common and tied to The Blight, it grants a charge of Blighted Rush, a quick dash that replaces the normal killer power until used. The dash can be gained again by hooking survivors.
beginner.whyItMatters: The dash gives The Blight a burst of mobility he does not normally have, letting him close gaps or reposition without committing to a full power sequence. It is a meaningful shift because it adds a new layer of chase control to a killer who otherwise relies on his standard toolkit.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when playing The Blight against fast survivors who punish slow chases, since the dash bridges the speed gap for a short burst. At common rarity it is easy to find and a low-risk pick for any Blight build.

ADDON_Lastbreath_AtaxicRespiration.name: Ataxic Respiration
ADDON_Lastbreath_AtaxicRespiration.description:
The irregular and deteriorating breath collected from the catatonic boy. Normally stable and calm, becomes incredibly agitated at The Nurse's touch.

Decreases base Blink fatigue duration by 7%.

beginner.whatItIs: Shortens the fatigue period The Nurse experiences after using a Blink, letting her recover and act again sooner. This applies to Blink use in general, not only to a teleport that misses its target.
beginner.whyItMatters: Shortening the fatigue penalty after a failed Blink reduces the punishment window that survivors exploit to reposition or escape, keeping The Nurse in the chase longer. The change is a moderate nudge rather than a redesign, softening the cost of a miss without altering the Blink itself.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Carry it in maps where The Nurse chases through narrow halls and risks overshooting a target, since a shorter stun after a miss keeps the hunter in play. Its rare rarity tag means it will not show up every session, so slot it in the moment it drops.

ADDON_Lastbreath_BadManLastBreath.name: "Bad Man's" Last Breath
ADDON_Lastbreath_BadManLastBreath.description:
A powerful last breath snatched from Crotus Prenn asylum patient "the Bad Man." In the hands of The Nurse, it jolts with intensity.

Hitting a survivor with a successful Blink Attack grants the Nurse Undetectable for 25 seconds. This effect may be only triggered once every 45 seconds.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

beginner.whatItIs: Attaches to Spencer's Last Breath and grants The Nurse Undetectable for a set duration after a successful Blink Attack. While active, the killer's aura, terror radius, and red stain are all hidden.
beginner.whyItMatters: Vanishing after a landed hit lets The Nurse peel off a generator or slip through a survivor loop unseen, breaking the team's ability to track and coordinate a rescue. The change lands as a significant shift, layering a stealth reward onto a power that is otherwise pure aggression and forward pressure.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it to the hook when a chase ends with a clean Blink hit and the killer wants to drop off survivor awareness, reposition, or slip toward the next generator unseen. Its very rare status means long stretches between drops, so equip it the moment it surfaces rather than waiting for a more convenient setup.

ADDON_Lastbreath_DullBracelet.name: Dull Bracelet
ADDON_Lastbreath_DullBracelet.description:
A worthless piece of jewelry that might have had an important significance to someone. Taken from the anxious girl's body.

Decreases maximum Blink distance by 20%.Increases Bloodpoints for Precise Blink score events by 100%.

beginner.whatItIs: Bolted onto Spencer's Last Breath, it reduces the maximum Blink distance. In exchange, it doubles the Bloodpoints earned from Precise Blink score events.
beginner.whyItMatters: The shorter Blink range makes the power less of an escape tool and more of a short-range reposition, but the doubled score reward makes precision Blinks far more valuable for progression. It reads as a trade-off, sacrificing reach for reward density.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Suit it to a killer who is comfortable with shorter Blink range and wants to stack Bloodpoint income from Precise Blink events, making it a natural pick when score-based progress matters. Its uncommon rarity keeps it available often enough to plan a loadout around without long waits.

ADDON_Lastbreath_HeavyPanting.name: Heavy Panting
ADDON_Lastbreath_HeavyPanting.description:
The slow and bulging breath stolen from the orderly. Dimly oscillates at The Nurse's touch.

Extends the duration of a lunge after more than one Blink by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Mounted on Spencer's Last Breath, it extends the lunge duration after chaining more than one Blink together. The final lunge lasts longer, giving the killer extra time to track a dodging survivor.
beginner.whyItMatters: Extending the lunge window after a Blink chain gives The Nurse a wider attack arc on the final swing, improving the odds of connecting when a survivor is mid-vault or mid-dash. The shift is modest, sharpening the payoff of committing to a multi-Blink sequence without changing earlier Blinks.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a killer frequently chains Blinks and wants the final lunge to have more time to connect, especially against survivors who side-step or drop smoke right as the lunge begins. It holds a rare rarity, making it less common in the loot pool than its lower-rarity counterparts.

ADDON_Lastbreath_JennerLastBreath.name: Jenner's Last Breath
ADDON_Lastbreath_JennerLastBreath.description:
A powerful last breath snatched from Crotus Prenn asylum patient Mary Jenner. In the hands of The Nurse, it trembles with intensity.

Once The Nurse has exhausted all of her Blinks, allows The Nurse to immediately Blink back to her original position by pressing the Active Ability Button.Must be triggered before The Nurse succumbs to fatigue.After returning to her original position, The Nurse will have one Blink charge ready.

beginner.whatItIs: Rigged into Spencer's Last Breath, it lets The Nurse immediately Blink back to her original position once all Blink charges are exhausted. It must be triggered before fatigue sets in, and one charge is ready upon return.
beginner.whyItMatters: An emergency return that snaps The Nurse back to her starting point with a fresh charge ready turns a botched Blink chain from a losing position into a controlled reset. The change is a substantial addition because the stock power offers no bailout, making the difference between a stranded killer and one who can re-engage.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a killer plans aggressive multi-Blink sequences on maps where a misjudged chain can leave The Nurse stranded in an open area with no cover. Its very rare rarity tag means it will not drop often, so slot it in immediately when it appears in the loot pool.

ADDON_Lastbreath_KavanaghLastBreath.name: Kavanagh's Last Breath
ADDON_Lastbreath_KavanaghLastBreath.description:
A powerful last breath snatched from Crotus Prenn asylum orderly Harvey Kavanagh. In the hands of The Nurse, it wobbles with intensity.

When succumbing to fatigue, any Survivors within 8 meters of The Nurse are afflicted with the Blindness status effect for 60 seconds.

Blindness prevents Survivors from seeing auras.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into Spencer's Last Breath and rewrites what fatigue does: any survivor caught nearby goes blind to auras for a long stretch. The Nurse's moment of exhaustion becomes a map-wide information blackout instead of a simple cooldown reset.
beginner.whyItMatters: A full stretch of invisible auras lets The Nurse hunt without being tracked back, turning the fatigue moment into a one-sided chase. It reads as a significant shift in how the power feels, swapping a free reset for sustained pressure.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when The Nurse is about to chase multiple survivors near a generator and fatigue would normally let them scatter safely. It is veryrare, so save it for matches where The Nurse is already built around blink pressure.

ADDON_Lastbreath_Matchbox.name: Matchbox
ADDON_Lastbreath_Matchbox.description:
A matchbox containing an odd collection of mismatched buttons. Serves as a reminder of a horrible place.

Sets maximum number of Blink charges to 1.Increases The Nurse's base movement speed to 4.4 m/s.

beginner.whatItIs: Attaches to Spencer's Last Breath, caps Blink at a single charge, and bumps The Nurse's base movement speed noticeably higher. The trade is straightforward: fewer dashes in exchange for a faster run between them.
beginner.whyItMatters: With only one Blink to spend, every teleport becomes a committed move, and the extra base speed carries The Nurse through the gaps that used to need a second dash. It reads as a bigger shift in identity, moving from a burst-dash tool to a sustained-speed pursuit style.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if a chase build around raw pursuit speed feels more natural than spamming blinks. It is iridescent, so it is a long-term pick rather than a casual experiment.

ADDON_Lastbreath_SpasmodicBreath.name: Spasmodic Breath
ADDON_Lastbreath_SpasmodicBreath.description:
The twitchy and tremulous breath stolen from the "Bad Man." Aggressively pulses and jumps at The Nurse's touch.

Hitting a survivor with a successful Blink Attack disables the ability to Blink and increases the Nurse's base movement speed to 4.6 m/s for 60 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Fits Spencer's Last Breath and converts each successful Blink hit into a long speed boost, locking the ability out while the bonus runs. The Nurse trades the next teleport for raw chase velocity instead.
beginner.whyItMatters: Landing a Blink attack no longer sets up another dash; it commits The Nurse to a faster pursuit until the boost wears off. That turns every successful hit into a commitment moment, rewarding a chase build that can maintain pressure without a second teleport.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when The Nurse lands blink attacks reliably and wants the follow-up to be a long fast chase instead of another teleport. It is rare, so it appears often enough to use as a staple.

ADDON_LFChainsaw_AwardWinningChili.name: Award-Winning Chili
ADDON_LFChainsaw_AwardWinningChili.description:
A big bowl of spicy chili made famous thanks to prime meat.

Increases maximum Chainsaw Sweep duration by 0.2 seconds per charge spent.

beginner.whatItIs: Lengthens the maximum sweep duration in Bubba's Chainsaw for each charge spent at the moment of triggering. The more charges invested, the longer the sweep lasts, creating a scaling reward for committing fully.
beginner.whyItMatters: A moderate tweak that rewards a full-charge sweep over a partial one, making the decision to dump all charges feel more meaningful. A killer who commits to a long sweep gets a proportionally longer window to land a hit, which changes the risk-reward of the trigger.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a killer already has a habit of dumping all charges into a sweep and wants that commitment to pay off with extra duration. Its very rare rarity makes it a premium pick, best suited to a confident chainsaw player who rarely triggers a partial sweep.

ADDON_LFChainsaw_BeastsMarks.name: The Beast's Marks
ADDON_LFChainsaw_BeastsMarks.description:
Jagged marks cover the Chainsaw's body, punishment from the dark beast that lives in The Fog. Memories of violent reprimands fill its holder with the fear of failure.

Increases Chainsaw Sweep movement speed by 2%.Increases time required to charge the Chainsaw by 12%.

beginner.whatItIs: Trades a longer charge-up time for a faster sweep speed in Bubba's Chainsaw. The sweep covers ground more quickly, but the killer has to wait longer before the tool is ready to trigger again.
beginner.whyItMatters: A clear trade-off that suits a playstyle favoring fast, decisive sweeps over quick re-availability. The faster sweep can close a gap or chase a survivor down a hallway more effectively, at the cost of a longer vulnerable window while the chainsaw charges.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a lobby has fast-moving survivors who can outpace a slower sweep, or when a killer prefers to commit to a single fast burst rather than staying flexible. Its rare rarity makes it a considered pick, and it fits best in maps with long straight corridors where speed matters most.

ADDON_LFChainsaw_BegrimedChain.name: Begrimed Chains
ADDON_LFChainsaw_BegrimedChain.description:
This chain is stained with a foul substance that debilitates anyone it touches.

Chainsaw hits cause Survivors to drop their items.

beginner.whatItIs: Makes every Chainsaw Sweep hit knock the held item out of a survivor's hands. The hit still deals its normal effect, but the survivor loses whatever they were carrying at the moment of contact.
beginner.whyItMatters: A utility addition that turns a sweep hit into a disarming moment, which is especially valuable against survivors who rely on a tool mid-chase. Losing a medkit, a generator tool, or a flashlight in the middle of a loop can be just as punishing as the hit itself.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a survivor tends to hold a tool during a chase and the killer wants to strip that advantage on contact. Its rare rarity makes it a deliberate pick, and it shines most in a loop where the survivor is likely to be clutching a medkit or a hook.

ADDON_LFChainsaw_CarburatorGuide.name: Carburetor Tuning Guide
ADDON_LFChainsaw_CarburatorGuide.description:
A crudely drawn guide to properly adjust and tune a Chainsaw carburetor.

Automatically consume all charges when triggering a Chainsaw Sweep.Increases Chainsaw Sweep duration by 0.5 seconds.Decreases Chainsaw Sweep movement speed by 2%.

beginner.whatItIs: Dumps all remaining charges at once in Bubba's Chainsaw for a longer but slower sweep. The sweep covers more distance over a longer window, but the killer moves at a reduced speed while it is active.
beginner.whyItMatters: A bigger shift in how the chainsaw feels, because it turns every trigger into a full commitment with a longer but less mobile sweep. A killer who can predict where a survivor will be during that slow, long window gets a much wider margin for landing a hit.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a killer is comfortable predicting a survivor's loop and wants a long, slow sweep to cover more ground in one burst. Its iridescent rarity makes it a premium situational pick, best used on maps with predictable generator routes where a slow sweep can still reach its target.

ADDON_LFChainsaw_ChainsawFile.name: Chainsaw File
ADDON_LFChainsaw_ChainsawFile.description:
A file whose purpose is to hone Chainsaw chains.

Decreases tantrum duration by 0.25 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Trims the tantrum timer on Bubba's Chainsaw so the tool is ready again sooner after a failed sweep. The window of vulnerability while the chainsaw sputters is shorter, giving the killer less time to be exposed.
beginner.whyItMatters: A small but practical tweak that reduces the punishment for a missed sweep, which matters most in chases where the killer is already committed and cannot easily disengage. A shorter tantrum means fewer seconds of helplessness at the worst possible moment.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it whenever a missed sweep feels punishing because the recovery window stretches long enough for a survivor to break free and re-loop. Common rarity makes it an easy slot to fill while learning the chainsaw, so there is no reason to skip it during early experimentation.

ADDON_LFChainsaw_Chili.name: Chili
ADDON_LFChainsaw_Chili.description:
A big bowl of steaming chili to keep you fresh and strong.

Increases maximum Chainsaw Sweep duration by 0.15 seconds per charge spent.

beginner.whatItIs: A power add-on for Bubba's Chainsaw that lengthens the maximum duration of a Chainsaw Sweep for every charge spent before firing. The extra sweep time gives the killer more room to track a moving target during the swing.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer sweep covers more ground and gives the killer extra time to track a target during a chase, making each committed swing feel heavier than a stock one. It reads as a moderate shift, rewarding careful charge management over quick reactive hits.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in trials where the killer builds up multiple charges before committing, especially in long hallway chases where the extended sweep can reach a survivor hiding near a pallet. It is an uncommon rarity, so it should turn up with fair regularity over a season.

ADDON_LFChainsaw_DepthGaugeRake.name: Depth Gauge Rake
ADDON_LFChainsaw_DepthGaugeRake.description:
Tool that increases the angle of the depth gauge, making the chain eat more "wood".

Grants 1 additional Chainsaw charge.Increases time required to charge the Chainsaw by 22%.Decreases Chainsaw Sweep movement speed by 2%.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into Bubba's Chainsaw, widening the depth gauge angle so the chain eats more material. It also grants an extra charge while slowing both the recharge cycle and the sweep speed slightly.
beginner.whyItMatters: The wider bite and bonus charge make each sweep more punishing in coverage, but the slower recharge and reduced sweep speed trade raw tempo for heavier damage per swing. It reads as a bigger philosophical shift, turning the power into a slower but more deliberate tool.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a killer prefers each committed hit to do more work and is comfortable waiting longer between swings, such as against teams that play cautiously and rarely loop. It carries a very rare rarity tag, so it will not show up in every match.

ADDON_LFChainsaw_GrislyChains.name: Grisly Chain
ADDON_LFChainsaw_GrislyChains.description:
A chain with unusually hefty cutter teeth that leaves victims crippled even after being healed.

Chainsaw hits inflict Mangled for 70 seconds.

Mangled increases time required to heal by 25% and lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

beginner.whatItIs: Attaches to Bubba's Chainsaw and makes every hit leave the target Mangled, a debuff that increases the time required to heal. The effect lasts for a set duration or until the survivor is fully healed.
beginner.whyItMatters: Slowing down healing after a Chainsaw hit punishes teams that rely on quick repairs, since the Mangled survivor takes longer to recover even if a healer is nearby. It reads as a moderate shift, adding a layer of post-hit pressure that extends well beyond the moment of impact.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the killer wants to stretch out the recovery window after a hit, particularly in matches where the survivor team has multiple healers or plays aggressively after being downed. It is a rare rarity, so it will not appear in every single match.

ADDON_LFChainsaw_HomemadeMuffler.name: Homemade Muffler
ADDON_LFChainsaw_HomemadeMuffler.description:
A makeshift exhaust system made of black gas pipes.

Decreases tantrum duration by 0.5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: A Bubba's Chainsaw add-on that shortens the stun window following a misfired swing, letting the killer stand and re-aim a moment earlier. The swing itself is unchanged; only the helpless period after a miss shrinks.
beginner.whyItMatters: A shorter tantrum window means the killer wastes less time defenseless after a failed hit, reducing the punish window that survivors exploit. It reads as a small tweak, shaving a bit of vulnerability without altering the core rhythm of the power.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if a killer tends to trigger tantrums in tight corridors where even a brief stun hands the survivor a free vault. Its uncommon rarity means it shows up often enough to build around without hunting for it.

ADDON_LFChainsaw_IridescentFlesh.name: Iridescent Flesh
ADDON_LFChainsaw_IridescentFlesh.description:
A thin slice of smooth, young flesh. The veins shimmer with luminescent glow, as if life still flows within.

Hitting a Survivor with the Chainsaw replenishes its charges.Limits the maximum tantrum duration to 3 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Fits into Bubba's Chainsaw and replenishes its charges when a survivor is hit. It also caps the maximum tantrum duration at a short fixed window, shrinking the punish space after a miss.
beginner.whyItMatters: The self-replenishing charges make the power far more sustained over a long trial, since the killer does not need to wait through a full recharge cycle after each swing. Capping the tantrum at a short duration further shrinks the punish window, making it a bigger shift in overall sustain and safety compared to the stock power.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a killer wants a Chainsaw that keeps coming back for more without long downtime, especially in extended trials where the fight drags on. It is an iridescent rarity, so it is a special find that does not appear in every season.

ADDON_LFChainsaw_KnifeScratches.name: Knife Scratches
ADDON_LFChainsaw_KnifeScratches.description:
Scratches cover the Chainsaw's body, caused by a searing blade. Memories of reprimands fill its holder with the fear of failure.

Increases Chainsaw Sweep movement speed by 1.5%.Increases time required to charge the Chainsaw by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into Bubba's Chainsaw, increasing the movement speed during a sweep. It also slows the recharge time between swings, trading a bit of uptime for a faster, more aggressive swing.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra sweep speed helps the killer close distance or track a dodging survivor more effectively during the swing, but the longer recharge means the power sits idle for more time between uses. It reads as a small trade-off, swapping a bit of uptime for a sharper, faster swing.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a killer tends to miss sweeps due to speed and wants the swing to track more aggressively, such as against fast-moving survivors who slip through the default sweep arc. Carrying an uncommon rarity tag, it will show up with reasonable frequency.

ADDON_LFChainsaw_LightChassis.name: Light Chassis
ADDON_LFChainsaw_LightChassis.description:
A light and durable Chainsaw chassis with a shorter guide bar. Makes the Chainsaw easier to handle.

While revving, see the auras of Survivors within 8 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: Fits into Bubba's Chainsaw and makes the weapon easier to handle. While revving, it reveals the auras of nearby survivors, removing much of the guesswork from aiming a sweep.
beginner.whyItMatters: Seeing survivor auras during the rev phase turns a blind commitment into a more informed one, since the killer can see exactly where the target is before swinging. The handling improvement also makes the power feel lighter and more responsive. Together these changes read as a bigger shift, since the killer gains information the stock power does not provide.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a killer struggles to land sweeps in dense maps or during foggy conditions where line-of-sight is limited. It is a very rare rarity, so expect to wait a while before it appears again.

ADDON_LFChainsaw_LongGuideBar.name: Long Guide Bar
ADDON_LFChainsaw_LongGuideBar.description:
A sturdy iron replacement bar for long chains.

Increases the time the Chainsaw can be revved before triggering a tantrum by 2 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into Bubba's Chainsaw to extend the rev window, giving the killer more time to line up a swing before the machine seizes up. The extra breathing room does not change the swing's reach or damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer rev window reduces the pressure to commit immediately, which is especially helpful when chasing through tight spaces or when a survivor is looping. It reads as a small-to-moderate tweak, widening the decision space without fundamentally changing how the swing works.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a killer frequently rushes a swing and triggers a tantrum, especially in maps with narrow corridors or heavy pallet density. It is an uncommon rarity, so expect to encounter it a good number of times across trials.

ADDON_LFChainsaw_PrimerBulb.name: Primer Bulb
ADDON_LFChainsaw_PrimerBulb.description:
Pumps more gas in the ignition system to ensure a quick and powerful start.

Decreases time required to replenish a charge by 1 second.

beginner.whatItIs: Bolted onto Bubba's Chainsaw, it reduces the time required to replenish a single charge. The power is ready for its next swing slightly sooner as a result.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster charge replenishment keeps the power in a ready state more often, which matters most during long chases where the killer needs to swing again quickly. It reads as a small tweak, trimming the recharge delay without altering the swing itself.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a killer wants to minimize the gap between swings, such as in extended chases or when pursuing a survivor who keeps breaking line of sight. It is a common rarity, so it should show up with fair regularity.

ADDON_LFChainsaw_RustedChain.name: Rusted Chain
ADDON_LFChainsaw_RustedChain.description:
