This chain is covered with crusty and volatile rust spots that make injuries particularly difficult to heal.

Chainsaw hits inflict Broken for 90 seconds.

Broken prevents Survivors from being healed.

beginner.whatItIs: Attaches to Bubba's Chainsaw and inflicts Broken on hit survivors, a debuff that prevents them from being healed. The effect lasts for a set duration, stretching out the recovery period for the target.
beginner.whyItMatters: Blocking healing after a Chainsaw hit is a significant pressure tool, since it removes the healer's ability to fully restore the target and can stretch out a down state. It reads as a bigger shift, adding a denial layer that the stock power does not have.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pair it with builds that chase down a single survivor and want to cut off healer support before a rescue arrives. The very rare rarity means it will not appear every trial, so lock it in when it drops and keep it on the loadout.

ADDON_LFChainsaw_ShopLubricant.name: Shop Lubricant
ADDON_LFChainsaw_ShopLubricant.description:
An oil specifically formulated for chainsaws. A special additive prevents oil throw off.

Downing a Survivor with the Chainsaw while no other Survivors are in your Terror Radius will hide the Survivor's aura for 20 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Bolted onto Bubba's Chainsaw, it hides the downed survivor's aura for a set duration. The effect triggers when the killer downs a survivor while no other survivors are within the terror radius.
beginner.whyItMatters: Rewarding isolated downings with a hidden aura forces the remaining survivors to hunt blind, stalling rescues and giving the killer room to reset position. The effect reads as a meaningful shift because it layers a stealth bonus onto a power that is otherwise loud and visible.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a killer excels at isolating survivors and wants to punish the moment after a down, especially in trials where the survivor team relies on fast resaves. It carries a rare rarity tag, meaning it shows up less frequently than common or uncommon drops.

ADDON_LFChainsaw_SparkPlug.name: Spark Plug
ADDON_LFChainsaw_SparkPlug.description:
A clean spark plug fitted for a Chainsaw.

Decreases time required to replenish a charge by 0.5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Mounted on Bubba's Chainsaw, it reduces the time it takes to replenish a single charge. The power cycles back to ready a touch sooner, keeping it available during longer chases.
beginner.whyItMatters: Keeping the charge cycle tight means the killer rarely waits long between swings, which keeps pressure on a survivor who tries to stall near a pallet or loop a generator. The change is modest in scale, smoothing out small gaps without reshaping how the power functions.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it as a simple uptime boost when a killer wants the power ready a touch sooner, particularly in extended trials or maps with long hallway chases. It holds a common rarity, making it one of the easier add-ons to come across.

ADDON_LFChainsaw_SpeedLimiter.name: Speed Limiter
ADDON_LFChainsaw_SpeedLimiter.description:
A mechanical device that limits the amount of fuel small engines can intake at one time, forcing a constant and safe speed.

Chainsaw does not automatically trigger dying state.Get 100% more Bloodpoints for Chainsaw Hit score events.

beginner.whatItIs: Mounted on Bubba's Chainsaw, it prevents the swing from automatically triggering a dying state on the survivor. It also doubles the Bloodpoints earned from hit score events.
beginner.whyItMatters: Removing the auto-dying-state effect gives the killer more control over when a survivor is put into that state, while the extra Bloodpoints make the power a more rewarding scoring tool. It reads as a moderate shift, changing the hit outcome in a way that affects how the killer manages tempo and reward.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a killer wants more control over the moment of impact and is building a Bloodpoint-heavy loadout, such as in trials where scoring events matter for progression. It is a common rarity, so expect to encounter it often in the loot pool.

ADDON_LFChainsaw_TheGrease.name: The Grease
ADDON_LFChainsaw_TheGrease.description:
A thick yellowish ooze, concocted by the Sawyers. Used for all-purpose lubrication around their house.

Increases the time the Chainsaw can be revved before triggering a tantrum by 3 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Rigged into Bubba's Chainsaw, it lengthens the time the killer can hold a rev before a tantrum triggers. The extra breathing room makes it easier to track a moving target before committing.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extended rev window lets the killer wait out a survivor's loop break or corner turn before committing, reducing the number of forced tantrums that waste a swing. It reads as a moderate tweak focused purely on extending the aiming window without touching damage or speed.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a killer wants maximum patience during a rev, such as when chasing a survivor who constantly breaks line of sight through windows or around corners. It is a rare rarity, so it is not something to expect on every drop roll.

ADDON_LFChainsaw_VegetableOil.name: Vegetable Oil
ADDON_LFChainsaw_VegetableOil.description:
A rancid oil used as a poor quality lubricant.

Decreases Chainsaw cooldown by 0.3 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Fits into Bubba's Chainsaw and trims the overall cooldown between uses. The power cycles back to available a little sooner after a swing completes.
beginner.whyItMatters: Trimming the cooldown lets the killer re-engage faster after a miss or a landed hit, keeping the chase tempo brisk and denying survivors a comfortable breathing window. The shift is subtle in practice, nudging the pace forward without altering the swing's character.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a killer wants the cooldown trimmed just a little and the power available again without a full recharge pause, especially in maps where chases drag on through multiple hallways. It carries a common rarity tag, so it will appear with reasonable frequency.

Addon_Map_001.name: Glowing Ink
Addon_Map_001.description:
Some of the images seemed to jump right off the page.

Increases the duration of auras revealed by maps for 2 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Common, it extends how long map-revealed auras linger on the screen after the map is used. The survivor gets more time to read and absorb the information.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer reveal window makes the map more useful for planning the next move, whether that is routing around a killer or confirming which generator is closest. It is a small tweak that makes the map feel less like a snapshot and more like a moment of clarity.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the survivor wants extra time to read what a map reveals before the auras fade, making those glimpses easier to turn into a plan. Since it is a common find, it is a low-risk option whenever the offering includes a map worth using.

Addon_Map_002.name: Retardant Jelly
Addon_Map_002.description:
A slimy, translucent substance with a ghastly lavender shade. This jelly from unknown origin is highly resistant to heat.

Slows down the burning rate of the Map by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: An uncommon map add-on that slows the rate at which the map burns down after use. The survivor has more time to absorb what it reveals before the item is gone.
beginner.whyItMatters: A slower burn means the map does not vanish before the survivor has processed the layout, which matters when the reveal is showing a killer position or a nearby hook. It is a modest shift that reduces the frustration of a map expiring before the information is useful.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the survivor uses the map in fast-moving situations where processing time is tight, such as during a chase break or while deciding which way to run. At uncommon rarity it is a reasonable find that pairs well with any map-focused build.

Addon_Map_003.name: Gnarled Compass
Addon_Map_003.description:
It seems to set itself to the perfect distance every time.

Increases a map's charges by 2.

beginner.whatItIs: An uncommon map add-on that bumps up the number of charges a map carries. The survivor gets more uses before the item is fully spent.
beginner.whyItMatters: More charges let the survivor consult the map at several different points during a trial instead of banking on a single glance, which smooths out the information flow between chases. That keeps map-based decisions feeling less like a gamble and more like a steady part of the routine.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the survivor plays a long trial and expects to need map information in more than one spot, such as confirming generator progress before committing to a vault. At uncommon rarity it shows up with reasonable frequency and is a solid default pick for the map slot.

Addon_Map_004.name: Crimson Stamp
Addon_Map_004.description:
Only those with absolute confidence dared to place their seal upon the map.

The Killer's Aura is revealed within 8 meters of the beam of light.Reduces beam of light duration by 10 seconds.Reduces number of charges by 2.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into the Map and widens the killer-aura detection around the beam of light. It trades a shorter beam and fewer total uses for a bigger kill-spotting radius.
beginner.whyItMatters: Knowing where the killer is before a chase starts lets a survivor pick a safer route or bait a pallet, turning a blind sprint into a planned escape. The trade-off of a shorter, charge-limited beam means it rewards a survivor who already knows the map well enough to make every tracking moment count.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it on the Map when a team wants proactive killer awareness rather than just gate and exit-gate tracking, since it trades away some beam time and charges. Its iridescent rarity means it takes a while to find, so save it for maps where the killer's starting position is hard to predict.

Addon_Map_005.name: Odd Stamp
Addon_Map_005.description:
A stamp carved out of sturdy blonde wood. The text found at the base is incomprehensible: "kw'zvre'od". Can be used with a Map.

Increases the range of the Map tracking ability by 12 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: Enlarges the tracking range of the Map so a survivor can see farther objectives from a single use. It is a rare add-on that stretches what the Map can cover without any other trade-off.
beginner.whyItMatters: A wider tracking radius means fewer trips back to the Map and more time spent on generators or rescues, which matters most on larger maps or when the killer is keeping survivors pinned in one half. It reads as a modest but steady quality-of-life improvement rather than a gameplay shift.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if a team struggles to find every generator on the first pass, or if the killer keeps forcing survivors to re-check areas that are just outside normal range. Finding one is not too hard given its rare drop rate, so it works well as an early upgrade for any survivor who carries the Map.

Addon_Map_006.name: Unusual Stamp
Addon_Map_006.description:
A wooden stamp with a crosshatched rubber pad used to mark documents. It is unclear as to how or by whom this stamp was originally used. Can be used with a Map.

Increases the range of the Map tracking ability by 8 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: Attaches to the Map and stretches the tracking radius a little, helping a survivor spot distant generators and totems from one tracking action. The uncommon drop makes it an easy early find for any survivor who carries the Map.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra range is a small but welcome convenience, especially on sprawling maps where re-running to the Map between checks wastes precious time. It fits any build that already relies on the Map and does not ask for a change in how a survivor plays.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it whenever the uncommon drop lands in a trial and a team is chasing a full generator count, since the modest range bump makes each tracking pass cover more ground. It is not a build-defining pick, but on open maps it quietly trims the time a survivor spends double-backing across the map.

Addon_Map_007.name: Sharpened Flint
Addon_Map_007.description:
When sparked near the map, new sigils appeared in unexpected locations.

When using the map, all totems within range are revealed.

beginner.whatItIs: Reveals every totem in range the moment the Map is activated, turning a simple tracking tool into a totem-sweeping instrument. It is a very rare add-on that changes what information a survivor can pull from a single Map use.
beginner.whyItMatters: Finding all totems early removes the guesswork from cleansing, so a team can allocate who goes where instead of sending survivors to check every suspicious spot one by one. The change is a bigger shift than a range bump, because it alters how a team plans its early minutes.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it on maps where totems spawn in hard-to-see corners, or when a team wants to clear all of them before committing to a generator strategy. Its very rare drop means it will not come up often, so equip it the first time it appears and keep it on the Map until a different totem-tracking need arises.

Addon_Map_008.name: Battered Tape
Addon_Map_008.description:
Additional pieces of parchment hung loosely from the map, hastily affixed with tape.

Increases the maximum range of a map by 8 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: Extends the maximum range of the Map by a small margin, giving a survivor a slightly wider window to catch distant objectives. The rare drop makes it a modest but reliable upgrade for any Map build.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra reach means a survivor standing at the edge of a generator can still confirm a distant totem or exit gate without repositioning, which adds up over a full trial. It is a subtle comfort upgrade, the kind that makes the Map feel a little more forgiving without changing how a survivor builds around it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a team wants a small range nudge and nothing more dramatic, particularly on maps where generators sit just out of normal tracking distance. Its rare rarity keeps it accessible early in a collection run, so it is a sensible first Map upgrade for most survivors.

Addon_Map_009.name: Yellow Wire
Addon_Map_009.description:
A small electrical wire. Both ends are heavily damaged like it has been forcefully torn out of its intended location. Can be tied around a Map to enhance its aura reading ability.

Unlocks the ability to track exit gates.

beginner.whatItIs: An uncommon add-on for the Map that unlocks the ability to track exit gates. It adds exit-gate tracking to the display, a capability the base Map does not include.
beginner.whyItMatters: Knowing where every exit gate is before a chase becomes critical removes the last-minute scramble to find one, and that certainty can be the difference between escaping through a gate or being cornered in an open field. That is a bigger shift than a range increase, because it changes what information a survivor can act on at all.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it the first time an uncommon Map drop appears, since exit-gate tracking fills a gap that the base Map does not cover. It is especially useful in trials where a team wants a clear, pre-planned escape route and is tired of one survivor wandering blindly looking for a gate.

Addon_Medkit_001.name: Bandages
Addon_Medkit_001.description:
A pack of bandages usually found in first aid kits.

Adds 8 charges to the Med-kit.

beginner.whatItIs: Adds extra charges to the Med-kit, stretching a single healing item across more survivors. It is the most basic common option available and has no side effects or trade-offs.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a straightforward quantity upgrade with no side effects, giving a Med-kit more healing to spend across a full trial. It is a solid, low-risk pick for any survivor who wants steady access to more heals.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a Med-kit is the main healing tool a survivor is carrying and the team wants it to absorb more hits before breaking down. Its common rarity means it will show up early in most trials, so there is no reason to sit on it while hunting for a fancier drop unless a specific healing strategy demands otherwise.

Addon_Medkit_002.name: Gel Dressings
Addon_Medkit_002.description:
A pack of gel forming pads used to patch up heavily exudating wounds.

Adds 16 charges to the Med-kit.

beginner.whatItIs: More than doubles the charge count of the Med-kit, turning a single healing item into a multi-use resource for an entire team. The iridescent rarity marks it as a late-game find that rewards a survivor with a full healing budget.
beginner.whyItMatters: A Med-kit that can heal multiple survivors in one trial shifts the team's damage budget considerably, because fewer survivors are left with nothing after the first round of chases. It reads as a meaningful upgrade over the common charge add-ons without requiring any change in how a survivor heals.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it on any team where a single Med-kit is expected to cover more than one or two survivors, especially in longer trials where everyone gets hit at least once. Its iridescent rarity makes it a late-game find, so equip it once it drops and keep it on the Med-kit for the rest of the collection run.

Addon_Medkit_003.name: Medical Scissors
Addon_Medkit_003.description:
Scissors designed to easily cut through textiles.

Increases healing speed by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into the Med-kit and speeds up the healing animation, shaving a small amount of time off every heal. The uncommon drop makes it a practical mid-game upgrade for any survivor who heals often.
beginner.whyItMatters: A faster heal means less time standing still in a vulnerable state, which is exactly the window a killer wants to punish. The change is modest, but over a full trial those saved seconds add up and can keep a survivor out of the killer's next attack window.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a survivor wants to minimize the time spent stationary while healing, particularly near pallets or window vaults where a quick heal-and-move is the plan. Its uncommon rarity makes it a mid-tier choice that slots in without much effort.

Addon_Medkit_004.name: Butterfly Tape
Addon_Medkit_004.description:
Medical quality tape used to close small wounds.

Increases healing speed by 5%.

beginner.whatItIs: Patches small wounds to speed up healing slightly, trimming a bit of time off every heal animation. It is a common Med-kit add-on with no drawbacks, a safe first upgrade for any healing build.
beginner.whyItMatters: The speed boost is small but consistent, and in a tight chase where a survivor is healing at a generator with a killer nearby, those extra fractions of a second can be the margin between finishing a heal and getting caught. It is a mild speed bump and a safe early pick for any survivor who wants a small healing advantage.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a Med-kit is the team's only healing source and a survivor wants a small speed edge without committing to a rarer drop. Its common rarity means it will appear early in a collection, making it a fine first Med-kit upgrade before anything iridescent shows up.

Addon_Medkit_005.name: Sponge
Addon_Medkit_005.description:
A mundane sponge used to soak up extra blood, providing easier access to wounds.

Increases the Bonus skill check size by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: Attaches to the Med-kit and widens the bonus skill-check window, making it easier to land a perfect heal. The uncommon rarity keeps it within easy reach for a survivor who wants a more forgiving timing check.
beginner.whyItMatters: A bigger bonus window means fewer whiffs on the skill check, which is helpful for a survivor who tends to miss the timing under pressure. The bonus heal it enables is worth extra healing and can be the difference between a full heal and a partial one on a critical moment.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a survivor struggles with the Med-kit skill check and wants the bonus window to be more forgiving, especially in trials where a clean bonus heal can swing a generator race. Its uncommon rarity keeps it within reach, so it is a practical mid-game upgrade for anyone who heals a lot.

Addon_Medkit_006.name: Rubber Gloves
Addon_Medkit_006.description:
Disposable medical gloves to avoid cross-contamination.

Increases the Bonus skill check size by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Widens the bonus skill-check window on the Med-kit by a smaller margin, giving a survivor a modest timing boost. It is a common pick that helps without demanding any change in how a survivor approaches healing.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra window is subtle but real, and for a survivor who is still learning the rhythm of a Med-kit heal it removes some of the pressure to hit the check perfectly. It is a low-stakes upgrade that helps without demanding a change in how a survivor approaches healing.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it early in a collection run when no other Med-kit add-on has dropped yet, since it quietly widens the bonus skill check window without any downside. Its common rarity keeps it out of the way, so slot it in without hesitation and swap it out later if a rarer drop changes the plan.

Addon_Medkit_007.name: Styptic Agent
Addon_Medkit_007.description:
A white powder with coagulant properties. Apply the agent to a wound to stop it from hemorrhaging.

Increases the efficiency when healing yourself with a Medkit by 15%.

beginner.whatItIs: A very rare add-on for the Med-kit that boosts healing efficiency when a survivor heals themselves. The self-heal efficiency bump makes it a standout drop for isolated survivors who cannot rely on a teammate.
beginner.whyItMatters: Self-healing is a moment where a survivor does not need to wait for a teammate, and making that heal more efficient is a meaningful shift for anyone who ends up far from their group. It turns a routine recovery into something noticeably snappier, which matters most in late-trial situations where no one is nearby to offer help.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Slot it onto a survivor who frequently ends up far from the group, since the self-heal efficiency bump is wasted if a teammate is always within reach to share the workload. Its very rare rarity makes it a standout drop, so let it ride through the rest of the trial once it surfaces.

Addon_Medkit_008.name: Anti-Exhaustion Syringe
Addon_Medkit_008.description:
A mysterious fluid that reinvigorates both body and mind.

Press the Secondary Action button while healing with the Med-kit to use the Anti-Exhaustion Syringe.The affected Survivor loses the Exhausted Status Effect upon use.Consumes the Med-kit on use.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating exhausting perks.

beginner.whatItIs: An iridescent add-on for the Med-kit that lets a survivor use the Secondary Action button during a heal to remove the Exhausted status. The entire Med-kit is consumed on use, which makes it a high-stakes emergency tool rather than a passive upgrade.
beginner.whyItMatters: Exhaustion locks out a survivor's most important escape perks, so clearing it mid-trial can turn a stranded, exhausted survivor back into an active one. The trade-off is the whole Med-kit, which makes it a high-stakes, high-reward choice rather than a passive upgrade.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it on a survivor who carries at least one exhausting perk and wants a backup plan for when that perk is down, since the syringe restores the ability to use it. Finding one is a late-game event, so equip it on the survivor most likely to need an emergency exhaustion reset.

ADDON_medkit_abdominaldressing.name: Abdominal Dressing
ADDON_medkit_abdominaldressing.description:
A highly absorbent pad that prevents bodily fluid leakage when applied to large abdominal wounds.

Increases healing speed by 15%.

beginner.whatItIs: The Abdominal Dressing is a very rare Med-kit add-on that speeds up healing for both the user and the injured survivor. It is a pure healing-speed boost with no trade-offs.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster healing means fewer seconds spent vulnerable next to a generator or in a locker while the patch completes. It matters most when a killer is hunting and the heal needs to finish before they arrive.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in matches where multiple hits are expected and each one needs to close quickly. Its very rare rarity means treat it as a strong find rather than a baseline expectation.

Addon_Medkit_BlightedSyringe.name: Refined Serum
Addon_Medkit_BlightedSyringe.description:
A refined version of the putrid serum that’s mostly safe for human consumption. Mostly.

Press the Secondary Action button while healing with the Med-kit to use the Refined Serum.Grants the Survivor 5% Haste and increases their field of view by 10 degrees for 20 seconds.Creates a blight trail behind the Survivor.Consumes the Med-kit on use.

beginner.whatItIs: Trades the Med-kit for a short burst of speed and wider vision, a common add-on that also creates a blight trail behind the survivor who uses it. The common rarity means it will drop often, making it a low-cost experiment for a survivor who needs a burst of mobility.
beginner.whyItMatters: The haste and vision boost can carry a survivor through a dangerous stretch of open ground or a long generator walk, but the blight trail gives the killer a clear line to follow. It is a risky gamble that rewards a survivor who is confident they can outrun the chase for the duration of the effect.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a team wants a last-ditch escape tool and the survivor carrying the Med-kit is comfortable leaving a trail for the killer to track. It is common enough to surface frequently, so it is worth slotting on a survivor who can use a quick sprint boost to break free from a tight corner.

ADDON_medkit_gauzeroll.name: Gauze Roll
ADDON_medkit_gauzeroll.description:
A sterile gauze used for a variety of wounds. Part of a total wound care system.

Adds 10 charges to the Med-kit.

beginner.whatItIs: Rare in the item pool, the Gauze Roll adds extra charges to the Med-kit so it lasts longer across a match. It is a straightforward charge extension with no other effects.
beginner.whyItMatters: More charges mean a survivor who keeps taking hits can patch themselves without hunting for another Med-kit. It is a big quality-of-life shift for any role that heals a lot throughout the trial.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the survivor role expects to self-heal frequently, such as when running to injured teammates repeatedly. It drops at a rare rate and will show up in a fair share of matches.

ADDON_medkit_needleandthread.name: Needle & Thread
ADDON_medkit_needleandthread.description:
Not exactly a medical device, however it can be used to quickly and painfully close up a wound.

Increases the chances of triggering a Skill Check by 10%.Increases progression bonus for succeeding Great Skill Checks by 5%.

beginner.whatItIs: Raises the odds of triggering a Skill Check while healing and adds a bonus payoff whenever a Great Skill Check succeeds. It trades a bit of extra risk for a chance at a stronger healing outcome.
beginner.whyItMatters: The added Skill Check risk means more failed checks can slow a heal down, but landing a Great success pushes that heal further ahead than a normal patch-up would. It rewards precise timing under pressure during a heal rather than a steady, risk-free approach.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when Skill Checks feel comfortable and the upside of a stronger healing outcome on a successful patch-up is worth the added risk. It is an uncommon find, so it should turn up with fair regularity.

ADDON_medkit_selfadherentwrap.name: Self Adherent Wrap
ADDON_medkit_selfadherentwrap.description:
A pack of bandages that sticks to themselves without the need of clips for a faster patch-up that requires less readjustments.

Adds 8 charges to the Med-kit.Increases healing speed by 5%.

beginner.whatItIs: Uncommon and straightforward, the Self Adherent Wrap adds extra charges to the Med-kit and a small bump to healing speed. It improves two things at once without adding any new risk.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra charges extend how long the Med-kit stays useful, and the speed bump shortens the vulnerable window during each heal. Together they make it a steady all-around improvement over the base item.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a Med-kit should last longer and patch faster without introducing any Skill Check risk. It is uncommon and will rotate through the item pool with reasonable frequency.

ADDON_medkit_surgicalsuture.name: Surgical Suture
ADDON_medkit_surgicalsuture.description:
A medical device used to close and hold body tissue. Even though it's very effective, the surgical suture is challenging to use.

Increases the chances of triggering a Skill Check by 15%.Increases progression bonus for succeeding Great Skill Checks by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Rare and high-risk, the Surgical Suture significantly raises the Skill Check chance and boosts the Great check bonus more than Needle & Thread does. It is the more extreme version of the same trade-off.
beginner.whyItMatters: The higher risk of a failed check can waste some progress, but landing a Great check delivers a noticeably bigger boost to that heal than any other Med-kit add-on offers. It is a high-variance tool that rewards confidence in the timing window.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when Skill Check reflexes are reliable and a successful heal should push further ahead rather than just close a wound at the normal pace. Because it is a rare find in the item pool, plan around the matches where it actually shows up rather than assuming it will be there.

Addon_PhantomTrap_BloodiedMud.name: Bloodied Mud
Addon_PhantomTrap_BloodiedMud.description:
A handful of mud with veins of deep crimson. The bloody layers empower the mud.

Decreases Phantasm Trap trigger range by 30%.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into Blackened Catalyst and shrinks the Phantasm Trap trigger range the most of the liquid and mud options. The rare add-on gives a killer more control over where traps fire, reducing accidental activations on nearby loops.
beginner.whyItMatters: A tighter trigger range means traps fire only when a survivor is very close, reducing the chance that a distant loop accidentally pops a trap and wastes a setup. It is a moderate shift in how the power plays, rewarding a killer who places traps with precision.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a killer wants traps to feel more deliberate and less like random landmines, particularly on maps with tight loops where a wide trigger range causes too many wasted activations. Its rare rarity makes it a mid-tier find, good for a killer who is past the very early learning phase.

Addon_PhantomTrap_BloodiedWater.name: Bloodied Water
Addon_PhantomTrap_BloodiedWater.description:
Tainted water contained in a folded waterlily leaf.

Decreases Phantasm Trap trigger range by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: An uncommon add-on for Blackened Catalyst that narrows the Phantasm Trap trigger range by a moderate amount. It sits between the mild and the aggressive options, offering a balanced middle ground for trap placement.
beginner.whyItMatters: The reduced trigger range gives a killer a little more forgiveness on placement, since a trap will not fire on a survivor who was merely passing near the zone. It reads as a balanced middle ground, neither too tight to be frustrating nor too loose to be wasted.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a killer is still learning where traps land best and wants a slightly smaller trigger zone than the default without going all the way to the rare option. Its uncommon rarity makes it easy to find, so it is a sensible default for a Blackened Catalyst build while a killer dials in trap placement.

Addon_PhantomTrap_BogWater.name: Bog Water
Addon_PhantomTrap_BogWater.description:
Murky water contained in a glass pill bottle from another time.

Decreases Phantasm Trap trigger range by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Shrinks the Phantasm Trap trigger range by the least of the liquid options, a common add-on that offers a small tweak to how traps activate. The common rarity means it will appear early and often, making it a safe first step for a new killer.
beginner.whyItMatters: The small reduction is enough to cut down a few accidental triggers without fundamentally changing how a killer plans trap placement, making it a gentle first step into refining the power. It is the kind of add-on that a new killer will appreciate before graduating to the rarer, tighter options.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it the first time a common drop lands on a Blackened Catalyst build, since it is a safe, low-risk improvement that does not ask for a change in trap strategy. It will show up early and often given its common rarity, so it is a fine placeholder until a rarer water or mud add-on arrives.

Addon_PhantomTrap_CrackedTurtleEgg.name: Cracked Turtle Egg
Addon_PhantomTrap_CrackedTurtleEgg.description:
A pale orange turtle egg, cracked and emptied of its content.

Increases triggered Phantasm Trap duration by 30%.

beginner.whatItIs: Lengthens the duration of triggered Phantasm Traps, a rare add-on for Blackened Catalyst that gives a killer more time to punish a trapped survivor. The longer window means a killer has more room to re-engage after a trap pops.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer trap duration means a survivor who breaks free still has less breathing room, because the killer has a wider window to re-engage or set up the next hit. The change is meaningful for a killer who wants traps to feel like a sustained threat rather than a brief nuisance.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a killer wants every triggered trap to feel weighty and is comfortable closing out a chase while the effect is still active. Finding one takes patience given its rare drop, but it is a worthwhile upgrade for a Blackened Catalyst build that already places traps reliably.

Addon_PhantomTrap_CypressNecklet.name: Cypress Necklet
Addon_PhantomTrap_CypressNecklet.description:
A rigid ornament worn around the neck made from dead plants adorned with crudely attached cypress bark and swamp moss.

Increases Phantasm Trap setting speed by 15%.

beginner.whatItIs: A Blackened Catalyst add-on of uncommon rarity that shortens the time it takes to set down Phantasm Traps, letting a killer lay down more snares during a chase. The faster placement is a real advantage in sustained pursuits where a killer needs to adapt trap positions on the fly.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster trap setting means a killer can adapt to a survivor's movement in real time, dropping new traps in the next loop instead of waiting for the animation to finish. The change is modest but noticeable in a sustained chase, where every second of setup time is a second a survivor can use to break the pattern.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a killer wants to keep up with fast, looping survivors and does not want the trap-setting animation to become a bottleneck. Its uncommon rarity keeps it within easy reach, so it is a practical upgrade for any Blackened Catalyst build that leans on trap density.

Addon_PhantomTrap_DeadFlyMud.name: Dead Fly Mud
Addon_PhantomTrap_DeadFlyMud.description:
A small lump of mud, black with the remains of flies. Devoured to increase stamina.

Increases teleportation range by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: A small lump of black mud, Dead Fly Mud slots into Blackened Catalyst to stretch how far The Hag can jump between her Phantasm Traps. It is common enough to appear frequently, making it an easy early upgrade to grab. The wider reach lets her reposition to distant traps without committing to a long walk across open ground.
beginner.whyItMatters: A slightly longer teleport reach gives more options when repositioning, making it easier to jump across a map without leaving vulnerable gaps. It is a small convenience tweak rather than a gameplay overhaul.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in early matches when learning where Phantasm Traps should go, since the extra reach forgives imperfect trap placement. Being common rarity, it is easy to find and a safe default.

Addon_PhantomTrap_DisfiguredEar.name: Disfigured Ear
Addon_PhantomTrap_DisfiguredEar.description:
The cannibal village deaf boy's ear. Deformed due to several hits to the head. The trapped life essence within unlocks tremendous potential in The Hag's power.

Survivors who trigger a Phantasm Trap will be deafened for 6 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: A very rare add-on, Disfigured Ear slots into Blackened Catalyst and deafens any survivor who steps into a triggered Phantasm Trap. The essence trapped in a deaf boy's deformed ear gives The Hag's power a cruel new edge. Survivors lose all audio cues for a brief moment, making it far harder to track pallet swings or hear approaching footsteps while they try to escape the mud.
beginner.whyItMatters: Losing sound cues mid-chase removes the audio tell that warns a survivor a trap has fired, which can turn a clean escape into a confused stumble. This is a meaningful shift because the trap now punishes attention as much as speed.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when facing survivors who rely heavily on sound to dodge loops, since the sudden silence at the worst moment throws their timing off. It is very rare, so slot it in when the grind pays off and a deafening effect feels right for a specific matchup.

Addon_PhantomTrap_DragonflyWings.name: Dragonfly Wings
Addon_PhantomTrap_DragonflyWings.description:
A handful of yellowish wings, dry and crisp. Devoured to increase stamina.

Increases teleportation range by 12.5%.

beginner.whatItIs: Dragonfly Wings are dry, crisp fragments that slot into Blackened Catalyst to push The Hag's hop distance well past the base range. Found as an uncommon drop, they offer a clear step up in mobility over the unmodified power. The extra reach makes it easier to chain jumps across the map when survivors scatter in different directions.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra distance means traps placed at the edge of a room or across a hallway become reachable in one hop, tightening map control without demanding a perfect spot. It reads as a modest upgrade layered on top of the default teleport.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when traps are being placed in spread-out positions across a map, since the longer reach connects distant traps into one continuous repositioning chain. Being uncommon, it is findable without an excessive grind.

Addon_PhantomTrap_DriedCicada.name: Dried Cicada
Addon_PhantomTrap_DriedCicada.description:
A large swamp cicada covered in a fine layer of ash. Crispy. Devoured to increase stamina.

Increases teleportation range by 15%.

beginner.whatItIs: A large swamp cicada coated in fine ash, Dried Cicada slots into Blackened Catalyst and stretches The Hag's teleport range considerably beyond what the base power allows. As a rare drop it takes more effort to locate, but the payoff is a meaningful boost to repositioning. The wider reach rewards careful trap placement, letting her hop to far corners without losing time to a long walk.
beginner.whyItMatters: The wider reach lets The Hag close more of the distance between traps that used to require a long walk, making repositioning around a cluster of nearby traps noticeably smoother. It reads as a meaningful upgrade because it cuts down on the travel penalty between traps that sit a bit farther apart, without turning teleport into a map-wide tool.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in matches where The Hag is playing aggressively across multiple map zones, since the long reach keeps the pressure rotating. It is rare, so the grind is worth it for players who want wide teleport flexibility.

Addon_PhantomTrap_GranmasHeart.name: Grandma's Heart
Addon_PhantomTrap_GranmasHeart.description:
The cold heart of the cannibal village elder. The trapped life essence within unlocks tremendous potential in The Hag's power.

Decreases Terror Radius to 0 meters when a Survivor triggers a Phantasm Trap.Increases Mud Phantasms' Terror Radius by 16 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: The cold heart of the village elder, it slots into Blackened Catalyst and reshapes how her traps function. When a survivor triggers a Phantasm Trap, The Hag's own terror radius vanishes entirely, removing her audio signal from the survivor's senses. At the same time, any Mud Phantasms already on the field emit a much larger terror radius of their own, making them easier for survivors to notice and avoid from farther away.
beginner.whyItMatters: The trade-off is a bigger shift in play: The Hag loses her own terror-radius warning at the worst moment, but her Mud Phantasms become a much louder, more noticeable presence on the field in exchange. Each triggered trap leaves behind a phantom that survivors have to actively route around rather than something that quietly ambushes them.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when The Hag wants traps to do double duty as both repositioning points and roaming sensors, which rewards a more active, map-covering style. Being very rare, it suits players who already have a trap layout they trust.

Addon_PhantomTrap_HalfEggshell.name: Half Eggshell
Addon_PhantomTrap_HalfEggshell.description:
One half of a perfectly round hollow eggshell.

Increases triggered Phantasm Trap duration by 25%.

beginner.whatItIs: One half of a perfectly round hollow shell, Half Eggshell slots into Blackened Catalyst and keeps a triggered Phantasm Trap active for a longer stretch after the survivor steps in. It is an uncommon drop, so it shows up with reasonable frequency during trials. The extended duration gives survivors less breathing room to wriggle free, making each trap a more persistent threat on the ground.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer active window gives more time to teleport to the trap or for the Mud Phantasm to finish its patrol before the trap resets, which is useful when a chase is still ongoing after the trigger. It is a straightforward duration buff without changing how the trap itself feels.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when chases tend to drag on after a trap fires and The Hag needs the trap to stay useful for a second escape attempt. Being uncommon, it is a reasonable default for trap-focused play.

Addon_PhantomTrap_MintRag.name: Mint Rag
Addon_PhantomTrap_MintRag.description:
A small piece of cotton torn from the dress worn by Lisa Sherwood on the day she disappeared. The trapped life essence within unlocks tremendous potential in The Hag's power.

The Hag can teleport to any Phantasm Trap in the level.Phantasm Trap teleport gains a cooldown of 10 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Mint Rag slots into Blackened Catalyst and lets The Hag teleport to any Phantasm Trap on the map instead of just the nearest one. It is an iridescent find that turns her repositioning into a far more deliberate choice, since a short cooldown sits between each jump. The rag itself is a torn scrap from Lisa Sherwood's dress, the trapped life essence inside unlocking this expanded reach.
beginner.whyItMatters: Removing the range limit entirely is a huge shift: The Hag can now chain teleport across the entire map, making trap placement a pure map-control tool rather than a local repositioning aid. The cooldown keeps it from becoming an infinite hop chain, so timing each jump matters.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when The Hag is running a full trap network across the map and wants to punish survivors who rotate between generators. Being iridescent, it is the hardest rarity to obtain and suits a finished trap layout.

Addon_PhantomTrap_PowderedEggshell.name: Powdered Eggshell
Addon_PhantomTrap_PowderedEggshell.description:
Minuscule eggshell fragments shimmering with a pale golden hue.

Increases triggered Phantasm Trap duration by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: Minuscule eggshell fragments with a pale golden shimmer, Powdered Eggshell slots into Blackened Catalyst and extends how long a triggered Phantasm Trap lingers before the mud releases the survivor. Being a common drop, it is one of the easier upgrades to find and equip early. The longer duration means survivors spend more time stuck in the mud, making each placement a heavier commitment for them to escape.
beginner.whyItMatters: A slightly longer active window gives a small cushion to teleport to the trap or let the Mud Phantasm finish its work before the trap resets. It is a modest convenience buff that keeps the trap useful a beat longer than the base duration.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in early play or when The Hag is still building trap confidence, since the extra time forgives a slow teleport after a trigger. Being common, it is an easy pick and a safe default.

Addon_PhantomTrap_PussyWillowCatkins.name: Pussy Willow Catkins
Addon_PhantomTrap_PussyWillowCatkins.description:
A handful of small, pristine flower clusters covered in a fine greyish fur.

Reveals the Survivor's aura for 3 seconds when they trigger a Phantasm Trap.

beginner.whatItIs: Soft greyish flower clusters, Pussy Willow Catkins slot into Blackened Catalyst and flash a survivor's aura the instant they step into a triggered Phantasm Trap. As an uncommon drop they are relatively easy to come across. The brief aura reveal gives The Hag a window to lock onto the survivor's exact position before they scramble away into the dark.
beginner.whyItMatters: The short aura reveal confirms exactly where the survivor went after triggering, which is useful when the trap fires in a dark corner or behind cover. It is a small information gain that helps target the next chase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when The Hag is losing track of survivors after a trap fires in a complex area with many exits. Being uncommon, it pairs well with builds focused on information and follow-up chases.

Addon_PhantomTrap_RopeNecklet.name: Rope Necklet
Addon_PhantomTrap_RopeNecklet.description:
A rigid ornament worn around the neck made from dead plants.

Increases Phantasm Trap setting speed by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Rope Necklet is a common ornament made from dead plants that slots into Blackened Catalyst, making The Hag place each Phantasm Trap quicker. The faster setup lets her lock down corridors and loop corners before survivors adjust their route. Being a common drop, it is easy to find and quick to equip between chases.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster trap placement means fewer moments of vulnerability while setting up, and more traps laid down in the same downtime window. It is a small but consistent improvement for anyone who places a lot of traps during a match.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when The Hag is placing traps during long chases or between gens and wants to minimize the window of being stationary. Being common, it is a safe and easy pick for anyone running Blackened Catalyst.

Addon_PhantomTrap_RustyShackles.name: Rusty Shackles
Addon_PhantomTrap_RustyShackles.description:
Shackles once used to hold prisoners and carcasses in the cannibal village cellar. The trapped life essence within unlocks tremendous potential in The Hag's power.

Triggered Phantasm Traps give no indication of being triggered to Survivors and do not spawn a Mud Phantasm.

beginner.whatItIs: Shackles that once held prisoners and carcasses in the village cellar, Rusty Shackles slot into Blackened Catalyst and change the character of her traps entirely. Once triggered, a Phantasm Trap reveals no sign to survivors that it has activated, and no Mud Phantasm spawns to mark the location. Survivors can walk right past a triggered trap without any warning, which turns her setup into a silent ambush.
beginner.whyItMatters: Removing the visual and audio cue is a bigger shift because it turns the trap into a pure teleport node that survivors never know fired. The absence of the Mud Phantasm means losing the roaming detector, so the trade is stealth over tracking.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when The Hag wants a silent teleport network and plans to hunt by sight and sound rather than by Phantasm patrols. Being very rare, it suits a deliberate stealth-focused build.

Addon_PhantomTrap_ScarredHand.name: Scarred Hand
Addon_PhantomTrap_ScarredHand.description:
The cut up, severed hand of the cannibal village butcher. The trapped life essence within unlocks tremendous potential in The Hag's power.

Mud Phantasms become solid and will block Survivors.Removes the ability to teleport to traps.Grants 300% bonus Deviousness Bloodpoints.

beginner.whatItIs: The severed, scarred hand of the village butcher, Scarred Hand slots into Blackened Catalyst and transforms Mud Phantasms into solid barriers that block survivors in their path. In exchange, The Hag loses her ability to teleport to traps, while gaining a large bonus to Deviousness bloodpoints. It is a very rare drop, and the trade-off shifts her entire playstyle from mobile repositioning to holding territory with solid obstacles.
beginner.whyItMatters: Losing teleport is a massive trade: The Hag can no longer hop between traps, but each Mud Phantasm becomes a wall that forces survivors to change direction. This is a fundamental shift from repositioning to area denial.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the goal is to lock down narrow passages and generator corners with solid Mud Phantasms that survivors cannot phase through. It suits a killer who is comfortable staying put and letting the traps do the blocking, since teleport is gone entirely. The very rare drop rate makes it a deliberate commitment, so pick it when the map layout rewards static control over mobility.

Addon_PhantomTrap_SwampOrchidNecklet.name: Swamp Orchid Necklet
Addon_PhantomTrap_SwampOrchidNecklet.description:
A rigid ornament worn around the neck made from dead plants adorned with withered orchid petals and leaves.

Increases Phantasm Trap setting speed by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: Swamp Orchid Necklet slots into Blackened Catalyst and gives The Hag a noticeably faster Phantasm Trap placement speed. Made from dead plants adorned with withered orchid petals, it is a rare drop that rewards hunters who dig for less common finds. The quicker setup pushes her tempo toward filling key paths and corners with traps before survivors can adapt.
beginner.whyItMatters: A larger reduction in placement time means traps go down almost instantly, which keeps The Hag mobile and reduces the vulnerable pause between setups. It reads as a meaningful upgrade over the smaller speed option in the same slot.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it whenever The Hag wants to chain chases with less dead time between trap drops. As a rare find, it rewards the grind, and the faster placement keeps pressure rolling without gaps.

Addon_PhantomTrap_WaterloggedShoe.name: Waterlogged Shoe
Addon_PhantomTrap_WaterloggedShoe.description:
A child's shoe, long lost in the bog's waters. The trapped life essence within unlocks tremendous potential in The Hag's power.

Survivors in the trigger zone of a triggered Phantasm Trap are Hindered by 9%.Increases movement speed by 7.5%.Removes the ability to teleport to traps.

Hindered reduces Survivor movement speed.

beginner.whatItIs: An iridescent upgrade for Blackened Catalyst, Waterlogged Shoe slows survivors who linger in the trigger zone of a triggered Phantasm Trap and quickens The Hag's own pace. It strips away the teleport-to-trap ability in exchange, trading a free reposition for a heavier area-control footprint.
beginner.whyItMatters: The trade is significant: The Hag walks faster and traps slow survivors down, but teleport is gone entirely. This shifts the power from a teleport tool into a speed-and-slow hybrid that rewards aggressive walking and zone control.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when The Hag wants to lean into pure chase speed and zone denial, sacrificing the repositioning hop for stronger close-range pressure. Being iridescent, it is an endgame pick for players who have outgrown the teleport playstyle.

Addon_PhantomTrap_WillowWreath.name: Willow Wreath
Addon_PhantomTrap_WillowWreath.description:
Three frail willow branches attached to form a triangular wreath.

Reveals the Survivor's aura for 5 seconds when they trigger a Phantasm Trap.

beginner.whatItIs: Willow Wreath is a rare upgrade for Blackened Catalyst that reveals a survivor's aura briefly after they step into a Phantasm Trap's trigger zone. That short glimpse is enough to confirm their direction and plan the next push.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extended reveal gives more time to spot which exit the survivor took after a trap fires, which is useful in open areas with multiple escape routes. It is a solid information boost that supports cleaner follow-up chases.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when The Hag is playing in maps with wide open corridors where a brief reveal is not enough to track a survivor's rotation. Being rare, it is a solid pick for information-focused builds.

Addon_PhaseWalker_BloodyHairBrooch.name: Mother's Glasses
Addon_PhaseWalker_BloodyHairBrooch.description:
Pair of glasses belonging to a loving mother afflicted with a chronic disease.

Survivors trigger Killer Instinct when they come within 2 meters of the husk.

beginner.whatItIs: Mother's Glasses, a rare find for Yamaoka's Haunting, sets off Killer Instinct whenever a survivor drifts close to the husk. The tight trigger range makes it a precision tool, rewarding The Spirit for holding ground near the husk instead of chasing far off.
beginner.whyItMatters: The short-range trigger punishes survivors who try to camp near the husk or use it as cover, turning what would be a safe hiding spot into a dangerous one. It is a modest addition that adds a small penalty to one specific survivor behavior.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when survivors are abusing the husk as a hiding spot or using it to break line of sight during a chase. Being rare, it is a targeted counter to a specific survivor habit rather than a broad gameplay change.

Addon_PhaseWalker_DirtyUwabaki.name: Uchiwa
Addon_PhaseWalker_DirtyUwabaki.description:
Handheld fan with a koi motif to create a nice breeze on a hot summer day.

Instantly recharges Yamaoka's Haunting when stunned by a pallet.

beginner.whatItIs: Uchiwa is a rare fan-themed add-on for Yamaoka's Haunting that instantly recharges the haunting the moment The Spirit is stunned by a pallet hit. The stagger from a dodge becomes a free reset, letting The Spirit re-engage with full pressure before the survivor can breathe.
beginner.whyItMatters: Getting the haunting back immediately after a pallet stun removes the downtime that usually follows a failed chase, which keeps pressure on survivors who bait pallets to escape. It is a meaningful shift because it turns a defensive moment back into an offensive one.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when The Spirit is dealing with pallet-heavy chases and needs to recover quickly after a stun. Being rare, it rewards the grind for a smoother recovery playstyle.

Addon_PhaseWalker_DriedCherryBlossom.name: Dried Cherry Blossom
Addon_PhaseWalker_DriedCherryBlossom.description:
A crumbling, dried cherry flower. Once the symbol of mortality.

Survivors trigger Killer Instinct when they come within 3 meters of The Spirit while she is phasing.Scratch marks are no longer visible while using Yamaoka’s Haunting.

beginner.whatItIs: Dried Cherry Blossom is a very rare add-on for Yamaoka's Haunting that triggers Killer Instinct on survivors near The Spirit during phasing and hides the scratch marks normally visible while haunting. Phasing becomes both a pressuring tool and a ghost, pushing survivors from close range while staying harder to track on the map.
beginner.whyItMatters: The longer-range Killer Instinct plus the hidden scratch marks is a bigger shift: survivors lose both the early warning and the visual cue, making phasing feel far more dangerous. It turns The Spirit's phantom state into a genuine threat rather than just a repositioning tool.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when The Spirit wants to punish survivors who camp near her or who track her through walls using the scratch marks. Being very rare, it suits a stealthy, information-denied playstyle.

Addon_PhaseWalker_FathersGlasses.name: Kintsugi Teacup
Addon_PhaseWalker_FathersGlasses.description:
Cup mended and lacquered with powdered gold. Both the breakage and repair are part the cup.

Whenever you basic-break Pallets or Breakable Walls, instantly recharge Yamaoka's Haunting.

beginner.whatItIs: The iridescent Kintsugi Teacup slots into Yamaoka's Haunting and recharges the haunting the moment The Spirit smashes a pallet or breakable wall. Each broken piece of cover becomes a fresh offensive window, so The Spirit's destruction of obstacles doubles as fuel for her next dash. It is a lacquered cup mended with powdered gold, the breakage and repair both part of the whole.
beginner.whyItMatters: Tying the recharge to basic-breaks means the more actively The Spirit is destroying obstacles, the more often the haunting is available, creating a positive feedback loop during aggressive chases. It is a big shift that rewards a destruction-heavy playstyle.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when The Spirit is running an aggressive, pallet-breaking build and wants the haunting to stay available through constant destruction. Being iridescent, it is an endgame pick that complements a fast, destructive approach.

Addon_PhaseWalker_GiftedBambooComb.name: Gifted Bamboo Comb
Addon_PhaseWalker_GiftedBambooComb.description:
A narrow tooth bamboo comb to gently untangle disheveled hair.

Increases Yamaoka's Haunting charge speed by 15%.

beginner.whatItIs: Gifted Bamboo Comb is a common add-on for Yamaoka's Haunting that speeds up how quickly the haunting recharges after each use. It is a straightforward quality-of-life tweak that keeps The Spirit's pressure rolling with less downtime between haunts.
beginner.whyItMatters: A faster recharge means less downtime between haunts, which keeps The Spirit mobile and reduces the window where survivors can reposition safely. It is a straightforward utility buff without changing how the haunting itself works.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Slap it on whenever The Spirit wants the haunting ready more often without spending a rarer slot. Its common rarity keeps it easy to find, and the charge speed bonus keeps the haunting loop tight.

Addon_PhaseWalker_JuniperBonsai.name: Juniper Bonsai
Addon_PhaseWalker_JuniperBonsai.description:
Dark blue-green foliage bonsai tree. Once the symbol of Yamaoka family tradition.

Increases Passive Phasing frequency by 20%.Increases Passive Phasing duration by 50%.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into Yamaoka's Haunting and raises both the frequency and the duration of Passive Phasing. It is a dark blue-green bonsai tree that was once a symbol of family tradition.
beginner.whyItMatters: More frequent and longer phasing windows let The Spirit weave through walls during chases, which keeps a survivor from settling into a safe loop. The shift is noticeable but not overwhelming, reading as a meaningful bump rather than a full redesign of the power.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it if you want The Spirit to phase through walls more regularly rather than committing to one long phase per charge. It is uncommon, so it should show up with reasonable regularity.

Addon_PhaseWalker_KaiunTalisman.name: Kaiun Talisman
Addon_PhaseWalker_KaiunTalisman.description:
A talisman to get luck on your side.

Increases Yamaoka's Haunting duration by 25%.

beginner.whatItIs: Attaches to Yamaoka's Haunting and stretches how long the phasing state persists before it expires on its own. The talisman is described as a charm that brings luck to its bearer.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer phase window gives The Spirit more room to cross rooms or reposition behind a survivor without being forced back into the husk. It reads as a meaningful adjustment rather than a wholesale change to the power's rhythm.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a phase keeps ending just as a survivor slips through a wall, since the extra duration closes that gap. It is uncommon and easy to find early in the collection.

Addon_PhaseWalker_KatanaTsuba.name: Katana Tsuba
Addon_PhaseWalker_KatanaTsuba.description:
The handguard of an ancestral blade. Crafted for the Yamaoka family.

Increases Yamaoka's Haunting reappearance duration by 20%.Increases Yamaoka's Haunting reappearance movement speed by 5%.

beginner.whatItIs: Fits into Yamaoka's Haunting and extends the reappearance phase while nudging The Spirit's movement speed upward during that window. It takes the form of a handguard from an ancestral blade crafted for the Yamaoka family.
beginner.whyItMatters: The longer, slightly faster reappearance helps close distance on a survivor who is kiting across open ground. The change is modest, a refinement that smooths out the reappear transition rather than reshaping the power entirely.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in trials where chases feel like they end too quickly because the reappear window runs out before a hook can land. It is rare, so expect to search a bit before it turns up.

Addon_PhaseWalker_KatsumoriTalisman.name: Senko Hanabi
Addon_PhaseWalker_KatsumoriTalisman.description:
Thin sparklers that light up summer nights and display the beauty of ephemeral moments in life.

When Yamaoka's Haunting ends, The Spirit's husk explodes and any vault locations within 4 meters are blocked for 5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Attaches to Yamaoka's Haunting and detonates The Spirit's husk the moment a phase ends, briefly blocking nearby vault locations. The item is a set of thin sparklers that light up summer nights.
beginner.whyItMatters: A survivor who plans to vault out of a tight corner loses that exit for a short moment, forcing a detour or a risky second attempt. The effect turns the end of a phase into a small defensive moment for the killer.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when opponents keep escaping through pallets or windows during a phase, since the blocked vaults punish that specific pattern. It is rare, so expect a bit of searching before it appears.

Addon_PhaseWalker_MotherDaughterRing.name: Mother-Daughter Ring
Addon_PhaseWalker_MotherDaughterRing.description:
A silver ring engraved with “for my precious daughter.”

Increases Yamaoka's Haunting movement speed by 25%.Scratch marks are no longer visible while using Yamaoka’s Haunting.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into Yamaoka's Haunting and raises The Spirit's movement speed while also hiding the scratch marks normally left behind during a phase. It is a silver ring engraved with a dedication to a daughter.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra pace helps keep a survivor trapped inside the terror radius longer, while the hidden scratch marks remove a key visual cue that survivors rely on to track the phase path. Combined, these two changes turn a transparent pursuit into a far more opaque one.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when chases feel sluggish or when opponents seem to use the scratch marks to predict where The Spirit will emerge. It is iridescent, making it one of the harder drops to find.

Addon_PhaseWalker_MuddySportsDayCap.name: Muddy Sports Day Cap
Addon_PhaseWalker_MuddySportsDayCap.description:
A muddy sport cap with a High School logo. Identified with a sewn name tag to "Rin".

Increases Yamaoka's Haunting movement speed by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Fits Yamaoka's Haunting and grants a modest boost to The Spirit's movement speed during a phase. The cap is a muddy sport cap bearing a High School logo and a sewn name tag.
beginner.whyItMatters: The small pace increase helps keep The Spirit level with a sprinting survivor without dramatically altering chase dynamics. It reads as a light touch, a nudge rather than a rework.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if chases feel a little slow during phasing and a gentle speed boost without a trade-off is what is needed. It is uncommon, so it should be straightforward to locate.

Addon_PhaseWalker_OrigamiCrane.name: Origami Crane
Addon_PhaseWalker_OrigamiCrane.description:
One of the one thousand orizuru for your wish to come true.

Increases Yamaoka's Haunting recharge rate by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: Speeds up the recharge cycle of Yamaoka's Haunting so the power is ready again sooner after each use. It appears as a folded paper crane, one of a set meant to carry a wish.
beginner.whyItMatters: A quicker recharge shrinks the vulnerable window where the killer is locked into normal form and exposed. It reads as a useful small tweak that keeps The Spirit hunting more consistently between phases.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the recharge feels too long and the killer is stranded between chases. It is common, so it should be easy to pick up.

Addon_PhaseWalker_PrayerBeadsBracelet.name: Furin
Addon_PhaseWalker_PrayerBeadsBracelet.description:
Warm summer breeze chimes the little bell hanging from the balcony ceiling.

The phasing sound is heard by all Survivors.

beginner.whatItIs: Attaches to Yamaoka's Haunting and makes the phasing sound audible to every survivor in the trial. It is a small wind chime that rings with a warm summer breeze.
beginner.whyItMatters: Survivors can now hear the moment The Spirit begins phasing through a wall, which removes the stealth element of the power. This lets a survivor reposition or pre-block an escape route before the phase completes.
beginner.whenToUseIt: This one is a thematic choice rather than a power boost, since it actually makes the killer easier to track. Equip it for flavor if a quiet eerie sound during phasing matters more than staying hidden. It is very rare, so it will not appear often.

Addon_PhaseWalker_RinsBrokenWatch.name: Rin's Broken Watch
Addon_PhaseWalker_RinsBrokenWatch.description:
A wristwatch with a shattered glass. The name "Rin" is scribbled on the wristband.

Increases Yamaoka's Haunting recharge rate by 30%.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into Yamaoka's Haunting and grants a meaningful speed-up to the recharge cycle between uses. The watch has shattered glass and the name Rin scribbled on its wristband.
beginner.whyItMatters: A shorter wait between phases keeps The Spirit a persistent threat across longer stretches of the trial. It trims the downtime where survivors can freely work generators or cross the map without fear.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the gap between phases gives survivors too much free time to progress the map and a quicker return to phasing form is the priority. Being uncommon, it tends to appear without much hunting through the pool.

Addon_PhaseWalker_RustyFlute.name: Rusty Flute
Addon_PhaseWalker_RustyFlute.description:
A rusty transverse flute with a haunting sound.

Increases Yamaoka's Haunting recharge rate by 40%.

beginner.whatItIs: A rusty transverse flute that slots into Yamaoka's Haunting and sharply increases its recharge rate. It makes the power cycle back far faster than it normally would.
beginner.whyItMatters: With the recharge noticeably quicker, The Spirit returns to phasing form sooner after each use and keeps pressure on survivors with less downtime. The effect is a clear and meaningful shift in how the power feels between chases.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the recharge feels like the main bottleneck in a chase sequence and a quicker return to phasing form matters most. As a rare find, it will take some searching before it turns up in the pool.

Addon_PhaseWalker_ShiawaseAmulet.name: Shiawase Amulet
Addon_PhaseWalker_ShiawaseAmulet.description:
A talisman that makes one happy and enthusiastic.

Increases Yamaoka's Haunting duration by 15%.

beginner.whatItIs: Fits Yamaoka's Haunting and extends the length of each phasing window before it ends naturally. The talisman is meant to bring happiness and enthusiasm to whoever carries it.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer phase gives The Spirit more time to hunt through walls or reposition without being cut off mid-pursuit. The shift is modest but consistent, making each individual phase feel more complete.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the phase duration feels too short to cross into the next room and more room is needed to work with each activation. It is common, so finding one should not require much effort.

Addon_PhaseWalker_WakizashiSaya.name: Wakizashi Saya
Addon_PhaseWalker_WakizashiSaya.description:
The scabbard of an ancestral blade. Once crafted for the Yamaoka family.

During Yamaoka's Haunting, use the Active Ability Button to return to the husk and end the haunting.

beginner.whatItIs: Wakizashi Saya is a scabbard out of the Yamaoka family's own armoury, slotted into Yamaoka's Haunting. Pressing the Active Ability Button mid-phase sends the killer straight back to the husk and ends the Haunting there and then. Bailing out early becomes a choice rather than a wait.
beginner.whyItMatters: Ending a phase deliberately removes the commitment of a long phase that might miss its target entirely. It turns a stranded-killer penalty into a quick reset, giving The Spirit control over when to exit the phasing state.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a missed phase leaves the killer vulnerable and bailing out is preferable to staying committed. It is very rare, so it will take some luck to pull.

Addon_PhaseWalker_WhiteHairRibbon.name: White Hair Ribbon
Addon_PhaseWalker_WhiteHairRibbon.description:
A silken bow to tame wild hair.

Increases Yamaoka's Haunting charge speed by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: Slotted into Yamaoka's Haunting, it speeds up how quickly the power recharges between uses. It is styled as a silken bow for taming wild hair.
beginner.whyItMatters: A quicker recharge cycle means The Spirit returns to hunting form with less downtime between uses. It reads as a small but steady tweak rather than a dramatic shift in how the power plays.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when The Spirit spends too much time waiting to phase again and survivors use the gap to slip away. It is uncommon, so the drop comes up fairly often in the vault.

Addon_PhaseWalker_YakuyokeAmulet.name: Yakuyoke Amulet
Addon_PhaseWalker_YakuyokeAmulet.description:
A powerful talisman to protect your endeavors from being hindered by suspicious circumstances.

Increases Yamaoka's Haunting duration by 70%.Decreases Yamaoka's Haunting movement speed by 15%.

beginner.whatItIs: It slots into Yamaoka's Haunting and stretches the phasing window to a much longer stretch while trimming The Spirit's movement pace. The talisman trades raw speed for a far more extended phase.
beginner.whyItMatters: Holding a phase for a far longer stretch suits camping tight interiors and forcing survivors to commit to a vault. The slower pace, however, makes it tougher to close a gap across open ground, so the trade favors position over pursuit.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the map is dense with tight corridors and The Spirit gains more from a drawn-out phase than a quick sprint. It is a very rare drop, so expect several trials before it appears in the vault.

Addon_PhaseWalker_Zori.name: Zōri
Addon_PhaseWalker_Zori.description:
A comfortable pair of flat sandals that can easily be slipped on and off.

Increases Yamaoka's Haunting movement speed by 5%.

beginner.whatItIs: It attaches to Yamaoka's Haunting and grants a small movement speed boost while phasing. The item is styled as a pair of flat sandals that slip on and off with ease.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra pace is modest, but in a short corridor it can be the difference between a clean hit and a survivor slipping through. It reads as a minor convenience rather than a meaningful shift in how the power feels.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it as a gentle speed bump when chases feel almost competitive but the killer falls just short. It is common, so it should turn up without much effort.

Addon_Plague_AshenApple.name: Ashen Apple
Addon_Plague_AshenApple.description:
A peeled apple rolled into sanctified ashes. Eating such a fruit warded off the malignantly envious spirits of the deceased.

Start the Trial with 1 additional Pool of Devotion already corrupted.Increases the number of Pools of Devotion in the trial by 1.

beginner.whatItIs: It plugs into Vile Purge and starts the trial with an extra Pool of Devotion already corrupted, while also adding another Pool of Devotion to the map. The item is styled as a peeled apple rolled into sanctified ashes.
beginner.whyItMatters: An extra corrupted pool at the start plus an additional pool on the map gives the Plague more tools to keep survivors off balance. It reads as a meaningful shift in how Vile Purge plays, since the pool count changes the pacing of the whole trial.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the trial feels too short or the pools run out before the killer can corner a survivor. It is rare, so expect some searching before it appears.

Addon_Plague_BlackIncense.name: Black Incense
Addon_Plague_BlackIncense.description:
A dark paste made of sharp osseous shavings. The inhaling of its foul fumes sharpens the mind's eye.

Survivors' auras are revealed to you for 3 seconds when they vomit.

beginner.whatItIs: A dark incense paste that slots into Vile Purge, briefly revealing a survivor's aura the moment they vomit. It is made from sharp osseous shavings with a foul, mind-sharpening smell.
beginner.whyItMatters: Seeing a survivor's aura the instant the debuff lands turns a blind search into a focused pursuit. It reads as a meaningful bump in information, since the killer no longer has to guess which direction a vomited survivor fled.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the vomit debuff gives survivors a clean escape window and the killer is left searching in the dark. It is an iridescent drop, so expect it to be one of the harder items to pull from the vault.

Addon_Plague_DevoteesAmulet.name: Devotee's Amulet
Addon_Plague_DevoteesAmulet.description:
A bloodstone amulet carved intricately with the effigy of the Babylonian god of mayhem and pestilence. Fills the wearer with boundless devotion.

Increases duration of Corrupt Purge by 20 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: A carved bloodstone that slots into Vile Purge, lengthening how long Corrupt Purge persists on a struck survivor. The amulet bears the effigy of a god of mayhem and pestilence.
beginner.whyItMatters: Holding a survivor in a weakened state for a far longer window gives the Plague time to close the gap and land the follow-up hit. It shifts the power toward sustained pressure rather than a quick burst, changing how a chase plays out.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the weakened state fades before the Plague can close the gap and punish a survivor. Being a very rare drop, it tends to show up only after a stretch of other pulls.

Addon_Plague_EmeticPotion.name: Emetic potion
Addon_Plague_EmeticPotion.description:
A mustard-water based syrup that induces vomiting when consumed. Used to purge evil from the body.

Increases the effectiveness of Vile Purge by 30%.

beginner.whatItIs: Emetic potion strengthens Vile Purge's overall vomiting effect, making the sickness it inflicts noticeably stronger once the potion is slotted in. It is an uncommon add-on that suits any situation where a harsher debuff helps lock down a chase.
beginner.whyItMatters: A stronger vomiting effect widens the gap between a survivor who barely notices the sickness and one who is properly hampered by it, giving the killer more room to capitalize afterward. It reads as a meaningful bump in strength rather than a complete rework of how the power plays.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the vomit debuff feels too short to punish a survivor and they recover before a hit lands. It is an uncommon drop, so it shows up with reasonable frequency in the vault.

Addon_Plague_ExorcismAmulet.name: Exorcism Amulet
Addon_Plague_ExorcismAmulet.description:
An obsidian amulet to ward off sickness during exorcism rituals. Inscribed with a prayer to the god of mayhem and pestilence. Fills the wearer with fierce devotion.

Increases the duration of Corrupt Purge by 10 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: An obsidian amulet that slots into Vile Purge, modestly lengthening how long Corrupt Purge holds a survivor in a weakened state. It is inscribed with a prayer to a god of mayhem and pestilence.
beginner.whyItMatters: A wider window in a weakened state gives the Plague room to close the gap and connect a hit before the debuff wears off. It reads as a steady improvement to the power's pacing rather than a dramatic overhaul.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the weakened state wears off before the Plague can close in and land a follow-up. It is a rare drop, so expect some searching before it shows up in the vault.

Addon_Plague_HealingSalve.name: Healing Salve
Addon_Plague_HealingSalve.description:
A bitterly pungent paste of crushed roots, which were marinated in fish brine for three days and in wine for two. Applied on skin rashes.

Decreases cooldown of Vile Purge and Corrupt Purge by 0.25 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Healing Salve trims the recovery time on Vile Purge before the next cast is ready. The shorter gap means the power is available more often during a trial.
beginner.whyItMatters: Keeping the cooldown tight ensures Vile Purge is not sitting idle while survivors finish a generator or heal. The constant threat of another wave forces them to keep moving rather than committing to long actions.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a chase build feels sluggish because Vile Purge is unavailable for too long between uses. It rolls at common rarity, so it is an easy pick from the offering screen.

Addon_Plague_HematiteSeal.name: Hematite Seal
Addon_Plague_HematiteSeal.description:
A cylindrical seal forged from a metallic hardstone, engraved with bird-headed beings that stood next to strange machines. Used as a container for sanctified ashes.

Increases object infection duration by 30 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: A seal forged from hardstone, Hematite Seal stretches how long an infected object stays dangerous after being hit by Vile Purge. The extended window gives survivors more time to accidentally trigger the effect.
beginner.whyItMatters: Survivors who step near a generator or an item to search it will linger in the infection cloud longer than they would without the add-on. That extra exposure forces them to either abandon the interaction or walk through additional pain.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when survivors keep using objects as safe staging spots between interactions. It is uncommon rarity, so it appears less often on the offering screen than common options.

Addon_Plague_IncensedOintment.name: Incensed Ointment
Addon_Plague_IncensedOintment.description:
A dark waxy paste, laced with cedar sap that diffuse a sweet and earthy aroma. Applied directly on infected skin.

Ingesting the corruption at a Pool of Devotion causes all Survivors within The Plague's Terror Radius to scream and reveal their locations.

beginner.whatItIs: Incensed Ointment adds a burst of information the moment The Plague drinks corruption at a Pool of Devotion. Every survivor within the terror radius screams and reveals their location.
beginner.whyItMatters: Turning a routine channel action into a map-wide ping means The Plague can track an aural survivor who would otherwise stay hidden. Each corrupted pool becomes a tracking tool rather than just a power refuel.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in matches where a survivor has a strong aural build and is hard to pin down. It is rare rarity, so expect a few trials before it surfaces on the offering screen.

Addon_Plague_InfectedEmetic.name: Infected Emetic
Addon_Plague_InfectedEmetic.description:
