A disgusting syrup of unknown origin. The thick yellow liquid is consumed to induce vomiting. Used to purge evil from the body.

Increases the effectiveness of Vile Purge by 40%.

beginner.whatItIs: Infected Emetic amplifies the damage output of each Vile Purge projectile that lands on a survivor. The boost is straightforward: same cast, same range, but each hit hurts more.
beginner.whyItMatters: Fewer casts are needed to drop a survivor into the injured state, which shortens chases and reduces the window where a survivor can escape. The effect is a clean power bump rather than a rework of how the power feels.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when Vile Purge feels underwhelming in direct chases and the killer wants each shot to land harder. It is rare rarity, so it takes a bit of patience to find.

Addon_Plague_IridescentSeal.name: Iridescent Seal
Addon_Plague_IridescentSeal.description:
A translucent cylindrical seal molded from The Fog Itself with the effigy of The Plague. Its surface is warm and pulsates with The Entity's power.

Corrupt Purge activates every time a generator is completed.Decreases duration of Corrupt Purge by 20 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Iridescent Seal auto-triggers Corrupt Purge each time a generator reaches completion while also trimming the duration of the effect. The activation is automatic and tied to generator progress, so no manual channel is required.
beginner.whyItMatters: The trigger fires at the exact moment survivors are most clustered around a finished generator, which makes the burst land when it matters most. The shorter duration demands quick decisions about where to aim the effect, adding a layer of timing that a static Corrupt Purge does not have.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a trial has many generators and survivors tend to group near the last few. It is iridescent rarity, so it is an uncommon find worth saving for a match that already suits The Plague.

Addon_Plague_LimestoneSeal.name: Limestone Seal
Addon_Plague_LimestoneSeal.description:
A cylindrical seal made from porous stone that displays a ritualistic scene with winged deities.

Increases object infection duration by 20 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Limestone Seal extends the time an object stays infected after a Vile Purge hit. The longer exposure window gives survivors more opportunity to accidentally trigger the effect.
beginner.whyItMatters: A small but steady pressure layer makes object-heavy maps feel more dangerous for survivors who camp near generators or items. The effect is modest on its own but compounds with other infection-focused add-ons to create a persistent hazard.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a match feels too passive and survivors are too comfortable loitering around objects. It is common rarity, so it is one of the easier picks from the offering screen.

Addon_Plague_OlibanumIncense.name: Olibanum Incense
Addon_Plague_OlibanumIncense.description:
Precious resin extracted from Boswellia trees, used during ceremonies for their sweet citrusy fragrance.

Survivors who cleanse at fountains have their auras revealed for 4 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Olibanum Incense reveals the auras of survivors who use a fountain to cleanse the infection off their body. The reveal window is short but enough to lock in a chase direction.
beginner.whyItMatters: A survivor who cleanses at a fountain is trying to stay hidden, and this add-on turns that safe action into a location ping. The Plague can chase down a survivor who thought they had bought themselves a reset.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a survivor is running a cleanse-heavy build and the map has several fountains. It is common rarity, making it an accessible choice for most trials.

Addon_Plague_PotentTincture.name: Potent Tincture
Addon_Plague_PotentTincture.description:
A frothing, murky liquid that permeates the air with an acute aroma of herbs and alcohol. Applied directly on blisters.

Decreases cooldown of Vile Purge and Corrupt Purge by 0.4 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Potent Tincture cuts the cooldown on both Vile Purge and Corrupt Purge further than the standard recovery. The combined effect makes the gap between casts feel noticeably shorter.
beginner.whyItMatters: A faster cycle means The Plague recovers between engagements sooner, which keeps pressure alive even after a long channel or a missed opportunity. It works best stacked with other cooldown-trimming options for a near-constant availability feel.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a build already trims cooldown and wants an extra layer of speed. It is uncommon rarity, so it shows up less often than common rolls.

Addon_Plague_PrayerApple.name: Blessed Apple
Addon_Plague_PrayerApple.description:
A perfectly ripe fruit to break fast during the purification ceremony. Delicious.

Start the Trial with 1 additional Pool of Devotion already corrupted.

beginner.whatItIs: Blessed Apple starts the trial with one Pool of Devotion already corrupted and ready to drink from. The free activation means The Plague can react to early survivor movements without spending a charge first.
beginner.whyItMatters: An earlier pressure window sets the tone for the first minute of the trial, which can rattle survivors who expect a slower start. The head start is small but real, especially on maps where pools sit close to early routes.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a map layout puts pools near early survivor paths and the first minute matters. It is uncommon rarity, so it lands at a moderate frequency on the offering screen.

Addon_Plague_PrayerTabletFragment.name: Prayer Tablet Fragment
Addon_Plague_PrayerTabletFragment.description:
A fragmented stone tablet with a corrupted incantation originally used to purge illnesses and feelings of general malaise.

Vile Purge no longer affects Survivors.Increases object infection duration by 40 seconds.Increases infection from infected objects by 100%.Increases Devious Bloodpoints by 100%.

beginner.whatItIs: Prayer Tablet Fragment removes the survivor-targeted effect from Vile Purge entirely and instead boosts how long infected objects last, how strongly they infect, and how quickly Devious Bloodpoints accumulate. It is a strategic rewire rather than a simple stat bump.
beginner.whyItMatters: The power shifts from a chase tool into a map-control tool, since the real threat now lives in the objects that stay infected longer and infect harder. Survivors who lean on items and searches will feel the pressure most, while a pure chaser build loses its main burst option.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a map has dense object clusters and the survivors favor item-heavy builds. It is common rarity, so it rolls frequently enough to be a reliable pick for this playstyle.

Addon_Plague_ProphylacticAmulet.name: Prophylactic Amulet
Addon_Plague_ProphylacticAmulet.description:
A soapstone amulet crudely engraved with a winged deity that wards off sickness. Fills the wearer with devotion.

Decreases the number of Pools of Devotion in the Trial by 2.

beginner.whatItIs: Prophylactic Amulet removes pools from the map at the start of the trial, reducing the number of safe cleanse spots available to survivors. The tighter map forces them to stay on the move.
beginner.whyItMatters: Fewer pools means fewer reset points, which breaks the rhythm of survivors who orbit a pool to heal and re-cleanse. The effect is a quiet map-shaping tool that rewards a killer who wants to control space rather than just chase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take it when survivors are leaning on pool healing to survive chases and the map layout gives them too many retreat spots. As an uncommon find on the offering screen it will surface at a reasonable rate, making it a solid grab when the plan is to starve opponents of healing ground.

Addon_Plague_RubbingOil.name: Rubbing Oil
Addon_Plague_RubbingOil.description:
A beaker of rubbing oil with expectorant quality. Exudes the evergreen scent of laurel and rosemary.

Increases the charge rate of Vile Purge and Corrupt Purge by 50%.

beginner.whatItIs: Rubbing Oil speeds up how quickly Vile Purge and Corrupt Purge build their charges. The faster recovery means The Plague is ready for the next engagement sooner.
beginner.whyItMatters: A quicker charge cycle keeps the pressure alive between chases, which is especially useful on maps where The Plague has to reposition a lot. It suits a build that relies on Corrupt Purge for sustained zone control rather than one-shot bursts.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the pause between channeling Vile Purge feels too long to maintain steady pressure on a survivor. The rare rarity tag means it takes more than a couple of offering rotations to appear, so take it the moment it shows up if channel pacing is the bottleneck.

Addon_Plague_SeveredToe.name: Severed Toe
Addon_Plague_SeveredToe.description:
The decaying severed toe of Adiris, weaved on a thread and worn as an amulet around the neck. Radiates with vile power.

Increases infection rate for Survivors who are performing interactions by 50%.

beginner.whatItIs: Severed Toe boosts the infection rate on survivors who are in the middle of an interaction like searching or repairing. The interaction lock means they have no time to react once the infection starts.
beginner.whyItMatters: Punishing overcommitment is the core of this add-on, since a survivor who commits to a long action is helpless against the boosted rate. It rewards a killer who reads survivor habits and places infected objects where long actions are likely.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when survivors are running long searches or generator work in open areas near objects. It is very rare rarity, so it is a slow find worth saving for a match that fits this style.

Addon_Plague_VileEmetic.name: Vile Emetic
Addon_Plague_VileEmetic.description:
A foul-smelling and half-congealed potion of unidentifiable ingredients. Consumed to rapidly induce vomiting. Used to purge evil from the body.

Increases velocity of vomit projectiles by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Vile Emetic makes the vomit projectiles from Vile Purge travel faster from cast to target. The shorter travel time gives survivors less reaction window to dodge or drop a pallet.
beginner.whyItMatters: A faster projectile nudges the hit rate up during tight chases where timing is everything. The shift is modest but consistent, and it rewards careful shot placement over brute force.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when Vile Purge feels like it is whiffing too often in chases and the killer wants a small reliability boost. It is very rare rarity, making it a long shot best held for a trial where the chase is the main focus.

Addon_Plague_WorshipTablet.name: Worship Tablet
Addon_Plague_WorshipTablet.description:
A stone tablet adorned with gold showing the drawings and writings of a corrupted incantation used originally to worship forgotten deities.

Increases speed of ingesting corruption at a Pool of Devotion by 100%.Increases movement speed while holding Corrupt Purge by 4.5%.

beginner.whatItIs: Worship Tablet doubles the speed of drinking corruption at a Pool of Devotion and adds a small movement speed bonus while holding Corrupt Purge. Both effects make The Plague faster in two different phases of the playstyle.
beginner.whyItMatters: The faster channel means less time spent vulnerable at a pool, which makes interruptions harder to pull off. The movement bonus during Corrupt Purge adds a subtle chase advantage that compounds with the already-strong zone control of the power.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pull it when the match centers on pool control and faster channeling lets the killer reclaim the initiative before survivors can loop out. The very rare rarity tier means it rarely graces the offering screen, so it deserves a spot the instant it appears if pools are the anchor of the strategy.

Addon_ReverseBearTrap_AmandasLetter.name: Amanda's Letter
Addon_ReverseBearTrap_AmandasLetter.description:
A blackmailing letter for the attention of Amanda. Fills the reader with rage and focus.

While crouched, reveals auras of Survivors within 16 meters.Decreases available Reverse Bear Traps by 2.

beginner.whatItIs: Amanda's Letter reveals survivor auras while crouched within a fixed range, at the cost of a reduced Reverse Bear Trap count. The trade is clear: fewer traps on the map in exchange for a stalking vision tool.
beginner.whyItMatters: The crouch-aura reveal turns every stalk into a tracking moment that can expose a survivor hiding behind a pallet or in a corner. It shifts Jigsaw's Baptism toward a stalk-and-reveal style rather than a pure trap-and-chase loop.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take it when opponents are stacking aural tools and the killer struggles to spot them through walls or darkness without a trap already in place. It carries iridescent rarity, so it will show up only infrequently and is a strong grab for any match where visibility is the main gap.

Addon_ReverseBearTrap_AmandasSecret.name: Amanda's Secret
Addon_ReverseBearTrap_AmandasSecret.description:
A black metal box containing a knife and various medical supplies, such as bandages and compresses. Deep cuts reduce stress and awaken the senses.

Gain a notification when a Survivor removes a Reverse Bear Trap.Auras of Survivors removing a Reverse Bear Trap are revealed to you for 6 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Amanda's Secret sends a notification the moment a survivor removes a Reverse Bear Trap and reveals that survivor's aura for a short window. The two effects combine to turn every trap removal into a tracked moment.
beginner.whyItMatters: The notification alone tells the killer exactly where a trap just came off, and the aura reveal adds a chase opportunity on top of that. Survivors who pop traps and run for a vault no longer get a clean escape.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Slot it in when opponents rip traps off their wrists quickly and the killer has no follow-up after the snare pops. Carrying very rare rarity means it will not appear on most offering screens, making it a worthwhile pick when trap pressure is the core plan.

Addon_ReverseBearTrap_BagofGears.name: Bag of Gears
Addon_ReverseBearTrap_BagofGears.description:
A few mechanical parts that allow the creation of challenging Jigsaw Boxes and easier to install Reverse Bear Traps.

Increases Reverse Bear Trap setting speed by 50%.Increases time required to search a Jigsaw Box by 17%.

beginner.whatItIs: Bag of Gears speeds up Reverse Bear Trap placement and makes Jigsaw Boxes take longer for survivors to search. Both effects push the game toward the killer's preferred pace.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster trap placement means the killer can set up coverage between chases without losing too much time. The slower box searches punish survivors who try to use the boxes as a healing or item resource.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick it when the map layout funnels survivors through narrow corridors where faster trap placement turns loops into death sentences. It holds rare rarity, so it surfaces on the offering screen less often than common add-ons and should be grabbed the moment it appears if box denial is part of the game plan.

Addon_ReverseBearTrap_CombatStraps.name: Combat Straps
Addon_ReverseBearTrap_CombatStraps.description:
Leather straps that hold fabric in place for nimbler movement.

Increases crouching and uncrouching speed by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Combat Straps make crouching and standing back up happen faster for Jigsaw's Baptism. The quicker cycle is useful for stalking through pallet lines or dropping behind cover mid-chase.
beginner.whyItMatters: A faster crouch-uncrouch cycle is a small but tangible speed bump for a killer who relies on crouch-based positioning. It helps in tight corridors and around pallet lines where the crouch state is the default.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a build leans on crouching to stalk through tight corridors or to hide behind pallets while waiting for a survivor to loop. It is common rarity, making it a straightforward pick from the offering screen.

Addon_ReverseBearTrap_CrateofGears.name: Crate of Gears
Addon_ReverseBearTrap_CrateofGears.description:
This collection of mechanical parts allows the creation of extra-challenging Jigsaw Boxes and Reverse Bear Traps that are easier to install.

Increases Reverse Bear Trap setting speed by 50%.Increases time required to search a Jigsaw Box by 33%.

beginner.whatItIs: Crate of Gears boosts Reverse Bear Trap placement speed and applies a heavier penalty to Jigsaw Box searches than a lighter gear option would. The box-search penalty is the standout change here.
beginner.whyItMatters: The heavier box penalty makes Jigsaw Boxes a much bigger risk for survivors who try to farm them between interactions. It suits a killer who wants to own the object economy of the map and punish every detour.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when opponents keep popping Jigsaw Boxes to stay healthy and the killer wants every box search to bleed more time. The very rare rarity tag means it is a long wait on the offering screen, so it earns a slot in any match where box denial is the win condition.

Addon_ReverseBearTrap_FaceMask.name: Face Mask
Addon_ReverseBearTrap_FaceMask.description:
A modification to the Reverse Bear Trap: The heavy cloth face mask, laced with a sedative, partially suffocates the target making it hard to concentrate.

Reverse Bear Traps inflict Blindness until removed.Does not affect the Jigsaw Box aura.

Blindness prevents Survivors from seeing auras.

beginner.whatItIs: A sedative-laced cloth face mask that modifies the Reverse Bear Trap under Jigsaw's Baptism, partially suffocating the target and making it hard to stay focused. Once a survivor is caught in it, they suffer Blindness until it is removed.
beginner.whyItMatters: Blinding a trapped survivor is a bigger shift than a small tweak, because it strips them of the auras they would normally rely on to stay oriented and coordinate. That loss of map awareness punishes anyone still trying to work on generators while stuck in the trap.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want to lock down a survivor who keeps escaping after a trap, since the blinding effect makes it harder for them to find an exit or call for help. It is an uncommon rarity, so expect to see it fairly often among your offerings.

Addon_ReverseBearTrap_InterlockingRazor.name: Interlocking Razor
Addon_ReverseBearTrap_InterlockingRazor.description:
A modification to the Jigsaw Box: The addition of interlocking razor blades makes it impossible to move suddenly in the Jigsaw Box without suffering the consequences.

Failing a Jigsaw Box skill check while injured will inflict Deep Wound on Survivor.

Deep Wound will put a Survivor in the dying state unless it is mended before the timer runs out.

beginner.whatItIs: Blades fitted into the Jigsaw Box under Jigsaw's Baptism so that moving suddenly inside carries real consequences. Failing a skill check while injured inflicts Deep Wound on the survivor.
beginner.whyItMatters: That turn toward Deep Wound makes the box far more threatening, since a single bad check can push a survivor into the dying state if the wound is not mended in time. It reads as a heavier shift in how the Jigsaw Box punishes hesitation rather than a minor nudge.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it against survivors who tend to panic-fail checks while already hurt, because the extra damage punishes that exact behavior. It is a common rarity, so it should show up frequently enough to build a trap-focused loadout around it.

Addon_ReverseBearTrap_JigsawsAnnotatedPl.name: Jigsaw's Annotated Plan
Addon_ReverseBearTrap_JigsawsAnnotatedPl.description:
A disturbing, yet brilliant, trap design laid down on paper and annotated by Jigsaw.

Increases available Reverse Bear Traps by 1.Increases Reverse Bear Trap death timer by 10 seconds.Whenever a generator is completed, 10 seconds is removed from the death timer of all active Reverse Bear Traps.

beginner.whatItIs: A trap-design note left on paper by Jigsaw, slotting into Jigsaw's Baptism to grant an extra Reverse Bear Trap and stretch each death timer. It also shaves time off every active trap whenever a generator is finished.
beginner.whyItMatters: Adding another trap widens the killer's reach and the timer changes reshape tempo in both directions, which is a bigger shift than a single stat bump. It rewards a patient killer who sets traps early and lets generator progress feed back into the pressure.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want a trap-heavy game where every completed generator actually feeds more pressure onto survivors. It is a rare rarity, so plan a build around it deliberately rather than assuming it appears every trial.

Addon_ReverseBearTrap_JigsawsSketch.name: Jigsaw's Sketch
Addon_ReverseBearTrap_JigsawsSketch.description:
A disturbing, yet brilliant, trap design sketched in details on a sheet of paper.

Increases available Reverse Bear Traps by 1.When a Survivor with a Reverse Bear Trap is working on a Generator, that Generator's Aura is revealed to you.

beginner.whatItIs: An annotated sketch of a trap design for Jigsaw's Baptism that grants an extra Reverse Bear Trap. While a trapped survivor works a generator, the aura of that generator is revealed to the killer.
beginner.whyItMatters: Revealing a generator's aura through a trapped survivor is a bigger information shift than a simple stat, since it hands the killer a way to track progress without leaving the trap. The extra trap on top makes the loadout feel more controlling overall.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when you want to stay in the trap and still stay informed about what the survivors are doing. It is very rare, so expect to hunt for it across several trials before it shows up.

Addon_ReverseBearTrap_JohnMedicalFile.name: John's Medical File
Addon_ReverseBearTrap_JohnMedicalFile.description:
The medical file of a cancerous man. Fills the reader with dread and recklessness.

Increases crouched move speed by 5%.

beginner.whatItIs: The medical file of a cancerous man, offered into Jigsaw's Baptism to nudge crouched move speed upward. It fills the killer with a sense of dread and recklessness.
beginner.whyItMatters: A little extra crouched speed is a small tweak, but it matters in the quiet moments when a killer is lining up an ambush or sliding into a better angle. It makes positioning feel a touch quicker and less punishing.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when your playstyle leans on crouched repositioning and ambush setups rather than open chases. It is a common rarity, so it is easy to find and slot in without much searching.

Addon_ReverseBearTrap_LastWill.name: Last Will
Addon_ReverseBearTrap_LastWill.description:
A latched wooden box with a satin lining, offered as part of a last will.

Increases Ambush attack movement speed by 5%.Increases time to charge Ambush attack by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: A latched, satin-lined wooden box offered into Jigsaw's Baptism, speeding up ambush movement and lengthening the ambush charge. It trades a bit of charge time for a faster approach.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster ambush movement closes gaps more quickly, which is a moderate shift in how an ambush lands, even if the slower charge means you wait a little longer to be ready. It rewards a killer who likes to commit to a fast, surprising strike.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when you want your ambush to hit faster and surprise survivors who are mid-vault or in a doorway. It is an uncommon rarity, so it should appear often enough to be a dependable part of a Jigsaw loadout.

Addon_ReverseBearTrap_RazorWires.name: Razor Wires
Addon_ReverseBearTrap_RazorWires.description:
A modification to the Jigsaw Box: The addition of razor-sharp wires makes it extra difficult and potentially painful to search.

Jigsaw Box skill check success zones are smaller.Failing a Jigsaw Box skill check while uninjured will injure the Survivor.

beginner.whatItIs: Razor-sharp wires woven into the Jigsaw Box under Jigsaw's Baptism, shrinking the skill-check success zones and making the search more painful. Failing a check while uninjured now injures the survivor.
beginner.whyItMatters: Tightening the success zones and punishing uninjured failures is a meaningful shift, since a survivor can no longer shrug off a missed check. It makes the Jigsaw Box a bigger test of precision rather than a minor inconvenience.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want the box to punish sloppy button-mashing instead of just injured failures. It is an uncommon rarity, so it is a reasonable bet for a control-focused build.

Addon_ReverseBearTrap_RuleSetN2.name: Rule Set No.2
Addon_ReverseBearTrap_RuleSetN2.description:
Not all games need to have the same rules.

Disables the Survivors' ability to see Jigsaw Boxes highlighted until their Trap is activated.

beginner.whatItIs: Rules that change how the boxes read: an offering for Jigsaw's Baptism that stops survivors from seeing Jigsaw Boxes highlighted until a trap actually activates. It keeps the boxes hidden and unmarked until they spring.
beginner.whyItMatters: Hiding the boxes until they fire is a bigger information shift than any stat bump, since it robs survivors of the early warning they normally use to route around danger. Survivors have to rely on sound and positioning instead of glowing highlights.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when you want to keep survivors guessing about where the hidden blades are lurking. It is a rare rarity, so treat it as a deliberate pick for a stealth-oriented trap build.

Addon_ReverseBearTrap_RustyAttachments.name: Rusty Attachments
Addon_ReverseBearTrap_RustyAttachments.description:
A modification to the Reverse Bear Trap: Mouth spikes, covered with crusty and volatile rust spots that make injuries particularly difficult to heal.

Reverse Bear Traps inflict Mangled for 70 seconds.

Mangled increases time required to heal by 25% and lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

beginner.whatItIs: Spikes for the Reverse Bear Trap under Jigsaw's Baptism, covered in crusty rust spots that make injuries hard to heal. Trapped survivors suffer Mangled for a set duration.
beginner.whyItMatters: Mangled stretches healing and makes the trap a longer, more painful commitment, which is a meaningful shift in how long a caught survivor is stuck. It punishes the survivors who try to heal through the trap instead of dealing with it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want a trap that keeps a survivor pinned while their teammates work, since the healing penalty drags out every escape attempt. It is a rare rarity, so build it into your loadout on purpose.

Addon_ReverseBearTrap_ShatteredSyringe.name: Shattered Syringe
Addon_ReverseBearTrap_ShatteredSyringe.description:
Symbol of a broken way of life. Reminiscing about her past-self hardens her determination.

Decreases Ambush attack miss cooldown by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Syringe, broken and offered into Jigsaw's Baptism, that shortens the cooldown after a missed ambush attack. It is framed as a symbol of a broken way of life.
beginner.whyItMatters: A quicker reset after a whiffed ambush is a small but useful tweak, since it lets the killer swing again sooner rather than standing exposed. It rewards a killer who accepts a fast, aggressive re-approach.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a survivor dodges the first Ambush swing and you want the next opportunity to arrive quicker. Its common rarity makes it easy to find, so slot it into any Jigsaw's Baptism build that leans on repeated strikes. It suits chase-heavy games where the initial attack whiffs more often than not.

Addon_ReverseBearTrap_SlowReleasingToxin.name: Slow-Release Toxin
Addon_ReverseBearTrap_SlowReleasingToxin.description:
A modification to the Reverse Bear Trap: A poison that is not fatal but weakens the body and makes it nearly impossible to recover fully from any effort.

Reverse Bear Traps inflict Exhausted until removed.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating exhausting perks.

beginner.whatItIs: Poison threaded into the Reverse Bear Trap under Jigsaw's Baptism, weakening the body and making full recovery nearly impossible. Trapped survivors stay Exhausted until the trap is removed.
beginner.whyItMatters: Leaving survivors Exhausted is a bigger control shift, since it shuts off the exhausting perks they might otherwise lean on to escape. It turns a single trap into a long, draining bind that eats into stamina on top of the timer.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it against a survivor lineup that leans heavily on stamina-based perks, since the exhaustion effect neutralizes exactly that strength. It is a rare rarity, so pick it deliberately when you read the lobby that way.

Addon_ReverseBearTrap_TamperedTimer.name: Tampered Timer
Addon_ReverseBearTrap_TamperedTimer.description:
A timer that has been fiddled with. A spring in the mechanism forces the gears to turn faster.

Decreases the Reverse Bear Trap death timer by 20 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: The fiddled timer offering for Jigsaw's Baptism, with a spring forcing the gears to turn faster and shortening the Reverse Bear Trap death timer. It makes every trapped survivor race against a shorter clock.
beginner.whyItMatters: A shorter death timer is a bigger urgency shift than a stat bump, since survivors have less room to work before the trap closes in. It pressures even the calmest survivor into rushed, error-prone generator work.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when you want to squeeze survivors hard and reward quick, decisive plays over slow grinding. It is a very rare rarity, so expect to chase it across multiple trials.

Addon_ReverseBearTrap_UtilityBlades.name: Utility Blades
Addon_ReverseBearTrap_UtilityBlades.description:
A modification to the Reverse Bear Trap: Sharp blades attached to the trap's interior lacerate the victim with every movement.

Reverse Bear Traps inflict Hemorrhage every time the Survivor is injured by any means.

Hemorrhage regresses healing progress when not healing, and increases blood trails left by injured survivors. This lasts for a set duration or until healed.

beginner.whatItIs: Blades fixed to the inside of the Reverse Bear Trap under Jigsaw's Baptism, lacerating the victim with every movement. Each injury inflicts Hemorrhage until it is healed.
beginner.whyItMatters: Hemorrhage regresses healing and thickens blood trails, which is a meaningful compounding shift that punishes survivors who keep moving. It turns the trap into a bleeding problem rather than just a timer problem.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want to bleed survivors who keep fleeing after a trap, since the healing regression drags out their escape. It is an uncommon rarity, so it fits neatly into a trap-focused build.

Addon_ReverseBearTrap_VideoTape.name: Video Tape
Addon_ReverseBearTrap_VideoTape.description:
A recording of Jigsaw, explaining the game's rules to Amanda. Reminiscing about her past-self hardens her determination.

Survivors begin the trial with Reverse Bear Traps installed.

beginner.whatItIs: An iridescent recording offered into Jigsaw's Baptism, showing Jigsaw explaining the game's rules to Amanda. Survivors begin the trial with Reverse Bear Traps already installed.
beginner.whyItMatters: Starting the trial with traps in place is a bigger tempo shift than any single stat, since the pressure is live before the survivors have even settled in. It compresses the early game and forces faster decisions from the very start.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when you want the trial to begin under immediate pressure rather than a slow build-up. It is an iridescent rarity, so it is a harder offering to come by and worth chasing for a bold Jigsaw identity.

Addon_ReverseBearTrap_WorkshopGrease.name: Workshop Grease
Addon_ReverseBearTrap_WorkshopGrease.description:
A simple tube of grease, used to lubricate the mechanisms of the hidden blade.

Increases Ambush attack charge speed by 50%.

beginner.whatItIs: Tube of grease used to lubricate the hidden blade, offered into Jigsaw's Baptism to speed up the ambush attack charge. It makes the ambush ready noticeably faster.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster charge is a clean, useful tweak that lets the killer spring an ambush more often in a short window. It suits a playstyle built around repeated quick strikes rather than long setups.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the Jigsaw's Baptism loop already centers on repeated ambush strikes and the goal is to have each one ready sooner. The uncommon rarity makes it a dependable find, so it fits naturally into aggressive strike-focused games. It shines most when survivors keep surviving the first hit and the blade needs re-arming quickly.

Addon_Rush_AdrenalineVial.name: Adrenaline Vial
Addon_Rush_AdrenalineVial.description:
A hormone removed from an unwilling subject’s adrenal gland. Though it provides a jolt of energy, it can fatigue its user.

Increases maximum Rush tokens by 2.Increases maximum look angle while Rushing by 20 degrees.Decreases Rush turn rate by 55%.Increases Rush speed by 5%.

beginner.whatItIs: Hormone taken from an unwilling subject's adrenal gland, offered into Blighted Corruption to grant extra Rush tokens and widen the look angle. It also slows the turn rate while rushing and nudges rush speed up a touch.
beginner.whyItMatters: More tokens and a wider look angle is a bigger shift than a small stat, since it lets the killer hold the rush state longer and see further, even at the cost of turning slower. It trades agility for a more commanding, sustained rush.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when the Blighted Corruption playstyle favors long, fast rushes that cover a wide arc, accepting tighter turning in exchange. The rare rarity means it will not drop often, so invest in it deliberately once the rest of the build supports sustained momentum. It fits best into games where chases unfold across open ground rather than through tight corridors.

Addon_Rush_AlchemistsRing.name: Alchemist’s Ring
Addon_Rush_AlchemistsRing.description:
A ring given to chemists graduating from the London School of Medicine. It’s a reminder of unrestrained ambition.

Increases Rush duration by 20% for each consecutive Rush.

beginner.whatItIs: The ring given to graduating chemists at a London medical school, offered into Blighted Corruption. Each consecutive rush extends the rush duration further.
beginner.whyItMatters: A duration bonus that stacks across consecutive rushes is a bigger momentum shift, since the longer a rush lasts, the harder it becomes for survivors to break it. It rewards a killer who can keep chaining rushes together.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when your Blighted Corruption identity is built around chaining rushes back to back and holding the state through extended chases. The very rare rarity means it will take many trials to land, so plan the build around it rather than bolting it on late. It rewards a rush-heavy loop where each consecutive burst outlasts the one before it.

Addon_Rush_BlightedCrow.name: Blighted Crow
Addon_Rush_BlightedCrow.description:
A dead crow that has been grotesquely mutated by blight serum.

Increases speed while Rushing by 3% for each consecutive Rush.

beginner.whatItIs: Crow, dead and grotesquely mutated by blight serum, offered into Blighted Corruption. Each consecutive rush adds a little more rush speed.
beginner.whyItMatters: A speed bonus that builds with each consecutive rush is a steady momentum shift, since the killer gets faster the longer the state is held. It suits a rush build that wants to outpace survivors over time.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when you like a rush that rewards sustained pressure and keeps gaining ground against fleeing survivors. It is a rare rarity, so it is a solid deliberate pick for a chase-heavy identity.

Addon_Rush_BlightedRat.name: Blighted Rat
Addon_Rush_BlightedRat.description:
A rat that briefly returned to life when injected with serum, becoming aggressive and uncontrollable.

Increases speed while Rushing by 2% for each consecutive Rush.

beginner.whatItIs: Blighted Rat slots into Blighted Corruption and makes the rush state move a touch faster with every consecutive burst, so a long chain of rushes builds real speed. The per-stack gain is small, but across a sustained chase the difference becomes very tangible.
beginner.whyItMatters: A smaller speed boost that stacks across rushes is a gentler shift than a big stat, but it still lets the killer pull ahead the longer the state holds. It suits a rush build that favors steady, compounding pressure.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you favor a gradual momentum build over a single big swing, wanting each rush to feel a touch faster than the last. The uncommon rarity keeps it easy to find, so it pairs well into any Blighted Corruption setup that values sustained pressure. It suits a style that keeps the state active through long chases rather than burning it in one burst.

Addon_Rush_CankerThorn.name: Canker Thorn
Addon_Rush_CankerThorn.description:
A sizable thorn snipped from a visceral canker. It secretes a mild toxin.

Decreases recovery time after Rushing by 0.5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Thorn, snipped from a visceral canker and dripping a mild toxin, offered into Blighted Corruption. It shortens the recovery time after a rush.
beginner.whyItMatters: A quicker recovery after a rush is a small but handy tweak, since it tightens the gap between one rush and the next. It suits a rush build that values smooth, continuous pressure over raw speed.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when your Blighted Corruption tempo depends on firing rush after rush with minimal dead time between them. The uncommon rarity makes it straightforward to find, so slot it into any setup that values quick recovery between bursts. It suits a fast, aggressive loop where the gap between states is the thing to shave off.

Addon_Rush_ChippedMonocle.name: Chipped Monocle
Addon_Rush_ChippedMonocle.description:
A monocle Talbot rarely used despite his eyesight weakening in later years.

Displays the target location of a Slam.

beginner.whatItIs: Fits into Blighted Corruption and marks the exact landing spot of a Slam. With it equipped, a throw you cannot see is no longer thrown blind.
beginner.whyItMatters: A slam that misses its mark wastes the moment, so a clear landing marker turns each throw into a deliberate strike and keeps your aggression honest. It is a small but useful accuracy shift rather than a whole new way to play.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it whenever you keep misjudging where Slams connect, which happens a lot early on and against survivors who weave around your aim. It is common rarity, so it shows up quickly as the set is worked through.

Addon_Rush_CompoundSeven.name: Compound Seven
Addon_Rush_CompoundSeven.description:
This early sample failed to achieve desired results but demonstrated surprising effects regardless.

Automatically face the nearest Survivor within 16 meters after a Slam.

beginner.whatItIs: Slots into Blighted Corruption and snaps the killer to face the nearest survivor the instant a Slam lands. The facing correction happens on its own the moment the slam connects.
beginner.whyItMatters: A survivor who slips past or repositions is easy to lose track of, and an automatic re-aim means the next chase starts already pointed their way instead of after a wasted turn. It reads as a small quality-of-life change that makes back-to-back pressure feel smoother.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if you frequently lose a survivor to a quick reposition right after a Slam and end up turning around to catch them. Being common rarity, it is an easy early pick for tightening that loop.

Addon_Rush_CompoundThirtyThree.name: Compound Thirty-Three
Addon_Rush_CompoundThirtyThree.description:
Talbot’s penultimate attempt at a serum. Though it did not facilitate his escape, it did have powerful side effects.

Rush cannot be performed more than 5 times.Increases Rush turn rate by 11%.Increases Rush duration by 11%.

beginner.whatItIs: Trades the Rush cap on Blighted Corruption for a quicker turn and a longer dash on every rush it allows. Fewer total dashes are the price, but each one that remains carries more speed and reach.
beginner.whyItMatters: Fewer total dashes is a real cost, but the ones that remain carry more speed and reach, which suits a committed, long-pursuit style over many short bursts. It is a meaningful shift in how the rush feels rather than a trivial tweak.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Choose it when you prefer locking into one sustained chase instead of spamming quick dashes, since the higher per-rush payoff rewards that commitment. Its iridescent rarity makes it a late-game find compared to the common Rush options.

Addon_Rush_CompoundTwentyOne.name: Compound Twenty-One
Addon_Rush_CompoundTwentyOne.description:
A serum that's fatal to humans. It evokes beneficial qualities in those who are... something more.

Reveals the auras of all Survivors within 8 meters for 3 seconds after a Slam.

beginner.whatItIs: Reveals the auras of every nearby survivor for a brief beat after a Slam. It sits on Blighted Corruption and turns the slam into a momentary scouting tool as well.
beginner.whyItMatters: A slam that would otherwise end blind now also shows exactly where the whole team is, which is a clear edge for deciding who to chase next. That reveal makes the power do double duty as both a strike and a scouting tool.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it to find survivors hiding in dense corners of a map right after you commit to a Slam. It is rare, so plan on more trials than the common Rush add-ons to pull it.

Addon_Rush_Foxglove.name: Foxglove
Addon_Rush_Foxglove.description:
A poisonous plant that sparked Talbot’s interest in chemistry. It rekindles deeply buried memories.

Decreases Rush recovery time by 0.25 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Shortens the wait before Rush becomes available again on Blighted Corruption. The recovery window is tighter, so the dash returns to your hand sooner.
beginner.whyItMatters: A shorter cooldown keeps the dash in the kit for longer, so a survivor who just broke the pursuit can be re-engaged rather than watched walking away. It is a small but reliable tempo change.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it whenever Rush keeps sitting on cooldown just as a survivor breaks free and slips away. Its common rarity makes it one of the first Rush options to unlock.

Addon_Rush_IridescentBlightTag.name: Iridescent Blight Tag
Addon_Rush_IridescentBlightTag.description:
A glass-like laboratory tag, molded from The Fog itself. Either a gift from The Entity or a cruel jest to tag The Blight as he once did to others.

Rush cannot be performed more than 3 times.Increases maximum Rush look angle by 20 degrees.Increases Rush speed by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Widens the view cone and speeds up the rush itself on Blighted Corruption. The cost is a tighter cap on how many times the rush can fire in a row.
beginner.whyItMatters: A wider sightline and a faster dash make each individual rush far more threatening, even though fewer of them are available overall. It is a deliberate trade toward quality over quantity.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a single committed rush matters more to your play than being able to dash repeatedly, since the extra speed and vision reward the long dash. Its iridescent rarity means it is a slower unlock.

Addon_Rush_PlaceboTablet.name: Placebo Tablet
Addon_Rush_PlaceboTablet.description:
A pill that’s utterly ineffective... or is it?

Decreases movement speed while Rushing by 15%.Gain 100% bonus Bloodpoints on Rush score events.

beginner.whatItIs: Slows the killer down while Rushing on Blighted Corruption. In return, every score the rush produces pays out a large bonus of Bloodpoints.
beginner.whyItMatters: Losing speed during the dash is a real handicap in a chase, but the extra Bloodpoints stack up quickly and make it a solid economic pick. It reads as a deliberate speed-for-rewards trade rather than a pure buff.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in a trial where you want to build Bloodpoints fast and can afford to be a touch slower, rather than in a match that hinges on raw dash speed. Its common rarity makes it an easy early option.

Addon_Rush_PlagueBile.name: Plague Bile
Addon_Rush_PlagueBile.description:
A sample of The Plague’s bile, distilled and treated with a mixture of chemicals.

Increases turn rate while Rushing by 10%.

beginner.whatItIs: Sharpens the turn rate while Rushing on Blighted Corruption. The dash tracks sharper angles with less overshoot.
beginner.whyItMatters: A quicker turn keeps the dash glued to a weaving survivor, which is the difference between a rush that tracks and one that overshoots. It is a clean, focused handling buff.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when you keep overshooting survivors who cut sharp angles during a rush. Its uncommon rarity places it just above the common Rush options.

Addon_Rush_PustulaDust.name: Pustula Dust
Addon_Rush_PustulaDust.description:
Dried pustula petals ground into a fine dust.

Increases maximum Slam duration by 0.75 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Lengthens the maximum duration of a Slam on Blighted Corruption. The hit window is wider, giving a survivor less room to react.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer slam gives a survivor less room to react and a wider window to land the hit, which makes each slam feel heavier and more punishing. It is a straightforward power boost to one part of the kit.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want every slam to carry more weight and give a fleeing survivor less time to break free. It is uncommon rarity, so it arrives a little later than the common set.

Addon_Rush_RoseTonic.name: Rose Tonic
Addon_Rush_RoseTonic.description:
A mixture made with dried roses from the exceedingly rare New Moon Bouquet.

Increases maximum Slam duration by 1 second.

beginner.whatItIs: Stretches the maximum duration of a Slam even further on Blighted Corruption. It builds on the same extension idea and lands a heavier hit window.
beginner.whyItMatters: It hands you a longer hit window and makes the slam the more reliable part of the kit. Being rarer than the dust option, it is a later unlock and a heavier slam to boot.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Choose it when you want the slam to be your main tool for closing a survivor down. Its rare rarity places it beyond the uncommon dust in the unlock order.

Addon_Rush_ShreddedNotes.name: Shredded Notes
Addon_Rush_ShreddedNotes.description:
The remnants of Talbot’s notes, they still contain some valuable information within.

Decreases time to recharge a Rush token by 0.33 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Speeds up the recharge of a Rush token on Blighted Corruption. A token that comes back sooner puts the dash back in play faster.
beginner.whyItMatters: A token that recovers sooner keeps pressure on a survivor who keeps trying to stall for recovery time. It is a small but dependable tempo buff.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when you want less dead time between rushes and more constant threat on a stalling survivor. It is uncommon rarity, so it is a step above the common options.

Addon_Rush_SoulChemical.name: Soul Chemical
Addon_Rush_SoulChemical.description:
A chemical squeezed from the pineal gland of a recently deceased Survivor.

Increases the initial Rush speed by 5%.

beginner.whatItIs: Boosts the initial burst of speed when a rush first starts on Blighted Corruption. The first moment of the dash hits harder as a result.
beginner.whyItMatters: That extra early speed can put distance on the board before a survivor reacts, which is exactly what you want when a dash is meant to close a gap fast. It is a focused buff to the opening moment of the rush.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a quick, punchy start to the rush is what you rely on to catch survivors off balance. Its very rare rarity makes it a late unlock in the set.

Addon_Rush_SummoningStone.name: Summoning Stone
Addon_Rush_SummoningStone.description:
Talbot used this stone to carve what he believed was his research into the opium den’s walls.

Increases the initial Rush duration by 0.5 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Extends the initial duration of a rush on Blighted Corruption. The opening stretch of the dash carries further before it begins to fade.
beginner.whyItMatters: A longer opening stretch gives a survivor less time to break free at the critical start of the pursuit. It is a clean extension aimed at the first part of the rush.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when you want the rush to carry further before it begins to fade, keeping pressure on a survivor right out of the gate. Its very rare rarity places it near the end of the unlock order.

Addon_Rush_UmbraSalts.name: Umbra Salts
Addon_Rush_UmbraSalts.description:
Regular sea salt that has momentarily passed through the spirit world, altering its properties in the process.

Increases turn rate while Rushing by 15%.

beginner.whatItIs: Slotted into Blighted Corruption, it lets the killer swing direction more crisply mid-Rush. That sharper handling keeps a looping survivor pinned inside the bile trail instead of slipping free.
beginner.whyItMatters: A still-sharper turn makes a weaving survivor far harder to lose during the dash, which is the core of what a rush should do. It is a stronger version of the same handling idea.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Choose it when tracking sharp, looping survivors is the main goal and you want the rush to stick to them tighter. Its rare rarity makes it a later find than the uncommon bile.

Addon_Rush_VigosJournal.name: Vigo's Journal
Addon_Rush_VigosJournal.description:
The journal of a man who claimed to have returned from the Void. The knowledge within has practical applications.

Grants Undetectable while Rushing.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, terror radius and red stain.

beginner.whatItIs: Hides the killer's aura, terror radius and red stain while Rushing. It slots into Blighted Corruption and flips the information advantage during the dash.
beginner.whyItMatters: A survivor who relies on auras and scans to read your position loses that read the moment the dash starts, which flips the information edge during the chase. It is a big shift in how transparent the rush is.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the survivor team leans on auras and scans to track a Rush, since the hidden state strips the red stain and terror radius from their view. The very rare drop rate means it takes a long time to earn, so save it for lobbies where you expect heavy tracker pressure.

Addon_Spark_CalmClassI.name: "Calm" - Class I
Addon_Spark_CalmClassI.description:
An ECT procedure using a deep wavelength that soothes various mental illness. With Carter's Spark as its source, this procedure can cause mild anxiety in the patient.

Increases Terror Radius by 4 meters while Static Blast is ready.Decreases Terror Radius by 4 meters while Static Blast is on cooldown.

Survivors with Madness suffer from the Affliction of Calm:

Madness II: Intermittently causes Survivors to hear a distant illusionary Terror Radius.Madness III: Constantly causes Survivors to hear a distant illusionary Terror Radius.

beginner.whatItIs: Expands the terror radius while Static Blast is ready on Carter's Spark. The radius shrinks again while the blast is on cooldown.
beginner.whyItMatters: A wider radius while the blast is charged gives a survivor less room to approach unseen, then pulls back when the tool is not ready. It also carries a Madness affliction that can feed a survivor a false sense of the radius. Overall it is a modest, situational shift.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when you want a broader scare zone while the blast is charged and are happy to lose that width on cooldown. Its common rarity makes it an early, accessible pick.

Addon_Spark_CalmClassII.name: "Calm" - Class II
Addon_Spark_CalmClassII.description:
A risky ECT procedure using a deep wavelength that soothes various mental illness. With Carter's Spark as its source, this procedure can cause moderate anxiety in the patient.

Increases Terror Radius by 6 meters while Static Blast is ready.Decreases Terror Radius by 6 meters while Static Blast is on cooldown.

Survivors with Madness suffer from the Affliction of Calm:

Madness II: Intermittently causes Survivors to hear a distant illusionary Terror Radius.Madness III: Constantly causes Survivors to hear a distant illusionary Terror Radius.

beginner.whatItIs: Attached to Carter's Spark, it widens the terror radius whenever Static Blast is charged and ready to fire. Once the blast has been used and is recovering, the radius shrinks back down.
beginner.whyItMatters: A wider ready-state radius makes the charged window more intimidating and gives survivors less slack to slip in. It carries the same Madness affliction as the lighter version but pushes it further. It is a stronger step on the same idea.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Choose it when the common radius feels too narrow and you want more pressure during the charged window. Its uncommon rarity places it above the common class.

Addon_Spark_CalmMuYisNotes.name: "Calm" - Carter's Notes
Addon_Spark_CalmMuYisNotes.description:
An experimental version of the ECT procedure annotated by Doctor Herman Carter himself. Uses a deep wavelength that soothes various mental illness. With Carter's Spark as its source, this procedure causes uncontrollable fear and anxiety in the patient.

Increases Terror Radius by 8 meters while Static Blast is ready.Decreases Terror Radius by 8 meters while Static Blast is on cooldown.

Survivors with Madness suffer from the Affliction of Calm:

Madness II: Intermittently causes Survivors to hear a distant illusionary Terror Radius.Madness III: Constantly causes Survivors to hear a distant illusionary Terror Radius.

beginner.whatItIs: Inflates the ready-state terror radius to a wide form on Carter's Spark. The retraction on cooldown is pronounced, so the charged window is the one to plan around.
beginner.whyItMatters: A ready radius of this width makes the charged window a genuine threat to any survivor who lingers nearby. It pairs the same Madness affliction with a heavy effect that clouds a targeted survivor's sense of their own radius. The bigger the width, the harder it is for a team to approach unseen.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a large scare zone while the blast is charged is what you are after, and the shrink on cooldown is acceptable. Its very rare rarity makes it a slow, late unlock.

Addon_Spark_DisciplineClassII.name: "Discipline" - Class II
Addon_Spark_DisciplineClassII.description:
Project Awakening ECT procedure for disciplinary action which uses a fixed dose at high voltage. Can cause a state of moderate paranoia in the patient.

Decreases the detonation delay of Shock Therapy by 0.06 seconds.

Survivors with Madness suffer from the Affliction of Discipline:

Madness II: While in a chase, Survivors perceive an illusionary Red Stain and Terror Radius as though The Doctor were directly behind them. This effect persists for 6 seconds after the chase ends.Madness III: Illusionary Red Stain and Terror Radius are constantly active.The Doctor also sees the illusionary Red Stain.

beginner.whatItIs: Tightens the detonation delay of Shock Therapy on Carter's Spark. The charge goes off sooner once it locks on a survivor.
beginner.whyItMatters: A shorter detonation delay closes the window a survivor has to escape after being marked, turning a tense chase moment into a near-certain hit. The paired Madness affliction adds a second layer of pressure by making a chased survivor sense a fake red stain at their back. Together it reads as a meaningful shift toward a more punishing tempo rather than a minor stat bump.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when you want a marked survivor punished faster once Shock Therapy locks on. Its uncommon rarity places it above the lighter class.

Addon_Spark_DisciplineClassIII.name: "Discipline" - Class III
Addon_Spark_DisciplineClassIII.description:
Project Awakening ECT procedure for disciplinary action which uses a fixed dose at very high voltage. Can cause a state of serious paranoia in the patient.

Decreases the detonation delay of Shock Therapy by 0.08 seconds.

Survivors with Madness suffer from the Affliction of Discipline:

Madness II: While in a chase, Survivors perceive an illusionary Red Stain and Terror Radius as though The Doctor were directly behind them. This effect persists for 6 seconds after the chase ends.Madness III: Illusionary Red Stain and Terror Radius are constantly active.The Doctor also sees the illusionary Red Stain.

beginner.whatItIs: Trims the detonation delay of Shock Therapy further on Carter's Spark. The charge detonates even sooner, leaving less room to break free.
beginner.whyItMatters: A faster detonation narrows the window a survivor has to escape once marked, which makes the therapy tool more reliable as finishing pressure. It carries the same Madness affliction but with a heavier paranoid read on a chased survivor. It lands the mark a beat sooner than the lighter class.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Choose it when a quicker lock-to-detonation is what you are chasing in a Shock Therapy build. Its rare rarity makes it a later unlock than the uncommon class.

Addon_Spark_DisciplineMuYisNotes.name: "Discipline" - Carter's Notes
Addon_Spark_DisciplineMuYisNotes.description:
Project Awakening ECT procedure for disciplinary action, annotated by Doctor Herman Carter himself. The intolerably high voltage leaves the patient in a severe state of paranoia.

Decreases the detonation delay of Shock Therapy by 0.1 seconds.

Survivors with Madness suffer from the Affliction of Discipline:

Madness II: While in a chase, Survivors perceive an illusionary Red Stain and Terror Radius as though The Doctor were directly behind them. This effect persists for 6 seconds after the chase ends.Madness III: Illusionary Red Stain and Terror Radius are constantly active.The Doctor also sees the illusionary Red Stain.

beginner.whatItIs: Annotated notes for Carter's Spark that shorten the delay before Shock Therapy detonates. Survivors already carrying Madness pick up the Affliction of Discipline on top of that. Caught in a chase, they see a Red Stain and hear a Terror Radius that are not really there, as if The Doctor were right behind them.
beginner.whyItMatters: The shortened fuse leaves survivors less time to react after a Shock Therapy lands. The illusionary chase pressure compounds the stress, making it harder for a Mad survivor to read a real pursuit from a fake one.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a build leans on quick follow-up pressure after Shock Therapy. The very rare drop rate means it rewards setups that already commit to a Discipline-focused game plan.

Addon_Spark_HighStimulusElectrode.name: High Stimulus Electrode
Addon_Spark_HighStimulusElectrode.description:
An experimental electrode that can withstand very-high charges for a longer period of time.

Increases the range of Shock Therapy by 4 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: High Stimulus Electrode is a rare upgrade for Carter's Spark that extends the reach of the Shock Therapy cone. The electrode withstands higher charges, pushing the hit zone farther out on the ground.
beginner.whyItMatters: Survivors who would normally step just outside the cone now find themselves caught inside it. That extra margin turns near-misses into hits and shrinks the safe distance a survivor can maintain during a chase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if a killer wants to close the gap between a survivor's perceived safety and the actual hit zone. It helps most in tight corridors or generator pockets where the extra reach changes the outcome of a swing.

Addon_Spark_IridescentGeneral.name: Iridescent King
Addon_Spark_IridescentGeneral.description:
A glass-like king chess piece molded from The Fog Itself. The Entity's trace reverberating within can break the most powerful minds.

Survivors with Madness status effect suffer from the following Afflictions: Calm, Discipline, Order, and Restraint.Causes Survivors to hear a distant illusionary Terror Radius. The effect is intermittent in Madness II and constant in Madness III.While in a chase, Survivors perceive an illusionary Red Stain and Terror Radius as though The Doctor were directly behind them. This effect persists for 6 seconds after the chase ends in Madness II and is constantly active in Madness III.Broken pallets may appear to be replaced with illusionary pallets that persist until approached. A new illusionary pallets is generated at the location of a random broken pallet every 20 seconds.Increases the duration of illusionary Doctor hallucinations by 6 seconds.The Doctor sees illusionary Red Stains as well as the auras of illusionary Doctors and illusionary pallets.

beginner.whatItIs: Molded from The Fog itself, an iridescent chess piece for Carter's Spark that stacks multiple Afflictions on Mad survivors. It layers the effects of Calm, Discipline, Order, and Restraint, and causes survivors to hear a distant illusionary Terror Radius.
beginner.whyItMatters: The layered hallucinations compound each other, so a Mad survivor who is already disoriented now faces phantom threats from several directions at once. That breaks their ability to read a chase reliably and punishes hesitation.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a build is already stacking Madness and the goal is to make every chase feel chaotic and unreadable. The iridescent rarity means it appears far less often than most other add-ons for Carter's Spark.

Addon_Spark_JadeCharm.name: Iridescent Queen
Addon_Spark_JadeCharm.description:
A glass-like queen chess piece molded from The Fog itself. It can't be touched without receiving a considerable jolt of electricity.

All Survivors struck by Shock Therapy or Static Blast acquire a lingering Static Charge. The Static Charge remains with The Survivor(s) until discharged.Multiple Survivors struck by the same Shock Therapy or Static Blast that are within 4 meters of each other do not acquire a Static Charge.Any time a Survivor is within 4 meters of another Survivor carrying a Static Charge, the Survivor receives a shock identical to Shock Therapy and the Static Charge is discharged immediately.

beginner.whatItIs: A glass-like queen chess piece for Carter's Spark that makes survivors struck by Shock Therapy or Static Blast carry a lingering Static Charge. The charge persists on the survivor until it is discharged, adding a persistent marker after each hit.
beginner.whyItMatters: A single well-placed hit now creates a lasting hazard that follows the survivor across the map rather than ending when the initial shock fades. Survivors who are hit in groups close together do not acquire the charge, which rewards precise, isolated strikes over blanket damage.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a killer wants to make every Shock Therapy or Static Blast hit carry a lingering consequence rather than a one-shot burst. The iridescent rarity means it is a long-term commitment for a build that already prioritizes area control.

Addon_Spark_MoldyElectrode.name: Moldy Electrode
Addon_Spark_MoldyElectrode.description:
A moldy electrode which nevertheless conducts a weak electrical current.

Increases the range of Shock Therapy by 2 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: The most basic electrode for Carter's Spark, it nudges the cone's reach outward by a small margin. It is the cheapest way to widen the hit zone without changing the power's shape.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra reach matters most in tight corridors where a survivor's sprint would carry them just past the cone's edge before the shock lands. Turning a near-miss into a clean hit is where this small extension earns its place in a close-range setup.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a killer wants a cheap, easy way to tighten the hit window around generators and narrow alleys. Its common rarity makes it one of the most accessible upgrades available for Carter's Spark.

Addon_Spark_NanmuCatapult.name: Maple Knight
Addon_Spark_NanmuCatapult.description:
A white knight chess piece made of maple. This gift from an old man brings back distant memories and imbues The Doctor with devastating focus.

Reveals the area of effect of Shock Therapy.

beginner.whatItIs: Maple Knight is a common chess piece for Carter's Spark that reveals the full footprint of Shock Therapy on the ground before it fires. Seeing the cone's shape in advance makes it easier to line up a shot on a moving target.
beginner.whyItMatters: Knowing exactly where the cone will land removes guesswork from the aiming process. A survivor who can no longer hide behind the edge of an invisible zone is easier to hit consistently.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when learning The Doctor's Shock Therapy timing or when a build relies on precise placement over raw range. The common rarity makes it a low-risk experiment for a Carter's Spark setup.

Addon_Spark_Obedience_MuYisNotes.name: Scrapped Tape
Addon_Spark_Obedience_MuYisNotes.description:
A compact cassette from Project Awakening containing mostly white noise. Opens The Doctor's mind to alternate treatment methods.

Changes the shape of Shock Therapy to a ring with a range of 8 meters, a radius of 4 meters, and a thickness of 1 meter.

beginner.whatItIs: It reshapes Shock Therapy from a cone into a ring for Carter's Spark, widening the overall footprint while thinning the band. Survivors now have to worry about a circular zone rather than a directional one.
beginner.whyItMatters: The ring shape changes the geometry of the threat entirely, since a survivor can no longer simply sprint away from the direction of the cone. The thinner band rewards placing the ring where a survivor is likely to run, not where they currently stand.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a build wants to punish predictable chase paths rather than rely on directional aiming. The rare drop rate means it suits setups that already commit to a ring-shaped game plan.

Addon_Spark_OrderClassI.name: "Order" - Class I
Addon_Spark_OrderClassI.description:
A conventional ECT procedure, part of a patient's daily routine at the Léry's Memorial Institute. Can cause a state of mild confusion in the patient.

Decreases Static Blast cooldown by 2 seconds.

Survivors with Madness suffer from the Affliction of Order:

Broken pallets may appear to be replaced with illusionary pallets that persist until approached.A new illusionary pallet is generated at the location of a random broken pallet every 20 seconds.The Doctor sees the auras of illusionary pallets.

beginner.whatItIs: The common Order procedure for Carter's Spark trims the Static Blast cooldown and inflicts the Affliction of Order on Mad survivors. Broken pallets may be replaced with illusionary ones that persist until approached, and The Doctor can see their auras.
beginner.whyItMatters: The faster Static Blast keeps pressure on survivors between chases, while the illusionary pallets waste time and create false confidence in a survivor's escape route. Together they turn the map's usual safe spots into unreliable ground.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a build wants to stretch Static Blast uptime and punish survivors who rely on pallet loops. The common rarity makes it an easy starting point for an Order-focused setup.

Addon_Spark_OrderClassII.name: "Order" - Class II
Addon_Spark_OrderClassII.description:
A high stimulus ECT procedure, part of a patient daily routine at the Léry's Memorial Institute. Can cause a state of moderate confusion in the patient.

Decreases Static Blast cooldown by 2.5 seconds.

Survivors with Madness suffer from the Affliction of Order:

Broken pallets may appear to be replaced with illusionary pallets that persist until approached.A new illusionary pallet is generated at the location of a random broken pallet every 20 seconds.The Doctor sees the auras of illusionary pallets.

beginner.whatItIs: An uncommon ECT procedure for Carter's Spark that shortens the Static Blast cooldown further than the Class I version. It inflicts the same illusionary pallet affliction on Mad survivors, who see broken pallets replaced by convincing fakes.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra cooldown reduction means Static Blast is ready more often, which keeps the pressure cycle tighter between chases. The illusionary pallets remain the core disruption, wasting a survivor's time and breaking their escape rhythm.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a build already uses the Class I procedure and wants a modest bump in Static Blast uptime without changing the affliction. The uncommon rarity makes it a natural step up for a committed Order setup.

Addon_Spark_OrderMuYisNotes.name: "Order" - Carter's Notes
Addon_Spark_OrderMuYisNotes.description:
An experimental version of the ECT procedure, annotated by Doctor Herman Carter himself. The long, constant stimulus leaves the patient in a state of severe confusion.

Decreases Static Blast cooldown by 3 seconds.

Survivors with Madness suffer from the Affliction of Order:

Broken pallets may appear to be replaced with illusionary pallets that persist until approached.A new illusionary pallet is generated at the location of a random broken pallet every 20 seconds.The Doctor sees the auras of illusionary pallets.

beginner.whatItIs: The very rare Order procedure for Carter's Spark delivers the longest Static Blast cooldown reduction in the line and pushes Mad survivors into severe confusion. The illusionary pallets work the same way as in the lower tiers, but the overall disorientation is stronger.
beginner.whyItMatters: The combination of faster Static Blast and deeper confusion makes the Order affliction the most punishing in its family. A survivor who is already losing track of real versus fake pallets now has less time to recover between pressure waves.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a build is fully committed to the Order line and wants the maximum disruption from both the cooldown and the hallucination. The very rare drop rate means it is a reward for long-term dedication to a specific game plan.

Addon_Spark_PolishedElectrode.name: Polished Electrode
Addon_Spark_PolishedElectrode.description:
A like-new electrode, standard equipment to conduct electroconvulsive treatments.

Increases the range of Shock Therapy by 3 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: An uncommon electrode for Carter's Spark that pushes the Shock Therapy cone further out than the moldy version does. The extra reach catches a runner who would have slipped past the arc under the basic electrode.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra reach covers more ground without the commitment of the rare option, making it a sensible middle ground for a build that wants more range at a lower rarity cost. It helps most in mid-range engagements where the default cone falls just short.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a killer wants a noticeable range bump without saving up for the rare electrode. The uncommon rarity keeps it accessible while still feeling like a real improvement over the common option.

Addon_Spark_RestraintClassII.name: "Restraint" - Class II
Addon_Spark_RestraintClassII.description:
An experimental ECT procedure developed within The Fog. Uses a wavelength that links the patient's and Doctor's minds. This procedure is known to cause mild cases of hallucinations in the patient.

Reveals Survivors' auras for 1 second when their Madness level increases.

Survivors with Madness suffer from the Affliction of Restraint:

Increases the duration of illusionary Doctor hallucinations by 6 seconds.Allows The Doctor to see the auras of hallucinations at any level of Madness.

beginner.whatItIs: A wavelength-based ECT procedure for Carter's Spark that briefly reveals survivor auras when their Madness level rises. It also lengthens the illusionary Doctor hallucinations that Mad survivors experience and lets The Doctor see their auras.
beginner.whyItMatters: The brief aura flash gives a killer a moment of information at exactly the moment a survivor's state is changing, which is useful for deciding whether to chase or hold. The extended hallucinations make the false Doctor harder to distinguish from the real one for longer.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a build wants to track Madness progression and use that knowledge to time pressure. The uncommon rarity makes it a reasonable first Restraint add-on for a setup that already generates Madness reliably.

Addon_Spark_RestraintClassIII.name: "Restraint" - Class III
Addon_Spark_RestraintClassIII.description:
An experimental ECT procedure developed within The Fog. Uses a high stimulus wavelength to link the patient's and Doctor's minds. This procedure is known to cause serious cases of hallucinations in the patient.

Reveals Survivors' auras for 2 seconds when their Madness level increases.

Survivors with Madness suffer from the Affliction of Restraint:

Increases the duration of illusionary Doctor hallucinations by 6 seconds.Allows The Doctor to see the auras of hallucinations at any level of Madness.

beginner.whatItIs: Restraint Class III is a rare ECT procedure for Carter's Spark that reveals survivor auras for a longer window when Madness increases. The hallucination affliction works the same as the Class II version but the aura reveal lasts noticeably longer.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extended window gives a killer more time to react to a Madness increase, whether that means adjusting chase direction or committing to a different survivor. The longer hallucinations also keep Mad survivors off-balance for a more meaningful stretch of time.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it on a Restraint build where reading a survivor's position after each Madness tick needs to last long enough to act on. The extended hallucination window pairs with that longer reveal to reward sustained mental pressure over a single quick read.

Addon_Spark_RestraintMuYisNotes.name: "Restraint" - Carter's Notes
Addon_Spark_RestraintMuYisNotes.description:
An experimental ECT procedure developed within The Fog, crudely annotated. Uses an unbearable stimulus wavelength to link the patient's and Doctor's minds. This procedure is known to cause severe cases of hallucinations in the patient.

Reveals Survivors' auras for 3 seconds when their Madness level increases.

Survivors with Madness suffer from the Affliction of Restraint:

Increases the duration of illusionary Doctor hallucinations by 6 seconds.Allows The Doctor to see the auras of hallucinations at any level of Madness.

beginner.whatItIs: A crudely annotated ECT procedure for Carter's Spark that flashes a survivor's aura for a wider window than the shorter reveal whenever Madness climbs. The hallucination affliction it applies is the same as the other Restraint entries.
beginner.whyItMatters: The long aura reveal turns every Madness increase into a clear informational moment, giving a killer a solid window to reassess which survivor to pressure next. The sustained hallucinations compound that advantage by keeping Mad survivors disoriented for longer.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Slip it into a build that has already locked in the Restraint approach and needs each Madness tick to produce a readable, sustained aura flash rather than a brief flicker. The very rare drop means it shows up often enough to plan around once the commitment is made.

Addon_Spark_TigerFangCharm.name: Interview Tape
Addon_Spark_TigerFangCharm.description:
A compact cassette from Project Awakening containing an un-edited interview of a victim. Opens The Doctor's mind to alternate treatment methods.

Shock Therapy special ability changes from a cone to a beam with a 24 meter range and a 2 meter width.

beginner.whatItIs: Interview Tape is a rare cassette for Carter's Spark that changes Shock Therapy from a cone into a narrow beam with extended reach. The beam trades width for distance, turning the power into a long-range precision tool.
beginner.whyItMatters: The beam shape completely changes how The Doctor approaches a chase, since there is no wider zone to compensate for a slightly off aim. A survivor who can read the beam's direction has a clear escape path, but one who cannot is in serious trouble from a much greater distance.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Reach for it when the Doctor already controls a long straight corridor and wants to lock a runner down from across the room instead of waiting for them to drift into a cone. The rare drop rate means it is a deliberate pick, not something you stumble into by accident.

Addon_Stalker_BlondHair.name: Blonde Hair
Addon_Stalker_BlondHair.description:
A single slightly wavy blond hair.

Scratch marks and pools of blood last 100% longer in Stalker Mode.

beginner.whatItIs: Blonde Hair is a common add-on for Evil Within that stretches how long scratch marks and pools of blood persist while the killer roams in Stalker Mode. It lays a longer-lasting breadcrumb line behind every step, making the disguised threat easier to follow for anyone hunting it.
beginner.whyItMatters: Longer-lasting visual cues give survivors more time to read where the killer has been and where they are heading. For a killer, the trail is harder to hide, but the Stalker Mode pressure remains the same.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it if a killer is comfortable being tracked and wants the psychological pressure of a visible trail to wear down survivors over time. The common rarity makes it an easy pick for an Evil Within setup.

Addon_Stalker_BoyfriendsMemo.name: Boyfriend's Memo
Addon_Stalker_BoyfriendsMemo.description:
A "romantic", if slightly sleazy, note left around to draw the attention of a female lover.

Increases Stalk range by 8 meters.

beginner.whatItIs: Boyfriend's Memo is a common note for Evil Within that increases the range of Stalk, making it easier to lock onto survivors from farther away. The romantic note broadens the window in which a survivor enters Stalker Mode.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra Stalk range means survivors have less safe distance to work with before the killer's attention locks in. That shrinks the space where a survivor can reposition or hide without triggering the Stalker Mode pressure.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Slot it in when a Stalk build needs to catch runners who camp just outside the default detection arc. The common drop rate means it is easy to acquire, so there is little reason to skip it if the Stalk range feels too tight for the map.

Addon_Stalker_DeadRabbit.name: Dead Rabbit
Addon_Stalker_DeadRabbit.description:
A grey rabbit which has been opened from neck to tail.

Decreases Terror Radius in Pursuer Mode by 25%.Increases Terror Radius in Evil Incarnate mode by 25%.

beginner.whatItIs: Dead Rabbit is an uncommon add-on for Evil Within that shrinks the Terror Radius in Pursuer Mode while expanding it in Evil Incarnate mode. The grey rabbit trades early-game awareness for a wider late-game pressure zone.
beginner.whyItMatters: The smaller Pursuer Mode radius gives survivors a slightly larger pocket of safety during the mid-game, but the expanded Evil Incarnate radius punishes them harder once the killer shifts modes. It is a bold choice that rewards a killer who can commit to the late-game advantage.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a build already excels in Evil Incarnate mode and wants to maximize the pressure zone at that stage. The uncommon rarity keeps it accessible for a setup that has already proven the late-game approach.

Addon_Stalker_FragrantTuftOfHair.name: Fragrant Tuft of Hair
Addon_Stalker_FragrantTuftOfHair.description:
A tuft of blond hair which was forcefully torn off someone's scalp. Releases hints of feminine floral fragrance.

In Evil Incarnate Mode:

Survivors are Exposed.Lunge range is increased by 50%.Slaughtering Strike cannot be used.
