beginner.whatItIs: Assigns a random bonus every eighth consecutive Blade Hit for Showstopper. The bonus can be extra throw speed, a short haste window, or an additional Style Point.
beginner.whyItMatters: A rolling bonus adds a layer of unpredictability that can snowball a chase if the right bonus lands at the right moment. It is a smaller shift than a flat stat boost, but the variance can swing a close kill.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a build already chains Blade hits frequently and can benefit from the occasional extra effect. At uncommon rarity it is a reasonable drop to pick up, though the random bonus means it is less reliable than a fixed-effect add-on.

Addon_Trickster_08.name: Caged Heart Shoes
Addon_Trickster_08.description:
Shoes that Ji-woon wore during the music video for One Caged Heart. Allows for smooth, graceful movements of the point dance.

When you basic-break Pallets and Breakable Walls or damage Generators, the next time you enter the Throw State, increase movement speed while in the Throw State by 5% for 10 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Boosts Throw State movement speed for Showstopper after breaking pallets, breakable walls, or damaging generators. The bonus applies to the next Throw State after those actions.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster movement in the Throw State is a tactical shift that lets the killer close distance on a survivor while aiming, which matters most in a chase where the target is trying to break off. It rewards the killer for mixing environmental destruction with Blade pressure.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a chase loop already involves breaking pallets and walls, so the follow-up Throw State feels snappier. It rolls at uncommon rarity, making it a frequent enough find to build a movement-heavy Showstopper kit around.

Addon_Trickster_09.name: Tequila Moonrock
Addon_Trickster_09.description:
A drink invented in a modest Changwon bar. Became a favorite of Ji-woon's.

Increases Throw Speed by 8% for 10 seconds after gaining a Style Rank.

beginner.whatItIs: Adds a throw-speed spike for Showstopper that fires after any Style Rank gain. The bonus lasts for a short window, giving faster throws during that period.
beginner.whyItMatters: A temporary speed boost after ranking up is a small but useful tweak that keeps momentum alive between rank transitions. It makes the killer feel quicker in the moments right after a rank pops.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a build triggers Style Ranks frequently and wants to capitalize on each gain with faster throws. At uncommon rarity it is a reliable drop that fits any Trickster kit.

Addon_Trickster_10.name: Bloody Boa
Addon_Trickster_10.description:
A boa that Ji-woon draped around a victim’s slashed neck. A number of pockets are concealed within it.

Decreases the speed at which Laceration decays by 75%.

beginner.whatItIs: Slows Laceration decay for Showstopper so the bleed effect persists on a survivor for much longer. The longer a survivor carries Laceration, the more pressure they face.
beginner.whyItMatters: A slower Laceration fade is a bigger shift in how the bleed pressure works, because it extends the window where a survivor is in danger from a fully stacked meter. It keeps the threat alive even when the killer is not actively throwing.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when building around Laceration as the primary kill condition, since the extended decay window gives more time to close out a kill. At uncommon rarity it is a good drop to grab for a Laceration-focused kit.

Addon_Trickster_11.name: Fizz-Spin Soda
Addon_Trickster_11.description:
A limited edition can of soda promoting NO SPIN. High sugar and caffeine content.

Decreases the number of Blade Throws required to increase Throw Speed by 2.

beginner.whatItIs: Trims the number of Blade throws required to build up Throw Speed for Showstopper. Fewer throws to the same speed means the killer ramps up faster.
beginner.whyItMatters: Reducing the throw count is a small but meaningful tweak in the early part of a chase, since the killer reaches peak throw speed sooner. It shortens the window where a survivor can outrun the initial Blade pressure.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Grab it when throw speed anchors the chase plan and ramping up quickly is what wins the chase. Rolling at rare rarity means it shows up less often, so lock it in whenever a Showstopper kit calls for faster Throw Speed gains.

Addon_Trickster_12.name: Waiting for You Watch
Addon_Trickster_12.description:
A pocket watch worn by Ji-woon during a live performance of I’ll Be Waiting for You. It’s a stage prop that doesn’t work and never will.

Survivors whose Laceration Meter fully decays are revealed for 10 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Reveals survivors for a short window the moment their Laceration Meter fully decays for Showstopper. It briefly exposes a survivor who just escaped the bleed pressure.
beginner.whyItMatters: A temporary reveal after Laceration fades is a targeted tactical shift, because it catches survivors at the exact moment they feel safe. It punishes the brief window of relief and can set up the next hit.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a Laceration kill chain is the plan and the goal is to punish survivors who assume they are safe once the meter empties. It rolls at rare rarity, so pick it up whenever it appears in a Showstopper kit built around bleeding.

Addon_Trickster_13.name: Ripper Brace
Addon_Trickster_13.description:
A wrist brace worn by Ji-woon during the filming of his music video Ripper. Though unintentional, the design stabilizes the wrist better than many medical braces.

For each Style Rank, you basic-vault Windows, basic-break Pallets or Breakable Walls, and damage Generators 6% faster.

beginner.whatItIs: Speeds up basic-vaults, pallet breaks, breakable wall breaks, and generator damage for Showstopper, scaling with the current Style Rank. Higher ranks mean faster environmental interactions.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster environmental interactions at higher ranks is a meaningful shift in pacing, since the killer moves through the map and sets up threats more quickly. It rewards the killer for maintaining Style Ranks through active play.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a build already prioritizes Style Ranks and wants the environmental bonus to keep pace. At rare rarity it is a solid drop for a rank-focused Trickster kit.

Addon_Trickster_14.name: Melodious Murder
Addon_Trickster_14.description:
An audio file of victims’ crisp, clear shrieks. Ji-woon incorporated the sounds into one of his more popular tracks.

Increases Blade reload speed at lockers by 25%.

beginner.whatItIs: Increases the reload speed of Blades picked up from lockers for Showstopper. The killer recovers ammunition faster during brief locker stops.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster locker reloads are a small but practical tweak that shortens the downtime between pressure phases. It keeps the Blade supply chain tighter, which matters in long matches with multiple chases.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Lock it in when Blades drain fast and waiting at lockers eats into the chase. It appears at rare rarity, so it is a good pick for any Showstopper build that goes through Blades quickly.

Addon_Trickster_15.name: Diamond Cufflinks
Addon_Trickster_15.description:
Cufflinks gouged into the eyes of a sasaeng fan who made the mistake of stalking Ji-woon. Rubbing off the blood, there’s so much to be seen in the glitter.

Reveals Survivor auras for 6 seconds when their Laceration reaches one Blade hit from maximum.

beginner.whatItIs: Exposes survivor auras for a short window when their Laceration is one Blade hit from maximum for Showstopper. It gives the killer a brief look at where a target is about to bleed out.
beginner.whyItMatters: A reveal near the Laceration cap is a targeted tactical shift that helps close out kills when a survivor is hiding. It removes the guesswork from the final hit and can turn a stalled chase into a down.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when the kill chain runs on Laceration and a clear fix on the survivor's position matters near full bleed. It appears at very rare rarity, so it is a drop worth holding for a Laceration-focused Showstopper build.

Addon_Trickster_16.name: Edge of Revival Album
Addon_Trickster_16.description:
The Trickster’s debut album. The coarse and vicious tone was met with a mixed reaction from fans despite critical acclaim.

Blade Hits from more than 20 meters away deal 100% more Laceration.

beginner.whatItIs: Doubles the Laceration dealt by Blade hits from long range for Showstopper. Throws from a distance become significantly more punishing on the bleed meter.
beginner.whyItMatters: Amplified long-range Laceration is a bigger shift in how the killer approaches chases from a distance, since a single well-placed throw can push a survivor much closer to bleeding out. It rewards the killer for choosing range over close-quarters pressure.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a build favors throwing from range rather than closing in, since the extra Laceration on those long hits accelerates the kill. At very rare rarity it is a premium drop for a ranged Trickster kit.

Addon_Trickster_17.name: Trick Blades
Addon_Trickster_17.description:
Specialty blades that are only seen as faulty by those who lack imagination. A young Ji-woon dazzled spectators with the tricks he performed.

Blades can ricochet off of the environment once.On every eighth Blade Hit after a ricochet, an additional bonus is assigned at random:Increases Laceration by 100%.Reveal Survivor auras within 12 meters for 4.4 seconds.Gain an additional Style Point.

beginner.whatItIs: Lets Blades ricochet off the environment once before they land for Showstopper. After a ricochet, every eighth hit assigns a random bonus like extra Laceration, a short aura reveal, or an additional Style Point.
beginner.whyItMatters: A ricochet adds a new layer of unpredictability to every throw, since a Blade can now hit a survivor from an unexpected angle. Combined with the rolling bonus, it makes Blade pressure feel less predictable and harder to dodge.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a high-volume Blade kit already lands plenty of hits and the ricochet bonus stacks naturally on top. It rolls at very rare rarity, so lock it in whenever it surfaces in a Showstopper kit that prioritizes consistent Blade contact.

Addon_Trickster_18.name: Cut Thru U Single
Addon_Trickster_18.description:
The first single released by NO SPIN after Ji-woon joined their ranks. Scored an all-kill on the Korean charts.

When reaching A-Rank, Survivors within 32 meters are revealed with Killer Instinct for 4.4 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: A very rare add-on that slots into the Trickster's Showstopper power. It adds a new effect: the moment the Trickster hits A-Rank, every survivor within a tight radius is revealed for a short burst.
beginner.whyItMatters: Landing A-Rank already signals a strong chase, and the aura reveal on top of that gives the Trickster a brief window to track down survivors who would otherwise scatter into the fog. It reads as a meaningful bump on top of the power's existing flow rather than a full rewrite of how Showstopper plays.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in lobbies where extra pressure at the A-Rank moment matters, since the reveal lands hardest when survivors are still clustered together in the late-chase phase. It is very rare, so only bring it when you are already comfortable chaining Showstopper all the way to A-Rank without stalling.

Addon_Trickster_19.name: Death Throes Compilation
Addon_Trickster_19.description:
A collection of the final sounds from Ji-woon's victims, adapted to a vinyl record. Terrifying and emotionally raw.

Refills Blades by 75% of the maximum when Main Event ends.

beginner.whatItIs: An iridescent add-on attached to Showstopper. When Main Event ends, it restores a large share of the Blade charge in one burst, so the Trickster does not start the next round from scratch.
beginner.whyItMatters: Main Event is the payoff phase of Showstopper, and having most of the Blade charge restored the moment it ends means the Trickster can immediately re-engage with full pressure rather than falling back into a slower build-up. It shifts the power's rhythm noticeably, since the gap between Main Event rounds becomes much shorter and less punishing.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when you want to keep the chase loop tight across multiple Main Event cycles, since the refill removes the downtime that would otherwise let survivors patch generators in peace. It is iridescent, and pairs well with a build that already pushes toward A-Rank quickly.

Addon_Trickster_20.name: Iridescent Photocard
Addon_Trickster_20.description:
A glass-like photo molded from The Fog itself. Ji-woon's eyes shimmer holographically on his grinning face.

Increases the duration of Main Event by 100%.When Main Event is activated: reveal your aura to all Survivors, all Survivors’ auras are revealed, and block all Generators for 6 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: An iridescent attachment for Showstopper that stretches how long Main Event persists. The instant the phase begins, both the Trickster's and every survivor's aura become visible, and all generators are sealed off for a short window.
beginner.whyItMatters: Doubling Main Event's duration stretches the killer's advantage window, but the cost is real: the Trickster's own aura is visible to every survivor the entire time, and generators freeze for a short burst, giving the other side a breather once the block lifts. It is a bigger shift than a small tweak, since it changes both the reward and the risk of the payoff phase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it in lobbies where survivors are spread out and a long Main Event can force multiple downs, since the doubled duration is most punishing when survivors cannot easily regroup. It is iridescent, and the aura-reveal risk means it suits a killer build that already has tools for catching survivors who scatter.
